tei:div.tei:p: 6 tā ri tre tā ri ( gyi tshoṣi rka lha rsā thi snye sdu lke ji / ji / jio tsho — snga 2 rja snephu sdu/ ji ma ne bra trīsto dzo nga tsho rte 7 bye ske 4 — / ju rte da//’/— ’ — / chopa5 rdzo da rīmi tshosna balha dzha 7snyi— ( — ṭwāṃ ༈ 4 sa/ spya ri 4 ṇajici nga— ‘ 1za ne/ ga ge rtsilacu / rikṣi3 tt+waṃ1 ri ṭwāṃ ji tsā di ḍa rsā stehūṃ/ — ji chi ji tsho dzo snye1 ring rwa3teci dzharica ci sto7 9 rdza dhi/ri7sna sna jis rṣa jujibyu rtswa// ri rīririri sna ne risgru ri 3 cho — spro rdo / ri ‘ sna dā — ( sto ’/ ‘ rtetshe ci kṣ-i rsha tsho 4 zlosdo tsho’ rsāni —— 〈 7— khya〉dze 7 4 'i ཿ4 rītswa dngha snye / jiste / mtsho sngon mirigasadapeskrunakhang /

tsha rtsal klo rīb —snye — 4 ‘ / — ca 35 miṣpe rngosnas ci —treḍi tsho 4 〉 cho ci sna rsha tsho rdo paṃ gyu tsho ji rī ༷ blo0rke zhe dzi kṣ-isnye rī 6 rtso — dze sto ske rme ‘ chi rngoritsu rdoci ji / zhejirmā rto ri— 3 tsā — byu —sngu tsho 2༄ rṣa ni ṣetshorjo ci byu 5 tsho cirnyici— lhatstshasnyegi ndha rmi ci rterngu chi cicirdorjo——ricihūṃtrerdu~Xdngha rī ci ci jurihūṃ ci༄ — riri snyeci dzee ji byocatstshaXcisno rkeortse ji tswa ༵ci rshacici glege mee sgyuni mi 0 1 sna — ske —4
pegi/ khritsho2herma wo'i tsham rtsal tshag ngeb/jang〉 / ngas/ / /zalhodzo rsā rikalagartsalacus/mtsho sngonabyerigasadaṣpeskrunakhab/

— —ri wa swā — spyo rkyurdzo 3 dzwa dzā5 sakhripyu dro chori sni mtsho sngon zhing chan gyi hru'u ci chang we lags rma lho khul u'i hru'u ci lis zhon hrin dang khul mi dmangs srid gzhung gi khul dpon rdo rje tshe ring sogs dang lhan du rma lho sog po rdzong dang rtse khog rdzong gi spyi tshogs ring lugs zhing sde gsar pa dang 'brog sde gsar pa'i ma dpe sde ba dang tshan rtsal ma dpe sde bar gzigs zhib gnang bzhin pa/

rtso tsho rme rtso dziphrotsho rme—rdzoṅka ji rdzi hūṃṭwāṃ ji skre hosna jiriribyuo— mtsho sngon 'ing chan mi dmangs srid gzhung gi hrin krang sung zhi'u yan gyis rma lho khul u'i hya'u ci lis zhon hrin sogs dang lhan du reb gong sgyu rtsal gsar gtod grub 'bras sde gzigs zhib gnang ba/ sto ༵ spya — ri ru snye pe — rwa )rma lho khul u'i hru'u ci lis zhon hrin gyis hrin krang sung zhi'u yan la rma lho'i tshan rtsal 'phel rgyas gnas tshul yar zhu byed bzhin pa/

3tsā 4 cho rsha shāgyi 3 lho — shāX — mi —ri— ༈ rā —4 micisnye dze — sne lce〉3nee— nyaltaspre—༷— ri chi snarī byārī rsha —chotre4 rnya ji midzo gyimi ci rte—jitsādzwajiram̐rtse ci ṇḍaṃ cho lha ci snesni rma lho khu~X u'i hru'u ci lis zhon hrin rgyas khul tshan rtsal chogs chen steng gsung bshad gal chan gnang bzhin pa/skochone sbyi dzha— ——— dzo dzha sme ji rirma lho khul gyi khusde dpon rdo rje tsha rirngo gis khul ༵dzo rtsal tshogs chen steng gsung bshad gal chen grenang bzhin pa/
ri/kyumi ཿsdo sgokyo (rteXspre'isnye—sde sdu rdze — smo / —warngetā ṇḍaṃ /rdo~X ༵tregle

dkar chags bcad dang po/ tshan rtsal gleng stegs/gcig malhokhulatshan rtsalatshogs stedzwagi gtamabashad/ khul yu'i hru'u ci lis zhon hrin/(3)gnyis/ zalhokhulatshan rtsalachogs steng gispyi bsdomasagatamabashad/khulayi dmangs srid gzhung gikhul dpon rdorje che ring /(29)gsum/ gsar gtod gnad donadang de'i gzhi rtsa'i go don skor/ mcho sngon zhing chen rtsal thin gyi thinakrang gzhon paka'opon lin/(42)bzhi/ rtsaladang gsar gtod skor phranatsamagleng ba/ gcan rong bstan 'dzin/(56)sa bcad gnyis pa/ rgyun bkol lag rtsal/gcig zhing phyugasalag rtsal/ (75)gnyis/ tshan rig dang mthun pa'i 'phrod bsten bde thadzeeshesabya/ (101)gsum/ nyi nusadrod khang du lug gsoba'i lag rtsal/ (147)1

bzhi tshanarigadabamathunapa'i'atshoba'iskoragyishesabya ( )159lnga/ 'go nad kyi 'gogabacos/ (194)sa bcad gsum pa/ tshan rtsal bca' khrims/gcig krudzeehāmidamangasaspyomathunargyalakhagekyi tshanarigalagartsalayar thonaskor gyi bca' khrimag (231)gnyis/ krung twamidamangasaspyimathunargyalakhagekyi zhingalasalagartsalakhyabagadaladu gtodzwaba'i bca'akhrims/ (251)gsum/ krubatwamidamangasaspyomathunargyalakhagrekyi lagartsalaganargya'i bca' khrims/ snye (265)2 —

gcig rma ltokhul tshan rtsal tshogasachen steng gi gtam bshad/khul yu'i hru'u ci lis zhon hrin/(2006lo'i zla10pa'i tshes27nyin)blo mthun rnam pa/thengs 'di'i khul tshan col tshogs chen gyi 'gan khur gtso bo ni rgyal yongs dang zhing chen gyi tshan rtsal tshogs chen gyi dgongs don lag len mthil phyin byas nas/ ‘‘lnga dgu'imi tshun gyi rang khul gyi tshan rtsal 'phel rgyas kyi grub 'bras phyir dran phyogs bsdoms byed pa dang / deng phyin gyi tshan rtsal yar thon dang tshan tsal gsar gtod bya bar zhib 'jug dang bkod sgrig byas te rma lho gsar pa 'dzugs skrun la yar skul gtong rgyu de yin/ gong nas‘‘lnga dgumi’tshun nas rang khul gyi tshan rtsal yar thon thad byas rjes khyad du 'phagase pa bzhag pa'i tshan rtsal pa dang tshan rtsal 'bras bu la bstod bsngags dang bya dga' byin pa red/ 'di nas ngas khul u dang khulasrid gzhung gi tshab byas nas bya dga' thob pa'i las khungs dang las rigs so so'i steng gi tshan rtsal pa rnams la lhag bsam 'khol ba'i ngang nas rten 'brel zhus pa yin/3

gcig ‘‘lnga dgu ’tshun gyi tshan rtsal bya ba'i phyir dran/‘‘lnga dgu'i’’tshun du/ khul u dang khul srid gzhung gis‘‘tshan slob khul dar’’gyi 'thab jus rgyun 'khyongs byas te tshan col yar thon de dpal 'byor spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas la skul 'ded gtong ba'i sgul shugs nus ldan zhig tu brtsis nas/ nan tan gyis tshan rtsal yar thon gyi bya ba dngos 'bebs dang / hur thag gis tshan rtsal las gzhi co 'dzugs lag bstar/tshan rtsal khyab gdal dang tshad mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas sngon thon gyi lag rtsal gzhi rim zhing 'brog sa khul gyi khyim tshang re rer bskyal te tshan rtsal las don la grub 'bras rab dang rim pa blangs yod/(gcig) tshan tsol las gzhi lag bstar byas pa bde legs yin pa dang / spyod sgo che ba'i tshan rtsal zhib 'jug dang gsar spel la grub 'bras gsar pa blangs pa/ ‘‘lnga dgu'imi’tshun du khul yongs kyis bsdoms pas tshan rtsal las gzhi80lag bstar byas shing / de'i khrod rgyal khab rim pa'i las gzhi dang zhing chen rim pa'i las gzhi24dang / khul rim pa'i las gzhi53yod/ zhing chen rim pa'i nor srid rogs skyor ma dngul sgor khri546 84brtson len byas shing / khul rim pa'i nor srid gzhogs 'degs ma dngul sgor khri41la slebs yod/ las gzhi de ni zhing las skye khams 'dzugs sbun dang spus legs lo tog gi sa bon nang 'dren byed pa/ sngo tshal 'debs 'dzugs byed pa/ chung ba li thon skyed dang las snon/ phan 4

'bras che ba'i lug gso ba/ drod spyil gso spel/ krung bod sman rdzas 'debs 'dzugs/ reb gong sgyu rtsal dngos rdzas las snon/ 'o ma'i thon rdzas las snon/ nyi 'od nus pa bkol spyod dang tshan rtsal gso sbyong sogs yin la/ las gzhi 'di dag lag bstar byas pa 'dis rang khul gyi dpal 'byor sgrig gzhi legs sgrig byed par skul 'ded gtong ba dang / dpal 'byor 'phar snon gyi rnam pa sgyur ba/ rong 'brog pa'i yong sgo 'phar ba/mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen legs bcos byed pa bcas kyi phyogs la grub 'bras gsar pa blangs yod pa red/(gnyis) sngon thon dang bkol spyod ran pa'i lag col bkol rgya jecher btang ba dang / tshan rtsal yar thon gyi byas rjes chu tshad gom gang sngon spos sgos mthor 'degs byung ba/ rgya che ba'i tshan rtsal mi sna dang mang tshogs rtsa 'dzugs byas pa brgyud nas‘‘lo legs 'char gzhi’’dang‘‘me stag 'char/ gzhi ’ ‘‘dmangs phyug 'char gzhi’’sogs rgyun 'khyongs lhod med kyis lag bstar byas pa dang / sngon thon dang bkol spyod chog pa'i lag rtsal rigs sna tshogs shig rang khul gyi las rigs so so'i khrod du khyab rgya che ba'i sgo nas bkol spyod byed thub par gyur/ ‘‘lnga bcu ’dus mjug tu slebs dus/ khul yongs kyi tshan col grub 'bras khyab spel dang bkol spyod byed tshad42lhul slebs pa dang / tshan rtsal yar thon gyis dpal 'byor 'pharasnon la bzhag pa'i byas rjes kyi tshad de5lnga brgyad’’dus mjug gi5

23ltanas‘‘lnga bcu’’dus mjug gi31yatu mthor 'degs byung ba red/(gsum) shes bya'i thon dbang gi bya ba go rim yod pa'i ngang nas spel ba dang / tshan rtsal gsar gtod kyi 'du shes dang nus pa cung je drag tu phyin yod/ nye ba'i lo shas ring / khul yongs kyis shes bya'i thon dbang dril sgrog dang shes bya'i thon dbang thad kyi khrims 'dzin la shugs snon byas pas/ dmangs yongs kyi shes bya'i thon dbang gi 'du shes la 'phel rgyas gsar pa byung yod/ ched khe'i bdag dbang thob 'dun zhu ba med pa nas yod par gyur cing / 〈〈stabs bde'i gdan〉〉dang〈〈rtswa thang gi gzan rtswa 'debs 'dzugs 'phrul chas〉〉gnyis kyi gsar gtod la rgyal khab shes bya'i thon dbang cu nas rnam pa gsar pa'i dngos spyod ched khe dpang yig gnang la lhag par du〈〈rtswa thang gi gzan rtswa 'debs 'dzugs 'phrul chas〉〉kyi ched khe de rgyal nang gi sngon thon gras su slebs yod/(bzhi) rong 'brog khul gyi nus khungs dang skye khams 'dzugs skrun la shugs bsnan pa dang / rong 'brog pa'i thon skyed 'tsho ba'i khor yug sngar las lhag par legs bcos byung ba/ rang khul gyi nus khungs mi 'dang ba dang skye khams nyams zhan yin pa sogs kyi don dngos gnad don la kha gtad de sa cha so sos dpe ston sna 'dren dang / lag rtsal zhabs zhu/ma rtsa'i kha snon sogs kyi byed thabs rab dang rim pa spyad de nus khungs dang skye khams 'dzugs skrun gyi tshan rtsal khyab gdal dang bkol spyod bya bar 6

shugs bsnan pas/ nyi 'od thab ka dang / 'od hphu glog g.yis/ rdzab rlangs sogs rong 'brog sa khul du rgya cher bkol spyod byed thub la/ 'brog khul gyi bra gsod dang rtswa 'debs/ ‘‘sa nag bcos skyong’misogs la'ang phan 'bras mngon gsalablangs te phan nus ldan pa'i sgo nas rong 'brog khul gyi nus khungs gnad don dang / skye khams khor yug srung skyob byas shing /rong 'brog khul gyi thon skyed 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen legs bcos byas pa red/dus mtshungs su/ rnam pa chung gras kyi mgyogs tshad dal ba'i rlung shugs glogaskrul 'phrul chas thog ma de rtse khog rdzong cha skor zhang nas tshod lta byas nas legs 'grub byung bas/ rang khul du sngar las lhag par rlung nus thon khungs gsar spel dang bkol spyod byed par lag col gyi rmang gzhi gsar pa btings yod pa red/(lnga) tshan rtsal khyab brdal dang brgyud sgrog thad grub 'bras gsar pa blangs pa dang / tshan tsol 'phel rgyas kyi khor yug la legs bcos mngon gsal byung ba/ slob gso dang tshan rtsal/ rig gnas sogs sde khag gis rang steng gi khyad chos dang zung 'brel byas te/ nan tan gyis‘‘tshan rtsal thad kyi gzhi rim du bgrod pa gsum’’dang‘‘tshan rtsal bya 'gul gyi gza' 'khor’’ ‘‘tshan rtsal khyab gdal dril sgrog zla ba’’ ‘‘4 26'dzam gling shes bya'i thon dbang nyin mo’’sogs kyi tshan col dril sgrog bya 'gul spel bas/spyi tshogs yongs kyis tshan rig la do snang byed pa dang tshan rig la dga' 7

zhen che ba/ tshan rig shes bya slob pa/ tshan rig shes bya bkol spyod byed pa bcas kyi 'du shes je drag tu phyin pa red/ sa khul so sos nus ldan gyi rnam pa mang po spyad de zhing phyugs las thad kyi bkol spyod ran pa'i lag rtsal dang ngal rtsol rtsal nus gso sbyong 'dzin grwa sgrub cing / rong 'brog mang tshogs mi khri14 6(thengs) gso sbyong byas la/ tshan rtsal gyi nus pa dang 'jon thang ldan pa'i mi skor zhig gis mang tshogs la 'go khrid de phyug sgyur gyi lam du dpe ston gyi nus pa bton yod pa red/(drug) 'jon thang ldan pa'i mi'i gso sbyong 'char gzhi khyon yongs nas lag bstar byas pa dang / tshan tsol dpung khag 'dzugs sbun la bstud mar shugs bsnan nas/ sa khul so sos 'jon thang can gyi dpung khag 'dzugs skrun la mthong chen byas shing / nan tan gyis〈〈rma lho khul gyis mtshosngon zhing chen gyi dus rabs brgal pa'i tshan rtsal 'jon thang can gyi dpung khag 'char 'god lag bstar byed pa'i skor gyi bsam 'chadku〉dngos 'bebs byas nas/ las rigs so so'i ched las lag rtsal mi sna'i gso sbyong 'dzin grwa sgrub pa dang / lag rtsal rkang 'dzin pa zhing chen phyi nang du ched las gso sbyong dang slob grwa chen mor zab zhugs byed par mngags pa sogs ched las lag col 'jon thang can gyi las ka'i chu tshad dang phyogs bsdus spus tshad la mthor 'degs nges can byung / ‘‘lnga bcu dus mjug tu khul yongs kyi khe las sde khag la lag rtsal thob thang gi ming yod pa'i mi sna niyolnga 8

brgyad’’dus mjug las mi1050'phar snon byung ba dang / ched las lag rtsal gyi gso sbyong dang len byas pa dang slob grwa sna tshogs su zab zhugs byed par song ba'i ched las lag rtsal mi sna27glil slebs shing / tshan rtsal dpung khag gi mi grangs ni‘‘lnga brgyad’midus mjug las21 8sti'apharab red/mdor bsdus na/ 'das pa'i lo ngo bcu ni rang khul gyi dpal 'byor rgyun mthud nas 'phel rgyas song ba dang spyi tshogs las don khyon yongs nas yar thon du song ba/ mkhar grong gi rnam par 'gyur ldog gting zab byung ba'i lo ngo bcu yin la/ rang khul gyi tshan rtsal las don mgyogs myur ngang 'phel rgyas su song ba'i lo ngo bcu yang yin/ lo ngo bcu'i brgyud rim la phyir dran dang phyogs bsdoms byas na nga tshor nges shes zab mo zhig thob thub pa ni/da nges par du bsam blo bcings 'grol dang 'du shes gsar sgyur byed rgyu rgyun 'khyongs byed dgos la/ srol rgyun gyi bsam blo 'du shes dang bsam gzhigs byed stangs/ lam lugs kyi bkag rkyen bcas kyi 'ching rgya las yongs su thar bar byas te gsar skrun gyi khrod nas 'phel rgyas dang /'phel rgyas kyi khrod nas gsar skrun byed dgos//nges par du tshan rig dang mthun pa'i 'phel rgyas lta tshul gyis gzhi bzung ste yod tshad don dngos nas mgo rtsom pa dang / dngos thog 9

bden 'tshol byed pa/ phyi rol yul gyi chos nyid la brtsi 'jog byas nas dpal 'byor spyi tshogs khyon yongs nas mthun sbyor yong ba dang mu mthud du 'phel rgyas yor bar skul 'ded gtong dgos/—nges par du mi gzhi cor 'dzin pa rgyun 'khyongs byas te ngal rtsol par brtsi 'jog dang / shes byar brtsi 'jog 'jon mir brtsi 'jogagasar skrun la brtsi 'jog byed pa bcas kyi khor yug bzang po zhig bskrun nas 'jon thang can gyi mi mang po 'tshar longs byung ba dang / gsar skrun gyi las don gnyer ba'i srid jus dang lam lugs/ spyi tshogs khor yug cig 'dzugs dgos/ da nges par du mang tshogs kyi lam phyogs rgyun 'khyongs byas te mang tshogs la brten pa dang mang tshogs la slob gso gtong ba/ mang tshogs la khrid ston byed pa/ mang tshogs la zhabs phyi sgrurbe pa bcas zung 'brel byas nas/ mang tshogs kyi gsar gtod rnam pa'i rma lho gsar pa 'dzugs skrun gyi rlabs chen lag len la grub 'bras gsar pa len dgos//yes par du tshan rig zhib 'jug dang thon skyed zung 'brel byed pa rgyun 'khyongs byas te mang tshogs kyi thon skyed 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi don dngos kyi gnad don gtsor bzung na/ tshan col gsar gtod de nyid bcos sgyur dang 'phel rgyas kyi sgul shugs gal chen zhig tu 'gyur nges red/grub 'bras khas len pa dang mnyam du nga tshos nges par du shes dgos 10

pa ni/ rang khul gyi tshan rtsal las don de phyogs yongs nas bltas na da dung cung rjes lus yin la/ gtso bo rgya che ba'i rong 'brog mang tshogs kyi tshan rtsal 'du shes cung zhan pa dang tshan rtsal la brten nas dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas su gtong ba'i 'du shes zhan pa/ bkol spyod ran pa'i lag rtsal khyab gdal byas pa dus dang mi 'tsham pa dang dka' khag che ba/ tshan rtsal grub 'bras bkol spyod kyi tshad dang / tshan rtsal gyis zhing phyugs las la bzhag pa'i byas rjes kyi tshad dma' ba/ khe las lag rtsal gyi sgrig chas rjes lus yin pa/ rang bdag gsar skrun gyi nus pa zhan pa/ thon rdzas tshan rtsal 'dus tshad nyung ba/ tshong ra'i 'gran rtsod kyi nus pa med pa/ tshan rtsal 'jon thang can dkon pa/ ched las sgrig gzhi lugs mthun min pa/lhag par du dpal 'byor lag col gyi 'jon mi dang khe las do dam phyogs kyi 'jon mi dkon pa bcas red/ tshan rtsal la ma dngul btang ba mi 'dang bas tshad nges can zhig gi steng nas bshad na spyod sgo yod pa'i lag rtsal bkol spyod byed par shan zhugs yod pa red/ der brten/ nga tshos nges par du mthong chen byas nas sdug rus kyis tshan rtsal yar thon dang gsar skrun gyi 'du shes/ srid jus/ lam lugs/ ma rtsa gtong ba sogs la shan thebs pa'i gnad don gyi phyogs thag gcod byas te/ dngos gnas tshan rtsal yar thon la brten nas rma lho spyi'i 'phel rgyas chu tshad de skas rim gsar pa zhig tu slebs par skul 'ded gtong dgos/11

gnyis/ ‘‘lnga bcu gcig’’dus skabasakli rang khul gyi tshan rtsal bya ba'i blang bya dang 'phelacus dmigs 'ben/‘‘lnga bcu gcig’’gi dus skabs ni rang khul gyis khyon yongs nas 'byor 'bring spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i gnad 'gag gi dus skabs yin/ rang khul gyi tshan col bya ba'i sbyi'i blang bya ni/ ting zha'o phen gyi tsho rigs pa'i gzhung lugs dngadzimatshon byed gsum7gyi dgongs pa gal chen bsam blo'i mdzub ston du bzung ste/ tshan rig dang mthun pa'i 'phel rgyas lta ba rgyun 'khyongs byed pa dang nan tan gyis〈〈krung gung krung dbyang dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis tshan rtsal 'char 'god co gnad lag bstar byed na rang bdag gsar sbun gyi nus pa je drag tu gtong dgos pa'i skor gyi chod don〉〉dang zhing chen tang u dang srid gzhung gi〈〈lag bstar bsam 'char〉〉dngos 'beb byed pa/ khul gyi gnas tshul la rkang btsugs te nan tanagyis tshan slob la brten nas khul dar rgyas su gtong ba'i 'thab jus lag bstar byas nas/ tshan rtsal lam lugs bcos sgyur gting zab byed rgyu sgul shugs su 'dzin pa dang / dpal 'byor spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas la tshod 'dzin thebs pa'i gnad 'gag gi lag rtsal de 'gag brtol sa'i dmigs 'ben du 'dzin pa/ yang bskyar gsar sgrun de shugs 'don sa byed pa/mi shugs thon khungs gsar spel byed rgyu de dam por bzung nas shugs chen gyis sngon thon gyi spyod phan ran pa'i lag rtsal khyab gdal du btang ste/ sa 12

khul gyi khyad chos ldan pa dang tshan rtsal gyi 'dus tshad nges can ldan pa'i thon las ma lag cig 'dzugs grub byas nas rma lho'i dpal 'byor spyi tshogs mgyogs shing legs pa'i sgo nas 'phel rgyas su 'gro bar skul 'ded gtong dgos/khul yongs kyi tshan rtsal 'phel rgyas kyi spyi'i dmigs 'ben ni2010lor smrebs dus spyi tshogs ring lugs tshong ra'i dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas kyi blang bya dang mthun pa'i tshan rtsal yar thon dang gsar skrun skul 'ded ma lag 'dzugs thub dgos la/ rang khul gyi thon khungs gsar spel dngakhyad ldan thon las 'phel rgyas/ skye khams 'dzugs skrun/ khor yug srung skyong bcas la tshod 'dzin thebs pa'i lag rtsal skor zhig gnad sar bzung nas 'gag brtol sa byed dgos pa dang / tshan rtsal ltar thon gyi chu tshad dang gsar skrun nus pa mngon gsal gyis je mthor 'gro dgos/rigs so so'i mang tshogs kyi tshan rtsal rig gnas spus tshad bstud mar je mthor gtong dgos/ tshan rtsal gyis dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas la bzhag pa'i byas rjes kyi tshad35lkol slebs par brtson len byed dgos pa dang tshan rtsal grub 'bras kyi khyab gdal dang bkol spyod kyi tshad455slebs dgos/

gsum/ tshan rtsalaspar thon dang gsar skrun gyi 'ganarṣar gsal po byas te/ gnad 'gag gi lag rtsal khrab khongs nang 'gag brtol thub pa byed dgos/(gcig) nus shugs chen pos zhing phyugs las thad kyi lag rtsal yar thon la skul 'ded btang ste/ srol rgyun gyi zhing phyugs las nas deng rabs can gyi zhing phyugs las la sgyur ba'i 'phel rim je mgyogs su gtong dgos/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi zhing sde gsar pa 'dzugs sbun byed rgyu la dmigs nas tshan rtsal gyis ram 'degs dang sne khrid byas te khyad ldan zhing phyugs thon khungs phyogs bsdus kyis gsar spel byed pa'i goms stabs je mgyogs su gtong dgos/ gcig nas zhing phyugs las thad kyi tshan rtsal gsar skrun dang lag rtsal gyi 'gag sgo legs 'dzin byas nas hur thag gis spus legs sa bon dang phan 'bras mtho ba'i zhing las 'debs gso lag col khyab gdal du gtong ba dang / nor gnag gi sha shed mi nyams pa sogs gnad sa'i bzo bkod lag bstar byas te rgyud bzang gi khebs tshad rgya bskyed dgos/ gnyis nas hur thag gis zhing phyugs las kyi sgrig gzhi'i khrod du tshan rtsal 'bras bu bed spyod dang khyab gdal bteng ste/ sa bon gsar pa dang / lag rtsal gsar pa nang 'dren byed pa/ tshod lta dang dpe ston bcas brgyud nas rgya khyon che ba'i sgo nas khyab gdal dang bkol spyod byed par cha tshang ba'i lag col bzang po mkho sprod byed dgos/ gsum nas 14

ljang mdog sngo tshal dang khyad ldan sil tog skye ldan phyugs thon dngos rdzas sogs phyugs thon dngos rdzas kyi tshan zhib dang dpe ston bcas kyi bya ba legs 'dzin byas te mgyogs myur ngang khyad ldan thon las kyi rten gzhi 'dzugs skrun byed pa dang khyad ldan thon rdzas la zhib tshags kyis las snon byed pa'i las rigs 'phel rgyas su gtong dgos la/ sa khul gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i thon rdzos ming grags can bskrun dgos/ bzhi nas srog chags dang rtsi shing gi 'bu'i gnod pa che gras sngon 'gog dang tshod 'dzin lag col gyi zhib 'jug dang bkol spyod la shugs snon byas te/ khyad ldan thon las tshan rtsal la brten nas skyon bral ngang 'phel rgyas su 'gro bar skul 'ded gtong dgos/ lnga nas mu mthud du‘‘me stag tshan rtsal zhing phan’mitshod lta'i dpe ston las gzhi lag bstar bzang po byas te tshan rtsal gyi 'dus tshad mtho ba dang khyab rgya che ba/ rong 'brog pas shes sla ba'i spyod sgo yod pa'i tshan rtsal las gzhi skor zhig gdam gses byas nas lag bstar byed dgos pa dang / 'khor skyod nang rkyen gsar sbun byed pa brgyud nas tshan col la brten nas zhing phyugs las kyi thon las 'phar ba dang rong 'brog pa'i yong sgo 'phar ba'i lam gsar pa zhig tu bskyod dgos/ drug nas spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi zhing sde gsar pa 'dzugs skrun khrod tshan rtsal bya ba'i khrid ston nus pa 'don spel gang legs byed dgos la/ rang khul gyis gtan 'khel byas pa'i khul rim pa'i tshod lta sde ba bzhi bo gnad sar bzung nas 'char 'god 15

ltar nan tan gyis zhing sde gsar pa'i tshan rtsal yar skul bya spyod rtsa 'dzugs dang lag bstar bzang po byed dgos/ bdun nas sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas zhing phyugs las kyi tshan rtsal khyab gdal zhabs phyi'i ma lag je tshang du btang ste/ rong 'brog par thon skyed kyi mgo snga bar gsum gyi zhabs phyi 'don sprod byas na/ rang khul gyi zhing phyugs las kyi thon 'bras 'phar ba'i thabs lam gtso bo de gang mgyogs kyis tshan rtsal yar thon la brten pa'i bgrod lam steng 'bab thub la/ tshan rtsal yar thon la brten— nas spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi zhing sde gsar pa 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i rgyal kha'i nyams myong zhig kyang 'bad pas len thub nges red/(gnyis) khe las tshan col gsar skrun gyi gom stabs je mgyogs su btang ste/ khyad ldan thon las 'bad pas bskrun dgos/ rang khul gyi zhing phyugs thon rdzas dang krung bod sman rdzas/ gter rdzas sogs khyad stobs thon las la gzhi bcol nas sne khrid khe las kyis tshan rtsal las gzhi gal chen lag bstarno byed pa'i nang rkyen 'dzugs pa dang / khe las kyi tshan rtsal las gzhi'i khral sdud rogs phan srid jus dngos 'bebs byas nas khe las dang tshan zhib las khungs gnyis kyis mnyam las dam tshags byed par skul 'ded btang na/ lag rtsal dang tshong ra sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas gzhi gcig tu sbrel thub pa dang / lag rtsal dang ma rtsa gnyis sngar las lhag pa'i phan 'bras ldan pa'i sgo nas mnyam 'dres byed thub la/ khe las de 16

nyid zhib 'jug gsar spel dang / lag col gsar skrun gyi 'bras bu bkol spyod byed pa'i gzhi gtso bo bcas su 'gyur thub/ rim bzhin lag rtsal gyi grub cha cung mtho ba'i khe las ming grags can dang khyad stobs ldan pa'i khe las gso skyong byas te khe las kyi tshong ra'i 'gran rtsod nus shugs je drag tu gtong dgos/(gsum) shugs ldan gyis yul skor ljongs rgyu thad kyi tshan rtsal bkol spyod dang gsar skrun gyi gom pa je mgyogs su btang ste yul skor thon rdzas kyi rim pa 'phar du 'jug dgos/ lag rtsal gsar pa rgya cher bkol nas yul skor ljongs rgyu sa khul gsar spel byed rgyu dang / ljongs rgyu sa khul 'dzugs skrun gyi rim pa je mthor gtong dgos pa dang / tshan zhib dang khyad ldan rig gnas thon khungs sngog 'don dang srung skyob/ gsar spel bcas byas te/ yul skor thon dzos kyi tshan col 'dus tshad je mthor btang na deng rabs kyi mi'i rig gnas dgos mkho dang mdzes dpyod kyi spro snang dang mthun pa red/ deng rabs cha 'phrin dang tshan rig lag rtsal gyis thon las ang gsum pa'i khrod khyab che ba'i sim 'dzul byed pa la rogs skyor dang sne khrid byed dgos la/ tshong las nyo tshong dang dngul lor/ rig gnas/yul skor sogs thon las kyi deng rabs can la sngon thon gyi lag col las stegs 'don sprod byed dgos/(bzhi) nus shugs chen pos skye khams 'dzugs skrun thad kyi 17

'brel yod lag rtsal 'gag brtol nas rgyun mthud 'phel rgyas yong chog pa'i nus pa je drag tu gtong dgos/ hur thag gis gtsang gsum mgo khungs srung skyong sa khul gyi bcos skyong dang rtswa sa bye thang du 'gyur ba bcos skyong / brlan sa srung skyob sogs lag rtsal che gras kyi 'gag brtol las gzhi brtson len byas nas skye khams ma lag nyams zhan du gyur pa slar gso byed pa dang nags tshal gyi 'bu'i gnod skyon 'gog bcos byed pa'i lag tsol zhib 'jug byed dgos/ hur thag gis sngon thon dang bkol spyod ran pa'i skye khams khor yug gi lag rtsal khyab gdal du btang nas/ dwangs gtsang thon skyed gnad sa yin pa'i sbags btsog phyogs bsdus bcos skyong byed pa'i ma dpe 'dzugs dgos/ thon khungs phyogs bsdus kyis bkol ba'i lag col nang 'dren dang gsar spel/ bkol spyod bcas byed dgos la/ rjob rlangs dang nyi 'od nus pa/ rlung nus sogs nus khungs dwangs gtsang gi rigs kyi gsar spel bkol spyod dang khyab gdal byed tshad la shugs snon rgyag dgos/(lnga) tshan rtsal las gzhi'i do dam la shugs snon byas te tshan rtsal ma dngul bkol ba'i phan 'bras mthor 'degs gtong dgos/ rang khul gyi don dngos dang zung 'brel byas nas khyad ldan thon las kyi lag rtsal gsar skrun las gzhi dang / zhing sde dang 'brog khul gyi spyod phan ran pa'i lag rtsal khyab gdal gyi las gzhi gnad sar bzung nas legs 'dzin byed 18

dgos/ hur thag gis gnad sa'i tshan rtsal las gzhi gsar spel gyi tshong ra can gyi 'khor skyod byed thabs 'tshol rtog byas te 'gran rtsod kyi nang rkyen 'dren dgos la/ ma dngul dang 'jon mi/ lag col sogs thon khungs sdeb sgrig legs 'gyur yong ba byed dgos/ tshan rtsal las gzhi'i do dam gyi rjes 'ded pa dang phan 'bras la gdeng 'jog byed par shugs bsnan nas las gzhi bde legs ngang lag bstar byed par khag theg dang dgos nges kyi phan 'bras len par byed dgos/ las gzhi'i ma dngul gyi 'gul skyod do dam la shugs bsnan nas tshan col ma dngul re res phan 'bras gang legs 'don dgos la/ ‘‘las gzhi gcig lag bstar byed pa dang rten gzhi gcig 'dzugs grub byed pa/ 'jon mi skor zhig gso sbyong byed pa/ thon las skor zhig gi sne khrid pa dang mang tshogs skor zhig phyug 'gyur byed par’’'bad pa byed dgos/(drug) nus shugs chen pos spyi tshogs las don thad kyi tshan rtsal yar thon la skul 'ded btang ste mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i spus tshad legs bcos byed dgos/ 'phrod bsten spyi'i bde 'jags dang nad yams che gras sngon 'gog byed pa'i lag rtsal nang 'dren dang khyab gdal btang nas/ sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas gzhi rim gyi nad rigs phyogs bsdus 'gog bcos lag rtsal 'tshol rtog byas te mi'i bde thang gi chu tshad mthor 'degs gtong dgos/ tshan rtsal gyis mkhar grong 'dzugs skrun la 19

skul 'ded gtong ba dang / grong rdal dang sde khul gyi zhabs phyi'i byed nus 'thus tshang du btang nas mkhar grong can 'dzugs skrun la lag col gsar pa mkho sprod byed dgos/ spyi'i bde 'jags dang sa 'gul hur thag gis 'gog pa/ gnod skyon je nyung du gtong ba/ gnod skyon che ba'i gnam gshis brtag dpyad snyan zhu sogs kyi lag col gsar pa khyab gdal dang bkolastod byas te/ glo bur rang bzhin gyi don rkyen che gras kyi myur skyob thag gcod nus pa mthor 'degs gtong dgos/ cha 'phrin dang dra rgya'i lag col gang legs kyis bkol spyod byas te glog rdul srid don 'dzugs skrun la skul 'ded gtong dgos la/ 'phrin gtong dang rgyang sgrog brnyan 'phrin bcas kyi khebs tshad rgya bskyed gtong dgos/ khyim tshang khri stong mang por tshan rtsal shes bya dang cha 'phrin bskyal nas sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas rgya che ba'i mang tshogs kyis tshan rig lag rtsal bkol spyod byas te rang nyid 'dzugs skrun dang spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas su gtong ba'i nus pa mthor 'degs su gtong bar skul 'ded gtong dgos/(bdun) tshan rig lag col khyab gdal du gtong ba'i bya bar shugs bsnan te rigs so so'i mang tshogs kyi tshan rig spus tshad mthor 'degs gtong dgos/ tshan rig lag rtsal khyab gdal du gtong ba ni dpal 'byor spyi tshogs rgyun mthud 'phel rgyas kyi spyi tshogs rmang gzhi dang mi shugs rmang gzhi yin/ nan tan gyis〈〈tshan rig lag rtsal khyab gdal 20

bca'akhrims〉〉dang〈〈mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi tshan rig lag col khyab gdal srol yig〉〉sogs kyi khrims srol lag bstar byas nas/ tshan col khyab gdal bya ba'i 'brel gtug tshogs 'du'i lam lugs 'thus tshang du gtong dgos la/ gzhi rim gyi tshan rtsal khyab gdal las khungs dang sgrig chas/dpung khag 'dzugs skrun bcas la shugs bsnan nas tshan rtsal khyab gdal gyi byed thabs gsar skrun dang tshan rtsal khyab gdal gyi nus pa je drag tu gtong dgos/ don dngos dang zung 'brel byas te dmangs yongs kyi tshan rtsal khyab gdal dril sgrog dang tshan rtsal gso sbyong 'char gzhi bzos nas/tshan rig shes bya dang tshan rig byed thabs/ tshan rig snying stobs bcas brgyud sgrog rgya cher byed dgos la/ mang tshogs kyis lag col gsar sgyur gyi bya 'gul spel bar rogs skyor byas te slob sbyong gi rnam pa can gyi spyi tshogs dngagasar skrun gyi rnam pa can gyi spyi tshogs gsar 'dzugs byed par skul 'dedagatong dgos/ zhing sde dang 'brog khul gyi tshan rtsal khyab gdal bya b.rabla lhag gis mthong chen dang shugs snon byed dgos la/ zhing phyus/sa dang dbul skyor/ chu don/ nags las/ gnam gshis/ tshan tsol sogs kyisde khag dang zhing phyugs las ched las mthun tshogs kyi rtsa 'dzugs kyis 'gan nus gang legs kyis 'don spel byed dgos pa dang / tshan rtsal khyab gdal du gtong ba dril sgrog dang lag rtsal gso sbyong 'dzin grwa sgrub pa/lag col 'chad khrid byed pa sogs kyi rnam pa mang por brten nas sngon thon 21

dang spyod phan ran pa'i lag rtsal de rong 'brog sa khul du brgyud khyab byed pa je mgyogs su gtong dgos/ 2010lor slebs dus dngos bkol lag rtsal gso sbyong dang tshan rtsal khyab gdal gyi khebs rgya lo rer cha snyoms byas na25ltayan la slebs dgos la/ rong 'brog khul nas cha snyoms byas na khyim rer tshan rtsal gyi ha go ba'i mi gcig yod par brtson len byed dgos/ sde ba rer nyung mthar yang mi gnyis yan gyi tshan col sne khrid pa yod dgos la/zhang re nas tshan rtsal dpe ston sa tshigs gcig 'dzugs dgos/ rdzong re res tshan col dpe ston gyi sde ba gcig nas gnyis 'dzugs dgos/ sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas slob grwa'i tshan col shes bya khyab gdal dang dril sgrogaslob gso bcas kyi bya bar shugs snon dgos la/ slob grwa chung 'bring rtsa 'dzugs byas te tshan tsol khyab gdal gyi 'chad khrid dang gsar gtod chung chung / gsar skrun chung chung sogs kyi bya 'gul rgya cher spel nas byis pa dang na gzhon gyi tshan rtsal spus tshad dang rig gnas spus tshad je mthor gtong dgos/(brgyad) tshan col 'phel rgyas 'char 'god 'thus tshang dang lag bstar byed pa legs 'dzin byas te/ tshan rtsal las don rgyun mthud 'phel rgyas 'byung bar skul 'ded gtong dgos/ khul dang rdzong gi tshan rtsal sde khag gis dngos gnas tshan rtsal 'phel rgyas 'char 'god bzo ba dang 'thus tshang du gtong ba'i bya ba legs 'dzin byas nas/ bzung bya'i co 22

gnad yod pa dang bsrung bya'i sgrig lam yod par byed dgos/ don dngos la zab zhugs byas nas brtag dpyad zhib 'jug byed par shugs snon dgos la/ gnad don rnyed pa dang 'gal ba thag gcod pa/ bya bar skul 'dedagatong ba bcas kyi co don la phyogs nas tshan rig dang mthun zhing don dngos gnyer ba'i jus gzhi 'don dgos shing / bye brag dang spyod chog pa'i byed thabs gtan 'khel byas te tang u dang srid gzhung gis jus thag gcod par dge mtshan ldan zhing lugs mthun yin pa'i bsam 'char dang gros gzhi 'don dgos/ 'char 'god tso 'dzugs dang lag bstar byed rgyu legs 'dzin byed dgos la/ tshan rtsal gsar skrun gyi chos nyid brtsi srung sgos rim bzhin yar rgyas yong ba dang rim bzhin skul spel byas nas bya ba'i kha gtad rang bzhin dang 'brel mthud rang bzhin shugs drag tu btang ste 'char 'god lag bstar gyi 'bras bu je mthor gtong dgos /bzhi/ 'gan srung byed thabs 'thus tshang du btang ste dpal 'byor dang tshan rtsal phan nus ldan pa'i ngang zung 'brel byed par skul 'ded gtong dgo sa/gsar skrun rnam pa can gyi rma lho 'dzugs skrun byed rgyu ni dus yun ring zhing dka' tshegs che ba'i 'gan khur zhig red la/ rgya che zhing gting zab pa'i spyi tshogs 'pho 'gyur zhig kyang yin/ nga tshos nges par du 'go khrid rtsa 'dzugs dang lam lugs nang rkyen sogs phyogs so so nas khag theg gi byed 23

thabs nus ldan gtan 'khel dang don dngos kyis khyab khongs so so'i khyon yongs kyi gsar skrun la skul 'ded gtong dgos/(gcig) 'go khrid la shugs sdon byas te tshan rtsal gsar skrun gyi thad du rtsa 'dzugs kyis khag theg yod dgos/ tshan rtsal yar thon dang gsar skrun la skul 'ded gtong rgyu ni spyi tshogs las don gyi rmang gzhi yin pas/ srid gzhung gi 'gan nus gal chen yin par ma zad tang u'i bya ba gal chen zhig kyang yin/ der brten/ rim pa so so'i tang us nges par du tshan tsol bya bar mthong chen gnang nas dngos gnas tshan rtsal bya ba'i 'gokhrid la shugs snon dgos la/ tshan col 'thab jus dang jus bkod lam lugs che gras 'dzugs pa dang 'thus tshang du gtong dgos/ tshan rtsal lasadon 'phel rgyas la skul 'ded gtong ba dang tshan rtsal gsar skrun la skul lcag gtong ba'i srid jus gtan 'khel byas te mu mthud du tshan col bya ba'i 'go khrid kyi chu tshad mthor 'degs gtong dgos/ rim pa so so'i srid gzhung gis tshan rtsal bya ba de nyin rgyun gyi gal che ba'i bya ba'i go rim nang bkod nas tshan rtsal las don 'phel rgyas byed rgyu legs 'dzin byed dgos shing / dus bcad ltar tshan rtsal bya ba'i snyan zhu la nyan nas tshan rtsal bya ba'i khrod gnas pa'i bye brag gi gnad don dus thog tu zhib 'jug thag gcod byed dgos/ mi shugs dang thon khungs/ ma dngul sogs kyi thad nas tshan rtsal gsar skrun gyi dgos mkho khag theg byed dgos/ 24

(gnyis) tshan rtsal do dam lam lugs bcos sgyur byed rgyu skul spel byas te gsar skrun gyi gson shugs je drag tu gtong dgos/ ‘‘skor zhig brtan 'jags su gtong ba dang skor zhig hur por gtong ba'i tshan zhib las khungs sna tshogs kyi bcos sgyur la skul spel gtong rgyu je mgyogs su btang ste/ de nyid rang khul gyi tshan zhib gsar spel bya ba ang dang por bsgyur pa dang / rgya khyab gtong ba bcas lte gnas dang phyi phyogs su lag rtsal mnyam las byed pa'i sge'u khung zhig tu 'gyur bar 'dzugs skrun byed dgos/ tshan col mi snas bya ba'i nang rkyen gsar pa dang byed thabs gsar pa 'tshol rtog byas te hur thag gis tshan rtsal ched mngags pa sde ba nas 'dug pa'i lam lugs 'dzugs dgos la/ tshan rtsal mi snas rong 'brog khul dang khe las la kha gtad nas lag rtsal gsar skrun zhabs zhu dang dngos nga bkol lag rtsal zhabs phyi sgrub par skul lcag gtong dgos/ rang khul gyi tshan zhib las khungs dang khul phyi'i tshan zhib dang slob gso las khungs/ khe las bcas bar gyi 'brel 'dris dang mnyam las byed par rdogs skyor dang skul lcag gtong dgos la/ rnam pa mang po'i blo rig 'dren pa'i bya 'gul spelab/ nus shugs chen pos rang khul gyi thon khungs gsar 'byed dang dpal 'byor spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas dang 'tsham pa'i sngon thon gyi lag col las gzhi yod tshad nang 'dren byas te/ rang khul gyi tshan rtsal sgo 'byed chu tshad dang phan 'bras mthor 'degs su gtong dgos/25

(gsum) tshan col thon khungs sdeb sgrig dang 'thus tshang du btang ste tshan rtsal 'phel rgyas khag theg byed dgos/ thog mar tshan rtsal gsar skrun gyi ma rtsa gtong ba'i lam lugs 'thus tshang du btang nas nor srid kyi ma rtsa gtong ba'i sne khrid pa dang / khe las kyi ma rtsa gtong ba gtso gzhi yin pa/ spyi tshogs kyi ma rtsa gtong ba kha snon yin pa'i rgyu mang can dang thabs lam mang ba/ phan 'bras mtho ba bcas kyi tshan rtsal gyi ma dngul gtong ba'i ma lag cig mgyogs myur ngang 'dzugs dgos/ sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas ma rtsa gtong ba'i sgrig gzhi legs sgrig dang je legs yong ba byas te nor srid ma dngul gyis khe las lag rtsal gsar skrun gyi sne khrid nus par skul ma gtong rgyu 'don spel byed dgos/ nor srid kyis tshan rtsal la ma rtsa gtong ba'i 'phar snon gyi tshad de rgyun ldan rang bzhin gyi nor srid yong sgo'i 'phar snon gyi tshad las mtho ba khag theg byed dgos/ srid gzhung dang dngul lor sde khag gi 'brel 'dris dang mthun sbyor la shugs snon byed dgos la/ hur thag dang brtan brling ngang tshan col nyen srung gi ma rtsa gtong ba'i las khungs 'phel rgyas su btang nas dmangs khrod kyi ma rtsas tshan rtsal gsar 'byed la ma rtsa gtong rgyu hur brtson byed dgos/ gnyis pa/tshan rtsal thon khungs lugs mthun ngang sdeb sgrig byed pa'i gcig gyur 'char 'god kyi lam lugs 'dzugs pa dang 'thus tshang du gtong dgos/sridagazhung gi 'gan nus sgyur rgyu je mgyogs su btang ste/ las sna so so 26

dang khyab khongs so so/ rim pa so so bcas su khyab yod pa'i tshan rtsal thon khungs dag sgrig dang bkol spyod byed dgos la/ tshan rtsal dang 'phrod bsten/ zhing phyugs/ nags las/ chu bed/ nor srid/ slob gso/khral don sogs 'brel yod sde khag gi mthun sbyor nang rkyen 'thus tshang du btang nas sde khag dang sde khag bar mthun sbyor dang gzhogs 'degs byed pa/ khe las dang khe las bar lag rtsal brje res dang mnyam las byed par skul 'ded btang ste/ nang rkyen hur po yin pa dang thon khungs mnyam spyod byed pa/ mnyam las dam zab yin pa bcas kyi tshan rtsal gsar skrun mnyam shugs chags su 'jug dgos/ gsum pa/ tshan col gsar skrun thad kyi mi shugs thon khungs dang do dam nang rkyen bde thang dang 'thus tshang du gtong dgos/ sa khul so so dang sde khag so sos 'jon mi'i thon khungs ang dang po yin pa'i 'du shes brtan por btsugs nas/ 'jon mi'i tshan rtsal gsar skrun ma lag khrod kyi nus pa gtso bo 'don spel gang legs byed du 'jug dgos/ mgyogs myur ngang 'jon mir gdeng 'jog byed pa dang bya dga' skul lcag gtong ba'i nang rkyen 'dzugs pa dang 'thus tshang du btang ste/ lag rtsal rgyu cha bgo bshar zhugs pa'i 'brel yod srid jus gnad sar bzhag nas dngos 'bebs bzang po byed dgos/ srid jus kyi khor yug bzang po zhig gis zhing chen phyi nang dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi phul du byung ba'i 'jon mi dang mtho rim 'jon mi skor zhig rang khul du nang 'dren byas 27

nas thon las gsar skrun byed du 'jug dgos/blo mthun tsho/ gnas bab gsar pa'i 'og gi tshan col bya ba legs sgrub byed rgyu ni dus rabs kyis nga tshor bgos pa'i gzi brjid kyi 'gan khur yin/ nga tshos zhing chen tang u dang srid gzhung gi 'go khrid 'og tshan rig dang mthun pa'i 'phel rgyas lta tshul gyis gcig 'doms byed pa rgyun 'khyongasakhyas te 'phel rgyas ni srid skyong rgyal dar gyi 'gan khur ang dang por bzhag thog tshan rig lag col ni thon skyed nus shugs ang dang po yin pa'i bsam blo'i 'du shes sra brtan ngang 'dzugs dgos la/ zhing chen dang khul gyi tshan rtsal tshogs chen gyi dgongs don gzhir bzung nas snying rus cher bskyed dang gsar gtod gsar skrun/ tan tig gis bya ba sgrub ste/gsar skrun rnam pa'i rma lho 'dzugs skrun byed pa dang rma lho'i dpal 'byor dngaspyi tshogs legs pa'i sgo nas 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba mngon 'gyur byed ched sngar las lhag pa'i byas rjes chen po 'jog dgos/28

gnyis/ rma lhokhul myo'id rtsal tshogasarmetshod steng gi spyi bsdomasagatam bshad/khul mi dmangs brid gzhung gi khul dpon rdorje che ring /(2006lo'i zla10pa'i tshes27nyin)blo mthun rnam pa/thengs 'di'i tshogs chen gyis khul yongs kyi thengs bzhi pa'i tshan rtsal yar thon bya dga' thob pa'i bya dga'i rnam grangs dgu bor gzengs bstod bya dga' gnang zin pa dang / hru'u ci zhon hrin gyis gtam bshad gal chen gnang zhing / lo ngo bcu'i ring rang khul gyi tshan rtsal las don thad blangs pa'i grub 'bras la khas len gang legs byas pa'i khar/ lnga bcu gcig skabs kyi tshan rtsal bya ba'i gong spel dmigs 'ben gtso bo dang las 'gan bkal pa red/ dmigs yul rang bzhin dang mdzub ston rang bzhin ldan pas/ sa khul dang sde khag so sos nan tan sgos shes rtogs byed rgyu dang / don dngos dang zung 'brel byas te bya ba don 'khyol byed dgos/gsham nas ngas bsam 'char gsum 'don rgyu yin/(gcig) thengs 'di'i gros tshogasakli dgongs don la gā ༵

gting zab blangs te/ tshan rtsal las don gyi 'phel rgyas rje mgyogs su gtong dgos pa'i don snying gal chen la nges shes gsal po 'drong dgos/thengs 'di'i khul yongs kyi tshan rtsal tshogs chen ni khul u dang khul srid gzhung gis‘‘lnga bcu gcig’’pa'i khul yongs kyi tshan rtsal bya bar gting zab kyis spyi bsdoms dang ma 'ongs par 'char 'god bzo ba'i gros tshogs gal chen zhig yin pa dang / tshan rtsal las don gong du spel bar skul spel dang gsar spel rnam pa yod pa'i rma lho 'dzugs skrun byed par skul slong byed pa'i tshogs chen zhig kyang yin/ hru'u ci zhon hrin gyis gnang ba'i gtam bshad kyi brjod bya mngon par gsal zhing gnad sa 'bur du thon pa dang /khul yongs kyi tshan rtsal yar thon la skul 'ded byed pa'i skor dang /dpal 'byor spyi tshogs mkhyogs myur sgos 'phel rgyas su gtong bar skul 'dedashrīd par gal 'gangs che ba'i mdzub ston gyi don snying ldan pa red/lo 'di ga'i ring la/ rang khul gyi tshan rtsal las don thad 'phel rgyas cung mgyogs po byung ba dang / tshan rtsal gyis khul yongs kyi dpal 'byor 'phar ba'i thad byas rjes 'jog tshad bstud mar mthor 'degs byung yod na'ang /nga tshos gsal por mthong dgos pa zhig ni/ rang khul gyi tshan rtsal las don sngar bzhin rjes lus yin pa dang / dus skabs gsar pa dang dus rabs gsar pa'i re 'dun dang mi 'tsham pa'i mtshon rtags gtso bo 'di lta 30

ste/ spyi tshogs yongs kyis tshan rtsal bya bar mthong chen byas tshad mi 'dang ba dang / tshan rtsal la gron dngul btang ba ha cang mi 'dang zhing / dpal 'byor spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas su gtong ba'i tshan rtsal zhabs phyi'i spyi'i chu tshad dma' ba/ tshan rtsal dpung sde spyi'i spus tshad sngar las je mthor gtong dgos pa sogs yin/ rnam pa gsar pa'i 'og nga tshos nges par du tshan col las don gyi 'phel rgyas je mgyogs su gtong rgyu ni tshan rig dang mthun pa'i 'phel rgyas lta tshul rgyun 'khyongs dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi zhing sde 'dzugs skrun khrod kyi re 'dun yin par nges shes gsal po 'drong dgos/ rgya che'i rong 'brog sa khul ni spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs spel dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi zhing sde gsar pa 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i grub cha gtso bo zhig yin stabs/ deng rabs tshan rig rig gnas kyis drag chas spras dgos/ de lta min tshe deng rabs zhing phyugs lag rtsal khyab gdal gtong ba dang / zhing phyugs las thon las kyi chu tshad je mthor gtong ba/ de min da dung rong 'brog pa'i thon skyed 'tsho ba'i rol stangs bsgyur bcos dang / 'gro ba mi dang rang byung khams kyi 'cham mthun 'phel rgyas la yar skul byed pa bcas tshang mar bkag rgya chen po bzo nges red/der brten/ rong 'brog pa'i spus tshad je mthor gtong rgyu ni 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun dang zhing sde gsar pa 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i gnad 31

'gag yin/ rong 'brog pa'i spus tshad je mthor gtong bar nges par du deng rabs tshan rtsal rig gnas shes bya spyad de rgya che'i rong 'brog pa'i bsam blor drag chas spras dgos pa dang / rig gnas yod pa dang lag rtsal yod pa/ tshong gnyer shes pa'i rnam pa gsar pa'i rong 'brog pa mang po gso skyong byas te/ khyon yongs 'phel rgyas su gtong dgos/ dus mtshungs su/ shugs chen sgos tshan rtsal las don 'phel rgyas su gtong ba de ni dpal 'byor 'phar gnas gsar pa gso skyong dang / dpal 'byor sgrig gzhi lugs mthun sgos legs sgrig dang legs 'gyur la skul 'ded byed pa/spyi tshogs mgyogs shing legs po'i sgo nas 'phel rgyas su gtong ba/ sa khul gyi phyogs bsdus dngos shugs je drag tu gtong ba bcas kyi byed thabs gal chen zhig yin/ nga tshos nges par du khyon yongs dang 'thab jus kyi steng nas/ tshan rtsal las don 'phel rgyas je mgyogs su gtong ba'i don snying gal chen la nges shes je gsal dang / thengs 'di'i gros tshogs kyi bkod sgrig ltar/ yul bab dang bstun pa dang / byed thabs spyad de tshan rtsal las don gyi 'phel rgyas la stobs shugs yod rgus skul 'khrid byas nas/ rma lho khyon yongs nas 'phel gong du gtong ba'i rmang gzhi'i nus pa 'don dgos/ dpal 'byor spyi tshogs rgyun mthud dang mgyogs myur/ skyon bral bcas kyi ngang 'phel rgyas su gtong ba'i thon skyed nus shugs ang dang po'i nus pa 'don spel byed dgos/32

(gnyis) bcos sgrur dang gsar gtod kyi snying stobs la brten nas/ khul yongs kyi tshan rtsal las don 'phel rgyas su gtong dgos/‘‘lnga bcu gcig’’gi dus skabs ni 'cham mthun rma lho 'dzugs skrun dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi zhing sde gsar pa 'dzugs skrun dang 'byor 'bring spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun je mgyogs su gtong ba'i gnad 'gag gi dus skabs shig yin pa dang / tshan rtsal bya ba'i mdun du sngar byung ma myong ba'i 'phel rgyas kyi go skabs gsar pa byung yod/ gnas tshul gyi dbang gis mi byed ka med byung ba dang dus kyis mi sgug pas/ nga tshos cis kyang gnas bab la lta zhib dang / go skabs dam 'dzin/ 'phel rgyas kyi rigs lam sngar bas gsal por byed pa/ 'phel rgyas su gtong ba'i las 'gan gsal thag chod pa/ byed thabs nus ldan du gtong ba/ dngos 'bebs legs 'dzin dang / rang khul gyi tshan rtsal las don khyon yongs nas 'phel rgyas su gtong bar skul 'ded byed dgos/gcig nas zhing phyugs las tshan rtsal mar thon 'byung bar shugs bsnan te/spyichogs ring lugs kyi zhing sde gsar pa 'dzugs than byed par rtsal zhabs zhu 'don sprod byed pa'i steng 'gag brtol gsar ba 'byung dgos/tshan col gyis spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi zhing sde gsar pa 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i khrod du gal 'gangs ches che ba'i las 'gan 'khur yod pa dang /thon skyed 'phel rgyas su gtong ba'am/ yang na rgya che'i rong 'brog pa spyi'i 33

spus tshad mthor 'degs su gtong ba/ zhing phyugs las kyi phan 'bras 'phar snon byed pa/ rong 'brog pa'i yong sgo 'phar ba bcas tshang ma tshan rtsal rig gnas chu tshad je mthor song ba dang kha 'bral thabs med/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi zhing sde gsar pa 'dzugs skrun la zhabs phyi rgyun 'khyongs byed dgos pa dang / zhing phyugs las dang rong 'brog khul gyi dpal 'byor sgrig gzhi legs sgrig la dmigs nas/ zhing phyugs las kyi tshan rtsal grub 'bras 'pho 'gyur dang zhing phyugs las lag rtsal rgya bskyed byed pa je mkhyogs su gtong ba dang / zhing phyugs las kyi tshan col yar thon je mgyogs su btang nas/ zhing sde'i thon skyed nus shugs gong du spel bar gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i lag rtsal nus ldan 'don sprod byed dgos/rong 'brog pa'i gso sbyong nus tshad rgya bskyed dgos pa dang / zhing thon dngos dzas khrom ra'i tshong gnyer dang nyi 'od nus pa'i drod khang / sna rigs gsar pa 'dzugs gso/ tshan rig dang mthun pa'i sgo nas gso spel byed pa/ chu gron chung dang / chu bed 'dzugs skrun sogs kyi rgyun bkol lag rtsal gting zab sgos rgya bskyed dang khyab gdal du gtong dgos shing /rig gnas yod pa dang lag rtsal yod pa/ tshong gnyer shes pa'i rnam pa gsar pa'i rong 'brog pa mang po gso skyong byas te/ zhing phyugs las kyi spyi'i chu tshad spar ba dang / zhing phyugs las kyi sgrig gzhi legs sgrig dang legs 'gyur byed par skul 'ded byas nas/ rong 'brog pa'i phan 'bras 34

dang yong sgo 'phar du 'jug dgos/gnyisanasakṣad ldan thon las mgyogs myur ngang gso skyong byas te/ thon las grub tshul snyom sgrig gi rim pa spar bar skul 'ded gtong ba'i snyeng nas 'gag brtol gsar pa 'byung dgos/zhing phyugs las dang / chu glog ha yang dang gser/ rig gnas gnas skor/ sog bod sman rdzas bcas khyad ldan thon las chen po lnga gso skyong byed pa dmigs gzhir 'dzin pa dang / tshan col ma dngul gtong rgyu khyon yongs nas lag bstar byed pa/ hur thag sgos 'brel yod kyi tshan rtsal las gzhi zhu 'bul byed pa/ gron chung dang zad gron chung du gtong ba dang khor yug srung skyong gi lag rtsal gsar pa gsar 'byed dang rgya bskyed du gtong ba/ thon khungs kyi phyogs bsdus bed spyod byed tshad dang zhing phyugs thon rdzas zhib tshags las snon lag rtsal mthor 'degs byed pa/ dma' rim las snon gyi tshad las brgal ba bcas byas te/ zhing phyugs thon rdzas las snon dang / glog shugs/ ha yang las rigs/ krung bod sman rdzas gsar 'byed/ reb gong sgyu rtsal thon rdzas las snon sogs gtso bo yin pa'i srog shing thon las chags par byed pa dang / khul yongs kyi thon las sgrig gzhi legs sgrig dang legs 'gyur rim spar la skul 'ded gtong dgos/gsumanas tshan rtsal rnam pa can gyi khe las 'bring chung shugs chen pos gong spel btang ste/ khe las spyi rang bdag gsar gtod skul 'ded byed par 'gag 35

brtol gsar pa 'byung dgos/rang khul gyi don dngos dang zung 'brel byas nas zhing phyugs las thon dzas gso nyar dang las snon legs po byed pa/ ljang mdog skye ldan bza' btung gsar 'byed/ zhing las lo tog gi sna rigs gdam gso sogs gnad sa'i las rigs dang khyab khongs la dam por dmigs nas/sa khongs dpal 'byor dang spyi tshogs gong 'phel gtong bar skul 'khrid byed pa'i 'gangs che'i tshan rtsal las gzhi skor rtsa 'dzugs sgos lag bstar byed pa dang / 'gran rtsod kyi gnas bab legs shing rgyun mthud gsar gtod kyi nus pa ldan pa'i gsar gtod rnam pa can gyi khe las 'bring chung skor gsar skrun byed dgos/ tshan rtsal rnam pa can gyi khe las 'bring chung gis shugs chen pos lag col gsar pa dang thon rdzos gsar pa gsar 'byed byed par hur thag sgos khrid ston byed pa dang / sgos su khyad ldan zhing phyugs las gsar 'byed dang / gnas bab legs pa'i thon khungs gsar 'byed/ krung bod sman rdzas gsar 'byed/ nus pa'i thon khungs gsar pa bkol spyod/ skye khams srung skyong dang slar gso sogs kyi thabs shes nang 'dren dang / lag col gsar pa rgya bskyed du btang ste/ rang bdag gsar gtod nus pa mthor 'degs su gtong dgos/bzhi nas tshan rtsal zhabs phyi'i ma lag 'dzugs skrun byed pa 'thus tshang du btang ste/ rtsal grub 'bras de dngos yod thon skyed nus shugs phyogs su bakhyur 36

spo byed pa'i steng nas 'gag brtol gsar pa 'byung dgos/‘‘srid gzhung gis sne khrid pa dang / khrom ra 'khor bskyod byed pa'i’’rtsa don ltar/ zhabs phyi'i rtsa 'dzugs dra rgya can dang / zhabs phyi'i do dam tshad ldan can/ zhabs phyi'i grub tshul khrom ra can/ dpal 'byor phan khe thun mong can/ zhabs phyi'i nus shugs rgyun mthud can bcas khyad ldan chen po lnga 'bur du thon par byed pa dang / khul yongs kyi tshan rtsal zhabs phyi'i ma lag 'dzugs skrun byed pa je mgyogs su btang ste/ rong 'brog khul dang / zhing phyugs las/ rong 'brog par dngos bkol lag rtsal zhabs phyi 'don sprod byed dgos/ sna so so'i ched las lag rtsal 'jon mi'i do dam byed thabs la bcos sgyur btang ste/ tshan rtsal mi sna lugs mthun sgos 'khor rgyugs byed chog pa dang / rgya che'i tshan rtsal mi sna khrom ra'i phyogs su bskyod par skul lcag dang khrid ston byed pa/ tshan rtsal rnam pa can gyi dmangs gnyer khe las sgrub ste/ lag rtsal zhabs phyi'i bya ba bsgrub tu 'jug dgos/ 'di nas nan bshad bya dgos pa zhig ni/ tshan rtsal ched mngags pa gzhi rim du mngags nas bya gzhag gsar gtod kyi las 'gul spel bar rgyab skyor dang / tshan col gyis zhing phyugs las drag chas spras pa'i gom stabs je mgyogs su gtong bar skul 'ded gtong ba bcas kyi thad la/khul u dang khul srid gzhung gis tshogs 'du'i rjes nas da dung〈〈tshan rtsal ched mngags pa gzhi rim du mngags nas bya bzhag gsar gtod byed par 37

skul 'ded byed pa'i skor gyi lag bstar bsam 'char〉〉'grem spel bya rgyu yin pas/ sa khul so sos don dngos dang 'brel nas lag bstar byed pa'i bya ba legs 'dzin byed dgos/lnga nas tshan rtsal khyab gdal bya brje dragatu btang ste/ dmangs yongasakli tshan rig spus tshad mthor 'degs gtong ba'i steng nas 'gag brtol gsar pa 'byung dgos/dmangs yongs kyi tshan rig spus tshad mthor 'degs gtong bar dmigs nas tshan rtsal khyab gdal gyi slob gso'i bya 'gul shugs cher spel te/ spyi tshogs yongs kyi tshan rtsal khyab gdal gyi slob gsor zhugs tshad dang / tshan rig la dga' ba/ tshan rig slob pa/ tshan rig spyod pa'i spro snang bcas mthor 'degs gtong dgos/ ‘‘tshan rtsal bya 'gul gza' 'khor’’dang‘‘tshan rtsal lag rtsal khyab gdal nyin mo’’zhes pa'i ched don bya 'gul rtsa 'dzugs gang legs bgyis te/ tshan rig lag rtsal shes bya dang tshan col khrims srol srid jus shugs chen pos dril sgrog byed dgos/ rim pa so so'i 'go khrid las byed pas tshan rtsal khyab gdal bya bar shugs bsnan te kho tsho'i tshan rtsal khyab gdal 'du shes dang / tshan rtsal do dam gyi chu tshad/tshan rig jus chod nus shugs mthor 'degs gtong dgos/ tshan rtsal bya sgrub pa rtsa 'dzugs dang skul slong byas te rang khul gyi dpal 'byor spyi tshogs gong spel khrod kyi gnad sa dang / gtso gnad/ dka' gnad bcas kyi 38

gnad don la dam por dmigs su 'jug pa dang / sgos su‘‘thon las chen po lnga’’gong spel dang / dpal 'byor 'phar gnas gsar pa gso skyong /thon khungs gron chung dang / khor yug 'cham mthun yin pa'i rnam pa can gyispyi tshogs bcas kyi gnad don la dmigs su bcug ste/ brtag dpyad zhib 'jug dang / rig gzhung zhib gleng / rig gzhung brje res bcas rgya khyab tu spel pa'i rnam pa legs po zhig bskrun dgos/(gsum) mnyam 'dzin mnyam gnyer rgyun 'khrongs byas te/tshan rtsal las don gong spel gyi las 'gan don 'khrol yong bar skul 'ded gtong dgos/khul u dang khul srid gzhung gis tshan rtsal las don gong spel gtong bar ha cang mthong chen byed bzhin yod/ thengs 'di'i tshogs 'du ma 'tshogs pa'i sngon du/ tshan col sde khag gis gting zab cing rgya che ba'i brtag dpyad zhib 'jug byed pa bkod sgrig byas pas tshan rtsal las don gong spel gyi rigs lam dang byed phyogs thog mar chags pa dang / tshogs 'du'i rjes su khul u dang khul srid gzhung gis da rung〈〈khul yongs kyi tshan rtsal las don gong spel je mgyogs su gtong ba'i skor gyi bsam 'char〉〉'don pa dang / de ni deng phyin gyi dus skabs shig gi rang khul gyi tshan rtsal las don gong spel la gcig gyur bkod 'doms byed pa'i mdzub ston rang bzhin gyi yig cha zhig yin/ sa khul so so dang sde khag so sos nges par du 39

tshan slob khul dar 'thab jus kyi mtho tshad dang / tshan rtsal 'dzin pa ni 'phel rgyas 'dzin pa dang / yar thon la skul 'ded gtong ba'i mtho tshad nas 'greng ste tshan rtsal las don gong spel je mgyogs su gtong ba de nyin re'i gros rim gal chen du bzhag nas/ mu mthud du nang rkyen dang sgrig lugs gsar gtod byed pa/ dmigs tshad do dam dang dpyad zhib byed tshad je drag tu gtong ba/ tshan rtsal bya ba dang / rtsa 'dzugs/ 'go khrid bcas la shugs snon pa dang 'thus tshang du btang ste tshan rtsal las don khyon yongs nas gong 'phel 'gro bar skul 'ded gtong dgos/ 'brel yod sde khag gis rang 'gan rang 'khur dang / shugs sgril mnyam las/ 'brel ba dam zab bcas byas te las rigs so so dang / khyab khongs tshan col thon khungs gcig sgril bed spyod gtong ba dang / sde khag bar gyi nang rkyen mthun skyong 'thus tshang du btang ste/ nang rkyen skyen po dang / thon khungs mnyam spyod/ dam zab mnyam las kyi tshan col yar thon sgril shugs chags par byas te/ mnyam du tshan col las don gong spel gtong bar skul 'ded gtong dgos/blo mthun rnam pa/ tshan rtsal las don ni 'cham mthun rma lho 'dzugs skrun dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi zhing sde gsar pa 'dzugs skrun la gang mgyogs sgos skul 'ded gtong ba/ spyi tshogs kyi khyon yongs dang / mthun sbyor/ rgyun mthud 'phel rgyas bcas mngon 'gyur bya ba'i rmang gzhi rang 40

bzhin gyi bzo skrun chen po zhig red/ nga tshos khul a dang khul srid gzhung ༄gi yang dag pa'i 'go khrid 'og thengs 'di'i tshogs 'du 'di 'gag rtsa dang sgul shugs su bzung ste tshan rig dang mthun pa'i 'phel rgyas lta ba khyon yongs nas lag len don 'khyol byed pa dang / gsar gtod mdun skyod/bya ba tan tig bcas byas te hur thag gis khul yongs kyi tshan col las don gong spel la rnam pa gsar pa zhig bskrun dgos/41

gsum/ gsar gtod gnad don dang de'i gzhi rtsa'i go don skor/mtsho sngon zhing chen rig lag rtsal thin gyi thinakrang gzhon pa/ ka'ospun lin/nyis stong drug lo'izla bdun par/sngon 'gro'i gtam/lo rgyus kyi 'khor lo dus rabs gsar par bskyod pa na/ srol rgyun gyi dpal 'byor dang spyi tshogs/ 'tsho ba'i sgrig rim sogs kun gyis lo rgyus kyi 'gran rtsod myong bzhin yod pa red/tshan rig lag rtsal spyi tshogs can dang dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas cha 'phrin can/ spyi tshogs 'tsho ba shes bya can bcas ni spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi gtso rgyun du gyur yod/ 'dzam gling gi rlabs rgyun ni rba rlabs bzhin du 'phyur gyin yod la/dedang bstun na dar thub pa dang / de dang 'gal na 'jig 'gro ba zhig red/tang krung dbyang gis lo rgyus kyi rlabs rgyun 'di dang bstun nas dus rabs 'di'i dus 'gor go skabs ma shor bar gsar gtod rnam pa'i rgyal khab 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i 'thab jus dmigs 'ben rngam brjid ldan pa bton zhing / 'di ni krung hwa dar rgyas su btang ste 'byor 'bring spyi tshogs 42

mngon 'gyur byed pa'i rlabs che ba'i 'thab jus kyi sgyur spo dang jus thag yin pas/ gting zab cing rgyang ring ba'i lo rgyus kyi don snying ldan/gsar gtod gnad don bton pa dang de'i gzhi rtsa'i go don skor/tshan rig lag rtsal gyis spyi tshogs la 'pho 'gyur slong bzhin yod/shes yon dpal 'byor dus rabs su slebs pa/phyogs bsdus rgyal shugs 'gran rtsod kyi dgos mkho/rgyun mthud 'phel rgyas yong chog pa'i dus rabs kyi dgos mkho/tshan rig lag rtsal gyis spyi tshogs la 'gyur ldog slong bzhin yod de/rlangs sgul 'phrul 'khor gyis bslangs pa'i lag rtsal gsar brje thengs dang pos gzhi khyon che ba'i bzo grwa dag mi rnams kyi mig mdun du byung du bcug pa red/ glog shugs gsar brje nas mgo bcoms pa na/tshan rig nyid thengs dang por lag rtsal dang sbrel ba la brten nas thon skyed nus shugs kyi rgyu char gyur pa red/ tshad rdul shugs rig dang ltos bcas smra bas spyi khog dang bye brag gi phyogs gnyis nas mi rnams kyi klad chen khrod kyi 'jig rten gyi dpe ris su gyur pa red/glog klad gsar gtod byas pa des mi'i rigs cha 'phrin gyi dus rabs su bskyal zhing / dra rgyas dus tshod dang bar snang je chung du btang /rgyu brgyud bzo bkod kyi lag rtsal bkol spyod byas pa des 'jig rten byed 43
rmyeṅge ṅgeyoṅgesbyi tshoga~X/

nye rabs kyi tshan rig dang lag rtsal/ thon las gsar brje bcas bar gyi 'brel ba/1760 1800 1850 1900 1950 2000thon las gsar brje dang po/thon las gsar brje gnyis pa/thon las gsar brje gsum pa/thon las gsar brje bzhi pa/thon lasagasar brje dang po/ thon lasagasar brjegagyispopa/ thonalasagasarabarjegasumopa/ thogalasagasar brje bzhi pa/'khela'athag 'phrul chas/ glog 'don 'phrulachas/ rtsis 'khor/ glog rdul phra rab kyi lag rtsal/rlangasasgral 'phrul chas/ glog sgul 'phrul chas/ ma rdul nusakhungs/ skye dngos bzo bkod sogs/thon lasagasar brje dang po/ thon lasagasar brjeganyisapa/ thon lasagasarabarjegasumopa/ thonalasagasar brje bzhi pa/nyi'u ton gyi shugs rig pa/ glog khab len rig pa/ ltosabacas rig pa/ cha 'azin smra ba/ rgyu brgyud smra ba/dus rabs gsar pa'i nang gi tshan rtsal yar thon gyi 'phel phyogs chen po/(1) phyogs bsdus can/ tshan rig lag rtsal de dus rabs21nang bstud mar phyogs bsdus can du 'gro ba red/ rang byung tshan rig dang nyer spyod lag rtsal/ rang byung tshan rig dang spyi tshogs tshan rig da dung rang byung tshan rig nang khul gyi mnyam bsres dang bsnol mar 'dres pa de sngar las dam tshags su 'gyur rgyu red/(2) rnyog 'dzing can/ zhib 'jug gi kha gtad yul de 'jig rten gyi khams dang sa'i go la/ dngos po dang tshe srog sogs rnyog 'dzing can gyi 45

ma lag kho na ma yin par/ mi'i lus phung ste mi'i rigs kyi ches rnyog 'dzing ldan pa'i ma lag khrod gting zhugs byed rgyu red/(3) cha 'phrin can/ dbyin thi dra rgyas ches rgya che ba'i khyab khongs nang sa'i go la yongs‘‘nya rgya 'dren thengs gcig gis yongs su 'dzin par byed’’thub pa dang / cha 'phrin lag rtsal dang thon las de 'dzam gling dpal 'byor gyi sgul shugs gtso bor byas nas mi'i rigs spyi tshogs de cha 'phrin spyi tshogs su 'gyur bar skul 'ded gtong rgyu red/(4) mgyogs myur can/ cha 'phrin lag rtsal gyi yar thon la brten nas tshan rtsal gsar gtod dang khyab gdal/ spo sgyur sogs kyi myur tshad je mgyogs su 'gro ba red/ de dang dus mtshungs su tshan rtsal grub 'bras dngos yod thon skyed nus shugs su 'gyur ba'i myur tshad de dus rabs20las je mgyogs su 'gro rgyu red/(5) chung gras can/ nā smi lag rtsal la dus rabs gsar pa'i nang du don dngos rang bzhin gyi yar thon byung yod la/ mi'i rigs kyi ngal rtsol yo byad la blo yul las 'das pa'i gsar bcos byung yod/ 'dis mi'i rigs kyi dngos po'i thon skyed kyi rnam pa rtsa ba nas bsgyur nges pas/ thon las gsar brje gsar pa zhig slong nges yin/(6) rgyal spyi can/ sa'i go la yongs kyi dpal 'byor phung po gcig can du 'gyur ba gting je zab tu 'gro ba dang / cha 'phrin dra rgya mgyogs 46

myur ngang yongs khyab tu 'gro ba dang bstun nas/ mi'i rigs kyi rgyu brgyud tsu'u 'char gzhi dang rgyal spyi'i bar snang sa tshigs kyis tshan rig 'phel rgyas kyi rnam pa gsar pa 'di mngon par byas zin/(7) ljang mdog can/ tshan rtsal dang dpal 'byor/ spyi tshogs/thon khungs dang khor yug bcas phan tshun mthun sbyor yin pa'i rgyun mthud 'phel rgyas yong chog pa'i lam bu zhig bdams gses byas te/ ljang mdog dpal yon 'dzugs grub byed rgyu de dus rabs gsar pa'i 'phel rgyas lta tshul gyi gtso rgyun du 'gyur rgyu red/(8) tshong ra can/ dpal 'byor dang tshong ra'i stobs shugs kyis tshan rtsal 'phel rgyas khrod kyi nus pa bstud mar je mthor song ste/ tshan rtsal 'phel rgyas la sgul shugs kyi nang rkyen gsar pa mkho 'don byas yod/( 9) spyi tshogs can/ tshan rig chen po'i dus rabs dang mi dmangs can gyi dus rabs su bskyod zin pa red/ tshan rig lag rtsal ni thon skyed nus shugs ang dang po yin la/ rgyal khab dang sa khongs 'phel rgyas kyi 'gran rtsod nus shugs gtso bor gyur nas spyi tshogs kyi sne khrid par 'phel rgyas 'gro 'go bcoms/shes yon dpal 'byor gyi dus rabs slebs pa/1990lor mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs kyi zhib 'jug las khungs kyis‘‘shes yon dpal 'byor’’gyi go don bton pa dang / 1996lor dpal 47

'byor mnyam las dang 'phel rgyas rtsa 'dzugs(02(ba)kyis〈〈shes yon rmang gzhi yin pa'i dpal 'byor〉〉snyan zhu bton pa red/199879lo'i 'dzam gling dngul khang gi‘‘'phel rgyas snyan zhu'i’’brjod bya ni shes bya dang 'phel rgyas kyi gnad don red/ sngon dpag byas na2030lor 'dzam gling yongs shes yon dpal 'byor gyi dus rabs su bskyod rgyu red/shes yon dpal 'byor ni shes bya dang cha 'phrin gyi thon skyed/ bgo bsha' dang bkol spyod bcas kyi steng nas btsugs pa yin la/ de ni 'dzam gling cha 'phrin myur bgrod can dang / tshong rdzas 'gran rtsod 'dzam gling can/tshan rtsal 'phel rgyas mtho gsar can du phyin pa'i dpal 'byor gyi rnam pa gsar gras shig red/shes yon dpal 'byor ni dus rabs nyi shu par mi'i rigs kyis dus rabs rjes mar bzhag pa'i shul bzhag dngos po rtsa chen zhig red/mi'i rigs kyi da bar gyi shes yon yod tshad la tshan rig lag rtsal dang do dam tshan rig cha 'phrin tshan rig dpal 'byor tshan rig spyi tshogs tshan rig sogs mi'i rigs kyi shes bya yod tshad 'dus pa red/ tshan rig lag rtsal ni srog shing yin/spyi'i khyad chos mdor bsdus na/shes bya'i cha 'phrin ni rmang gzhi yin/48

tshan rig lag rtsal ni srog shing yin/'jon mi'i rig stobs ni thon khungs yin/tshan rtsal gsar gtod ni khyad chos yin/tshong ra'i dpal 'byor ni nang rkyen yin/tshan rtsal dpal 'byor can dang shes bya'i dpal 'byor/shes bya'i dpal 'byor ni thon skyed nus shugs 'phel rgyas su phyin pa'i dus rim gsar pa yin/tshan rtsal de spyi tshogs kyi 'dzugs lugs dang thon las sde khag(tshan rtsal chen po'i dus rabs)tu gyur yod/thon las sgrig gzhi la 'gyur ldog gal chen byung yod/(thon las rigs bzhi dang lag rtsal mtho gras)shes bya ni rgyu nor dang 'jon mi ni thon khungs yin/(ngal rtsol gyi rin thang la phan nus med pa)shes yon dpal 'byor ni nus khungs kyi zad gron nyung ba'i dpal 'byor yin/(rgyun mthud 'phel rgyas chog pa)spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi tshad mtho ba'i cha 'phrin can/(cha 'phrin dra rgya dang sa'i go la'i sde ba) lag rtsal 'thab jus de rgyal khab kyi 'thab jus su gyur cing / tshan col 'phel rgyas kyis phyogs bsdus rgyal shugs mtshon pa red/49

phyogs bsdus rgyal shugs 'gran rtsod kyi dgos mkho/gsar gtod ni mi rigs yar thon gyi bla srog yin la/ rgyal khab dar rgyas su gtong byed kyi sgul shugs tshad med yin/ tshan rtsal gsar gtod nang rkyen 'dzugs rgyu de spyi tshogs ring lugs tshong ra'i dpal 'byor lam lugs 'dzugs skrun byed rgyu'i dmigs 'ben gal chen du brtsi dgos/(cang tse men/ 1995)rin thang gsar bskrun/kung zi'i 'gran rtsod nus shugs/khe las do dam/ srid gzhung gi srid jus/rgyal nang dpal 'byor/ rgyal spyi can gyi chu tshad/tshan rig lag rtsal/ rgyun mthud 'phel sa yong chog pa/ rmang gzhi'i sgrig bkod/rgyal dmangs kyi spus tshad/ dngul lor khor yugargyal khab kyi 'gran rtsod nus shugs/rgyal khab 'gran rtsod nus shugs kyi chags grub dpe ris/dus rabs sngon ma'i dus 'gor/ sa khongs sam mi ser spel yul gyi 'gran rtsod/zhi ba'i 'khrug chen gyi rjes/ 'dzam gling gi tshong ra 'phrog rtsod byed pa'i 'go brtsams pa/ da lta/ tshong ra'i 'phrog rtsod de tshan rtsal mdun thad dang shes bya'i bdag dbang ki 'gran rtsod thad nas thad kar mngon yod la/ dus mtshungs su 'du shes 'dzin stangs dang / smyan byed dang rig gnas tshod 'dzin dbang cha'i 'phrog rtsod dang 'grogs yod/50

'god dang tshod bzo/ thon skyed/ tshong gnyer dang tshong ra can bcas kyi bya 'gul rab dang rim pa zhig yin la/ shes bya'i gsar bskrun dang sgyur brje/ nyer spyod bcas kyi go rim zhig kyang yin/ de'i ngo bo ni lag rtsal gsar pa'i byung ba dang tshong las nyer spyod yin/de la lag rtsal gsar gtod 'dus la/ do dam gsar gtod dang rtsa 'dzugs gsar gtod/ zhabs phyi'i khyab khongs kyi gsar gtod kyang 'dus/ gsar gtod ni tshong rar 'brel ba dam zab yod pa'i bya 'gul zhig yin la/ khe las kyis tshong ra'i nang rkyen gyi skul lcag 'og thon skyed rgyu cha gsar du bskyar sgrig byed rgyu mngon 'gyur byed dgos/lag rtsal gsar gtod ni gtso bor rnam pa lnga'i steng nas mngon yod/1 thon rdzos gsar pa thon skyed byed pa/2 thon skyed byed thabs gsar pa nang 'dren byed pa/3 tshong ra gsar pa 'byed pa/4 ma bcos rgyu cha gsar pa'am phyed bzos thon rdzas kyi yongs khungs gsar gtod byed dgos par ma zad bkol spyod byed dgos pa/5 co 'dzugs byed thabs gsar pa nyer spyod byed dgos pa/phyogs 'di gcig po de spyir btang gi don snying steng gi zhib 'jug dang gsar gtod/ sgyur bcos bcas dang mi mtshungs pa red/ de'i 53

dmigs yul rang bzhin dang phan 'bras rang bzhin/ tshong ra'i rang bzhin ha cang drag la/ rang bzhin 'di gsum po'i khrod kyi gang rung zhig la ma slebs tshe tshang ma mngon 'gyur byed thub nges min/'dzam gling gi gsar gtod kyi 'phel phyogs bcu/1 tshan rtsal gsar gtod de 'dzam gling gi gzhi khyon can gyi rlabs rgyun drag po zhig tu gyur yod/2 shes bya'i thon khungs de tshan rtsal gsar gtod kyi rgyu cha ang dang por gyur yod/3 tshan rtsal mdun mtha' de gsar gtod 'gran rtsod kyi gnad sa gtso bor gyur yod/4 tshan rtsal mang 'dus de gsar gtod kyi rgyun bkol rnam par gyur yod/5 zhib 'jugadaperaphel rgyas—thon skyed de gsar gtod kyi cha tshang ba'i lhu tshigs su gyur yod/6 lag rtsal gsar gtod de gsar gtod gal chen gyi dgos nges kyi sngon 'gror gyur yod/7 rgyun mthud 'phel rgyas de gsar gtod kyi gzhi rtsa'i las 'gan du gyur yod/54

8 kung zi mnyam bsres byed pa de gsar gtod kyi nus pa gtsigs su 'dzin pa'i phan 'bras ldan pa'i thabs lam du gyur yod/9 nyen kha'i ma rtsa de gsar gtod dngul lor gyi gdung 'degs ka bar gyur yod/10 gsar gtod kyi 'thab jus de rgyal khab kyi 'phel rgyas la sne khrid byed pa'i phyogs ston du gyur yod/

bzhi/ tshan rtsaladang gsar gtod skor phran tsamagleng ba/gcan rdong bstan 'dzin/deng skabs 'dzam gling kun tu tshan rtsal dang gsar gtod ni rgyal khab dang spyi tshogs mi'i rigs bcas khyon yongs nas dar rgyas su 'gro ba'i sgul shugs nus ldan gcig pur ngos 'dzin byed bzhin yod pa ma zad/ sa khul dang mi rigs 'phel rgyas kyi bla srog dang / dngos po'i dpal yon dang bsam pa'i dpal yon gnyis kyi 'byung khungs gsar pa zhig bcas yin pa spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi lag len dngos las ra sprod gsal po byung dang 'byung bzhin yod/khyad par du dus rabs nyer gcig pa ni 'dzam gling rang bzhin gyi 'gran rtsod dus rabs yin la/ 'gran rtsod de mthar gtugs na/ phyogs bsdus rgyal stobs kyi 'gran rtsod dang / don dngos su mi'i 'gran rtsod dang mi'i shes yon gyi spyi tshad dang spus tshad/ tshan rtsal gyi chu tshad/ 'jon thang mi sna'i gsar gtod kyi nus pa'i 'gran rtsod nyag gcig red/'on kyang da lta rang re'i nub rgyud zhing 'brog sa khul la mtshon na/lo rgyus steng gi gsar gtod kyi 'bras bu mang po bed spyod byas dang byed bzhin yod na'ang da dung gsar gtod kyi ngos 'dzin dang / 'du shes/56

lta tshul/ 'bras bu thon tshad dang / khyab brdal gyi tshad bcas phyogs gang thad nas dus rabs kyi re ba dang bar thag nges can zhig shor yod/bar thag de yang nub rgyud sa khul gyi mi rnams lhan skyes blo rig dang shes rab dman pa ma yin par tshan rig dang gsar gtod la ngos 'dzin yang dag pa zhig med pa dang / tshan col gsar gtod bya bar gtsigs chen dang byed thabs/ blo sgo phyes pa mi 'dang ba bcas kyi mjug 'bras yin nges red/ de bas/ 'dir nub rgyud gsar spel gyi bzo bkod chen po'i khrod du rang re'i mtho sgang sa khul du tshan rtsal gsar gtod kyi 'du shesagasar pa zhig dang khor yug bzang po zhig chags ched de'i skor phran tsam gleng ba la/(gcig) gsar gtod rig pa'i skor/grogs po mang po zhig la‘‘go don’’dang‘‘sgra bshad’’ ‘‘mtshan nyid’’‘‘nges tshig’ sogs gleng tshe/ 'di ni 'tsho ba dang bar thag cung ring ba'i tshig skam don stong tsam zhig red snyam ste nyan 'dod med par 'gyur srid na yang / gsar gtod la ngos 'dzin gsar pa zhig dang khor yug bzang po zhig chags dgos tshe/ ma mtha' yang gsar gtod rig pa'i go don rags tsam zhig shes rgyu ni bshol thabs bral ba'i gnad don gal chen zhig tu gyur yod pa red/1 gsar gtod rig pa'i go don/57

gsar gtod rig pa ni mi'i rigs kyi gsar gtod bya 'gul chos nyid la zhib 'jug byed pa'i tshan rig cig yin la/ gal te klog pa po rnams kyis gsar gtod rig pa'i go don la ngos 'dzin rags tsam zhig byas tshe/ da gzod gsar gtod la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i chos nyid gang dag gis khyab yod pa dang / gsar gtod kyi bya rim/gsar gtod kyi khor yug gsar gtod pa/ gsar gtod bya 'gul gyi grub tshul re re dang / gnas stangs so sor rgyus lon bzang po zhig byed thub la/ rim gyis gsar gtod la ngos 'dzin dang gtsigs chen byas te rgya che ba'i klog pa po re re gsar gtod pa'i lam du phyogs nges red/ de nas mi re re gsar gtod bya 'gul gyi sngog 'don brgyud de mi'i nus pa'i thon khungs sngog 'don de rang bzhin gyis dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i gter mdzod gcig pur 'gyur nges yin pas/ mi phal che ba zhig la gsar gtod nus shugs ni gsang ba lkog gyur gyi gnas zhig dang / gsar gtod kyi 'bras bu ni tshan rig lag col pa re gnyis las mi phal mo cher gtan nas 'byung mi srid pa zhig red snyam pa'i nor 'khrul gyi lta tshul de yang rang bzhin gyis bsal te/ gsar gtod kyi nus shugs ni dbang bo skyon can re gnyis las gzhan/ rgya che ba'i zhing 'brog mang tshogs tshang mar gsar gtod kyi dma' rim nus pas khyab yod pa dang / su'i nus rtsal de sngon la sngog 'don byas na su zhig myur du gsar gtod par 'gyur thub pa/ gsar 58

gtod kyi nus rtsal der sus gtsigs chen dang sus sbyong brdar byas na/gsaragatod kyi 'bras bu de su la thob thub pa lag len gyis ra sprod byed thub nges red/bod yig gsar du btod pa la mtshon na/ thon mis lo1360sngon tsam la tsha grang dang gcan gzan gyi 'jigs pa sogs dka' khag sna tshogs khyad du bsal te phyi gling du slob sbyong la phyin nas lo bdun tsam na slob mthar phyin te phyir log lo ngo bzhi tsam la gting zab kyis zhib 'jug byas te/ mthar bod spyi'i skad dang nga ro'i khyad chos rnams dang yongs su mthun pa'i sgra sbyor gyi yi ge 'di'i srol btod cing / des gsar gtod kyi lam 'di ni ha cang bde bo zhig min yang mi su dang gang zhig yin kyang dka' khag la mgo bo ma sgur bar dkan gzar gyi rkang lam phra mor 'gos tshe/ da gzod 'od stong 'bar ba'i yang rtser snyeg thub pa'i re ba yod pa gsal bshad byas yod/2 gsar gtod kyi khyad chos/spyir gsar gtod ni gsar byung dang phan nus ldan pa tsam la ngos 'dzin byed bzhin yod la/ 〈〈deng rabs rgya bod tshig mdzod〉〉(74shutsho྾7dku)du gsar gtod ni‘‘bya thabs gsar pa 'then te gzhung lugs gsar pa brtsams shing / thon 'bras sam dngos po gsar pa la zer’’ces bstan yod/ 'dir zhib tu dpyad na/ bshad stangs de da dung cha tshang ba 59

zhig ma red snyam ste/ sgra bshad 'dis gsar(khya ))dang gtod(〉〉)gnyis so sor bkar nas bsam gzhigs btang yod na yang / de dag gzhi gcig tu bsdus te dpyad pa ma btang ba 'dra/ dper na/ bkra shis kyis‘‘bya thabs gsar pa 'then’’te 'tsho ba'i dka' khag sel ba'i‘‘thon 'bras gsar pa blangs na’’de yang gsar gtod dang / bkra shis gsar gtod par 'gyur ba'i nor 'khrul rang bzhin gyis 'byung srid pa dang / gal te rdo rjes‘‘bya thabs gsar pa 'then ’yod na'ang bya thabs gsar pa des 'tsho ba'i dka' ngal thag gcod byed ma thub na/ 'di gsar gtod du brtsi mi rung bar 'gyur/ phal cher‘‘gsar(rmyaglu)mi’gyi sngon 'gro tsam grub kyang‘‘gtod(tshomi) ’kyi mjug 'bras byung med pa lta bu red/de bas gsar gtod rig pa'i dgongs don gzhir bzung nas thon mis bod yig gi srol btod tshul sogs gsar gtod kyi don dngos mang po la dpyad zhib dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi gsar gtod rig pa'i tha snyad dang go don bcas zhib tu bsdur na/ ‘‘gsar’’zhes pa ni rgyun ldan las 'das pa dang / ‘‘gtod’’ces pa ni rgyun ldan las 'das pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng du dngos gnas kyi don snying ldan pa'i dngos po zhig gsar du btod pa la go dgos nges red/ skabs 'dir dngos po zhes pa ni bya thabs dang /gzhung lugs/ thon khungs/ don dngos bcas la go dgos/ de'i phyir/gsar gtod la nges par du khyad chos gnyis ldan dgos te/ gcig ni rgyun 60

srol las ma 'das na gsar du btod thabs med pas/ gsar du byung ba'i khyad chos ldan dgos pa las stabs bde'am bskyar bzlas tsam dang / sngar yod kyi rnam pa 'dra bshus tsam yin mi rung ba dang / gnyis ni dngos gnas kyi spyi tshogs don snying ldan pa'i dngos po sngar med pa zhig gsar du btod pa dang byung ba la gsar gtod rang bzhin nam gsar gtod nus shugs zer ba red/go rim gyi thad nas bshad na/ gsar gtod ni khyad par can gyi gnad don dang 'brel ba'i bya 'gul zhig red/ 'bras bu'i thad nas bshad na/ gsar gtod rang bzhin gyi 'bras bu de gsar gtod kyi rgyud rim khrod du gnas yod pa dang / gsar gtod rgyud rim gyi 'bras bu de spyi tshogs steng du phyir mngon yod pa red/ yin na'ang 'di'i nang du thon mi rang gi lta tshul dang shes rab kyi cha yod par ma zad/ gsar gtod kyi bsam gzhigs dang gshis ka sogs la dus rabs brgyad pa'i bod spyi tshogs kyi phyi yul gyi khor yug dang / bye brag gi cha rkyen nges can zhig gis phan nus thon yod pa smos ma dgos pa red/ 3 gsar gtod pa/ gsar gtod pa zhig yin tshe gsar gtod khyab khongs kyi srol rgyun chos nyid byang chub pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng du srol rgyun las 'das pa'i bsam blo gsar pa zhig kyang chags dgos la/ don dngos dang spyi tshogs la zhabs 61

'degs zhu ba'i kun slong gis thog ridrangs shing rang gi 'jon thang la brten nas spobs pa cher bskyed dang dka' khag khyad gsod kyi sgo nas kun slong de mngon 'gyur byas te/ spyi tshogs la don snying ldan pa'i dngos po gsar du btod pa'i nus pa 'dzoms dgos/'jig rten khams kyi mi su zhig yin rung / kho'i steng na tshad mi 'dra ba'i gsar gtod nus rtsal gyi gter kha yod pas khyab la/ gter kha de dag sngog 'don gyi tshad mi 'dra ba las/ gsar gtod kyi nus rtsal dang 'bras bu mi 'dra ba 'byung nges yin la/ gsar gtod kyi 'bras bu mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis gsar gtod pa'am mi so so'i lag rjes dang spyi tshogs shan shugs che chung yang gtan nas mi 'dra ba red/'bras bu de dag gis spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas la thun mong ma yin pa'i sgul shugs kyi nus pa 'dra min thon bzhin yod pas/ dus rabs nam zhig tu gsar gtod la mthong chen byas tshe dus rabs de'i 'phel rgyas mastsogs la/ rgyal khab dang sa khul gang zhig gis gsar gtod la mthong chen byas na/ de dag gi dpal yon gyi chu tshad mthon por 'gyur ba dang / mi rigs su zhig dang khyim tshang gang zhig gis mi'i gsar gtod kyi nus ༈la sngog 'don byed rgyu de gal chen zhig tu brtsis tshe/ mi rigs de dang khyim tshang de 'dzam gling mi rigs kyi dga' tshal khrod du yal 'dab rab tu rgyas pa'i me tog cig tu 'gyur nges yin pa lag len rnam gzhag gis ra sprod byed bzhin 62

yod/spyir na/ gsar gtod pa zhes pa ni gsar gtod khyab khongs kyi srol rgyun chos nyid byang chub pa waṃ bsam blo gsar pa rgo spyi tshogs la zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i bsam blo gsar byung khyab khongs kyi yon tan dka' ngal la mgo mi sgur ba'i snying stobs dang spobs pargogasar gtod bya 'gul la tshod 'dzin byed mkhas pasgogasar gtod pa yin no/ / spyi 'gros 'di bkol te zhing 'brog mang tshogs rnams kyis rang gi gsar gtod kyi nus pa’la tshod zhib byas tshe/ gsar gtod kyi col nus gang dag sbyong brdar dang /gang dag la shugs snon byed dgos pa yang rang bzhin gyis shes thub nges yin la slob gso pas slob ma chung dus nas rtsal nus 'di dag skyed sring byed par gtsigs chen byed dgos/(gnyis) bod yig bstan bcos las gsar gtod ces pa'i tha snyad kyi go don/spra mi mir gyur pa'i go rim khrod nas rim bzhin ngal rtsol yo byad kyi re snyeg je mthor gyur pas/ thog mar‘‘rus chas ’dang‘‘rdo chas’’kyi yo byad bkol ba nas da lta gsar gtod rig pa byung ba'i bar du gsar gtod la ngos 'dzin dang lta tshul sna tshogs pa zhig byung yod/de dang mnyam du gsar gtod ces pa'i tha snyad chags tshul la yang 'gyur ldog mang po zhig byung yod de/ dper na/ bod rgyal dgu pa spu de 63

gung rgyal gyi sku ring la/ blon po ru las skyes kyis shing bsregs te sol ba len pa dang / gser dngul zangs lcags kyi btso bzhu/ zhing las yo byad gshol dang gnya' shing / chu yur bar drangs nas zhing 'debs pa sogs kyi thabs gsar gtod byas pas/ skabs de'i zhing las thon skyed kyi phyogs la phan nus gsar pa zhig thon yod/ 〈〈chos 'byung mkhas dga'〉〉las/‘‘bod yul 'phrul blon mdzangs pa'i mi bdun gyi/ / thog mar gyur pa ru las skyes 'di yin/ /mdzangs pa'i las su shing bsregs sol ba byung / /de yis rdo bzhus gser dngul zangs lcags blangs/ / shing la mig phug gsholadang gnya' shing bzos/ / chu rka las nas phu chu yur du drangs/ /rmon pa dor bsdebs spang thang zhing du rmos/ /brgal bas mi thar chu la zam pa btsugs/ / mi’zhes dang / de nas bod rgyal bcu pa sad na legs kyi skabs su/ ‘‘de yi blon po lha bu mgo dkar zhes/ /khu khu ru las skyes kyi bu yis byas/ /'phrul blon mdzangs mi bdun gyi gnyis pa yin/ / mdzangs pa'i las su zhing la dor kha brtsis/ / zhes dang / bod rgyal so gcig pa stag ri gnyan gzigs kyi skabs su/ ‘‘'di nas khri ngor snang btsan mong gi bus/ / bre srang phul bcos 'bru mar tshad kyis bcal/ / de gong bod na tshong dang bre srang med/ / de'i phyir mdzangs mi bdun gyi gsum par grags/ / ’’zhes dang / bod rgyal so gnyis pa srong btsan sgam po'i sku ring la/ ‘‘thon mis bod yig thog mar mdzad pa'i phyir/ / bod phrug mdzangs 64

mi bdun gyi bzhi bar bsngags/ / ’’zhes dang / de nas gnyags khri bzang yang ston la/ ‘‘mdzangs pa'i las su ri khyim klung du phab/ /spo tho mkhar du brtsigs nas grong khyer bcos/ /'di yan bod kyi khang khyim ri la yod/ / desnyir bod kyi mdzangs mi lnga pa yin/ / ’’zhes dang / rgyal bo khri srong lde btsan gyi skabs su/ ‘‘'gos kyi blon chen khri bzang yab lhag gis/ /mdzangs pa'i las su gsom thang stong thang bcad/ / ’’ces dang / ‘‘stag btsan gdong gzigs blon po gnyer gyi bus/ / mdzangs pa'i las su dbyar rtswa dgun du bskams/ / ’’zhes pa 'di dag shis yang bskyar bden dpangakhyas pa ni bod rgyal dgu pa spu de gung rgyal te spyi lo'i sngon gyi dus rabs dang po tsam nas bod rgyal gdung rabs so brgyad pa khri srong lde btsan gyi sku ring ste spyi lo730bar du gsar gtod pa mang po zhig byung la/ don dngos su mdzangs mi bdun ni bod gna' rabs kyi gsar gtod pa chen po bdun dang / mdzangs pa'i las bdun ni gsar gtod chen po bdun yin pa yang zhor la shes par 'gyur/ de nas bod sil bu༄ thor ba'i rjes su gsar gtod de btsan po'i yig tshangs su bzhag nas bsngags brjod dang gtsigs chen gnang ba'i srol nyams pas/ rim gyis mdzangs mi dang mdzangs pa'i las zhes pa'i tha snyad 'di'i go don la yang 'gyur ldog byung ste spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi phyogs so so'i gsar gtod de phal cher rig gnas kyi phyogs kho na tsam la bkol zhing / rim bzhin mdzangs mi zhes pa ni rig 65

pa gsal ba'am shes yon can tsam la go ba las/ gsar gtod pa la go ba je nyung nas je nyung du gyur/ de'i phyir bod gna' rabs kyi lo rgyus steng gi‘‘mdzangs mimi’zhes pa dang phyis kyi‘‘mdzangs mi’’zhes pa gnyis ni yig gzugs tsam 'dra na yang nang don gyi khyab che chung mi 'dra bas/ mkhas dbang tshe tan zhabs drung gis mdzangs mi zhes pa mkhas pa'am lag rjes chen po can gyi don no/ / zhes gsungs pa ni khong gis bod kyi lo rgyus khrod kyi mdzangs mi zhes pa de la zhib 'jug byas rjes/ de mkhas pa tsam la go na khyab chung bar dgongs nas/ ‘‘lag rjes chen po can’’zhes 'grel bshad gnang ba red snyam/ de nas rim gyis gsar gtod la‘‘shing rta'i srol dang / gsar gtod pa la‘‘shing rta'i srol 'byed pa’’zhes pa'i tha snyad chags la/ de ni 'grim 'grul gyi brda chad cig ste/ sngar bgrod lam med sa zhig tu shing rta bgrod thub pa'i lam gsar pa zhig btod pa la shing rta'i srol dang / lam srol de gsar du gtod mkhan la shing rta'i srol 'byed pa zhes pa'i tha snyad chags par gyur/ de nas chos lugs dang rig gzhung khag gi steng du yang sngar med kyi gzhung lugs dang thabs jus gsar du btod pa la‘‘shing rta'i srol’’lam‘‘rgya chen spyod pa'i srol phyes’’ ‘‘zab mo lta ba'i srol phyes’’ ‘‘shing rta'i srol 'byed pa’’ ‘‘'byed byed kyi bstan bcos’’ ‘‘ji ltar phyes pa'i tshul’’ ‘‘phyes pa'i lam srol’’ ‘‘bod yig srol 'byed thon mi sam bho ṭa’’sogs byung ba ni don la gsar gtod pa dang gsar gtod kyi ming gi 66

rnam grangs tsam yin no/ / skabs 'di dag tu bod spyi'i tha snyad la gcig gyur gyi bkas bcad med pas/ gzhung lugs khyab khongs dang rig gnas khyab khongs/ chos lugs khag tu tha snyad de ltar chags yod na yang bod kyi zhing las dang phyugs las/ tshong 'grul/ dpal 'byor/ chab srid sogs spyi tshogs hril bo'i thad nas bshad na rim bzhin bkol spyod kyi rgya je chung nas je chung du gyur pa red/ khyad par du slob gso'i phyogs su gsar gtod rig pa bed spyod dang dar rgyas su btang ba ha cang mi 'dang bas‘‘mdzangs mi’’dang‘‘shing rta'i srol 'byed pari’ste gsar gtod pa je nyung nas je nyung du gyur pa red/deng rabs kyi spyi tshogs la mtshon na gsar gtod ni mi rigs 'phel rgyas kyi bla srog gsar pa zhig tu brtsi bar ma zad/ da dung rgyal khab dar rgyas kyi sgul shugs nus ldan zhig yin pa'i ngos 'dzin gsar pa byung yod na yang / dus deb mang po dang tshags par/ ming grags can gyi tshig mdzod dang rgya bod ming mdzod/ gsar rtsom dang sgyur rtsom gyi dpe cha'i nang du gsar gtod la‘‘gsar skrun’’dang‘‘gsar bcos’’ ‘‘gsar 'dzugs’’sogs gang 'dod ltar bris dang 'bri bzhin yod pa 'dis/ rang cag gzhi rim sa khul du tshan col gsar gtod ni 'phel rgyas kyi bla srog gyugasar pa zhig tu 'gyur thub med la/ thon skyed nus shugs ang dang por de bas 67
