kyang 'gyur thub med pas/ gsar gtod la ngos 'dzin gsar pa zhig dgos pa ma zad/ gsar gtod kyi chos nyid la slob sbyong dang / khyab gdal/ dpyad bsdur/ gleng brjod byed pa dang mnyam du gsar gtod kyi nus pa skyed sring byed par gtsigs chen byed dgos/(gsum) gsar gtod las byung ba'i bslab bya/mi'i rigs kyis dngos po'i dpal yon dang bsam pa'i dpal yon phun sum tshogs pa zhig gsar skrun byas yod la/ rang cag la mtshon na/phyogs ston 'khor lo dang / shog bu bzo thabs/ par skrun byed thabs/me rdzas sogs gsar gtod byas par ma zad/ da dung ru las skyes kyis shing bsregs te sol ba len thabs dang / gser dngul zangs lcags kyi btso bzhu/ blon chen lha bu mgo dkar gyis zhing la dor kha brtsi tshul/ khri ngor snang btsan gyis bre srang la 'jal tshul gyi thabs/ thon mis bod yig srol btod/ gnyags khri bzang yang ston gyis mkhar las dang grong khyer 'dzugs skrun/ khri bzang yab lhag gis gsos thang stong gcod tshul/ stag btsan gdong gzigs kyis dbyar rtswa bskams nas dgun spyod pa'i thabs gsar gtod byas pas mtshon te bod gna' rabs kyi gsar gtod pa chen po bdun dang / g.yu thog yon tan mgon poyobod kyi gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs gsar gtod byas pa/ grub chen thang stong rgyal pos chu la zam pa 'dzugs thabs sogs gsar gtod byas te mtho sgang gi 'phel rgyas la 68

byas rjes gsar pa bzhag yod par ma zad/ mi'i rigs kyi bsam pa'i dpal yon dang dngos po'i dpal yon gyi ldum ra chen por gya nom pa'i me tog mang po bskrun yod/yun ring gi lo rgyus khrod du mi rnams kyis gus bkur dang bstod bsngags byed sa phal che ba ni/ ne'u thin dang en si ten/ e ti sin/thon mi sam bho ṭa/ g.yu thog yon tan mgon po/ mgon po klu sgrub/ rgyal sras thogs med/ phywa ba chos kyi seng ge sogs rlabs chen mi sna'i gsar gtodakho na'i steng du phyogs pa las mi dkyus ma'i gsar gtod dang thon skyed las gnas dang po'i steng gi gsar gtod chung ba'i rigs rnams rim gyis snang med du gyur cing / mi yod tshad la gsar gtod kyi nus pa zhig gang na yod snyam pa'i nor 'khrul gyi lta tshul byung ba/ des rgya che ba'i mang tshogs kyi gsar gtod kyi lam rang bzhin gyis 'gags par gyur pa red snyam/gsar gtod ni mi'i rigs 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i bla srog dang / rgyal khab 'byor phyug ldan pa'i sgul shugs chen po zhig dang / ched las la gson shugs rgyas pa'i khrag rgyun dron mo lta bu zhig bcas yin pas/ chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ rig gnas kyis mtshon pa'i las gnas so so'i steng du gsar gtod kyi bya bar gtsigs chen byas te rim bzhin dpal yon gnyis la 'bras bu sngar las phun sum tshogs pa zhig bskrun rgyu dang / nga 69

tshos gsar du ngos 'dzin byed dgos pa zhig ni nyin re re gsar gtod dus tshod dang / mi re re gsar gtod byed mkhan/ gnas sa so so gsar gtod bya yul/ las so so gsar gtod bya bzhag tu 'gyur bar 'bad brtson bya dgos/ mgo khrid zhig la mtshon na/ gsar gtod la gtsigs chen byed min ni thad kar mang tshogs kyi dbul phyug dang ched las kyi dar rgud la rag las pa'i bya ba gal chen zhig tu brtsi dgos/mig sngar spus tshad slob gso dar spel du gtong ba'i sgang 'dir gsar gtod slob gso ni spus tshad slob gso'i gnad sa gcig pur grub yod pas/ slob grwa so so dang khyim tshang re re nas spyi tshogs hril bos gsar gtod slob gso'i phyogs la sngar las lhag par mthong chen dang shugs snon byed dgos/deng skabs kun spyod slob gso srog shing dang / gsar gtod rang bzhin dang don dngos gnyis gnad sar gyur pa'i spus tshad slob gso dar spel du gtong bzhin yod na'ang / nga tsho gzhi rim zhing 'brog sa khul gyi rgan dar byis pa'i slob khrid gang zhig yin kyang / dge rgan gyis sgo sam steng du ku shu zhig bris rjes slob ma rnams kyis dge rgan gyis bris pa'i ku shu'i ma phyi ltar bu bshu byas rjes/ slob mas rgyun du‘‘mtshungs dang mi mtshungs’’kyi lan btab ste tshad ldan yin min gtan phab byed bzhin yod/de ltar slob khrid de rgyun du sgo sam—slob ma'i mig—slob ma'i lag pa 70

brgyud de sgo sam steng gi ma phyi bu bshu tsam dang / mig dang lag pa'i go rim tsam/ 'dra bshus tsam dang bskyar dpar gyi go rim zhig tu gyur pas/slob ma re re'i mig lam du ri mo rnam par bkra yang / rang gi sems gting na ri mo gson po zhig med la/ mig lam gyi ri mo de mi gzhan gyi ri mo dang sems gting gi ri mo de da gzod rang gi ri mo yin pas/ gal te sems rgeting gi ri mo zhig gsar gtod byed dgos tshe slob grogs mang po zhig dang grogs po mang po zhig la dka' khag 'byung ba'i don dngos 'dis gnad don mang po zhig gsal bshad byas yod/ 'brel yod rgyu cha'i mtshams sbyor ltar na/ a— ri'i byis pa rnams ri mo'i slob khrid skabs su/ dge rgan gyis ma phyi dang rnam pa mi 'bri bar slob mas rang gi 'tsho ba dngos dang sems nang gi bsam gzhigs kyi rgyud rim khrod nas rang dbang gis ri mo 'bri ba red/ de bas/ a ri'i slob mas bris tshar rjes gzhan la‘‘bzang ngam mi bzang’’zhes 'dri ba tsam las‘‘mtshungs sam mi mtshungasari’zhes 'dri mi srid pa lta bu red/ de bas‘‘mtshungs sam mi mtshungs’’zhes pa gtso bo rnam pa'i bsam gzhigs kyi gnad don du gyur pa dang / ‘‘bzang ngam mi bzang’’zhes pa gtan tshigs bsam gzhigs kyi gnad don yin la/ dge rgan dang slob grwa/ spyi tshogs sogs kyi phyi rkyen las grub pa'i nus shugs 'di dag gis slob ma'i rang dbang gi 'phel rgyas dang bsam gzhigs kyi mdun ljongs la tshod 'dzin thebs yod pas/ slob ma'i sbyong brdar dang dge rgan 71

gyi khrid ston gnyis dbye ba gsal bor 'byed dgos/ slob ma'i gsar gtod rang bzhin skyed sring byed pa las thad kar khrid thabs med na yang /gsaragatod kyi shes bya dang rtsal nus kyi slob khrid la gtsigs chen byas te slob ma tshor chung dus nas gsar gtod kyi khor yug phun sum tshogs pa zhig mkho sprod byed ma thub na/ ‘‘bskyar dpar’mikho na tsam byed pa'i mi rabs gsar pa rabs dang rim pa mang po dang / 5bskyar dpar’’gyi khyim tshang mang po/ ‘‘bskyar dparamimigyi spyi tshogs shig chags tshe/ gsar gtod kyi dus rabs dang brda 'phrin gyi dus rabs dang 'tsham thabs med pas/ spyi tshogs hril bos gtsigs chen byed dgos so// 72

gcig zhing phyugs lag rtsal las/nas 'debs pa'i lag rtsal/(gcig) zhing 'debs pa'i gra sgrig1 sog shul 'dem pa/ skya 'debs mi byed pa'i ched du ske tshe dang sran rigs kyi sog shul 'dem dgos/2 sa thang snyom pa/ ston dgun la sa thang snyom pa/ lo tog bregs rjes dus ltor ston log rgyag pa dang / sa zhing mu'u rer phyugs lud smi lham pa2re 'jog dgos/ zla10ba'i zla dkyil la sa ngos rim bzhin khengs pa'i skabs su shal brgyab nas brlan 'dzin du 'jug pa dang dgu gsum par hro tho brdung ba sogs byas nas brlan 'dzin du 'jug dgos/dpyid kar sa thang snyom pa/ dpyid tshugs nas sa dros pa'i skabs su dus thog tu zhing 'debs dgos/ gal te ston log rgyag skabs lud bzhag med tshe sa zhing mu'u rer khyim lud smi lham pa gnyis nas gnyis dang phyed ka 'jog pa dang / zhing 'debs zhor dang sa snyom zhor byas nas ser 'dzin du 'jug dgos/ dpyid kar spyir btang du ston log brgyab pa'i sa zhing la gting 'debs mi byed pa dang shal brgyab nas ser 'dzin par byed pa yin/3 zhing la sman rdzos gtor ba/ ma btab pa'i sngon la dpyid 75

'debs kyi sa thang snyom pa dang 'brel nas40ṣṭhayi yug po gsod sman be ra'ospyi rgya0 2/ chu spyi rgya15nang du bsres nas sa ngos la gtor ba'am sa nang du sman bsres nas sa zhing steng du gtor te yug po'i gnod pa 'gog bcos byed dgos/ sman gtor ba'i skabs su shal rgyag zhor du zhing 'debs pa'am shal brgyab nas bde thang byed dgos/ sman gtor ba'i skabs su yid 'jog byed sa ni sman bsres nas dus yun ring bor mi 'jog pa'am lhag par du zhag 'gor mtshan brgal mi rung / char rlung gi nang du sman gtor na sman nus je chung du bud 'gro/4 sa bon legs po 'dem pa/ ma btab pa'i sngon la tshags mas sa bon tshags rgyag pa dang sa bon chag po dang sngo skam du song ba/ 'bru chung ba sogs bsal nas sa bon bzang bo 'dem dgos/ sa bon la slad ma 'dres pa'i tshad96gliyan la basmreb dgos pa dang gtsang tshad94ltayan la bsleb dgos/5 sman gyis sa bon 'phur ba/ ma btab pa'i sngon la sa bon gyi khri cha'i gcig gi 'bu phra 'gog sman402de sa bon ljid tshad kyi chu55nas7chogyi nang du bsres nas sa bon 'phur ba'am/ 255yi ta'o cun lin phye sman khe0 2chu spyi rgya25nas50nang du bsres nas sa bon dus tshod48la sbangs na nad khra thig 'gog thub/ 50ltayi chin lig 'o sgrum khe50yisas bon spyi rgya25nas50la 'phur na sa 'og gi gnod 'bu 'gog thub/76

(gnyis) zhing 'debs pa/ 1 sa bon 'debs pa'i dus skabs ni/ zla3pa'i tshes20nas zla4ba'i tshes10nyin bar btab na 'os shing 'tsham/2 sa bon gyi mthug tshad dang lud 'jog tshad/ mu'u re nas spyi rgya250thon pa'i re ba yod na mu'u rer sa bon spyi rgya19nas20'debs dgos pa dang sngo lud(gcin rgyu) spyi rgya5dang lin son ar an spyi rgya15'jog dgos/ mu'u re nas spyi rgya300thon pa'i re ba yod na mu'u rer sa bon spyi rgya20nas21'debs dgos pa dang / sngo lud(gcin rgyu) spyi rgya6dang lin son ar an spyi rgya15'jog dgos/ 3 'debs thabs/ bshur 'debs byed pa dang bar thag la lis smi15yod dgos/ sa bon sa 'og tu 'debs tshad lis smi3nas5yin dgos/btab rjes bcags byas nas ser 'dzin du 'jug dgos/(gsum) zhing kha'i do dam/1 myu gu'i do dam/ myu gu'i dus kyi do dam ni snga mo nas dam por 'dzinadagos pa ste/ snga mor 'debs pa dang snga mor yur ma yur ba/ snga mor sngo lud 'jog pa/ snga mor chu gtong ba bcas byed dgos/ tshigs thog rjes lud bzhag na mi bzang 2 sngo lud 'jog pa/ lo ma gsum 'bus pa'i dus su sa sob pa dang mnyam du yur zin pa'i zhing mu'u rer gcin rgyu spyi rgya2nas2 5yi sngo lud 77

'jog dgos/ snye ma gtong ba'i skabs su mu'u rer lin son ar ca spyi rgya0 3/ chuspyi rgya22 5nas30nang du bsres nas lo ma'i steng du thengs1nas2la gtor dgos/ myu gu zhan sar mu'u rer gcin rgyu spyi rgya0 5bsnan nas lo ma'i steng du gtor na myu gu'i skye 'phel la phan/kan lan dbyibs kyi ske che spus bzang gi 'debs gso lag rtsal/(gcig) sa bon bzang bo 'dem spyod dang sa bon gcig gyur gyis mkho 'don byed dgos/mtsho ngos las smi2600man gyi sa khul nas mtsho sngon rgyud 'dres ang gnyis parsā྾rngedngha 'dem spyod byed dgos pa dang / mtsho ngos las smi2600nas2800yi sa khul nas hu'u hphin010'am mtsho sngon rgyud 'dres ang dang po 'dem spyod byed dgos/ bar sa sa khul nas khin g.yu ang dang po 'dem spyod byed dgos/ ri ma sa khul nas mgo tshos ches snga ba'i kan lan dbyibs kyi rgyud 'dres sa bon mtsho sngon rgyud 'dres ang gsum pa 'dem spyod byed dgos/ rgyud 'dres sa bon bzang bo'i dge mtshan mngon pa dang spus tshad longs pa'i ched du/ lo gcig la btab pa'i rgyud 'dres sa bon de rgyun ldan gyi sa bon ltar rang gi sa bon la bzhag nas lo rjes ma'i sa bon byed mi rung / de ltar byas na rgyud 'dres sa bon kha gyes nas rgyun ldan ltar mgo mi tshos pa'i dbang gis thon tshad mar chag 'gro/ de bas thon skyed sa bon de nges par du gtan la phab pa'i mkho 'don sde khag gis 78

gcig gyur gyis mkho 'don byed dgos/(gnyis) zhing sa bzang bor bsnyam dgos/zhing sa bsnyams pa bzang ngan des ske tshe'i myu gu sa khar 'bud pa dang rtsa lag rgyas pa/ gzhung rta sbom pa sogs la shan shugs chen po thebs pa yin pas/ ston khar dus thog tu log brgyab nas nyi mar skem pa dang /dgun tshugs rjes shal brgyab nas ser 'dzin du 'jug dgos/ phyi lo'i dpyid kar dpyid log rgyag dgos/ spyir btang du nyis log nyis shal brgyab na chog chu ma sa cha nas dgun chu gtong ba dang ma btab pa'i sngon gyi nyin bco lnga yas mas la dpyid chu btang na sa sob pa dang spo tho med par 'gro ba yin/(gsum) snga 'debs bshur 'debs dang mthug tshad 'os mthun yin dgos/mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi ske tshe bzang bo ni kan lan dbyibs kyi rgyud 'dres ske tshe rigs gtso bo yin/ de 'debs pa'i dus tshod ni nyin re'i drod tshad cha snyoms tu'u2nas3gtan 'jags yin pa'i skabs 'os 'tsham yin/ spyir btang du chu ma sa khul nas zla gsum pa'i tshes nyi shu nas zla bzhi pa'i tshes lnga la btab na chog pa dang / bar sa dang ri ma sa cha nas zla bzhi ba'i zla stod dang zla dkyil la 'debs dgos/ de yang bshur 'debs 'phrul 'khor gyis bshur 'debs byed dgos/ ma btab pa'i sngon la sa 79

bon gtor khung tshad mthun yin min stoms sgrig byed dgos/ mu'u rer spyi rgya0 25nas0 5yin na ran pa dang / kha 'debs dang gting 'debs mi byed par bar 'debs(lis smi2nas3)byed dgos/ bshur 'debs kyi mgyogs tshad ha cang mgyogs mi rung bar ma zad/ dus dang rnam pa kun tu sa bon gtor khung nas sa bon gtor min la lta zhib byas te sa bon gtor khung gcod pa'i snang tshul mi 'byung ba byed dgos/gnam gshis kyi cha rkyen dang / sa gshis/ lud kyi khyad par/bdagaganyer gyi chu tshad/ sa bon gyi khyad chos bcas kyi dbang gis ske tshe spus bzang gi sa bon mthug tshad la khyad par yod/ spyir btang du chu ma gshin sa nas mu'u rer smyug rkang khri tsho1nas1 2'jog pa dang / sa cung gshin sa nas mu'u rer smyug rkang khri tsho1 3nas1 4'jog dgos/ than skam sa khul nas mu'u rer smyug rkang khri tsho1 5nas1 7'jog pa dang sa cung gshin sa nas mu'u rer smyug rkang khri tsho2'jog dgos/ ri ma sa khul nas mu'u rer smyug rkang khri tsho3nas6'jog dgos/(bzhi) lud ran pa 'jog dgos/ske tshe la lud 'jog stangs ni gting lud 'dang nges 'jog pa dang sngo ludakha snon byed pa/ me tog gad lud dang gang bu chags lud 'jog pa bcas gtso bo 'ga' gnad du 'dzin dgos/gting lud 'dang nges 'jog pa ni ske tshe snga mor 'bus pa dang bar du 80

legs por skye ba/ mjug tu sngo skam mi rgyag pa bcas la phan pa'i byed thabs gtso bo yin/ gting lud la skye ldan lud rdzas gtso bo yin dgos pa ma zad/ tan dang lin/ cwa bcas 'os 'tsham gyis sdeb dgos/ chu ma sa khul du mu'u rer skye ldan lud rdzas spyi rgya3500nas4000dang / gcin rgyu mu'u rer spyi rgya10nas12 5/trelin skyur ar an mu'u rer spyi rgya12 5nas15bcas 'jog dgos/ bar sar mu'u rer skye ldan lud rdzas spyi rgya2slo0nas3000dang / gcin rgyu mu'u rer spyi rgya10nas12 5/ lin skyur ar an mu'u rer spyi rgya7 5nas10bcas 'jog dgos/ ri ma sa khul du mu'u rer skye ldan lud rdzas spyi rgya10nas12 5bcas 'jog dgos/de'i nang gi gcin rgyu dang lin skyur ar an gnyis so so mu'u rer spyi rgya2 5sa bon dang phur nas 'debs pa dang lin lud tshang ma gting lud byed dgos/ ske tshe myu gu'i dus skabs 'tsho bcud gtso bo yin pa dang 'tsho bcud sdud pa'i dus tshod kyis skye 'phel dus skabs kyi505yas mas zin/ de bas sngo lud 'jog pa ni myu gu skyed pa'i gnad 'gag yin/ spyir btang du chu ma nasaske tshe'i myu gur lo ma4nas5thogs pa'i skabs su mu'u rer gcin rgyukṇi rgya3nas4chu gtong ba dang 'brel nas 'jog dgos par ma zad sa sob por bzos nas myu gu rgyas su 'jug dgos/ myu gur lo ma5nas6thogs pa'i skabs su chu gnyis pa gtong ba dang 'brelanas sa mu'u rer 81

gcin rgyu spyi rgya gsum nas bzhi 'jog dgos/ skam sa nas chu gtong ba'am shur slog pa'i skabs su mu'u rer gcin rgyu spyi rgya bzhi nas lnga 'jog dgos/rispa sa khul nas mu'u rer gcin rgyu spyi rgya2 5bzhag nas myu gu skyed gso byed dgos/ me tog gad lud dang gang bu chags lud 'jog pa ni snga mor smin pa dang gzhung rta sbom pa/ yal ga mang ba/ gang bu mang ba/ 'bru gu mang ba bcas kyi byed thabs gtso bo zhig yin/ ske tshe'i me tog gad pa dang gang bu thogs pa'i skabs su mu'u rer spyi rgya0 5dang / lin skyur ar an ka pa mu'u rer khe100chu spyi rgya50nang du sbangs nas gtor na phan 'bras mngon gsal yod/(lnga) myu gu gtan 'bebs dang myu gu'i do dam la shugs snon dgos/chu ma sa khul nas myu gu la lo ma2nas3thogs pa'i skabs su yur ma yur ba dang sa gtsab pa'i 'go rtsom dgos/ spyir btang du thengs2nas3la yur dgos/ sa gtsab pa'i gting tshad myu gu skye ba dang bstun je mang du gtong dgos/ 'di'i nus pa gtso bo sa sob por bzo ba dang rtswa yan bal nas rtsa lag rgyas su 'jug pa de red/ dus mtshungs su myu gu'i bar bsal ba ste/ myu gu mi bzang ba dang rgyud 'dres ma/ gzhung rta ring ba'i ske tshe 'bal dgos/ myu gu la lo ma4nas5thogs pa'i skabs su mthug tshad blang bya ltar gtan la phab na myu gu bskyed par phan/ ske tshe skye skabs su ske tshe la 82

gnod 'bu sna tshogs kyis gnod pa skyel srid pas snga mo nas sa bon la sman 'phur ba'am sman gtor nas 'gog bcos byas na phan nus che/(drug) dus mthun gyis 'breg pa dang dus thog tu g.yul gcog dgos/ske tshe 'breg pa'i skabs ni sa zhing yongs kyi80ltayi gang bu ser por gyur pa'i dus yin pa dang / skabs der dus thog tu 'breg dgos/ ske tshe sdud pa'i skabs su dal mor 'breg pa dang dal mor sar 'jog pa/ dal mor shog rgyag pa/ dal mor skyel ba sogs byed dgos/ gzhan da dung ske tshe 'breg pa'i skabs su 'breg zhor dang skyel zhor/ rtsig zhor bcas byed dgos/ ske tshe'i shog zhing kha nas 'jog pa dang nyi mar skam pa sogs byas na 'bras bu thor 'gro/ bregs pa'i ske tshe mnyam du bslangs nas bzhag na mgo tshos par phan/ nyin10nas15'gor nas tshang ma bskams rjes dus thog tu g.yul bcag na gyong gud je nyung du gtong thub/yug po 'debs gso lag rtsal gyi sgrig srol/(gcig) 'debs gso khyab khongs/sgrig srol 'di'i nang du mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi skye khams mi 'dra ba nas yug po'i rigs 'debs thabs dang de mthun gyi 'debs gso'i lag rtsal/zhing sa'i do dam/ 'breg bsdu/ gsog nyar dang las snon byed thabs sogs gtan la phab yod/83

sgrig srol 'di ni mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi mtsho ngos las smi2600las dma' ba'i sa khul nas yug po'i sa bon gyi zhing sa bzo ba dang mtsho ngos las smi4500las dma' ba'i sa khul nas gzan rtswa'i zhing sa bzo ba'i skabs su spyad pa yin/(gnyis) skye khams sa khul mi 'dra bar 'phrod pa'i 'debs gso'i rigs/1 shar brgyud zhing las sa khul/rong sa'i chu ma dang bar sa/ mtsho ngos las mtho tshad smi1650nas2600yi sa nas sa bon gyi zhing sa dang gzan rtswa'i zhing sa bzos na bzang ba dang yug po ches snga smin dang snga smin/ bar smin/ 'phyi smin/ ches 'phyi smin gyi yug po'i rigs sna tshogs 'debs dgos/ ri ma dang mtsho ngos las mtho tshad smi2600nas2900yi sa nas gzan rtswa'i zhing sa bzos na 'grig pa dang / ches snga smin dang snga smin/ bar smin/ 'phyi smin/ ches 'phyi smin bcas kyi yug po'i rigs 'debs dgos/2 mtsho sngon po'i mtha' 'khor sa khul/mtsho ngos las mtho tshad smi2800nas3500yin pa'i sa nas gzan rtswa'i zhing sa bzos na 'grig pa dang / ches snga smin dang snga smin/ bar smin/'phyi smin gyi yug po'i rigs 'debs dgos/3 mtsho ngos las mtho tshad smi36slonas4500yin pa'i sa nas 84

gzan rtswa'i zhing sa bzos na 'grig pa dang / ches snga smin dang snga smin/bar smin gyi yug po'i rigs 'debs dgos/(gsum) 'debs gso'i lag col/1 zhing thang snyom pa/ ma btab pa'i sngon la lud 'jog pa dang log rgyag pa(log gi gting tshad la li smi20nas30)shal rgyag pa bcas byas nas dus mthun gyis 'debs thub pa khag theg byed dgos/ 2 sa bon 'debs pa/ (1) sa bon bzang ngan rim pa'i tshad gzhi/sa bon 'debs pa'i zhing sar rgyal khab kyis gtan la phab pa'i rim pa dang po'i sa bon gyi tshad gzhi spyod dgos/ gzan rtswa'i zhing sar rgyal khabakyis gtan la phab pa'i rim pa gsum pa yan gyi sa bon gyi tshad gzhi spyod dgos/ snye2—6142nas1985〈〈snye ldan phyugs rtswa'i sa bon spus ka'i rim pa dbye ba〉〉zhes pa ltar yin/ (2) sa bon 'debs tshul/ sa bon 'debs pa'i zhing sar bshur 'debs byed thabs spyod dgos pa dang / bar thag la lis smi20nas25yin dgos/ bshur 'debs kyi bar thag la lis smi15yin pa dang btab rjes sa 'gebs pa dang shal rgyag dgos/ 85

(3) sa bon 'debs tshad/sa bon 'debs sa'i zhing sar 'debs tshad ni/ shar mo re'i 'debs tshad spyi rgya135nas180dang / gzan rtswa'i zhing sar 'debs tshad ni/ shar mo re'i 'debs tshad spyi rgya195nas240/ mis gtor tshad225nas270yin/(4) 'debs pa'i dus tshigs/mtsho sngon shar rgyud zhing las sa khul gyi sa bon 'debs pa'i zhing sar zla4ba'i zla stod nas zla dkyil du 'debs pa dang / gzan rtswa'i zhing sar zla4ba nas 'debs 'go rtsom dgos la/ ches 'phyi na'ang zla6pa'i zla mjug bar yin/ mtsho sngon po'i mtha' skor sa khul du gzan rtswa'i zhing sar zla4ba'i zla mjug nas 'debs 'go rtsom pa dang / ches 'phyi na'ang zla6pa'i zla mjug las 'gor 'gyangs byed mi rung / mtsho sngon lho rgyud sa khul du gzan rtswa'i zhing sar zla5ba'i zla stod nas 'debs 'go rtsom pa dang / ches 'phyi na'ang zla6pa'i zla stod bar yin/(5) sa bon 'debs pa'i gting tshad/gting tshad ni lis smi3nas4yin/ sa rgyu'i brlan tshad cung zhan pa'i skabs su li smi5las brgal mi rung /(bzhi) zhing kha'i do dam/1 yur ma yur ba dang lud 'jog pa/86

(1) yur ma yur ba ste/ myu gur gzhung lag rgyas pa'i skabs su yur ma yur ba'am rtswa sdum sel sman (spyi ching rer ha'o hring750spyod pa dang72ṣṭhayi 'ozhan2mi4—2/'am yang na lo ma che ba'i rtswa yan sel sman ha'o hring225chu spyi rgya375dang bsres nas gtor ba)bkol nas lo ma che ba'i rtswa yan sel ba dang / snye tshigs thon pa'i skabs su chu gtong rgyu'i cha rkyen yod pa'i sa khul du chu thengs gcig gtong ba/ me tog gi skabs su rtswa ldum yur ba dang rtswa yan sna tshogs sel ba'o//(2) lud 'jog pa/ sa bon 'debs sa'i zhing sa'i rmang lud du spyi ching rer skye ldan lud smi lham pa30nas45dang / 'debs lud du spyi ching rer lin skyur ar an spyi rgya135nas180'jog dgos pa dang / snye tshigs thon pa'i skabs su spyi ching rer gcin rgyu lud smi lham pa45nas75'jog dgos/ gzan rtswa'i zhing sa'i rmang lud du spyi ching rer skye ldan lud smi lham pa30nas45dang / 'debs lud du spyi ching rer lin skyur ar an spyi rgya75nas97 5gtor ba dang / snye tshigs rgyas pa'i skabs su gcin rgyu lud75nas120bcas 'jog dgos/2 gnod 'bu sel thabs/ yug po'i btsa' nad la btsa' sel phye ma'am hphul spel skyur gsher155gtor ba dang / snye nag la hphur ma lin nam yang na mtshur gsher55bkol nas sa bon sbang dgos/ skye dngos gnod 'bu dang 'byar 'bu sogs gnod 'bu la spyi ching rer2 5lkoyi por 87

chin cus 'o zha ka snum khe375gtor dgos/(lnga) 'breg bsdu/sa bon 'debs sa'i zhing sa rkyang mar bsdu ba dang g.yul gcog pa/nyar 'jog bcas byed dgos/ gzan rtswa'i zhing sa snye ma gtong ba'am me tog gad pa'am mgo tshos la nye skabs 'breg dgos /(drug) sngo 'jog las sdon/ sngo rtswa bregs ma gnas der gdal nas 'jog pa dang / nyin1nas2la skam pa dang / dus tshod3nas4bar steng 'og brje dgos/ cung bskams rjes shog brgyab na chog la/ zhing thog nas bskams rjes yul du skyel yong nas khyim dang / gtan sdod sa khul/ khang klad/ sgo mgo/ gyang kha sogs la bzhag nas bsil skam byas te sngo skam rtswa'i chu 'dus tshad175man la bslebs rjes brtsigs nas 'jog pa'am 'thag nas rtswa rdul du btang ste nyar 'jog byas chog la 'bru ni rta dang nor/ lug bcas kyi gzan chas las snon byed pa'i rgyu cha bzang bo yin/phyugs las lag rtsal phyugs(lug)rgyud spel stangs/(gcig) khrom rgyud bzang bo 'dem dgos/khrom gyi rgyud pa'i bzang ngan gyis thad kar khyu rjes ma'i bzang ngan la shan shugs thebs bzhin yod pas khrom rgyud bzang bo 'dem dgos/(gnyis) 'o phyugs rgyun ldan ngang sbyig pa dang khams dmar 88

'bab par skul 'ded gtong dgos/mophyugs kyi gzan gso'i do dam la shugs snon pa dang mo phyugs la 'os 'tsham gyi 'tsho bcud dang 'tsho ba'i khor yug byin nas rgyud spel mo phyugs kyi shed 'dzin dgos par ma zad/ phyugs khang phyi'i 'gul skyod dang nyi 'od ldan dgos/ mtshan ma'i nus pa shor nas rgyun ldan ngang sbyig mi thub pa'i mo phyugs la skul rgyu spyad nas bkod sgrig 'os 'tsham byed dgos/(gsum) khrom gyi rgyud spel nus pa je mthor gtong dgos/khrom gyi gzan gso'i do dam la shugs bsnan nas/ de'i sha shed bzung ste khams dkar legs po dang mang po thon du 'jug pa dang / khrom gyi rgyud spel nus pa je mthor gtong dgos/(bzhi) bkol spyod byed lugs la brtsi srung byas nas rgyud spel ba'i lag rtsal gsar pa spyod dgos/mi'i thabs kyis thig le 'bab pa'i lag rtsal bkol ba/ 'di ni sbyig min la dpyad 'jog byed pa dang / yo chas bkru ba/ dag gtsang byed pa/bcud len pa/ bcud la bdag gnyer dang gsog gnyer byed pa bcas khams dkar gtong ba'i bar du zhib tshags ha cang che ba'i bkol stangs cha tshang zhig yod la/ gnad so so'i bar 'brel ba dam pas gnad gang zhig yin rung bkol stangs ma 'grig tshe rgyud spel nyams pa dang lu gu mi chags pa'i mjug 'bras bzo ba red/ de bas nges par du bkol spyod byed stangs 89

la brtsi srung nan mo byed dgos/ risgo phyugs kyi rgyud spel nus pa je mthor gtong ba'i ched du dus mnyam du sbyig pa dang dus mnyam du rtseb pa/mngal phrug srung 'dzin/ mngal phrug spo ba la sogs pa'i rgyud spel gyi lag rtsal gsar pa mu mthud du spyod dgos/ (lnga) lu gu chags min snga mo nas thag gcod byas te phru gu nyams pa 'gog dgos/mo phyugs la lu gu chags min snga mo nas thag gcod byas te/ lu gu chags pa'i mo phyugs kyi mngal phrug srung bar shugs bsnan nas mngal phrug rgyun ldan ngang skye 'phel 'byung du 'jug dgos/ lu gu chags pa gtan la phab kyang da dung sbyig pa'i snang tshul yod pa'i mo phyugs la sdeb nor byung ba las phru gu shor ba 'gog dgos/ lu gu ma chags pa'i mo phyugs la dus thog tu rgyu rkyen 'tshol ba dang der mthun gyi byed thabs spyad de dus thog tu gsab sdeb byed dgos/ mtshan mar nad yod pa'i mo phyugs la gnas tshul mi 'dra ba ltar thag gcod byed pa dang / gso thub pa gso ba dang gso mi thub pa dus thog tu 'dor dgos/(drug) mngal phrug 'chi ba dang skye shor du 'gro ba je nyung du gtong dgos/mo phyugs sna tshogs kyi mngal phrug 'chi ba'i rgyu rkyen dang chos nyid la rgyus lon byed dgos par ma zad dus thog tu byed thabs spyad nas sngon 90

'gog byed dgos/ dper na/ phag ma la mngal chags pa'i dus skabs snga ma'i nang du mngal phrug 'chi ba mang zhing / gzan geso'i do dam la shugs bsnan na mngal phrug la gnod pa 'byung ba je nyung du gtong thub/ ba mo yin na sdeb sbyor byas rjes kyi nyin7nas11bar la 'byung bas sman dbyin thun ha'o khe30brgyab na mngal phrug 'chi ba je nyung du gtong thub pa lta bu'o//(bdun) sgo phyugs la mngal mi chags pa'i nad 'gog bcos byed dgos/mngal mi chags pa'i rgyu rkyen gzhir bzung nas so sor byed thabs mi 'dra ba spyod dgos/ lhan skyes kyis mngal mi chags pa'i mo phyugs dus thog tu 'dor dgos/ 'tsho bcud ma 'dang ba dang bkol spyod 'os mthun min pa'i rkyen gyis mngal ma chags pa yin tshe gzan gso'i cha rkyen dang bkol spyod 'os mthun la brten nas thag gcod dgos/ spyir btang rang bzhin gyi na tsha'i dbang gis mngal ma chags pa yin tshe thabs lam bzang bo spyad nas myur du mo phyugs kyi rgyud spel nus pa bskyar gso byed dgos/sngo gzan las snon dang gsog nyar gyi lag rtsal/(gcig) sngo gzan bsnyal ba'i lag col gyi gnad 'gag 1 gtub pa dang bcags byas nas dbyang rlung bral ba'i rnam pa bzo dgos/91

sngo gzan bsnyal ba'i rgyud rim khrod rgyu cha gtub pa ci ltar thung ba dang ci ltar bcags song ba/ ci ltar kha dam pa yin na de ltar du bzang /bcags nan mo song na da gzod dbyang rlung bral ba'i cha rkyen skrun thub pa dang / da gzod 'o skyur 'bu phra myur du skyed thub la/ myur du chi ma'e 'bu phra dang gnod 'bu gzhan dag 'gog thub/ de bas sngo gzan rgyu cha nges par du thung ngur gtub dgos pa dang / de'i ring tshad lis smi2nas5yin na bzang / gtub rjes rim pa bzhin bsnyal dong du 'jog pa dang 'jog zhor dang 'chag zhor byed dgos/2 chu'i 'dus tshad 'os 'tsham yin dgos/sngo gzan rgyu cha'i nang du chu'i 'dus tshad65lhunas755yi bar yin na 'os 'tsham yin pa dang / thon skyed khrod rgyun du gsham gyi byed thabs spyad nas tshad 'jal bzhin yod pa ste/ rgyu cha gtub ma spar gang blangs nas cung zad phur ba dang / phyis su shed kyis btsir na mdzub bar nas chu 'dzum tshe chu'i 'dus tshad 'os 'tsham yin/ gal te chu ma 'dzum tshe chu ma 'dang ba yin pas chu cung zad snon pa'am chu 'dus tshad mang ba'i gzan chas nges can zhig snon dgos/ gal te mdzub bar nas chu'i thigs pa phreng rdog thor ba bzhin thon tshe chu mang song ba yin pas rtswa skam mam gzan chas skam po 'os 'tsham kha snon bya dgos/3 rgyu char nges par du mngar cha 'os 'tsham zhig 'dus dgos/92

'oskyur du 'gyur ba'i dgos mkho skong ba'i ched du sngo gzan rgyu cha'i nang du mngar cha 'dang nges shig 'dus dgos/ de'i mngar cha'i 'dus tshad15las nyung mi rung / snye ma can gyi skye dngos sam sog rtswa'i nang gi mngar cha'i 'dus tshad sngo gzan gyi blang bya dang mthun pas sngo gzan rkyang snyal byas chog sran rigs kyi gzan rtswa'i nang du mngar cha'i 'dus tshad nyung bas35nas5ltayi phye dang phub ma bsnan nas mngar cha je mang du gtong ba'am yang na snye ma can gyi gzan chas dang mnyam du sngo bsnyal byas chog de'i bsdur tshad2 1yin/ rī(gnyis) sngo bsnyal gzan chas kyi sdeb sbyor byed thabs/1 sngo bsnyal gzan chas/sngo bsnyal gzan chas la rigs ha cang mang / gtso bo sngo gzan log ril ma dang dong bsnyal ma/ 'gyig khug ma/ thang du brtsigs nas 'jog pa sogs so// sa dong dang gyo mog rdo ba/ ar 'dam/ 'gyig shog sogs kyi snod du bzos chog de'i sgrig gzhi dang rgyu chas gang zhig yin rung kha dam pa dang ljid theg pa/ gnon 'degs pa zhig yin na chog cung stabs bde zhing las sla ba ni sngo gzan dong bsnyal ma dang 'gyig khug tu gnyer ba de yin/ (1) sngo gzan bsnyal dong / 'di la sa 'og dang sa 'og phyed ma gnyis yod/ dang po ni sa 'og na chu med pa dang sa gshis cung bzang ba'i 93

sa khul du 'os/ gnyis pa ni sa 'og gi chu cung mtho ba'am sa gshis mi bzang ba'i sa khul du 'os/ sngo gzan bsnyal dong spyir btang du zlum po dang gru bzhi yin/ bzo sbun blang bya ni sra zhing 'thas pa dang mkha' dbugs mi rgyu ba/ thigs chu mi bzhur ba/ nang ngos 'jam pa/ kha che zhing zhabs chung ba/ bcags byed sla ba bcas yin/ dong gi che chung sngo rtswa mang nyung dang sgo phyugs kyi mang nyung / gzan ster ba'i dus tshod kyi ring thung ltar thag gcod pa yin/ spyir btang gi sngo gzan bsnyal dong la smi lham pa reragazan chas spyi rgya500nas600shong ba yin/ sngo gzan bsnyal dong gi shong tshad rtsis gzhi ni/ dbyibs zlum bsnyal dong gi shong tshadatho3 14spotshangs phyed2 mo dong zab/ gru bzhi nar mo'i bsnyal dong gi shong tshad ྈdong ring྾dong zhengadzedong zab/(2) 'gyig khug gi sngo gzan gsog nyar/ 'gyig khug nang du shong tshad nyung rung bstud mar mkho 'don byed pa'i gnas tshul 'og tu bkol spyod byas chog la/ 'gyig khug gis zhing ba'i khyim la stabs bde skyel yong /cu'u dbyi zhi 'gyig shog ngar btsir byas nas khug ma bzos chog pa dang /'gyig shog mthug tshad ha'o smi0 1las srab mi rung / spyi rgya0 5dang ha'o smi0 1mthug pa'i 'gyig shog gis ring tsha da la phal cher smi2 5yod pa'i sngo gzan khug ma zhig bzos chog khug ma re'i nang du rgyu cha gtub ma spyi rgya ha lam200nas250shong ba yin/94

2 sngo gzan rgyu cha/mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi sngo gzan rgyu cha cung phun sum tshogs/ de dag ha lam zhing las lo tog gi zhor rdzas dang gzan rtswa rigs gnyis su bkar chog zhing las lo tog gi zhor rdzas la ma rmos lo tog dang sran ma'i rigs kyi gzhung rta dang lo ma/ kun tha dang zhog khog la phug sogs sngo tshod kyi gzhung rta dang lo ma sogs yod/ snye ma btog rjes kyi ma rmos lo tog gi gzhung rta ni sngo gzan rgyu cha cung bzang bo zhig yin la/ sngo gzan snyal ba'i skabs su rgyu cha spyi rgya100rer chu spyi rgya5nas15snon dgos/ sran ma'i rigs kyi lo tog gi gzhung rta dang lo ma'i nang du mngar cha 'dus tshad cung nyung ba'i dbang gis rkyang snyal byas na mi bzang / de ni snye ma can gyi gzan rtswa'am mngar cha 'dus tshad cung mtho ba'i skye dngos dang mnyam du snyal ba'am/ yang na sing phye dang mngar khu bsnan nas snyal na'ang chog sngo tshod kyi lo ma'am rtsa ba'i nang du chu cung mang bas rtswa skam cung snon pa'am yang na skam rjes sngo snyal byed dgos/ gzan rtswa la gtso bo sngo rtswa dang ma rmos lo togayug po bcas dang / snye ma can gyi phyugs rtswa la rtswa yug dang ram pa/ gzhan yangasran ma'i rigs kyi phyugs rtswa la sran dmar dang sran ril sogs yod cing sngo rtswa ma rmos lo tog ni sngo gzan rgyu cha ches bzang bo yin pa dang / snye ma gtong ba'i skabs su bregs nas sngo snyal byed dgos/ snye ma can gyi phyugs rtswa spyir btang du snye ma thon pa'i dus skabs su 'breg dgos mod/95

'on kyang mngar cha 'dus tshad nyung bas rab yin na snye ma can gyi phyugs rtswa dang bsdebs nas bsnyal na bzang /3 sngo gzan gyi sdeb bzo/(1) sngo gzan dong bsnyal byed thabs/ sngo gzan dong du bsnyal nas gsog nyar byed thabs la phal cher bsnyal dong legs bcos byed pa dang rgyu cha bsdu skyel byed pa/ gtub nas dong la bsdu ba/ kha gcod pa bcas rim pa bzhi yod/bsnyal dong legs bcos byed pa/ thog mar bsnyal dong nang gi snyigs rdzas dang gzan lhag sogs phyir phyung nas gtsang phyags byed dgos/bsnyal dong rnying pa yin na byugs bdar byed dgos/ sa dong yin na dong ngos kyi sa drags 'dred pa dang brdung nas byugs pa'am dong zhabs dang phyogs bzhi la 'gyig shog 'ding dgos/rgyu cha bsdu skyel dang gtub pa/ nges par du stobs shugs gcig la sgril nas dus tshod thung ngu'i nang du sngo gzan rgyu cha dong khar bsdu skyel byed pa las dus tshod ring bor nyi mar g.yengs mi rung ba ma zad/ dusatshothog tu gtub nas myur du bsnyal dong du bsdu dgos/bsnyal dong du bsdu ba/ bsnyal dong du sdud pa'i skabs su 'dam dang snyigs rdzas sngo gzan nang du 'dres pa 'gog dgos/ rgyu cha gtub ma rim pa bzhin blugs nas bcags nan mo byed dgos/ gnad 'gag ni 96

bcags bzang bo 'gro ba de yin la/ lhag par du dong gi 'gram gzhi dang zur bzhi la bcags nan mo byed par yid 'jog byed dgos/kha gcod pa/ bsdus nas dong khar lis smi50nas70'bud du 'jug pa dang dong khar bud pa de dong kha dang phal cher che chung 'dra dgos/phyis su 'gyig shog bkab nas de'i steng sa yis gnon dgos la sa 'gebs zhor dang bcags zhor byed dgos/ sa'i mthug tshad la nyung mtha' yang lis smi10yod dgos/ nyin 'ga' 'gor nas sa cung tsam mar babs pa'i skabs suyang bskyar sa 'gebs dgos/ rjes su rgyun du lta zhib legs bcos byas nas chu dang dbugs mi 'gro ba byed dgos/(2) 'gyig khug nang du sngo gzan bsnyal thabs/ thog mar cu'u dbyi zhi 'gyig shog ngar btsir byas nas khug ma bcos rjes rgyu cha gtub ma nang du bcus nas rdzong ba dang dbugs phyir phud nas kha dam por bsdams dgos/ tsi gu'i gnod pa 'byung bar lhag par gzab dgos shing / rgyun du 'gyig khug nang gi dbugs phyi la mi 'gro ba byed dgos/(gsum) sngo gzan bsnyal ba'i lag col gsar pa/1 phyed skam gyi sngo gzan bsnyal thabs/ phyed skam gyi sngo gzan bsnyal thabs ni rgyu cha'i chu 'dus tshad mi 'dra ba las gzhan de'i sdeb bzo'i go rim phal cher 'dra ba ste/ dus ltar 'breg pa dang cung zad skam pa/ gtub nas snyal dong du bsdu ba/ bcags nan 97

mo byas nas kha dam por gcod pa lta bu'o//2 sngo gzan nang du sbyor rta 'jog pa/(1) sngo gzan nang du sbyor rta 'jog pa/ lag len gyi khrod du rtag paragacin rgyu bsnan nas sngo gzan nang du spri dkar 'tsho bcud mi 'dang ba'i gnad don thag gcod pa red/ tshad 'jal byas pa ltar na/ sngo gzan ma rmos lo tog gi nang du gcin rgyu0 5stibasnan na spri dkar 'dus tshad sngon chad kyi2 35de3 7glil je mang du 'gro ba red/ gcin rgyu snon pa'i skabs su tshad dang mthun dgos pa dang gcig sngo gzan rgyu cha tun re'i nang du gcin rgyu spyi rgya5re snon dgos shing / bsres nas 'dres su 'jug pa dang gnyis/ nor lug kho na la ster dgos pa dang gsum bcas la yid 'jog byed dgos/(2) rul 'gog dang gnod 'bu 'gog sman snon pa/ sngo gzan bsnyal nas langs dka' ba'i dus su skye med skyur dang rul 'gog sman dzas kha shas 'os 'tsham bsnan na myur du gnod ldan 'bu phra 'gog thub pa dang /sngo gzan rgyu cha rgyun ldan ngang langs par skul 'ded gtong thub la/ dus yun cung ring bor 'jog nyar byed par 'gan len yang byed thub/ rgyun spyod kyi dul 'gog dang gnod 'bu 'gog sman la 'di dag yod pa ste/skyur ka pa/ sngo gzan rgyu cha tun re'i nang du855nas90ltacan gyi skyur ka paspyi rgya2 8nas3 5snon dgos/ chon ka pa/ spyir btang du37lkonas98

40stiyi chon ka pa'i khu ba snon pa dang / de'i snon tshad sngo gzan ljid tshad kyi1 5ltanas3ltayin/ pin skyur ka pa dang nā tshwa yi spyod tshad sngo gzan rgyu cha'i0 1las brgal mi rung /(3) 'o skyur 'bu phra skyed pa/ 'o skyur 'bu phra spyad nas dngos pos grub pa'i skyur rta'am 'o skyur 'bu phra/ skyur rdzos 'bu phra las grub pa'i mnyam 'dres sman rdzas bcas skyed sring byas te sngo gzan rgyu cha'i nang du bsnan na rgyu cha'i khrod kyi 'o skyur 'bu phra'i rgyud 'phel skul 'ded gtong thub pa dang / gnod ldan skye dngos phra rab la myur du tshod 'dzin byed thub/spyir btang du sngo gzan rgyu cha tun re'i nang du 'o skyur 'bu phra skyed dngos khe250dang yang na 'o skyur 'bu phra'i sman rdzas khe450snon dgos/3 'phrul chas kyis shog rgyag pa dang thum rgyag thabs/ 'phrul chas spyad nas bregs pa'i gzan rtswar shog brgyab rjes thum rgyag 'phrul chas steng du bzhag ste 'gyig shog gis thum brgyab nas bzhag na chog(bzhi) sngo bsnyal gzan chas kyi bkol spyod/1 bkol spyod/sngo bsnyal gzan chas kyi kha bcad nas nyin40nas50'gor rjes bkol spyod byas chog bkol spyod byed pa'i skabs su sngon la dong kha'i sa bshu ba dang de nas kha phye ste rim pa bzhin blangs nas spyod pa las dong brko ba bzhin len mi rung / blangs rjes dus thog tu kha legs por bkab nas 99
—hūṃs kyi ljejo mede snye sgrorme0sderme snyeṅge —rerme rgezarne sgye —sgro 75rnye1re/

gnyis/ tshan rig dang mthun pa'i 'phrod bsten bde thang shes bya/bde thang gi 'cho ba rol stangs/(gcig) bde thang gi tshad gzhi bcu/lus stobs rgyas shing sems shugs che ba dang / 'tshab 'tshub med pa'i sgo nas rgyun ldan gyi 'tsho ba'i 'gan theg thub la/ bya ba'i 'gan lci mo la yang thang chad pa'i nyams snang med pa dang gcig bya ba las par spro zhing rnam 'gyur bzang ba/ 'gan len par dga' ba/ bya ba che chung gang yin rung 'dem gses med pa dang gnyis/ngal gso shes pa dang gnyid 'dang ba dang gsum/phyi phyogs khor yug khrod kyi 'gyur ldog sna tshogs la 'phrod mthun yong ba dang bzhi/spyir btang gi cham pa dang 'go nad 'gog thub pa dang lnga/lus kyi ljid tshad ran zhing phung bo do mnyam pa dang / langs nas sdod pa'i skabs su mgo bo dang phrag pa'i gnas 'dra chags pa dang drugamig 'od gsal zhing tshor pa rno la gdong mdog skya bo min pa dang bdun/so dkar ba dang / rnyil na ba dang khrag 'bud pa sogs med pa/101

mdog rgyun ldan yin pa dang brgyad/ sku la 'od mdangs 'khyug cing kog shi med pa dang dgu/sha rgod rgyas shing skyi pags la mnyen cha ldan pa dang bcu bcas so//(gnyis) mi'i rigs kyi bde thang la shan shugs thebs pa'i rgyu rkyen/1 rgyud 'dzin gyi rgyu rkyen/ mi'i rigs kyi nad ha cang mang po zhig ni rgyud 'dzin gyi gzhi rgyu la 'brel ba che ba zhig ste/ dper na khrag thon sla ba'i nad dang lhan skyes sha bkra/ khrag shed mtho ba'i nad/ gcin snyi za khu'i nad sogs lta bu'o//2 sems khams kyi rgyu rkyen/ tshan rig zhib 'jug las mi'i rigs kyi nad ha cang mang po zhig sems khams kyi rgyu rkyen dang 'brel che ba gsal bshad byas/ da lta'i spyi tshogs kyi 'gran rtsod nyin re bzhin dza drag che ba dang / 'tsho ba'i rol stangs myur ba/ phyi yul rgyu rkyen sna tshogs kyis phog thug gtong ba tshang mas 'gro ba mi la sems khams mi bde ba sogs 'byung du bcug nas/ sems kyi bkag rdo dang sems khams la nyen kha bzo ba red/ bsdoms rtsis byas pa ltar na/ nye ba'i lo 'ga'i ring la sgo bsten sman bcos kyi nad pa'i khrod70ṣṭhayas mas kyi nad kyi 'byung rkyen spyi tshogs dang 'brel che bar snang /3 spyod lam dang 'tsho ba'i rol stangs/ 'os mthun min pa'i 102

bzang btung dang du ba 'then pa/ chang 'thung ba/ yun ring bor bsdad nas sbyong brdar mi byed pa/ sems 'tshab pa/ 'tsho bar go rim med pa/du nag 'then pa/ 'khrig sbyor nyog pa/ 'grim 'grul sgrig srol mi brtsi ba sogs tshang ma mi yi bde thang la gnod pa yod/4 khor yug gi rgyu rkyen/ 'di'i nang du rang byung khor yug dang spyi tshogs khor yug gnyis ka 'dus shing / rang byung khor yug ni mi'i rigs 'tsho gnas byed pa'i dngos po'i rmang gzhi yin pa dang / skye khams kyi gtor brlag dang khor yug 'bag btsog gis mi lus bde thang la gnod 'tshe bzo ba red/ gnod 'tshe 'di ni rgyu rkyen gzhan dag dang bsdur na/gnod nus dal zhing dus yun ring ba/ khyab khongs che ba/ mi grangs mang ba/ mjug 'bras tshabs che ba bcas kyi khyad chos ldan/spyi tshogs khor yug 'di la chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ tshan rigarig gnas/ slob gso/ bde srung / sdod gnas sogs 'dus shing /chab srid zing cha dang dmag 'khrug dbul phongs/ blun rmongs/ sdod gnas dog pa sogs spyi tshogs rgyu rkyen gyis bde thang la 'jigs snang ha cang chen po bzo ba red/ 5 skye dngos rig pa'i rgyu rkyen/ gtso bo nad rgyu skye dngos phra rab dang gzhan brten srin 'bu sogs nad slong ba'i rgyu rkyen 'dus/6 'phrod bsten zhabs phyi'i rgyu rkyen/ gtso bo 'phrod bsten bde 103

srung ma lag dang sman gso zhabs phyi'i chu tshad dang spus tshad 'dus/ gal te 'phrod bsten zhabs phyi dang spyi tshogs sman gso bde srung ma lag cha tshang min tshe sdod dmangs kyi nad la 'gog bcos legs po byed mi thub la/ mi rnams kyi bde thang la yar skul yang gtong mi thub bo// (gsum) bde thang gi 'tsho ba rol stangs kyi rgyu rkyen brgyad/1 'tsho bcud/ mi la 'tsho bcud cha snyoms po mkho/ 'tsho bcud dang shān we su'u 'dus tshad mang ba'i bza' chas dang 'bru rigs sna lnga za ba dang / sngo tshod dang sil tog mang po za ba/ snum dang spri dkar gyi 'dus tshad mtho ba'i tshi gu mang po za ba bcas dar spel du gtong dgos/2 'gul skyod/ 'gro ba mis 'gul skyod byed dgos/ rang gi lus khams kyi gnas tshul dang spro ba ltar rang nyid dang 'phrod pa'i 'gul skyod kyi 'char gzhi 'god dgos pa ste/ mgyogs por 'gro ba'am dal bur 'gro ba/yang na chu rkyal byed pa sogs kyi 'gul skyod rnam pa lta bu'o// yin na'ang de ni 'gul skyod kyi phan 'bras la bsleb tu 'jug pa ste/ lus ngar ba'i tshor snang 'byung ba'am rngul chu phran bu 'byung ba/ 'phar rtsa skar cha rer thengs130ldang bar byed pa sogs lta bu'o//3 chu/ chu ni tshe srog gi 'byung khungs yin pa dang / mi'i rigs chu dang 'bral thabs med/ chu gtsang ma ngoms rag bar du btung ba dang nyin rer chu dkar yol6nas8bar btung ba'i goms srol chags su 'jug 104

dgos/ chu 'khol btung ba dar spel du btang nas ka ra dang kho hphe dbyin/rlangs gzugs bcas 'dres pa'i btung bya mi 'thung ba bya dgos/4 nyi 'od/ nyi 'od la nus pa mi nyung ba zhig yod/ dper na/ nyi 'od nang gi smug phyi'i 'od zer gyis 'bu phra gsod pa dang / da dung lus phung nang gi 'tsho bcud 'grub par skul 'ded gtong thub pa bcas so//5 'dod par tshod 'dzin/ rang gi 'dod par tshod 'dzin byed dgos/ de'i nang du za 'dod 'thung 'dod dang / dngos po bdag gir 'dzin pa'i 'dod pa/ thob dang go sa/ mtshan dang snyan grags kyi 'dod pa sogs 'dus/6 mkha' dbugs/ rang byung khams chen por song nas mkha' dbugs gsar pa rngub pa dang / mkha' dbugs mi bzang ba'i nang du 'tsho ba ma rol na rab yin/ rang byung khor yug la srung skyong byas nas mi'i rigs kyi 'tsho gzhes khor yug gtsang ma yong bar yar skul gtong dgos/7 ngal gso/ mis ngal rtsol dang ngal gso zung 'brel byed dgos/bya ba las pa dang ngal rtsol byas pa'i rjes su ngal gso bzang bo byed dgos/de yang thog mar gnyid kyi dus tshod 'dang bar khag theg byed dgos/ gal te dus yun ring bor gnyid kyi dus tshod ma 'dang tshe nad 'gog nus pa je zhan du 'gro ba dang nad 'byung sla/8 dad pa dang yid ches/ sems khams rig pa'i phyogs nas 105

bshad na/ dad pa dang yid ches ni sems khams bzang bo snyom sgrig byed par med du mi rung pa'i rmang gzhi yin/ nga tshor bde thang thob 'dod na yid ches ngo ma yod dgos pa dang / tshan rig la yid ches byas nas yang dag pa'i bde thang gi 'du shes yod dgos/(bzhi) bde thang sman bsten gyi spyod lam/1 dus bcad ltar nad yod med la brtag pa/ dus bcad ltar nad yod med la brteg pa ni nad 'gog par ha cang 'gangs che bar 'dugadus bcad ltar nad yod med la brtag pa ni bde thang la 'gan khur ba'i spyod lam zhig yin la/ 'phrod bsten thon khungs nus ldan ngang bed spyod pa'i spyod lam zhig kyang yin/ dus bcad ltar nad yod med la brtag pa'i nang don la phyogs yongs nas rgyun srol rang bzhin gyi brtag zhib yod pa dang ched dmigs kyi brtag zhib kyang yod/ rgyun ldan rang bzhin gyi brtag zhib rnam grangs gtso bo spyir btang gi brtag zhib(lus kyi mtho tshad dang ljid tshad 'phar rtsa/ mig shed khrag shed sogs 'dus)dang / khrag dang chu/rtsa'i rgyun srol gyi brtag zhib/ mchin nus dang mchin nad kha pa'i rnam grangs lnga'i brtag zhib/ mkhal ma'i brtag zhib/ 2khri'o bcas yod pa dang / skyes mas da dung nu rdo dang mo nad la brtag zhib byed dgos/ched dmigs brtag zhib la gtso bo nad kyi dogs gzhi che ba'i mi tshogs la dmigs nas ched du brtag zhib byed pa zhig dang / 'bras skran 106

yod pa'i khyim rgyud kyi mi la 'bras skran la brtag zhib byed pa/ khrag shed mtho ba dang snying nad/ gcin snyi za khu'i nad dam yang na rgyud 'dzin rang bzhin gyi nad yod pa'i khyim rgyud kyi mi la ched dmigs kyis khrag shed dang khrag tshil/ khrag mngar sogs la brtag zhib byed pa lta bu'o//2 'gog sman rgyag pa/'di ni nad yams 'gog pa'i sman khab rgyag pa der bya zhing / ched du bzos pa'i rims 'gog sman khab dang nad 'gog ril bu spri dkar(yang na dug 'gog su'u)sogs thabs lam 'os mthun zhig brgyud nas mi'i lus la brgyab ste mi lus la nad yams 'gog nus khyad par can thob tu bcug ste mi sger ram mi tshogs kyi rims 'gog nus pa je mthor btang nas der mthun gyi nad yams (gtso bo 'go nad rang bzhin gyi nad)'byung ba dang mched pa sngon 'gog byed pa yin/'gog sman brgyab pa'i phan 'bras ni lha 'brum med par gtong ba dang / sib dang rgyungs pa klad skya'i gnyan tshad/ 'dus 'dril nad/nyin brgya'i glo nad/ mgrin nad sogs nad yams 'byung tshad je nyung du gtong ba de yin/ da lta cham rims dang rgyu tsha/ zwa 'brum/ mchin tshad ka pa/ mchin tshad kha pa/ glo tshad/ glo sbug gnyan tshad sogs kyi nad dang khyi smyon gyi nad bcas 'gog pa'i phyogs su rgya bskyed yod/bu phrug dang lhag par du btsas ma thag pa'i phru gu dang byis pa la 107

'char gzhi yod pa'i sgo nas 'gog sman brgyab na byis nad mi nyung ba zhig bkag ste kho tsho bde thang ngang 'tshar longs 'byung thub/ dar ma dang rgan pa/ lhag par du lus khams mi bzang ba dang dal langs rang bzhin gyi nad yod pa'i nad par cham rims kyi 'gog sman dang glo tshad ril srin 'gog sman/ glo sbug gnyan tshad 'gog sman sogs brgyab nas dar ma dang rgan pa'i bde thang la srung skyob byed pa dang / 'tsho ba'i tshad je mthor gtong ba/ sman gso'i 'gro gron je nyung du gtong ba bcas la mthun rkyen mang bo bskrun dgos/gsar mor zwa 'brum 'gog sman dang rma ngan dug mched kyi 'gog sman brgyab na mngal phrug ya ma gzugs dang sbrum ma dang bu phrug gi rma ngan dug mched sogs nad yams je nyung du gtong thub/3 sman pa'i gdams pa bzhin sman btung ba/ sman tho dang sman tho ma yin pa'i sman mi nyung ba zhig nad gzhi ltar sman pas gdams pa bzhin 'thung dgos/ dper na khrig shed mtho ba'i nad pas sman 'thung na/ khrag shed mtho ba'i dus bgo ba dang nad 'phar min sogs kyi gnas tshul gzhir bzung nas sman sna gcig gam sman sna 'ga' 'thung dgos par ma zad/ sman gyi mang nyung yang nad pa'i gnas tshul ltar thag gcod dgos/ khrag shed mar babs rjes nges par du dus yun ring bor dus bcad dang sman tshad ltar sman 'thung dgos/ skul rgyu 108

rigs kyi sman bsten dgos pa'i nad yin na sman tshad 'dang dgos la gso yun yang 'dang nges spyod dgos/ sman tshad rim bzhin je nyung du gtong ba las glo bur du sman mtshams 'jog mi rung / 'dus dril 'gog pa'i sman yin na dus thog dang mnyam 'brel/ tshad mthun/ nges srol/ gso yun hril bo bcas kyi sgo nas spyod dgos pa las 'thung 'dod na 'thung ba dang 'thung mi 'dod na mi 'thung ba bya mi rung /(lnga) 'phrod bsten gyi goms srol bzang bo chags su 'jug dgos/1 rgyun du sen mo btog pa dang / bza' btung gi sngon dang gsang spyod la song ba'i rjes/ las ka las pa dang rtse rjes lag pa bkru dgos/ 2 shog sgor rtsi ba dang shog nye zlog pa'i skabs su mdzub mor lce ldag bya mi rung / 3 nyin rer ngo dang rkang pa/ khog smad bkru dgos/ mi re rer rang rang gi lag phyis dang sder gzhong yod dgos/ byis pas nyung mtha' yang nyin rer ngo thengs gcig bkru dgos/ 'di ltar byas na sbrang nag 'gog thub pa dang ngo gdong la 'bag btsog chags nas nad 'byung ba 'gog thub/4 rgyun du lus dang mgo bkru ba dang / sku bzhar ba/ lwa bkrus nas brje gsor byed dgos/5 chu 'khol 'thung ba las chu 'khyag mi 'thung ba dang / sngo tshod dang sil tog bkrus nas za dgos/109

6 gang sar gcin skyag mi gtong bar spyod khang nang du gtong dgos/7 rgyun du nyal thul dang nyal gdan bkru ba dang nyi mar g.yeng dgos/8 zhogs pa dang dgung mor dus ltar so bkru ba dang kha zas zos rjes kha nang bshal dgos/9 tha mag mi 'then pa dang chang mi 'thung ba/ 10 'tsho bar go rim yod dgos/(drug) chu gtsang ma spyad na nad 'gog thub/dong chu dang rang 'bab chu/ 'os mthun gyi gnam chu dang chu mig sogs bed spyod byed pa'i khyim tshang gis ci ltar bed spyod byed tshul shes na khyim mi la nad 'byung ba je nyung du gtong thub/ chu gtsang’ma len sa med pa'i khyim gyis gal te gsham gyi byed thabs spyad na'ang nad je nyung du gtong thub/(1)dong chu'i kha kha leb kyis legs po rgyag dgos/(2)rdzing chu dang chu snyigs(lharge par du spyod khang nas thon pa'i btsog chu) de za ma las pa'i chu dang 'thung chu/ khrus byed pa'i chu bcas dang bar thag ring dgos/(3)chu len spyad dang chu zo/ chu rdza bcas gang thub kyis gtsang ma byed dgos/110

(4)'thung chu yod sar srog chags yong du 'jug mi rung /2 khyim nas gsham gyi byed thabs 'di dag spyad de chu gtsang srung 'dzin byed dgos/(1)btung chu ni kha leb yod pa'i snod gtsang ma'i nang du gsog dgos/(2)chu snod nang nas chu len pa'i skabs su thom bu gtsang mas len dgos/(3)mi su zhig yin rung chu snod nang du lag pa mi sgre ba dang chu snod la kha gtad nas chu mi 'thung ba/ (4)srog chags khang pa'i nang du 'gro ru 'jug mi dung /3 chu 'khyag mi 'thung bar chu khol 'thung na nad 'gog thub/(1) chu khol rjes 'thung na chu brgyud nas mched pa'i nad yams 'gog thub/ chu dwangs mo yin rung chu'i nang du nad 'bu yod/ 'thung chu gtsang ma ni 'gog srung yod pa'i dong chu dang chu mig 'os mthun gyis bsdus pa'i gnam chu'am chu rang 'bab bcas nas thon pa yin/(2)chu bskol nas khol na nad 'bu gsod thub/ de bas chu rdzing dang chu phran/ yang na 'gog srung med pa'i chu mig dang dong chu bcas nas blangs pa'i chu tshang ma bskol nas 'thung dgos/ lhag par du bu phrug gi 'thung chu nges par du bskol dgos/ rgyu mtshan ni kho tsho'i nad 'bu 'gog ri 111

nus mi dar ma las dma' bas yin/(bdun) 'phrod brasten spyod khang bkol ba/khyim tshang nas nad 'bu mched pa 'gog pa'i byed thabs gtso bo zhig ni gcin skyag gi gnad don thag gcod pa de red/ nad yams mi nyung ba zhig dang lhag par du khog pa bshal ba ni mi'am srog chags kyi gcin rtug khrod kyi nad 'bus bslangs pa zhig red/ gal te nad 'bu 'di dag gis chu dang bza' chas/ meg pa/ za ma g.yo chas sogs btsog par bzos na mis bza' btung gi skabs su nad 'bu khog tu song nas nad slong ba red/gcin skyag gi nang du 'bu phra dang gzhan rten srin sgong / nad slong skye dngos sogs yod pa dang / gcin skyag phyir btang rjes bkag 'gog gam ma bsad tshe khor yug btsog por bzo ba ste/ lag pa dang gon chas/spyod chas/ chu/ zhing sa sogs btsog por bzo ba dang / sbrang nag gis khyer ba'am khyim gsos srog chags kyis za ba/ mis thad kar nad rgyu la thug pa'am btsog 'gyur gyi bza' chas za ba bcas las nad yams 'byung ba red/de 'gog pa'i thabs lam ni 'phrod bsten spyod khang bkol spyod byed rgyu de yin/ 'phrod bsten spyod khang gi tshad gzhi ni gyang dang klad yod pa dang sa ngos sra ba/ gcin dong dang skyag rdzing las gcin skyag phyir mi 'dzum pa bcas yin dgos/ spyod khang gi nang gtsang ba dang sbrang nag dang 112

'bu med pa/ ha lam skyag dri mi bro ba/ gcin dong gi kha leb yod pa bcas bzo dgos/ 'phrod bsten spyod khang gi gnas 'os 'tsham yin dgos pa ste/lhas ra'i zur gcig dang sdod khang nas mar la rlung rgyu ba/ sdod khang dang thag cung ring ba zhig bcas yin dgos/ yin na'ang thag ring drags na stabs bde mi yong / mtho sgang gi rgyun mthong nad rigs kyi 'gog bcos/(gcig) cham pa dang dbugs lam ma lag gi nad rigs/rang zhing gi nad pa'i gnas tshul dang 'chi rkyen la rtog dpyod byas pa'i gnas tshul ltar na/ dbugs lam ma lag gi nad kyi spyi'i 'byung tshad16 06lkoyin pa dang nad rigs byung tshad kyi ang dang po red/ spyi'i 'chi tshad mi khri tsho bcu cha'i110 42yin zhing / nad rigs spyi'i 'chi tshad kyi ang gnyis pa yin la/ nang logs sa khul las ldab 'gyur gyis mtho/'di las dbugs lam ma lag gi nad rigs kyis mi'i rigs la gnod 'tshe skyel ba nyin re las nyin rer tshabs chen du 'gro bzhin pa gsal bor mtshon thub/ 1 nad thog mngon tshul/ (1)myur langs rang bzhin gyi dbugs lam gong ma'i gnyan tshad/myur langs rang bzhin gyi dbugs lam gong ma'i gnyan tshad kyi nad rtags gtso bo/ tsha rgyas pa dang mid pa skam pa/ za 'phrug langs pa sna 113

'tshub pa/ sna chu bzhur ba/ lu ba/ skad 'gag pa/ pho ba 'khyag pa/ rtsa 'gag pa bcas yin/(2)dal langs rang bzhin gyi glo yu'i yan lag gnyan tshad/rgyun mthong gi nad rtags ni‘‘lu ba dang lud pa mang ba/ dbugs 'tshang ba/ gnyan tshad yod pa’’bcas bzhi la bsdu chog dus yun ring bor 'phar ba dang lu ba ni nad rtags ches gtso bo yin/(3)dal langs rang bzhin gyi 'gag brnangs glo ba'i rlung skungs/'di ni dal langs rang bzhin gyi glo yu'i yan lag gnyan tshad 'phar ba las 'byung ba dang / glo yu'i yan lag dbugs 'tshang dang / glo yu'i yan lag je cher phyin pa sogs las glo ba rlung skungs 'phar ba'i skabs su glo lu dang lud pa yod pa'i khar rim bzhin je lcir song nas dbugs 'byin rngub byed dka' ba red/ (4)dal langs rang bzhin gyi glo snying bsdongs pa'i nad/nad 'di ni gtso bo nam zla 'khyag pa'i byang phyogs dang drod cing brlan che ba'i sa khul kha shas nas 'byung ba dang / grong khyer las zhing sde na mang / dgun dpyid la nad 'di myur du langs pa mang / myur langs rang bzhin gyi dbugs lam gnyan tshad kyis rgyun du glo nus dang snying nus nyams su 'jug pa dang 'chi tshad mtho/ nad rtags gtso bo lu ba dang lud pa yod pa/ 'gul skyod byas rjes dbugs 'byin rngub byed dka' ba bcas yin/114

(5)glo yu'i yan lag dbugs 'tshang /nad rtags gtso bo yang yang 'phar ba dang bsdongs nas mid pa nas sag sgra thon pa'i dbugs 'tshang rang bzhin gyi dbugs 'byin rngub byed dka' ba dang / sems 'tshab pa'am lu ba bcas yin/ nad ngo ma ma 'phar ba'i sngon la sna dang ngo / mig bcas la za 'phrug langs pa dang / sna chu bzhur ba/ sbyid pa bcas dang / dbugs rngub dka' ba dang sems 'tshab nas 'dug mi bde ba/ gan rkyal du nyal nas 'dug mi thub pa/skam lu rgyag pa'am lud pa nyung shas yod pa bcas yin/(6)glo tshad/nad byung ba mang che shos myur ba dang / lus tsha rgyas pa/ grang 'dar byed pa/ lus drod dus tshod 'ga'i nang du tu'u39nas40la 'phar/ nad pa'i tshor snang la lus yongs kyi sha gnad gzer ba dang / brang gzhogs na ba de phrag pa dang gsus par khyab nas/ lu ba'am dbugs gtong rngub byed skabs na zug je cher 'gro ba/ skabs 'gar skyug mer langs pa dang skyug pa/ gsus pa na ba'am khog pa bshal ba bcas kyi nad rtags mngon no//2 sngon 'gog byed thabs/(1)tha mag gcod pa/ tha mag gis mi'i rigs kyi bde thang la gnod pa chen po skyel bzhin yod pa red/ tha mag 'then na mi la gnod skyel ba tshan rig pa mang pos zhib 'jug byas te bden dpang thob yod/115

tha mag 'then tshe dal langs rang bzhin gyi glo yu'i gnyan tshad dang / glo ba rlung skungs/ tog dbyibs snying nad/ klad pa'i grib nad/ glo ba'i 'bras skun/ gre ba'i 'bras skran/ kha sbug 'bras skran sogs slong bar byed/(2)lus rtsal sbyong brdar la shugs snon dang phyi rol gyi bya 'gul je mang du btang ste/ gzugs gzhi'i rims 'gog nus pa je mthor gtong dgos/(3)drod srung bar yid 'jog byas te 'khyag tu mi 'jug pa dang /ngal rtsol dang ngal gso mnyam 'brel byas te cham nad sngon 'gog byed dgos/ cham nad ni glo yu'i gnyan tshad dang dal langs rang bzhin gyi glo yu'i yan lag gnyan tshad/ glo ba rlung skungs/ glo snying bsdongs nad sogs slong ba'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo yin/ grang ngar che ba'i dus tshigs dang yang na nam zlar 'gyur ldog che ba'i dus su 'os 'tsham sgos lwa ba je srab dang je mthug tu gtong bar yid 'jog byed pa dang / cham rims 'byung ba'i dus tshigs su cham sman 'os 'tsham 'thung ba'am yang na khang pa'i nang du tshu'u bdug pa dang / rgyun du sge'u khung phye ba dang nyal gos dang nyal gdan/sngas 'bol sogs bkrus nas nyi mar g.yeng ba bcas byas tshe/ nad dug thad kar gsod thub/ (4)grang thub sbyong brdar 'os 'tsham byas na cham nad 'gog thub pa dang / 'tsho bcud 'os 'tsham kha gsab byed pa ste/ nya dang sha smi/ 'o ma 116

dang sran bzos bza' chas sogs 'tsho bcud rin thang cung mtho ba'i zas rigs zos na rims 'gog nus pa je mthor gtong thub/(5)sman log tu 'gro sla na sman mi 'phrod pa la 'dzem dgos/(6)dal langs rang bzhin gyi glo yu'i yan lag gnyan tshad byung yod pa snga mo nas sman bcos byas te/ glo ba rlung skrangs dang glo bsdongs nad sngon 'gog byed pa dang / nad rnying 'phar ba dang nad je sdug tu 'gro ba 'gog dgos/ myur langs rang bzhin gyi nad 'phar ba'i skabs su dus thog tu sman pa bsten te/ sman pa'i mdzub ston 'og tu dug srin 'gog sman dang co sel dbugs snyoms kyi sman/ de min lu ba'i sman 'thung ba'am khab rgyag dgos/ dal langs rang bzhin gyi glo yu'i yan lag gnyan tshad dang glo ba rlung skrangs nad pas stabs bde'i 'byin rngub lus rtsal sbyong ba dang / 'byin rngub tshan khag gi sman pa'i mdzub ston 'og lus khams bde srungagi lus rtsal dang / skas 'dzeg sbyong brdar byas te/ dbugs 'byin rngub je legs su gtong ba dang / mchin dri'i nus par shugs snon byas chog(gnyis) pho rgyu'i nad rigs/rtog dpyod byas pa ltar na/ rang zhing du 'ju byed ma lag gi nad rigs byung ba'i nad pa ni nad rigs ma lag gzhan dag gi ang gsum pa ste13 10lkozin/ skyes ma skyes pa las cung mang ba dang / nad 'byung ba'i lo tshad lo40nas60bar red/117

1 nad thog mngon tshul/(1) pho ba'i gnyan tshad/ pho ba'i gnyan tshad ni nad rigs sna tshogs kyis bslangs pa'i pho ba'i 'byar skyi'i gnyan tshad yin zhing / spyir btang du myur langs rang bzhin dang dal langs rang bzhin gyi pho ba'i gnyan tshad de rigs chen po gnyis su dbye/ myur langs rang bzhin gyi gnyan tshad de 'phar ba myur zhing / mang shos la brang khog mi bde ba dang gzer ba/ yi ga med pa/ skyugs pa sogs kyi snang tshul yod la/ skabs 'gar pho bar khrag 'bab pa ste/ spyir btang du tshad nyung zhing bar mtshams yod la/ rang nyid kyis sman bcos kyang byed thub mod/ 'on kyang khrag mang bo shor tshe bshang ba nag por bsgyur yang srid/ dal langs rang bzhin gyi pho ba'i gnyan tshad de 'phar ba dal zhing / mang shos ni zas zos rjes mi bde ba'am gzor ba dang / go rim med par glo bur ram rgyun du gzer ba/yi ga med cing skyug mer langs pa dang skyugs pa/ pho ba sbos pa'am skyugs pa/ lus rid cing thang chad pa/ khog pa bshal ba/ lcags mi 'dang ba'i rang bzhin gyi zungs khrag nyams pa/ brang khog gzer ba/ lce'i dreg pa 'jam zhing nyung ba sogs kyi nad rtags yod/(2) 'ju byed rang bzhin gyi rma 'bras/ 'ju byed rang bzhin gyi rma ji'abras kyi nad rtags dpe mtshon can ni dus 'khor dang dus tshigs/mtshams tshigs ltar 'phar ba'i dal langs rang bzhin gyi pho kha dang brang 118

khog gzer ba de yin/ pho ba'i rma 'bras ni mang shos mtshams rer gzer ba dang / pho kha tsha ba sbos pa bcas dang / zas zos rjes cang ma 'gor bar na zhing na zug la go rim med pa/ mi gsal ba bcas yin la/ rgyu sor bcuganyis kyi rma 'bras ni mang shos zas zos nas dus tshod2nas3'gor rjes na zug langs te/ thengs rjes ma'i zas zos rjes da gzod bde la 'bab/(3) pho ba'i 'bras skun/ pho ba'i 'bras skun gyi rgyun mthong gi nad thog mngon tshul ni/ snga mor brang khog gzer ba dang / yi ga 'gag pa/zas la bro ba med pa/ skyug mer langs pa/ skyugs pa/ lus rid pa bcas kyi nad rtags mngon zhing / nad pa rgyun par rgyags sla ba(ltogs pa'i tshor pa yod na'ang zas nyung tsam zos rjes rgyags nas mi bde ba'i tshor pa 'byung)dang / lus po nyob pa'i tshor pa skyes/ 'bras skran de mid pa'i zhabs su 'dus skabs/ skyigs pa dang zas mid dka'/ pho ba'i rma 'bras rang bzhin gyi 'bras skran la khrag 'bab pa'i skabs su bshang ba nag por 'gyur ba dang / tha na khrag skyug la/ der mthud nas zungs nyams pa/mang shos ni brang khog gi g.yas gzhogs su skrangs 'bur yod la/ na gzer langs/ pho ba'i 'bras skran de glo ba dang mchin pa/ rus brang sogs lus po'i gnas mi 'dra bar khyab tshe/ nad rtags kyang mi 'dra ba 'byung /2 sngon 'gog byed thabs/ 119

bza' btung gi goms gshis bzang bo lobs su bcug ste/ dus ltar zas za ba dang zas tshod 'dzin dgos/ zas thun zas ngan ngon dang bzang bo bsdebs nas za ba dang / sngo tshod dang sil tog gi rigs mang po za dgos/ 'khyag drags la tsha drags pa'i zas rigs mi za ba dang / kha tsha ba'i zas rigs de bas kyang za mi rung / rgyun du sems pa skyid po yong thabs byed rgyu de pho ba'i rgyu lam gyi bde thang la mtshon na shin tu gal che/ tha mag gcod pa dang chang 'os 'tsham zhig las 'thung mi rung / gal te 'ju byed ma lag gi nad rigs yod tshe/ myur du tha mag dang chang gcod dgos/pho rgyu la gnod pa'i sman gang byung du mi 'thung ba dang/ bza' btung gi 'phrod bsten la mnyam 'jog byas te/ zas rul ba dang rgya srang gi 'phrod bstenakhag theg mi thub pa'i zas rigs za mi rung / lus zungs rgyas na 'ju byed nus pa'i rgyun ldan 'gul skyod la phan zhing / 'ju stobs legs pos kyang lus zungs rgyas su 'jug thub pas/ de gnyis ni gcig ram gcig 'degs yin/(gsum) mkhris pa'i nad rigs/mkhris pa'i nad ni rang zhing du 'phar ba mang ba'i 'ju byed ma lag gi nad rigs shig yin la/ rgyun du mthong ba ni gtso bo mkhris pa'i rde'u skun dang mkhris pa'i gnyan tshad yin pa dang / nad rigs sna tshogs las 'byung tshad ang lnga pa red/120

1 nad thog mngon tshul/(1) mkhris pa'i de'u skran(mkhris rdo)/ mkhris pa'i de'u skran ni mkhris snod dang mkhris sbug gi khag tu de'u skun byung ba'i nad rigs la ston/spyir btang du nad par pho ba sbos pa dang / skabs 'gar pho bar tsha langs pa dang / skyug pa/ skyur langs pa/ khog pa sbos pa sogs kyi nad rtags mngon zhing / nad rtags de dag snum can gyi zas rigs zas rjes je lcir 'gro ba dang / gal te mkhris snod rde'u skran yod tshe/ tsha langs pa dang brang khog la na gzer langs/ nad pa la lar khyad par can gyi nad rtags kha shas yod cing / de las ches 'bur du thon pa ni mkhris par zug gzer langs pa ste/ mang shos zas zos nas rgyags pa dang snum mang ba'i zas rigs zos rjes 'byung / na gzer langs ma thag pa'i skabs su rgyun mthud rang bzhin gyis gzer ba dang / de'i rjes su rim bzhin je drag tu 'gyur la/ tha na zug bzod mi thub pa'i tshad du bslebs pa dang / nad pa rgyun du btsog sdod mi bde ba dang / sgur ba/ 'gre log rgyag pa/ khu tshur gyis brang khog gnon pa/ tha na ngu ngag 'don pa bcas byed/ na gzer langs dus rgyun du rngul chu bzhur ba dang / ngo gdong skya bor 'gyur ba/ skyug mer langs pa dang skyugs pa sogs kyi snang tshul mngon/(2) mkhris pa'i gnyan tshad/ mkhris pa'i gnyan tshad mang shos mi dar ma dang tshon por 'byung zhing / nad rtags mkhris pa'i rde'u skun can 121

gyi nad pa dang 'dra ste/ gtso bo brang khog gi g.yas gzhogs la rgyun mthud rang bzhin gyis na gzer langs pa'am yang na gsus khog gi g.yas gzhogs na ba/ yang na phrag pa g.yas pa dang g.yas rgyab la na gzer langs pa/ skyug mer langs pa dang skyug pa/ tsha langs pa dang grang 'dar rgyag pa/ nad pa la lar mkhris pa thor ba sogs nad rtagasda mngon/2 sngon 'gog byed thabs/(1) mkhris pa'i nad rigs de mi rang nyid kyi bza' btung gom gshis dang 'brel ba dam po yod de/ dper na dus yun ring bor tshil mang ba'i zas rigs za ba dang / sngo tshod dang sil tog gi rigs za tshad nyung ba/ zhogs zas mi za ba sogs tshang mas mkhris khu bsags nas/mkhris nad slong bar byed/ de bas/ bza' btung gi goms gshis bsgyur nas/ snum che ba'i zas rigs nyung bza' dang / sngo tshod dang sil tog gi rigs mang bza'/ zhogs zas za ba rgyun 'khyongs bcas byas tshe/ mkhris nad kyi rigs sngon 'gog byed par phan/(2) lus col sbyong brdar shugs snon byas te lus po'i ljid 'phar bar g.yol na/ mkhris pa'i nad rigs sngon 'gog byed par phan/(3) mkhris pa'i gnyan tshad yang yang 'phar ba'i nad par mtshon na/mkhris snod len pa'i bshags bcos byed dgos/(bzhi) grum nad/122

rang zhing gi sa bab mtho la sa khams khor yug zhan pa dang / gnam gshis mi legs pas/ grum nad 'byung sla/ grum nad ni tsha grum byung rjes kyi nad 'gyur zhig ste/ rgyun mthong can dang yang yang 'phar ba'i myur langs sam dal langs rang bzhin gyi lus yongs la 'brel ba'i phung grub kyi gnyan tshad cig yin/ nad thog mngon tshul ni snying rtsa'i gnyan tshad dang grum bu'i gnyan tshad gtso bo yin pa dang / tsha langs dang khrag dug pags 'brum/ pags 'og rtsa rdog 'khrab nad sogs dang 'dres/snying rtsa'i gnyan tshad/1 nad thog mngon tshul/snying co'i gnyan tshad/ snying khams mi bde ba'am na gzer langs pa/snying 'phar ba/ khrag rgyas pa'i rang bzhin gyi snying nus nyams pa sogs kyi nad rtags yod/ rgyun mthong gi nad mngon tshul la/ snying gi 'phar tshad mgyogs drags pa dang snying je cher 'gyur ba/ snying lding ba'i sgra 'gyur ba/sgra lhad pa/ snying gi 'phar tshad mi snyoms pa/ snying shugs nyams pa bcas yod/ snying gi nang skyi'i gnyan tshad/ nad thog sman bcos thad/ snying rtsa'i khag cung skum pa'i dus su sgra lhad pa yin pas/ nus pa'i rang bzhin la gtogs shing / snying co'i nad 'gyur ram tsha langs pa dang khrag shed nyams pa sogs 'byung srid pa'i rgyu rkyen yin/ snying shun gnyan tshad/ nad par snying khams gzer ba'i snang ba skyes la/ nyan brtag byas tshe rgyun du 123

snying shun rdar sgra yod pa dang / smo'aphro thig gis zhib bsher byas tshe snying gi phyi mtha' drang snyoms yin pa dang / snying gi 'og phyogs che bar mngon/2 sngon 'gog byed thabs/(1) thog mar tsha grum 'byung ba sngon 'gog byed par mthong chen byed dgos shing / de'i gnad 'gag ni dug srin zlum phreng can gyis bslangs pa'i dbugs lam stod ma'i gnyan tshad dang gre ba'i gnyan tshad/ lkog then gnyan tshad bcas 'gog bcos byed pa de yin/(2) ngal rtsol dang ngal gso mnyam 'brel ngang lus rtsal sbyong brdar 'os 'tsham byas te/ rims 'gog nus pa je mthor gtong dgos/(3)bza' btung 'os 'tsham yin dgos pa dang / tshwa dang chu tshod 'dzin 'os 'tsham byed dgos/ (4) rang gis rang la bdag skyong bzang bo byas te/ nad je sdug tu 'gro ba 'gog pa dang / dus thog tu nad tshul 'gyur ba shes dgos/dreg grum/ 1 nad thog mngon tshul/de'i mngon tshul dpe mtshon can ni 'pho 'khyam rang bzhin gyi tshigs mang na ba ste/ rgyun par pus mo dang long bu/ phrag pa/ mkhrig ma/ gru mo/dpyi sogs kyi tshigs chen dag tu g.yas g.yon mnyam por 'khel ba red/cha shas dmar por 'gyur ba dang skungs pa/ na ba/ tsha langs pa bcas kyi 124

nad rtags mngon la/ rnag tu mi 'gro/ nad pa 'ga' zhig tshigs 'ga' mnyam du na ba dang / lag pa dang rkang ba'i rus tshigs chung ba'am sgal tshigs na ba'ang khyab che/ dpe mtshon can min pa la rus tshigs na ba las gnyan tshad gzhan gyi nad rtags med do//2 sngon 'gog byed tshul/ (1) thog mar tsha grum 'byung ba sngon 'gog byed pa gtso bor bzung ste/ grum nad co ba nas 'byung mi thub pa byed dgos/(2) rgyun du 'gul skyod dang lus col sbyong brdar byas te/ rims 'gog nus pa je cher gtong dgos/(3) grang rlung dang brlan 'gog dgos pa ste/ 'khyag tu mi 'jug pa dang / char gyis brlan pa'am brlan thebs su mi 'jug pa dang /brlan yod sar mi sdod pa/ nad 'gyur gyi rus tshigs la pus shubs sogs kyis srung skyob byed gang thub bya dgos/ rus tshigs kyi ljid theg dang 'gul skyod drag po'i tshad je nyung du gtong dgos/ (lnga) khrag shed mtho ba'i nad/ khrag shed mtho ba ni snying khams khrag rtsa'i nad kyi 'byung rtsa yin la/gal te khrag shed mtho tshe/ sman rdzos mkho bar ma zad/ de bas kyang gtso che ba ni khyod kyis sman pa dang ji ltar ram 'degs byed dgos pa dang / rang nyidakyi 'tsho ba sngar bas bde thang dang tshe thag je ring du gtong rogs ji 125

ltar byed dgos pa de yin/sngon 'gog byed thabs/1 tha mag gcod pa dang chang 'thung bar tshod 'dzin byed pa/2 tshwa khu za bar tshod 'dzin byed pa dang / bza' btung nang du mngar cha 'dus tshad dma' ba dang tshil nyung ba/ mkhris rgyu gsher rtsi dma' ba bcas yin dgos/3 ngal rtsol dang ngal gso zung 'brel byas te/ dus bcad ltar sgo bsten sman bcos byed par mnyam 'jog byed dgos/4 sems khams bzang bo zhig srung 'dzin byas te/ gnyid 'dang bar khag theg byed dgos/5 sil tog dang sngo tshod/ 'o ma/ zha smi skam po/ la phug sogs mang du bza' dgos/ (drug) gcin snyi za khu'i nad/gcin snyi za khu'i nad ni rgyun mthong gi snying tshab gsar byed rigs kyi gsang rgyud zags gsher gyi nad rigs shig yin la/ mang shos la rgyud 'dzin rang bzhin yod cing / cha rkyen nges can 'og tu 'byung ba dang /'tsho ba rol stangs mi legs pa ni nad de slong ba'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo yin no//sngon 'gog byed thabs/1 'tsho bcud 'os 'tsham yin dgos pa dang / tshil dang mngar cha 126

'dus tshad mang ba'i zas rigs la 'dzem dgos/2 lus shugs 'gul skyod dang lus rtsal sbyong brdar 'os 'tsham byed pa rgyun 'khyongs byed dgos/3 rgyun du gcin gyi mngar cha zhib bsher tshad len byas te/ nad snga mo nas shes su 'jug dgos/(bdun) ci zhig la tog dbyibs snying nad zer/tog dbyibs snying nad ni tog dbyibs khrag rtsa sra 'gyur las bslangs pa'i snying la khrag dang dbyang dkon pa'i snying nad rigs shig yin zhing / der‘‘khrag mi 'dang ba'i rang bzhin gyi snying nad’’kyang zer/ tog dbyibs snying nad kyi nyen kha'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo ni khrag shed mtho ba dang khrag spri mtho ba'i nad/ tha mag 'then pa bcas las gzhan/ da dung gcin snyi za khu'i nad dang / tsho 'bud pa/ lus shugs 'gul skyod kyis mi 'dang ba/sems 'tshab drags pa/ tog dbyibs snying nad can gyi khyim rgyud/ gshis rgyud rigs gcig gam yang na sbrum 'gog sman 'thung ba sogs so//sngon 'gog byed thabs/1 ngal rtsol dang ngal gso mnyam 'brel byed pa dang / sems pa snyom sgrig byed pa ste/ sems 'tshab pa dang sun snang / ngal dub las g.yol zhing / 'tsho bar go rim yod dgos/ klad pa 'gul shes dgos la/klad pa 'gul drags kyang mi nung /127

2 bza' btung lugs mthun yin dgos te/ bza' btung sman bcos kyi rtsa don ches gtso bo ni tshil dang mkhris rgyu gsher rtsi bsdu len byed tshad la tshod 'dzin byed pa de yin/ 3 lus shugs 'gul skyod de/ rang gi nus tshod kyis lus rtsal sbyong brdar dang lus shugs 'gul skyod du zhugs tshe/ khrag rgyun 'khor bskyod je legs su btang ste/ lus stobs rgyas shing tsho 'bud pa 'gog par phan no// 4 khrag shed mtho ba dang tog dbyibs snying nad can/ gcin snyi za khu'i khyim rgyud kyi mi bcas la mtshon na/ snga mo nas khrag shed dang khrag sbri'i 'gyuraldog la mnyam 'jog byas te/ byed thabs bstar na legs/ (brgyad) mchin tshad kha pa/mchin tshad kha pa ni mchin tshad kha pa'i nad dug gis bslangs pa'i 'go nad cig yin/ skyes ma thag pa'i byis pa dang phru gu'i dus su 'gos rjes/ cha snyoms byas na ha lam 'go mkhan phyed ka'i khrag gi nang du nad dug gnas la/ de'i khrod kyi mi khag cig nar son rjes dal langs rang bzhin gyi mchin tshad dang / mchin pa mkhregs 'gyur/ mchin pa 'bras skran bcas su 'gyur bas/ mjug 'bras ha cang tshabs chen yin/1 mched stangs/ —(1) ma'i steng nas phru gur 'go ba/ mchin tshad nad dug yod pa'i 128

sbrum mas mngal sbrum pa dang phru gu skyes pa'i brgyud rim du nad dug mngal gnas phru gu dang skyes ma thag pa'i byis par 'go bar byed/(2) lus 'brel las 'go ba/ mchin tshad kha pa'i nad dug dang lus 'brel byas pa brgyud nas pho mo phan tshun la 'go bar byed/(3) khrag bsher las 'go ba/ zhib bsher ma brgyud pa'i khrag dang /dug sel ma byas pa'i sman khab rgyag byed sbyod pa dang / so la khung bu brtol ba/ rna phug pa/ lus su ri mo gtsags pa/ so shad dam kha spu bzhar spyad mnyam spyod byed pa bcas las 'go bar byed/2 sngon 'gog byed thabs/(1) mchin tshad kha pa'i sngon 'gog sman khab rgyag pa ni mchin tshad kha pa 'gog pa'i thabs lam ches nus ldan zhig yin/(2) skyes ma thag pa'i byis pa yod tshad la mchin tshad kha pa'i sngon 'gog sman khab rgyag dgos/(dgu) thum 'bu'i nad/thum 'bu'i nad kyis mi lus kyi bde thang la gnod 'tshe bzo zhing /phyugs las thon skyed la bar chad bzo ba red/ de ni tsher ril rigs kyi rgyu srinaleb mo'i 'bu phrug de mi'am nor lug sogs srog chags kyi phung bo'i nang du gzhan brten byas te bslangs pa'i mi phyugs gnyis la byung ba dang /sa gnas su mched pa'i khyad chos ldan pa'i dal langs rang bzhin gyi gzhan 129

brten srin 'bu'i nad rigs shig yin la/ tsher ril 'bu phrug gi nad kyang zer/ thum 'bu'i nad de mchin pa'i thum 'bu dang glo ba'i thum 'bu/klad pa'i thum 'bu bcas su phye chog1 thum 'bu'i nad kyi gnod 'tshe/de'i thad kyi gnod 'tshe ni gtso bo thad rkyen gyi gnon shugs dang dug rgyu'i dug phog pa'i tshur snang yin/ rang zhing gi thum 'bu'i nad ni phal cher mchin pa'i thum 'bu dang gsus khog thum 'bu yin zhing / mi la mchin pa'i thum 'bu byung na mang shos ni mchin pa'i sdod rtsa mnyam 'dres kyi gnod shed che ba dang / mchin mtsher je cher 'gyur ba/ chu gsog pa/lus zungs zad pa/ rid pa/ ngal rtsol nus shugs nyams pa bcas yin pas/ khyim tshang dang spyi tshogs la khur bo lcid mo bzo srid/2 mi la thum 'bu'i nad ji ltar 'go ba yin/ tsher ril rgyu srin leb mo'i 'bu nar de khyi dang spyang ki wa mo sogs sha gzan srog chags kyi rgyu nag nang du gzhan brten byas nas dus yun nges can zhig tu slebs tshe/ rgyun chad med par srog chags kyi gcin skyag dang mnyam du 'bu sgong 'bor chen phyir phud de nye 'khor du khyab cing / nor lug gis rtswa za ba dang chu 'thung dus 'go sla la/ mi la mtshon na 'bag btsog gi chu khungs dang zas rigs/ khyi la rtse ba dang ri skyes srog chags rngon pa sogs brgyud nas kha nang du 'gro/130

3 sngon 'gog byed thabs/(1) khyi'i bdag skyong la shugs snon byed pa ste/ hur brtson sgos khyi'i steng gi 'bu phra med par bzo ba'i sman bcos spel ba dang / khyi'i 'go nad kyi tshad je dma' ru btang ste/ khor yug btsog por mi bzo bar khag theg byed dgos/(2) phyugs zog bsha' ba'i do dam la shugs snon pa ste/ bsha' ba'i sgrig gzhi'i 'phrod bsten la lta skul byed par shugs bsnan nas/ thum 'bu can gyi nang khrol do dam nan mo byed dgos pa las/ gang byung du g.yug pa dang khyi la ster ba sogs bya mi rung /(3) 'phrod bsten gyi goms gshis bzang bo lobs par byed pa ste/zas za dus dang gcin skyag btang rjes lag pa bkrus te/ nad 'go ba sngon 'gog byed dgos/ (4) 'thung chu'i 'phrod bsten je legs su gtong ba dang / chu khungs srung skyob byas te/ chu khungs la 'bag btsog thebs pa 'gog dgos/ (5) bde thang gi phyogs kyi slob gso gtong bar shugs snon byas te/nad 'go sla ba'i mang tshogs la srung skyob byed dgos/ lhag par du slob grwa chung 'bring du thum 'bu'i nad 'gog pa'i bde thang slob gso'i slob tshan bkod sgrig byed par gtsigs 'dzin byed dgos par ma zad/ slob grwa chung 'bring gi slob ma brgyud nas khyim tshang dang spyi tshogs la yongs khyab tu dril 131

bsgrags byed dgos/(bcu) pu lu hri 'bu phra'i nad/pu lu hri 'bu phra'i nad(bsdus ming la pu nad zer)ni pu lu hri 'bu phras bslangs ba'i mi phyugs gnyis la byung ba'i 'go nad de tshul ldog snang tshul gyi rigs shig yin/ pu lu hri'i nad 'gos pa'i sgo phyugs ni mi'i rigs la nad de 'go ba'i 'byung khungs gtso bo yin la/ de las gzhan ri skyes srog chags mang po'ang 'go nad de'i 'byung khungs byas chog pu lu hri'ind de 'ju lam dang skyi mo'i 'byar skyi/ dbugs lam sogs brgyud nas mi la 'go zhing nad phog pa yin/ des lus khrag 'bu nad dang khrag dug gi nad slong thub pa dang / dbang rtsa dang 'khor skyod/ skye 'phel/rims 'gog ma lag bcas dang / lhag par du rus tshigs ma lag la gnod pa bzo/ mi la pu lu hri'i nad byung rjes kyi nad rtags gtso bo ni lus tsha rgyas pa dang rngul chu bzhur ba/ lus yongs su shugs med pa/ rus tshigs na ba sogs yin/ pu lu hri'i nad la spyir btang du‘‘rlabs dbyibs tsha nad ’dang‘‘mngal shor nad’’/ ‘‘'phyi ba'i nad ’dam‘‘pā khrong nad bcas kyang zer/1 khor yug ci 'dra'i 'og tu mi la pu lu hri'i nad 'go sla ba yin/(1) zog nad pa'i 'phyi ro dang sha ma/ 'go chu sogs su pu lu hri'i 'bu phra 'bor chen yod pas/ mi rnams kyis lu gu skye len byed dus/ las 132

gos mi gyon la lag shubs kyang mi gon pas/ lag pa dang lwa ba'i thog tu pu lu hri'i 'bu phra yod pa'i zags thon dngos rdzas 'go ba smos ma dgos/'bu phra de sha skyi dang rma kha brgyud nas mi la 'go ba red/ gal te lu gu skye len byas rjes lag pa ma bkrus par zas bza' ba dang tha mag 'then na'ang pu lu hri'i 'bu phra de zas rigs brgyud nas mi la 'go srid/(2) phyugs zog nad pa'i zags thon snyigs rdzas kyis sa ngos dang chu khungs/ khor yug bcas btsog por bzos nas/ sa ngos bskams rjes pu lu hri'i 'bu phra de sa rdul dang mnyam du mkha' dbugs nang du khyab cing /mi rnams kyis pu lu hri'i 'bu phra rngub pa'am/ yang na kha'i nang du song ste nad phog pa red/ cho(3) pu lu hri'i nad byung ba'i sgo phyugs dang phyugs las thon dzas/de min ma bcos rgyu cha bcas la thug rjes dgos nges kyi 'gog thabs ma bkol ba dang yang na dug sel ma byas tshe pu lu hri'i nad 'go srid/2 sngon 'gog byed thabs/(1) pu lu hri'i nad ni gtso bo phyugs zog nad pa las mir 'go ba yin pas/ pu lu hri'i nad sngon 'gog byed ched/ phyugs zog nad pa med par gtong ba'am do dam legs po byed pa las gzhan/ pu lu hri 'bu phra'i 'go lam gcod pa de yang ha cang gal che ba'i thabs shig yin/(2) rgyal khab kyi〈〈ri skyes srog chags srung skyob bca' khrims〉〉brtsi 133

srung byas te/ ri skyes srog chags gang byung du gsod pa dang rngon par mi bya ba de yang pu lu hri'i 'go nad 'gog pa'i thabs gal chen zhig yin/(3) chu khungs bdag gnyer legs po byas te 'bag btsog thebs par g.yol ba dang / mi phyugs kyi 'thung chu dgar ba/ zog nad pa dang phyugs las thon rdzas la nges par du dug sel nan mo byed pa/ zog nad pa'i sha rlangs 'tshod dam rlangs pas btums 'tshod byas rjes ma gtogs bza' mi rung la/ 'o ma dang 'o rdzas kyang bskol rjes ma gtogs 'thung mi rung ngo //(4) 'gog sman brgyab ste/ mang tshogs kyi rims 'gog nus shugs je mtho dang nad phog tshad je nyung du gtong dgos/(bcu gcig) ci zhig la ten dkon pa'i nad zer/ten dkon pa'i nad ni rang byung khor yug khrod ten dkon pa las bslangs pa'i nad rigs shig yin/1 ten dkon pa las mi la thebs pa'i gnod 'tshe/ten dkon pa las mi la thebs pa'i ches che ba'i gnod 'tshe ni blo rig rgyas par gnod pa thebs pa de yin/ ten dkon pa las bslangs pa'i blo rig nyams pa de ha cang khyab che ba dang / ten dkon pa tshabs che tshe glen skugs sogs dbang bo skyon can 'byung srid/sbrum mar ten dkon tshe/ zla ma tshang gong phru gu skye ba dang mngal shor 134

ba/ phru gu lhan skyes rang bzhin gyi ya ma gzugs yin par ma zad/ de bas kyang tshabs che ba ni mngal gnas phru gu'i klad chen gyi rgyun ldan skye 'phel la gnod pa bzo ba red/ ten dkon tshe ol gong gsher rmen skrangs par byed la/ der‘‘lba ba ’zer/ tshabs che tshe mi'u thung du 'gyur srid/ btsa' lo ran pa'i bud med dang sbrum ma/ nu ma ldud kyin yod pa'i a ma/ phru gu dang byis pa bcas la ten 'dang nges shig kha gsab byed dgos shing / dmangs yongs kyis ten tshwa zos tshe phan nus ldan pa'i sgo nas ten dkon pa'i nad sngon 'gog byed thub/ten mi shor ba'i ched du/ ten tshwa nyos rjes kha dam por bsdams te/nyi 'od dang bser bu/ drod bcas phog par mi bya ba dang / yun ring du nyar bar mi bya'o//(bcu gnyis) byi rims/byi rims ni byi rims 'bu phras bslangs pa'i nad phog pa myur zhing yun thung ba dang / 'gos tshad drags pa/ shi tshad mtho ba sogs mi'i rigs kyi bde thang la gnod pa tshabs che ba'i 'gos nad cig yin/ rang byung cha rkyen nges can gyi 'og tu/ nad gzhi de lji bas srog chags(mtsho bod mtho sgang du gtso bo 'phyi ba yin)rigs la so btab nas phan tshun bar mched du bcug ste/ sa gnas rang bzhin gyi nad yams byung ba red/ mi rnams la mtshon na 'go nad byung ba'i srog chags la reg pa'am 'go nad 135

can gyi lji bas so btab pa las 'go ba red/1 byi rims kyi gnod 'tshe rang bzhin/byi rims kyis mang tshogs kyi bde thang la shugs rkyen ngan pa thebs shing / mi'i srog len par ma zad/ 'go nad mched pa'i sa khul gyi spyi tshogs bde 'jags dang dpal 'byor gyi 'phel rgyas la'ang shugs rkyen ngan pa thebs pa red/2 byi rims la nad rtags gang dag yod ce na/byi rims sna tshogs byung ba'i nad pa de nad phog pa mgyogs shing grang 'dar rgyag pa dang / tsha rgyas nas tu'u39nas40la thon pa/ mgo la gzer langs pa/ skabs 'gar skyug pa dang mgo yom 'khor ba/ dbugs 'tshang ba/ lus stobs shin tu nyams la snying gi 'phar tshad mgyogs shing do mi mnyam pa dang / rtsa 'phar tshad skar ma rer120yin/ gsher rmen byi rims kyi nad rtags gtso bo ni/ gong gsal gyi spyir btang gi nad rtags las gzhan/ gtso bo spen 'bras skrangs pa dang / de'i mtha' ru khrag rgyas pa dang khrag bzhur ba/ pags 'og phung grub dang 'byar ba/ rmen 'bras kyi mtha' gsal bo min zhing cung sra mo yin pa bcas so glo ba'i byi rims kyi nad rtags gtso bo ni/ de ni byi rims nad thog sman bcos ches tshabs che ba'i nad rigs shig yin te/ nad rtags gtso bo nilu ba dang brang khog na ba/ dbugs 'byin rngub byed dka' ba/ kha ngo 136

dang yan lag gi sha skyi skug por 'gyur zhing / lud pa'i nang du khrag 'dres pa'o//3 sngon 'gog byed thabs/(1) 'phyi ba dang srog chags la nad byung ba'am shi yod pa mthong tshe myur du yar zhu byed pa/(2) 'phyi ba dang srog chags gzhan dag gam yang na shi ba'i ro la mi reg pa dang / pags pa mi bshu ba/ sha mi za ba'o//(3) lji bas so 'debs pa 'gog ched/ 'phyi khung gi nye 'khor du ngal gso mi byed pa'o//(4) byi rims kyis shi ba'am yang na byi rims nad pa dogs can gyi khyim du 'tshams 'dri dang nad gnyor/ mya ngan zhu bar mi 'gro ba'o//(bcu gsum) gcong nad/1 gcong nad kyi gnod 'tshe dang mched stangs/mkha' dbugs las 'go ba ni gcong nad kyi mched lam gtso bo yin/'gulaskyod rang bzhin gyi glo gcong nad phog pa'i nad pa lu ba dang hab sbrid rgyag pa/ skad gseng mthon pos skad cha bshad pa bcas kyi skabs su 'bu phra yod pa'i mchil zegs phyir phud de mkha' dbugs khrod khyab la/ mi gzhan gyis de rngub rjes 'go sla ba red/gcong nad kyis mi'i rigs la lo ngo stong phrag du mar gnod 'tshe 137

btang zhing / des mi'i rigs la nad 'phar tshad dang 'chi tshad mthon po bzos pas/ lo rgyus steng‘‘gcong nad can bcu las dgu 'chi ’zhes pa'i bshadasrol yod la/ de las nad de'i gnod 'tshe tshabs che ba shes thub cing / de ni rang rgyal mi dmangs kyi bde thang la gnod 'tshe gtong ba'i dal langs rang bzhin gyi nad cig dang / 'dzam gling yongs su 'phar tshad ches mardzoba'i nad cig yin pa red/2 sngon 'gog byed thabs/(1) dmangs yongs la 'phrod bsten gyi 'du shes chags pa dang /mi sger gyi 'phrod bsten la mnyam 'jog byed pa'i slob gso gtong dgos/(2) 'ju lam la gnyan tshad langs par g.yol te/ zas yan gar du za ba dang zas snod sogs ched sbyod byed dgos/(3) nyal gos dang nyal gdan rgyun du nyi mar g.yeng ba dang / khang pa'i nang rlung rgyu ru bcug ste mkha' dbugs gsar pa srung 'dzin byed dgos/gcong nad kyi rdzas 'gyur sman bcos ni nad par sman bcos byed pa'i thabs lam nus ldan zhig yin la/ 'go khungs med par bzo ba dang gcong nad mched pa tshod 'dzin byed pa'i lag col gyi thabs shig kyang yin/thad kar gyi lta skul slob ston 'og gi yun thung bcos thabs(15)7༄5))ni deng skabs gcong nad tshod 'dzin byed pa'i sman bcos byed thabs ches 138
