nus ldan zhig yin/ des glo gcong byung ba'i nad pa mang shos sangs drag bzo thub pa dang / gcong nad 'go ba dang / sman gyis mi phan pa'i nad rigs sna tshogs 'byung ba 'gog thub par ma zad/ sman khang du sdod mi dgos par khyim nas drag tu 'jug thub pas/ rgya che'i rong 'brog mang tshogs kyi khur bo je yang du gtong thub pa ni de bas kyang smos ma dgos so//(bcu bzhi) lus 'brel las 'go ba'i nad rigs/mig sngar/ lus 'brel las 'go ba'i nad rigs 'go ba dang mched pa des mi'i rigs kyi 'tsho gnas dang spyi tshogs kyi bde 'jags/ dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun bcas la 'jigs snang chen po thebs la/ bud med dang byis pa/ na gzhon bcas la de bas kyang gnod pa tshabs che/ de'i phyir/ hur brtson sgos lus 'brel las 'go ba'i nad rigs 'gog bcos byed pa dang / sngon 'gog shes bya ches cher khyab gdal du btang ste/ lus 'brel las 'go ba'i nad rigs kyis mi'i rigs kyi bde thang la thebs pa'i gnod 'tshe je nyung ngam sel thabs byed rgyu de ni nga tsho'i thun mong gi 'gan khur yin no//1 lus 'brel las 'go ba'i nad kyi mched lam gtso bo/(1) lus 'brel las mched pa/(2) lus 'brel ma yin pa las mched pa(thad kar thug pa dang gzhan brgyud nas thug pa)139

(3) khrag khungs nas mched pa/ (4) ma las thad kar byis par mched pa/(5) sman bcos thad nas mched pa/2 sngon 'gog byed thabs/(1) sbrum 'gog shubs bkol spyod yang dag byed pa/(2) rang lus rang gces byas te gnyen ma bsgrigs gong dang gnyen zur nas lus 'brel byed par g.yol dgos/ (3) dug rdzas dang ring du gyes pa dang / dug rdzas rgyag byed mnyam spyod mi byed pa/(4) sbyar nad byung tshe dus thog tu tshad ldan sman khang du song nas sman bcos byed dgos/(5) sbyar nad sangs drag ma byung gong lus 'brel mi byed pa dang /mngal chags pa dang nu ma ldud pa mi bya'o/ /(bco lnga) e tsi 'gos nad/e tsi 'gos nad ni mi'i rigs kyi rims 'gog nus shugs zhan pas nad dug 'gos pa las bslangs pa'i nad rigs shig yin/ nad dug de rigs 'gos pa'i dbang gis/ lus khams kyi rims 'gog nus shugs cha shas sam yongs rdzogs nyams par gyur te/ rkyen nad rang bzhin gyi 'go nad dang nyen tshabs che ba'i 'bras skran sogs 'byung la/ shi tshad ha cang 140

mtho 1 mched stangs/(1) lus 'brel las mched pa/ mtshan mthun can dang mtshan mthun ma yin pa'i bar lus 'brel byed pa ma zad/ lus 'brel dga' rogs ji ltar mang na mched tshad de ltar mtho/(2) khrag bsher las mched pa/ e tsi 'gos nad can gyi khrag dang khrag bzos sman rdzas rgyag pa dang / rtsa nang du dug rdzas rgyag mkhan gyis e tsi nad dug 'gos pa'i mi'i sman khab mnyam spyod byed pa dang de min dug sel nan mo ma byas pa'i sman chas sam 'tsho ba'i yo byad(dper na nad dug 'gos pa'i mi'i so shad dang kha spu bzhar spyad bkol ba)mnyam bkol byas na'ang mched srid/(3) ma las phru gur mched pa/ e tsi'i nad dug 'gos pa'i sbrum mas phru gu ma btsas pa'i sngon dang btsa' ba'i go rim khrod dang yang na btsas rjes mngal phrug dang phru gu la nad 'gos pa bcas so//2 sngon 'gog byed thabs/ (1) hur brtson sgos bde thang slob gso spel te/ sbyar nad dang e tsi nad dug 'gog bcos kyi shes bya khyab gdal du gtong ba/(2) rang lus rang gces byas te/ lus 'brel bya spyod mi legs pa 'dor ba dang / sbrum 'gog shubs spyod pa dar spel gtong dgos/141

(3) rin tshab mi dgos par khrag 'bul ba dar spel gtong dgos/(4) sman bcos las 'go ba 'gog dgos/stabs bde'i ngangand bcos byed thabs/(gcig) snying nad 'phar tshe stabs bde'i myur skyob byed thabs/snying nad yod pa'i nad pa'i snying mi bde ba'am tshor pa nyams tshe/myuraskyob byed thabs ni khu tshur gyis nu 'og gi brang gzhogs rdung ba dang /shugs bkol tshad ni dran pa gsal ba'i nad pa'i na zug skye rag bar yin/gal te lan4la brdungs kyang nad pa'i ngo mdangs da dung skya bo yin zhing dran pa ma sos tshe/ 'phral du snying gi phyi ngos 'phur mnyed byed dgos te/lag pa gcig lag pa ya gcig gi thog bzhag ste snying khar yang yang gnon dgos/snying nad 'phar rjes zla gcig gi ring du lus 'brel mi byed pa dang tha mag mi 'then pa/ lus po'i ljid tshad la mnyam 'jog pa/ 'o zas sam ka ra nyung nyung bza' ba/ go rim ldan pa'i lus rtsal sbyong brdar byed dgos/(gnyis) byis pa'i nyin brgya'i glo nad bcos thabs/gtsags khab zur gsum mar(gal te med na 'tshem khab spyad chog)rgyun srol gyi dug sel byas rjes/ gsang mig bzhi la(gong mdzub dang dkyil mdzub/ srin mdzub/ mtheb chung bcas kyi tshigs gnyis pa'i bar)gtsags nas/ 'byer chu phyir bton te chang bcud kyi sring bal gyis 142

khab kyi gtsags mig tu yang mor gnon dgos/ nyin rer thengs gcig la gtsags pa dang / thengs rer lag pa gnyis brje res kyis gtsags dgos/spyir btang du sman mi bkol zhing / 'khyag pa 'dzem pa dang zas sla bo zos na/ mang na nyin lnga'i nang du je dgar 'gro'o//(gsum) dal langs rang bzhin gyi rlon 'brum bcos thabs/hreng ti dang hru'u khe30re dang / hro'u wu'u dang tang kun/ shing pad ma'i rtsad shun/ sran dmar/ g.yer shing / gze ma ra mgo bcas so so khe15re gdus nas 'thung dgos la/ nyin rer thun re dang thengs2nas3la bgos nas 'thung dgos/ nyin10gso yun1yin/ spyir btang du gso yun1nas3gyi sman 'thung na sangs drag tu 'gro'o//(bzhi) 'tshig rmas bcos thabs/ling men kren dang cin ying me tog gi rtsad pa khe250re'i nang du chu ha'o hreng1000blugs nas/ ha'o hreng500la 'bab rag tu gdus rjes/snyigs ma bton nas gsher khu len pa dang / 'khyag rjes sman bkol sring bal gyis sman khu btig pa dang / bstud mar nyin2la glan rjes sangs drag tu 'gro la/ rma shul yang med/ bcos thabs 'dis me dang chu/ snum/rlangs pa/ mu zi'i skyur bcas kyis 'tshig pa'i rma kha bcos chog tshad6dngakyokyi 'tshig rmas bcos na lhag tu phan che'o//(lnga) khrag tshil mar chag pa'i zas kyi sbyor thabs/143

mog ro nag po khe10dang sga skya mo3/ kha sur dmar po5/ sha snag khe50bcas kyi nang du chu ha'o hreng1200ldug pa dang / me shugs chung ngus skar ma30la btsos nas bro rdzos 'debs pa'o// nyin rer thun re zos na/khrag tshil mar chag pa dang rtsa lam 'gag pa sel ba'i phan nus thon thub bo//(drug) dbang rtsa'i rang bzhin gyi pags nad bcos thabs/ri skyes re lcag khe100tsam gtsang mar bkrus nas shun pags bshus te leb mor gtsabs pa dang / chu 'dang nges shig blugs te me shugs gnyom pos lde gur bskol rjes/ dam bu'i nang bcug ste nyer spyod du nyar dgos/ thengs rer tog tsam blangs nas rma khar bsku ba dang / nyin rer thengs3nas4dang nyin10ni gso yun gcig yin/ spyir btang du sman nyin2la bkol na phyi shun lhung ba dang / nyin10yi rjes su sangs drag yong thub/(bdun) bkru ba'i thabs kyis lus phyid pa bcos thabs/mtshe ldum dang tang kun gyi rnga ma/ shing tsha'i yal ga tang kun dkar po/ hreng te bcas khe20re dang / ming can dang skug rtswa/ la co/gur kum/ rtswa 'bru bcas so so khe15 re skar ma30la mnyam du gdus rjes/sman khu'i drod tshad 'os 'tsham zhig la sleb dus phyid pa'i khag skar ma20la sbang dgos/ rna cog phyid pa'i mi la mtshon na lag phyis sman khu dron mo'i nang du sbangs rjes rna ba'i thog tu glan dgos/ sman gdu thengs re nyin2la 144

bkol ba dang / nyin re'i nangs dgong du thengs1rer gso dgos/ skyi pags smug po'i nad can gyis bkol mi rung / sman khu'i nang du sbangs res gtsang mar 'byid pa dang / de'i rjes su sman hphin thung lin 'os 'tshams shig byugs te ngar langs su 'jug dgos shing / nyin rer thengs2la byugs dgos/ spyir btang du nyin6yas mas su sman bcos byas na sangs drag yong thub/(brgyad) dmangs khrod kyi stabs bde'i rkang rul sel thabs 'ga'/1 ja khus rkang dul sel ba/ ja lo tog tsam chu khol gyi nang du 'phangs nas skar ma15la sbangs rjes/ rkang pa khrus gzhong du bzhag nas skar ma20la sbangs pa dang / gza' 'khor dang por nyin rer thengs gcig re dang / de'i rjes gza' 'khor rer thengs gcig rer sbangs na rkang rul sel thub/2 la phug gis rkang rul sel ba/ la phug dkar po 'dang tshad cig leb mor gtsabs nas chur btsos te rkang pa bkru ba ste/ rkang pa chur thim par byas te skar ma20tsam la sbangs nas bkru dgos/ dgong mo rer thengs1dang / gza' 'khor1la rgyun mthud nas bkrus na/ rkang rul 'dag pa dang rkang rul sel thub/3 tshwa khusarkang rul sel ba/ dgong mo rer lham gyi nang du tshwa khu 145

tog tsam gtor nas rlung rgyu sar bzhag na/ lham khog gi dri ngan sel thub/4 a si phi lin gyis rkang rul sel ba/ a si phi lin ril bu2chu dron mo ha'o hreng50yi nang zhu ru bcug ste/ sman bkol sring bal gyis de dang bsgres nas rkang par byugs pa dang / bskams rjes bskyar du byugs pa dang / thengs2nas3la byugs tshe/ rkang rngul 'dag thub la rkang rul sel thub/5 mān mtho skyur ca yis rkang rul sel ba/ gar tshad0 15can gyi mān mtho skyur ca'i gsher khu chu dron mo'i nang du skar ma10la sbangs nas bkru ba dang / bskams rjes khil 'byur ha yang255yi zhu gsher byugs nas rang shugs su bsil skam byas na/ rkang rngul 'gog pa dang rkang rul sel thub/(dgu)pags nad smug po bcos thabs/ hong chen khe200yi nang du chu dwangs mo ha'o hreng1500blugs nas/me shugs chen pos gdu ru bcug rjes/ me shugs chung ngus ha'o hreng700la 'bab rag tu skol ba dang / seng ras gtsang ma nyis brtsegs can gyis dwangs 'tshag byas rjes/ sman khug de me shugs chung ngus ha'o hreng500la 'bab rag tu bskol nas 'khyag tu bcug rjes dam be'u nang blugs te nyer spyod byed pa'o// sman bcos byed skabs dug sel byas pa'i seng ras nar mo sman khur sbangs te pags nad smug po'i ngos su glan pa dang / bskams 146

rjes sman khu btig nas brlan nas brlan par bya'o// sman bcos kyi phan nus ni/ spyir btang du sman bkol nas chu tshod3nas5yi rjes su pags nad smug po'i ngos kyi 'dzum gsher mngon gsal du je nyung du 'gro la/gza' 'khor2'gor rjes gsar skyes sha'u thon pa dang / zla1gi nang sangs drag tu 'gro thub/ sman bcos byas myong ba'i nad pa phal che bar phan nus yid tshim pa zhig byung yod/(bcu) rkang lag gi ser kha bcos thabs/nyin re'i mtshan mor rkang pa gtsang mar bkrus rjes/ 'gyig khug gtsang ma zhig gis rkang pa gcud de rkang 'bob gyon dgos/ spyir btang du nyin gnyis gsum gyi nang la phan 'bras mngon gsal thob/ lag mthil gyi ser kha bcos thabs ni/ lag pa gtsang mar bkrus nas phyis rjes/ sman bkolaspyin ras sam zug 'joms lde gu bkol nas ser kha'i che chung ltar dras te sbyar na/ nyin gsum bzhi'i nang sangs drag tu 'gro'o//gsum/ nyi nus drod khang du lug gso ba'i lag rtsal/(gcig) drod khang gi jus 'god rtsa don/drod khang du nges par du lug gi 'tsho ba dang thon skyed la phan pa'i khor yug gi cha rkyen bskrun dgos/ der brten/ drod khang jus 'god kyi rtsa don ni sra mkhregs rang bzhin gyi rmang gzhi'i steng nyi 'od bsdu ba dang drod 'dzin pa/ mkha' dbugs brje ba bcas kyi khyad nus bzang bo ldan 147

dgos pa de yin/ lag len gyi nyams myong ltar na/ drod khang gi bzo skrun rgya khyon de lug rer dngos spyod rgya khyon1 27ཿltar gtan la phab nas jus 'god bya dgos/ —(gnyis)drodakhang gi bzo skyun/drod khang gi sgrig gzhi ni drod khang gi phyi dbyibs ltar dbye ba bkar ba yin/ de la spyir btang du khang klad gzhogs gcig gyen gzar ma dang sgur khang / gzhu dbyibs phyed can ma/ gzhu dbyibs can sogs yod/ lug gso bar spyod pa la khang klad gzhogs gcig gyen gzar ma'am sgur khang las na cung bzang 1 drod khang gzhogs gzar ma/drod khang gzhogs gzar ma ni khang klad kyi gzhogs gcig shel lam 'gyig shog gis bkab pa dang / gzhogs gzhan gcig sa dang shing cha/rdza leb kyis bkab pa yin/ drod khang 'di rigs mang che ba'i gzhogs gnyis shar nub la gtod pa dang mdun rgyab lho byang la gtod do//(jilha (rikyi sku2 sgur khang /148

sgur khang ni drod khang klad kyi gzhogs gnyis tshang ma shel lam 'gyig shog gis bkab pa yin zhing / gzhogs gnyis na chu gzar yod/ la la'i khang klad gzhogs gnyis 'dra mtshungs yin zhing de la klad 'dra ma zer/ ri mo(3)/ la la'i khang klad kyi gzhogs gnyis 'dra mtshungs min/ de la klad mi 'dra ma zer/ ri mo(2)/mtsho lho khul gyi 'brog phyogs mang che ba mtsho ngos las mtho zhing than pa che ba/ rlung mang zhing rlung shugs che ba bcas kyi rang byung khor yug na gnas shing / 'di 'dra'i cha rkyen gzhir bzung na/ drod khang gzhogs gzar ma las na bzang bar 'dug (gsum)drodakhang las pa'irgyu cha'i blang bya/drod khang las pa'i rgyu cha'i 'dem spyod dang blang bya/ de ni 'brog khyim gyi dpal 'byor gnas tshul dang dgos mkho ltar gdam dgos/ yang gcig bshad na/ sra zhing mkhregs pa dang sbyod yun ring bo zhig mkho na gyo mog dang ar 'dam/ rno lcags kyi ka gdung / shel sgo'i 'od bsdu can gyi drod khang ngam sa dang shing / 'gyig shog gi klad bkab pa'i 'gyig shog drod khang las dgos/ mig sngar yongs khyab tu las pa dang sbyod bzhin pa'i gyo mog dang ar 'dam rmang gzhi yin zhing / rno lcags kyi ka gdung dang klad shel sgo yin pa'i drod khang gi sra mkhregs dang yun brtan rang bzhin de 'gyig shog drod khang dang bsdur na phyogs gang thad nas bzang ba red/ da 149

ni drod khang rigs gnyis po 'di'i rgyu cha'i blang bya mtshams sbyor byas na/1 lcags sgrom shel sgo'i drod khang /(1)drod khang 'di las na/ gyang la gyo mog gam gyo mog nang stong ma spyod dgos pa dang / gyang rting la ar 'dam spyod dgos/ khang klad la 'od bsdu bar spyod pa'i rno lcags zur gsum ma'am rno lcags nang stong can de gdung mar sbrel nas tsha la byed pa dang / 0 4sloyi shel sgos klad 'gebs dgos/ drod 'dzin khag la smi0 16 yi shing drab dang smyug drab 'phen pa dang / steng 'dam rtswa dang rdza leb kyis 'gebs dgos/(2)lcags sgrom shel ngos drod khang hril bo'i tshad gzhi/ drod khang gi bkol spyod rgya khyon gyi che chung de khyim bdag gi dgos mkho ngo ma ltar gtan la dbab dgos/ yin na'ang spyir btang du6072las chung mi rung /drod khang gi dkyil ka'i mtho la smi2 5dang ltag gyang gi mtho la smi1 7/mdun gyang gi mtho la smi1 3/ ltag gyang dang dkyil gdung bar du shing drab(zlum po'am gru bzhi ma)'phen dgos/ dkyil gdung dang mdun gyang kha'i bar du rno lcags zur gsum ma'am rno lcags nang stong can tsha la byas nas mthud de50྾500smoyi sgrom gru bzhi ma bzo dgos/ rno lcags zur gsum ma(2mnyam du tsha la bya dgos)tsha la byas nas zur bzhi brtan 'jags bzo dgos/ klad ngos su shel sgo(0 4tsos)sprod par bya/ drod khang gi mdun rgyab bar thag la smi6dang gyan re'i zheng tshad la smi bcu dang /150

drod khang gi dbyibs gzugs/2 'gyig shog drod khang / 'gyig shog drod khang gi las tshul zhib mo dpe ston ri mo ru gsal/(1) gzhi sgrom gyi rgyu cha/ 'gyig shog drod khang gi gzhi sgrom gyi rgyu cha gtso bo shing cha dang smyug cha/lcags cha/ 'gyig shog sra mo/ ha yang sogs yin la/ bkol spyod byed pa'i skabs su/ 'brog khyim gyi dpal 'byor gnas tshul ltar/ drod khang gi sra mkhregs la 'gan len byed pa 'i gnas tshul 'og gzhi sgrom gyi rgyu cha 'os mthun gyis 'dem spyod bya dgos/(2) klad 'gebs byed kyi rgyu cha/ drod khang gi klad 'gebs byed kyi rgyu cha de gtso bo klad 'gebs byed kyi 'gyig shog la bstan pa dang de'i rigs cung mang / mig sngar thon skyed byed pa'i 'gyig shog srab mo la cu lu'u dbyi zhi 'gyig shog(mamalkusgo.oṃtsho)dang cu dbyi zhi 'gyig shog ( lkolkusgo.oṃ )/ chu mi thigs pa'i 152

'gyig shog(76lotsho )/ cu hpho dbyi zhi 'gyig shog(chutshilku 〉〉oṃtshorgyu)/nus mang 'gyig shog sogs yod la/ de'i rigs tshang zhing tshad gzhi ha cang mang / 'gyig shog drod khang gi bkol spyod ngo ma'i phan 'bras gzhir bzung nas bltas na/ mthug la100—12000dang zheng la smi3nas4yin pa'i yun thub pa dang chu 'gog pa/ drod 'dzin pa bcas rmang gzhi cha rkyen yin pa'i mdog ldan nam mdog bral gyi cu lu'u dbyi zhi 'gyig shog bdams na bzang /(3)'gyig shog gi sbyor thabs/tsha sbyor/ 100—200sa7pe glog gi dbur ti'am spyir btang gi dbur ti spyad nas sbyar na chog sbyor ba'i skabs su/ 'gyig shog sbyor sne'i mtha' gnyis gtsang mar phyi ba dang / zhing tshad nges can zhig(5—647bsnol nas shing leb ngos 'jam steng du bde mor 'ding ba dang)mi sreg pa'i ched du 'gyig shog steng la mnyen cha ldan pa'i skya shog(rdokhungame()rim pa zhig bkab ste/ dbur ti ngar mos skya shog steng du glan nas rim bzhin ded de sbyor dgos/ tsha sbyor byed skabs 'gyig shog gi srab mthug dang 'gyig shog gi rigs/ tsha drod dang dbur ti'i nus pa mi 'dra ba ltar sbyor mthud kyi drod tshad shes dgos/ gal te ma shes tshe sbyor mi thub pa'am 'gyig shog la sreg skyon byung nas dmigs yul du bsleb mi thub/ spyir btang gi gnas tshul 'og cu lu'u dbyi zhi 'gyig shog gi tsha sbyor drod tshad 153

tu'u130dang cu dbyi zhi 'gyig shog gi tsha sbyor drod tshad tu'u110yin/spyin sbyor/ spyin sbyor ni khyad bzos kyi spyin chu spyad nas 'gyig shog gtsang mar phyis pa'i steng du spyin chu bskus te sbyor ba zhig yin/ sbyor thabs 'di ni lhan pa'i phyogs la spyod pa las ngos chen po sbyor bar spyod pa min/ drod khang gi 'gyig shog la lhan pa rgyag pa'i skabs su 'gyig shog rigs mi 'dra ba ltar spyin chu mi 'dra ba spyod dgos pa ste/ cu lu'u dbyi zhi 'gyig shog la cu lu'u dbyi zhi rgyu snyi spyin chu(rsālolkomalku sgoṣṭhapye(/)spyad nas sbyor dgos la/ cu dbyi zhi 'gyig shog la cu an kri spyin chu(smo3matshe7ṣpetsho))spyad nas sbyor dgos pa lta bu'o//cu lu'u dbyi zhi spyin chu de rang gis sdeb sbyor byas chog de'i sdeb lugs ni/ (byeko'o lu'u dbyi zhi shing tshil(rwa1shā mu 〉khye81rsākhri)2/ cu lu'u dbyi zhi 'gyig shog10/ hon ci thung(tomupha)700/ tshu'u skyur tin kri(dzalhatshe41sgo)18(bzo las la sbyod pa'i rgyu cha'i tshad gzhi/ rtsis gzhi sdur tshad re re'i ljid tshad ltar brtsi dgos) ()ka'o lu'u dbyi zhi shing tshil15/ pin thung('ogatshes)28/ tshu'u skyur tin kri31/ ca pin26bcas yin/ sdeb pa'i skabs su gsher khu rgyu cha re re tshang ma lhan du bsres pa dang / dkrugs nas 'dag rjes spyad chogalhan thabs/ 'gyig shog drod khang bkol spyod kyi go rim khrod rgyu rkyen sna mang gi stabs kyis 'gyig shog gshags pa 'dra byung tshe myur du lhan pa rgyag dgos/ lhan pa rgyag pa'i skabs su thog mar 'gyig shog gshags ral 154

gyi che chung ltar de las cung che ba'i 'gyig shog cig 'dra ba dang / 'gyig shog ngos kyi sa rdul dang chu smug gtsang mar phyi dgos/ phyis su spyin chu sbyor gnas kyi mtha' gnyis la bskus nas cung bskams rjes mnan nas sbyor dgos la/ dus tshod 'gar rlung skam byas na chog rjoge mchoskyiru 6 sa cho niྈmu 3shu rṣa skyi 2〉rṣaji (bzhi) drod khang bkol spyod kyi 'apod mthun dus chod/mtsho lho khul rig smon sa cha'i lo hril bo'i gor thig man gyi drod tshad bsdoms na—1778spul bslebs pa dang / mtshan mor〈 —5bul bslebs pa'i thog mtha'i skabs ni zla11pa'i zla stod nas lo rjes ma'i zla4pa'i zla mjug bar yin/ der brten/ gshib bsdur gyi rigs lam spyad 155

nas bltas na/ khul gyi sa khul mang che ba'i drod khang bkol spyod kyi 'os mthun dus tshod ni lo de'i zla11pa nas phyi lo'i dpyid lug rtsebs tshar ba'i zla4ba'i zla mjug bar yin la/ spyod yun lo phyed la nye ba zhig yin/〈〈mtsho sngon zhing chen zhing phyugs las kyi gnam gshis thon khungs dang sa khul dbye 'byed〉〉sogs zhib 'jug dpyad yig nas mtshon pa ltar na/nyin hril bo'i cha snyoms drod tshad〈—50yin pa'i nyin dang po nas lug shed lhung 'go brtsams pa nas phyi lo'i zla4pa'i zla dkyil bar gyi zla5dang phyed ka'i rjes ni lug shed 'bud 'go bcoms pa'i dus skabs yin par gtan la phab yod/ de bas dus skabs 'dir drod khang spyad na sha shed lhung ba 'gog thub la/ drod khang gi nus pa ches bzang po 'don thub/(lnga) drod khang gi drod tshad dang rlan tshad/ snyom sgrig 'os 'tsham byed pa/drod khang gi ches bzang ba'i drod tshad ni8—220bar yin pa dang /rlan tshad75chil tshod 'dzin byas na ha cang 'phrod/ nam zla ha cang 'khyag pa'i zla dang por drod khang gi kha dbugs rgyu sa kho na ma gtogs dra ma brgyab na drod khang hril bor bser bu 'ong sa med pas drod khang nang gi drod tshad6buyas mas srung 'dzin bya thub/ de min zla ba gzhan dag gi drod tshad rlung rgyu sa spyad nas snyom sgrig dang tshod 'dzin bya dgos/ drod khang nang gi rlan tshad la snyom sgrig dang tshod 'dzin byas nas lug la ltos bcas kyis 156

'phrod mthun yin pa'i rlan tshad khor yug la bsleb par bya rgyu ni lug gi skye 'phel dang sha shed rgyas par ha cang gal 'gangs che/ mtsho sngon mtho sgang gi 'khyags grang dus tshigs la phyi rol skam zhing 'khyag pa'i nam zla'i khyad chos ltar na/ spyir btang du drod khang gi mtshan mo'i rlan tshad75lkoyin na chog rlan tshad kyi snyom sgrig de yang drod tshad snyom sgrig gi byed thabs dang 'dra bar rlung rgyu sa'i dra ma 'os 'tsham gyis phyes na chog pa yin la/ cha rkyen yodatshe da dung rlung g.yab sgrig chas sprad na ltos bcas kyis 'phrod mthun rlon tshad la bslobs pa yin/(drug) drod khang gi gtsang sbra dang rims nad 'gog bcos/1 gtsang sbra/thog mar drod khang nang gi mkha' dbugasagasar pa rgyun srung byed pa dang mkha' dbugs brje bar shugs snon dgos/ rtag par nam zla'i gnas tshul ltar/ gnam thang dus mkha' dbugs brje ba'i dus tshod ring chog pa dang / gnam rub pa'am kha ba 'bab nyin mkha' dbugs brje ba'i dus tshod thung dgos/ spyi'i rtsa don ni drod khang nang gi drod tshad 'os 'tsham zhig je dmar song yang mkha' dbugs gsar pa rgyun srung bya dgos/mjug tu/ dus bcad ltar drod khang nang la gtsang sbra dang lud rdzas phyir phud pa rgyun 'khyongs bya dgos par ma zad/ kon min son ca'am(oṃ ṣṭhaṣṭhami)rdo thal chu yis sa ngos la dgagatsang byas te gnod ldan 'bu phra 157

gnas su mi 'jug pa bya dgos/2 lug gi rims nad 'gog bcos/ka cham nad 'gog dgos/ lug khyu spyir btang du nyin dkar phyi rol na 'tsho ba dang mtshan mor drod khang du 'jug pa red/ drod khang nang dang phyi rol gyi khyad par cung che bas lug la cham pa phog sla/ de bas lug phyi la ma phud pa'i dus tshod gcig gi sngon la dkar khung dang sgo/ mkha' dbugs rgyu sa bcas phye nas drod khang phyi nang la khyad par chen po med pa'i skabs su da gzod sgor dbyung dgos/ kha lug khyu la nad byung ba dang 'go ba 'gog dgos/ dper na sa skyonadang kha tsha rmig tsha/ lug 'brum/ lug gi 'jag sbos nad/ rgyu ma'i dugakhrag nad/ lu gu'i rnyang nad sogs lta bu'o// de dag byung ba shes ma thag dus thog tu 'brel yod las khungs la yar zhu byed pa dang / dgos nges kyi byed thabs spyad nas sman bcos dang sngon 'gog bya dgos/ga drod khang nang gi 'phrod mthun gyi drod tshad dang rlan tshad/gnod ldan rlangs gzugs phyir gtong ba bcas rgyu na srung byed par yid 'jog bya dgos/ 158
snra kṣiṃ shlau

ja nul ba/ dug rgyu mang du 'dus pa'o//dri mang 'dres pa'i ja/ ja kha shas la dug yod pa ste/ dper na bkrag rtsi dang ga bur sogs lta bu/ja 'tshig ro/ brngos thal drags pa'i ja lo la 'tsho bcud med pa dang bro ba'ang legs po med/zhag lus ja/ nang sgos su dri 'gyur zin pa'i ja ste/ dri gzhan myong mi thub na'ang de'i nang du phal cher 'bu phra mang du bskyed yod/sbangs yun ring ba'i ja/ ja sbangs nas yun ring drags na/ de'i nang gi mi'i lus phung la gnod pa'i rdzas mang po bangs srid/ja 'khyag ja tsha mor 'thung dgos/ ja 'khyag la grang 'dzin dang lud pa gsog pa'i gnod skyon yod/tsha drags pa'i ja/ ja thams cad spyir btang du chu khol du sbang ba yin mod/ tsha drags pa'i skabs su 'thung mi rung / tsha drags pa'i ja 'thung na pho ba dang rgyu ma sogs la gnod che'o//g.yisakli bzang ngan la ciltar blta dgos/dang po blta ba/ thog mar dwangs tshad la blta ba ste/ g.yis gtsang ma ni dwangs mo yin/ g.yis 'tshag pa'i skabs su rdzas nya nyog 'dres tshe/g.yis dwangs shing gtsang ma zhig yong mi thub/ de'i 'phror mdog la blta ba ste/ g.yis gtsang ma ni mdog med yin/ g.yis 'tshag pa'i skabs su log 160

dkar sogs btsag bya'i 'bru rigs kyi tshos rgyu de g.yis kyi nang du 'dres tshe/g.yis la mdog 'byung srid/ mtha' mar g.yis snyigs la blta dgos/de'igrub cha gtso bo ni dzas nya nyog yin pas/ g.yis kyi zhabs su byings srid/ g.yis nyo skabs dwangs shing mdog skya ba(zar g.yis mi gtogs)g.yis snyigs med pa bdams na ches bzang ngo //gnyis pa bsnam pa/ g.yis gang yin rung tshang mar rang rang gi thun min gyi dri ma ldan/ g.yis rdza'i kha 'byed skabs/ snas myangs tshe bsnam thub/ lag mthil du btigs nas thal mo sbyar te phur na/ tsha langs pa dngade'i skabs su dri ma zhib tu snom chog g.yis la dri ma gzhan yod tshe/rgyu spus la skyon zhugagapa yin/ gter g.yis bsres pa'i g.yis la de'i dri ma ldan pas nyo mi rung /gsum pa myong ba/ thur ma'am shel thur gtsang mas g.yis thigs tog tsam blangs te/ lces de'i ro zhib tu myong ba dang / ro skyur ba'i g.yis ni thon rdzas tshad ldan min la/ dri ma gzhan yod na g.yis rdzun ma bsres pa yin/ bzhi ba nyan pa/ 'bar ba'i sgra la nyan pa/ dmigs yul ni chu 'dus tshad mang yod med la blta ba de yin/ g.yis zhabs las thigs pa re gnyis shog bu'i ngos su blugs nas/ mer bsgron te g.yis sgra la nyan pa ste/ 'bar ba rgyun ldan yin na sgra med pa dang / chu 'dus tshad0 25161

yin pa thon rdzas tshad ldan du gtogs/ 'bar skabs tsag sgra byung tshe g.yis kyi chu 'dus tshad0 4gliyin pa mtshon pas/ tshad gzhi las brgal tshabs cheb dang /rī thon rdzas rdzun ma bsres yod srid pas gtan nas nyo mi rung ngo //lnga ba 'dri ba/ tshong bar tshong rdzas kyi yong khungs 'dri ba dang /dgos gal che dus tshong 'dren 'dzin byang ngam sa de'i zas rigs 'phrod bsten lta skul sde khag gi 'dra bcad zhib bsher snyan zhu la blta thabs byed pa'o//sbrang rtsi la brtag thabs/mdog sbrang rtsi bzang bo ni dwangs shing gsal la/ kha dog snyoms pa/sbrang rtsi ngan pa ni nyog cing sbags pa'o// sbrang rtsi gsar pa spos shel gyi mdangs dang ldan zhing / phyi nang gsal ba ni slad med pa'o//dri/ sbrang rtsi blangs nas yud tsam la nyar rjes/ dri ma khyad par ba zhig 'byung ba dang / dri ma che zhing 'thul yun ring ba dang / snod kha phye ma thag snom thub/ sbrang rtsi tog tsam lag mthil du blangs nas phur te bsnams kyang chog la/ sbrang rtsi'i dri zhim por snam tshe spus legs pa'o// sbrang rtsi ngan pa la khyad chos de dag mi ldan/ro/ sbrang rtsi'i ro mngar zhing kha la 'jam pa/ chu khol dang bsres nas dkrugs na zhu sla ba snyigs ro med pa bcas ni spus legs pa'o// sbrang 162

rtsi mi legs pa ni zhu dka' zhing snyigs ro ldan/gar bo/ sbrang rtsi bzang bo gar tshad mtho zhing bzhur dal la/ shog ngos su thigs gā gcig btigs tshe/ rdog por chags pa las 'grem par mi 'gyur ro// sbrang rtsi ngan pa ni rdog por mi chags par 'grem sla'o//chod dkar ci ltar zos na legs/spyir na tshod dkar ni rngos ma thag za dgos pa las/ zhag lus kyi tshod dkar tshos ma bza' mi rung / tshwa bsnyal byas pa'i tshod dkar yang langs ma thag 'tshod dgos la/ gtsang mar bkrus rjes brngos nas za dgos/ rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/tshod dkar so ma'i nang du 'bu phra med pa'i ze skyur tshwa mang po 'dus pa dang / tshod dkar bsnyal nas ma langs pa'am ma tshos par 'jog yun ring tshe/ 'bu phra'i nus pa'i dbang gis ze skyur tshwa de ze skyur tshwa 'bring du 'gyur 'gro/ ze skyur tshwa 'bring zos na pho bar phyin rjes/ khrag gsher khrod kyi lcags nyung khrag dmar spri dkar dbyang 'gyur byas te/ lcags mang khrag dmar spri dkar du gyur nas/ dbyang len pa'i nus pa nyams par byed pa dang / lus khams su dbyang zhan par gyur nas dug phog ste/ mgo yomā 'khor ba dang mgo na ba/ skyug mer langs pa/ gsus pa na ba dang sbos pa bcas kyi nad rtags 'byung la/ lci na skyi pags dmar nag smug nag tu 'gyur la/ tha na dran pa nyams pa dang gza' phog par byed pas/ mi lus 163

kyi bde thang la gnod 'tshe shin tu che'o//'o ma ci ltar 'thung na lus por lhag par phan pa yin/mi la las nangs snga mo khog stong du 'o ma 'thung bar spyiga'/ de ltar byas na lus por phan che bar snyam/ don dngos su 'o ma 'thung tshul de rigs ni tshan rig dang mthun pa zhig min/'o ma'i nang du spri dkar rdzos mang po 'dus na'ang / mi lus la tsha nus 'don khungs ches gtso bo dang ches gron chung ba —ni mngar cha yin la/de'i 'phror tshil dang de nas spri dkar rdzas yin/ khog stong du 'o ma 'thung na/ 'o ma de sing phye rigs kyi bza' chas kyi tshab tu song nas tsha tshad 'dzad gron byed pa tsam las ma 'das pas/ spri dkar rdzas dang 'tsho gso rgyu mang po 'dus pa'i 'o ma la mtshon na/ de ni ha cang gron che ba zhig tu zad/tshan rig dang mthun pa'i 'o ma 'thung lugs ni sing phye rigs kyi bza' chas de tsha tshad kyi 'byung khungs su byas pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng 'thung dgos pa dang / yang na zhogs zas zos rjes kyi dus tshod gcig nas gnyis kyi yun du 'thung ba dang / dus mnyam du ka ra go re dang go re cong rdog sogs phye rigs kyi bza' chas za dgos/ de ltar byas na 'o ma pho ba'i nang chags pa'i yun ring ba dang / pho ba'i gsher khu dang sme 'byed kyi nus pa gang legs thon thub la/ 'o ma'i nang gi 'tsho rgyu mang bo sdud par byed thub bo//lug sha'i spod du sran zho zos na bse rag mi 'byung /164

lug sha ni drod rigs yin pas/ rgyun du zos na bse rag 'byung sla/krung dbyi gso rig gis‘‘tsha ba grang 'joms’’kyi bcos thabs la dang dod byed/ der brten lug sha za skabs bsil rigs dang snyoms rigs kyi sngo tshod spod yar sbyar na/ bsil skyed dang dug sel/ tsha 'joms bcas kyi nus pa bskyed thub/ bsil rigs kyi sngo tshod la tung kwa dang si kwa yi'u tshal/ tshod dkar/ cin krin sha mo/ sha mo/ pad rtsa/ co pe/ smyug rtswa/tshal zhin sogs yod la/ zhog khog mngar mo dang zhog khog ser sha sogs snyoms rigs kyi sngo tshod yin/ lug sha za skabs sran zho dang sbyar na ches legs te/ des gzhi rgyu phra rigs mang po gsab thub pa ma zad/ de'i nang gi cu gang gis da dung tsha ba sel ba dang khams dwangs par byed pa/ skom pa sel ba sogs kyi nus pa bskyed thub/ lug sha dang la phug gis tshod ma bzos na/ la phug gi bsil gshis gang legs su thon thub pas/ zas 'ju ba dang glo lu sel bar phan/lug sha 'tshod skabs/ bro rdzas kyi sbyor ba la'ang mthong chung byed mi rung / shun pa ma bshus pa'i sga skya cung 'phangs na ches legs te/ cisga skya'i shun pa ni ro tsha la bsil ba'i rigs su gtogs pas/ tsha sel zug 'joms dang grum nad sel ba'i nus pa ldan zhing / lug sha dang mnyam du zos na sbre dri'ang sel thub/ sha khu'i nang du la co dang pho ba ris/ sga skya/li shi go snyod sogs ro tsha ba'i bro rdzas 'phen pa mang mi nung / pad 'bras 165

cung 'phangs na tsha ba sel bar phan/mi mang po zhig lug sha sbre dri can la mi dga'/ don dngos su de ni 'tshang ra dang sha gnad bar gyi tshilagyi nang du 'dus pa'i yal sla ba'i tshi skyur zhig yin la/ dri de yal du 'jug 'dod na tsi ran cung zad 'phangs pas chog der‘‘an zhi'i go tog’mikyang zer la/ dang thog gna' bo'i an zhi rgyal po'i rgyal khab ste da lta'i dbyi ran khul brgyud du thon/ de'i dri che zhing zhim pas/ lug sha 'tshod par 'tsham la/ zas kyi dang ga 'byed pa dang grum nad sel ba/ zug gzer 'joms pa sogs la phan no// sgong nyog ci ltar g.yosan gsar zhing sob pa yong /sgong khu'i nang bsres pa'i cha de cha khol dron mo yin dgos pa las cha ri mi ri mi rigi 'khyag ldugs mi nung / chu khol dron mos sgong khu 'byed thub la/ sgong nyog de gsar zhing sob pa sran rus lta bur chags su 'jug thub/ sgong nyog bskol yun de skar ma7nas8yin dgos pa dang / dus tshod de tag tag gnada'i khel tshe/ sgong nyog gi ngos su chu g.yeng mi srid/ sgong khu bskol nas sra mor chags rjes/ de'i steng du thur ma zhig btsugs te blta ba dang /gal te thur ma'i steng 'byar khu med na sgong nyog tshos yod pa yin/g.yer ma'i spyod sgo legs po/1 pags pa'i nang du g.yer ma bzhag na/ pags par 'bus mi rgyaki66

2 zas rigs g.yis nang du 'tshod skabs/ g.yis phyi la 'phyur ba'i mgo gnon thub/3 thab tshang gi tsha sgam sogs kyi gru khar g.yer phye nyung tsam gtor na/'bu dang byi ba sogs 'gog thub la/ za ma'ang gtsang ma yong ngo //4 bza' ba'i 'bru g.yis(dper na ba dam gyi g.yis dang sran g.yis/ ke tshe'i g.yis sogs lta bu) skol skabs g.yer rdog 'ga' 'phangs na/ g.yis 'khyag rjes g.yis dri zhim po yong /5 gos sgam gyi nang du seng ras kyis btums pa'i g.yer thum 'ga' bzhag na 'bus mi rgyag par phan/6 'bru rigs nyar 'jog byed skabs/ seng ras kyis btums pa'i g.yer thum 'ga' 'bru khar bzhag tshe/ 'bru rigs kyi phyi nang du 'bus mi rgyag par phan/7 zas la yi ga med pa'i skabs su/ g.yer phye nyung tsam ldag na yi ga 'byed thub la/ ja 'thung skabs g.yer phye nyung tsam 'phangs na yi ga 'byed par phan no//bulaskrung gi spyod sgo 'ga'/1 nya snum tshod byed skabs/ gro phye nang du bul rkyang tog tsam bsres na/ snum btsos byas pa'i nya sha snyi zhing sob/2 zhib mor gtubs pa'i zog sha de bul rkyang gi gsher khu nang cung 167

tsam sbangs nas brngos na/ brngos pa'i sha de'i tshi sna sob po yin/3 nya mkhris bkad tshe/ mkhris khu 'gos pa'i nya der bul rkyang byugs na ro kha ba sel thub/4 me tog gi gang bu kha phye la nye ba'i skabs/ gar tshad khri cha'i gcig gi bul rkyang gi gsher khu gtor na/ me tog sngar bas mdzes shing sdug pa 'gad do//5 tsha dam gyi nang du chu dreg chags tshe/ bul rkyang dang sgong shun/tshwa cha bcas nyung tsam 'phangs nas yang mor dkrugs na/ cha dreg mar lhung ri pa ri pa srid/6 gu gu sha'i snod chas steng gi ser thig 'byid na/ ras rlon pa byas te bul rkyang dang bsgres nas/ shed kyis phyi bdar byas na gtsang ma dang gsar pa yong ngo g.ya' med no yigasol chas bkol ba'i 'dzem bya/1 tshwa dang cang yi'u/ tshod khu sogs blugs nas yun ring bor 'jog mi rung ste/ zas rigs de dag gi nang du glog 'byed rgyu 'bor chen 'dus pa dang / yun ring bor snod du bzhag na/ g.ya' med rno de yang lcags rigs gzhan dang 'dra bar/ glog 'byed rgyu de dag dang dzras kyi 'gyur ba byung ste/ dug ldan lcags rigs kyi gzhi rgyu zhu 'byed byed/2 g.ya' med rdo yi snod chas su rtswa sman gdu mi rung ste/ rtswa sman gyi ci 168

nang du skye dngos bul dang skye ldan skyur sogs kyi grub cha mang du 'dus shing /nang sgos su tsha snod byas rjes/ de dag dang rdzas kyi 'gyur ba las g.yol dka' bas/ sman rdzas kyi nus pa nyams par byed la/ tha na dug gshis can gyi 'gyur rdzas 'dres ma sngar bas mang po zhig bskyed pas so//3 bul gshis drag pa'am dbyang 'gyur rang bzhin che ba'i rdzas 'gyur sman rdzas te dper na bul rkyang dang dkar 'jug phye/ khil skyur nā phal ba sogs bkol nas 'khru bshal gtan nas byed mi rung ste/ dngos rdzas de dag tshang ma ni glog 'byed rgyu tag tag yin pas/ g.ya' med rno dang rdzas kyi 'gyur ba 'byung ba red/thab tshang girghan shes chung ba/1 ba dam gyi g.yis nyar yun ring na dri 'gyur sla bas/ tshwa brngos ma tog tsam 'phangs na mdog dri ro gsum 'dzin thub par ma zad/ rul bslad du 'gro dka' 'o//2 gsar du nyos pa'i lcags zags de ma bkol ba'i sngon la thog mar tshu'u yis bkru dgos/ de ltar byas na tshod ma rngo ba'i skabs su g.ya' ris chags mi srid/3 tshod khu la tshwa mang drags tshe/ zhog khog gtsang ma zhig dkyil nas bshags te tshod khu'i nang 'phangs nas skar ma 'ga' la btsos na/ tshod khu'i tshwa len thub/169

4 nya 'tshod skabs/ sla nga'i nang du 'o ma khem bu gang blugs na/nya dri sel thub par ma zad/ nya sha'ang snyi zhing dkar por 'gyur la/ bro ba ha cang zhim po yong ngo /5 skam sha 'tshod skabs/ thab zangs nang du ras kyis btums pa'i ja lo nyung tsam 'phangs na/ sha tshos sla bar ma zad bro ba lhag tu zhim/6 sran zho sla nga'i nang ma btab gong la thog mar chu khol gyi nang du skar ma bcu lhag la sbangs na/ ba tshwa'i dri 'dag thub la/ kha la 'jam zhing bro ba zhim/7 cung rdog leb mo snum 'tshod byed skabs/ thog mar chu 'khyag gi nang du cung tsam sbangs rjes btsos na/ cung rdog leb mo ser zhing sob la/zos na zhim zhing snum yang gron thub/8 bya sgong 'tshod skabs/ thog mar bya sgong chu 'khyag gi nang du cung sbangs rjes/ chu tsha mo'i nang du 'phangs te btsos na/ bya sgong tshos ma'i sgong shun mi gas shing / shun bshu sla'o//9 nya bkrus rjes kyi lag pa'i nya dri de/ sga skya byugs rjes 'dag rdzas kyis bkrus na sel thub/10 nya dang sha tsongaci / sgog pa bcas gtsabs pa'i tshal gri dang shing leb der sga skya byugs na dri sel thub la gri la g.ya' chags pa'ang 'gog thub/170

tshal gtsabs shing leb la dug sel byed pa'i thabs 'ga'/1 nyi 'od kyis dug sel byed pa/ gnam ngo thang ba'i skabs su/tshal gtsabs shing leb nyi mar bskams te/ sprug phyi'i 'od 'gyed du bcug pa la brten nas 'bu gsod pa'o//2 tsha bshal gyis dug sel byed pa/ tshal gtsabs shing leb thengs gcig bkrus na nad 'bu sum cha'i gcig je nyung du 'gro thub/ gal te chu khol gyis tsha bshal thengs gcig byas na/ nad 'bu lhag ma de bas kyang je nyung du 'gro'o//3 brad nas tshwa brgyab ste dug sel byed pa/ shing leb bkol thengs re'i rjes su/ snyigs ro brad nas gza' 'khor rer tshwa thengs gcig byugs na/ 'bu phra gsod thub la shing leb kyang gas par mi 'gyur ro//4 sman rdzos kyis dug sel byed pa/ chu spyi rgya2kyi nang du cer ma'i gsal ba50ltacan ha'o hreng8nas16bsres te/ shing leb skar ma10nas15bar sbangs pa dang / dkar mjug phye spus legs leb mo gnyis chu spyi rgya5yi nang du bsres nas skar ma10nas15la sbangs kyang choga'agyig zo'i nang du 'dru rigs nyar na 'bu mi zhugs/dbyar kha slebs tshe/ 'bru rigs la 'bu zhugs sla/ bkol tshar ba'i 'gyig zo dang btung bya'i rigs kyi 'gyig dam gtsang mar bkrus nas bsil skam byas rjes/ 'bras dang sran ljang / til sogs blugs nas kha 171

dam por bcad de bsil sar bzhag na/ lo gcig gi nang 'bu zhugs mi srid/skyes ma'i lu ba gyon thabs 'ga'/1 rgyas drags pa'i nu ma ci ltar 'gebs dgos she na/ sgrog gu zung bstar can gyi lu ba phyed ring ngam lwa ring gis khyod kyi rgyas drags pa'i nu ma dang dpyi bkab chog2 ci ltar byas na‘‘mtho shing snyoms po’’mi yong zhe na/ sgron zhu'i dbyibs can gyi smad g.yogs kyis‘‘mtho zhing snyoms po’’skyes pa'i gzugs can gyi bud med tshor khyad 'phags kyi sgeg nyams thon par byed/3 skyes gzugs ring bo'i nyams ci ltar thon par byed ce na/ phra ris gzhung phab can gyi lwa bas mig lam du thur du dpyangs pa'i snang ba ster bas/ bltas tshe skyes gzugs mtho zhing ring bor mngon/4 dpyi rgyas drags na ci ltar bya zhe na/tag tag ong sha khebs pa'i stod lu ca khe gyon tshe/ smad g.yog dog na'ang ong sha che drags par mngon pa'i sems khur byed mi dgos/5 rgyas drags pa'i nu ma la'ang rgyan spras byed dgos sam zhe na/stod thung ca khe zhig gis mi rnams kyi mig zung gi mda' mo khyod kyi che drags pa'i nu ma nas phra zhing ldem pa'i rted pa'i thad la 'phen par 'gyur/6 gsus rlung ci ltar sdud ce na/172

smad g.yogs tshugs kasacan gyi steng du stod lwa 'tsham po zhig sbyar na/bu mo mang che shos kyi zhan cha ste gsus chung 'bur po myur bar mi mngon par 'gyur/skyes pa'i phyi lugs gyon chas kyi 'dzem bya bcu/ 1 phyi lugs khyon chas kyi phyi'i khug ma'i kha btsem yod pas/ gang 'dod du gtan nas gtor mi rung / des lwa ba'i tshugs ka 'chol du mi 'jug par sor gnas byed do/ /2 tshi len nges par du gtsang ma dang snyoms po yin dgos la/ gong kha dang phur khar tshi dreg chags su 'jug mi rung /3 gong dkris bcings rjes/ de'i rtse mo dor ma'i kha 'dig dang gtan nas reg tu 'jug mi rung /4 gal te gong dkris bcings tshe/ mthil snyoms po'i lham gtan nas gyon mi rung /5 phyi lugs gyon chas kyi phu kha'i tshong rtags bkod pa'i ras leb mo de nges par du len dgos/ 6 rked par2ya'abod chas dang lag khyer kha par/ me cha sogs 'dogs mi rung / 7 dang dod kyi nyams cher ma thon gong la/ phyi lugs gyon chas gon skabasadang nang sgos su phyi lugs gyon chas mdog nag po can gon skabs 173

rkang 'bob dkar po gon mi 'os/8 tshi len gyi brang kha dang dor ma'i cha mgo 'dom kha bcas gseg mi rung bar drang thig gcig tu 'bab dgos/9 ko lham nag po ni phyi lugs gyon chas mdog gang rung dang 'tsham zhing / ko lham sprug po ni lwa mdog de rigs ma gtogs gzhan dang mi 'tsham mo/10 phyi lugs gyon chas kyi tshugs ka 'chol mi 'dod na/ dus tshigs rer skam 'khru thengs gnyis kyi yan mi bya zhing / ched gnyer gyi skam 'khru khang 'tshol ci thub byed dgos/khrim tshang la 'tsham pa'i par chas/khyim tshang phal bas par chas nyo ba ni ljongs rgyu'i dran rten dang khyim gyi 'tsho ba sogs par la 'debs pa gtso bo yin pas/ rgyang sgyur par chas nyo ba'i skabs su rgyang sgyur zur skyed(kroṭhaḍalko)'go rtsom gnas kyi 'dus thag(mesbyo7pa)ci ltar thung na de ltar bzang ba de bdams na legs/ yang gcig bshad na/ mig sngar rgyang thag sgyur ba'i(46ṭhatshog)‘‘hra kwa par chas kyi rgyang sgyur zur skyed 'go rtsom gnas kyi 'dus thag ches thung ba28spung yin/ de bas28bso'inas 'go brtsams te rgyang thag sgyur ba'i rgyang sgyur‘‘hra kwaripar chas bdam dgos zer ba de yin/ 'di ni khyim nas par blangs na par len cha rkyen gyis tshad bkag thebs te/ rtag par zur skyed 174

spyod pa'i gnas tshul 'byung ba'i dbang gis yin/ dper na/ ljongs rgyu'i khrod du bar thag cung nye sa nas yul ljongs cung chen po zhig len 'dod tshe zuraskyed rgya khyon cung che ba'i par shel(tshe 〉)spyod pa lta bu dang / yang dper na/ khyim gyi khang mig nas mi mang po mnyam du par la 'debs skabs zur skyed par shel de bas kyang spyod sgo che ba lta bu yin la/ 'di ni par chas kyi rgyang sgyur ci ltar thung na par len pa'i mthong rgya de ltar che ba'i rkyen gyis red/ rgyang sgyur zur skyed28baspu'inas 'go brtsams pa'i par chas kyis ches che na zur tshad tu'u75par la len thub/ mi'i mig gi mthong rgya dang 'dra ba'i50par yi tshad ldan par shel par chas la mtshon na/ de'i mthong rgya phal cher tu'u46ma gtogs med/ der brten/ rgyang sgyur zur skyed2807smonas 'go rtsom pa'i rgyang sgyur280smosayi rgyang sgyur hra kwa par chas bdams na/ khyim tshang phal ba'i par 'debs la zur skyed rgyang sgyur gyi spyod sgo khyab khongs 'dang nges shig mkho 'don byed la/ dngos spyod rang bzhin cung chen po ldan/sgro sru'i lwa ba'i bzang ngan ngos 'dzin thabs/blta ba/ tho bkod tshong rtags dang thon rdzas bed spyod gsal bshad yod med dang / thon rdzas kyi phyi tshugs dang 'tshem bzo'i rgyu spus la blta ba ste/ phyi ngos su sgro spu bud yod med dang / sgro spu bting ba cha snyoms yin min la yid 'jog byed dgos la/ 'tshem zhib pa dang gra dag po yin 175

dgos/ gsab pa dang btags pa/ bsgril ba bcas kyi bzo rtsal mkhregs shing snyoms la/ thar chod po yin pa las 'khyog cing gug mi rung / thon rdzas legs po zhig yin phyin/ sob tshad legs la dbugs rgyu gshis kyang legs dgos/ thon rdzas la rgyal khab spus tshad lag col lta skul sde khag gis dbang bstsal ba'i zhing chen dang grong khyer rim pa yan gyi spus tshad lta skul zhib bsher las khungs kyis bton pa'i zhib bsher snyan zhu brgyud yod med la blta ba'o// gnon pa/ sgro lwa skar ma gnyis nas gsum bar rang shugs kyis sbos su bcug rjes/ lag pas lwa ba mnan nas 'phral du btang ste myur mor sor chud yong min la blta dgos/ sor mi chud pa'am sor chud pa dal ba/sor chud tshad dma' ba bcas yin na/ sgro spu'i spus tshad zhan pa yin/reg pa/ lag pas reg cing btsir na de'i 'jam mnyen gyi tshad dang / sgro spu leb mo cha tshang can yod med la blta dgos/ 'jam zhing mnyen la sgro spu'ang cha tshang yin na thon rdzas legs po yin/brdab pa/ lag pas yang mor brdabs nas/ 'tshem shul du rdul yod med la blta ba'o//rdul med tshe thon rdzas legs po yin/mnyed pa/ sgro spu phyir bud tshe/ ras phyi nang gi rgyu spus zhan pa yin pagathon rdzos zhan pa yin/bsnom pa/ dri ngan pa sogs bro tshe/ sgro spu la bzo rtsal las snon ma 176

byas pa'am khrus kyis dug sel gzab nan ma byas pa'i rkyen yin pas/ rgyu spus mi legs pa'am re 'dun dang mi 'tsham pa gsal bshad byas shing /thon rdzas rdzun zhan can la gtogs so//'degs pa/ spyir btang du bongs che zhing yang na/ sgro spu mang zhing rgyu spus cung legs pa yin/ de las ldo ga na rgyu spus zhan pa'o//lag khyer kha par nyo che grangs ka drug yid la nges dgos/logacig lag khyer kha par gyi‘‘'gan len gsum ’gyi phan yun lo gcig yin la/ nyos 'dzin blangs pa nas brtsi dgos/ nyo mkhan gyis nyos 'dzin len skabs/ lo dang zla/ tshes bcas la mnyam 'jog byed dgos/nyin gcig nas nyin bdun bar/ lag khyer kha par nyos pa nas nyin bdun gyi nang / kha par gyi glog sgo 'byed mi thub pa'am tho 'god mi thub pa/skad mi rgyu ba/ shel yol gyi ngos su yi ge 'char mi thub pa'am yig nor 'char ba/ smyug kha chad pa/ 'dar dril gyi sgra med pa/ ang grangs nor 'dzol du 'gro ba/ rgyun ldan min par glog sgo rgyag pa sogs kyi gnas tshul byung tshe/ nyo mkhan la kha par phyir slog pa'i dbang cha yod/nyin brgyad nas bco lnga'i bar/ lag khyer kha par nyos rjes nyin brgyad nas bco lnga'i nang / kha par la gong smos kyi skyon zhugs tshe/ nyo mkhan la kha par brje ba'am yang na zhig gso byed pa'i re ba 'don dbang yod/ 177

nyin bdun/ zhig gsor sprad pa'i lag khyer kha par de nyin bdun gyi nang las ma thub tshe/ nyo mkhan gyis zhig gso par nyer spyod kha par g.yor dgos pa'i re ba bton chog la/ zhig gso byas rjes da gzod phyir slog choganyin drug cu/ gal te thon skyed tshong ba'i dbang gis zhig gso'i dus 'gyangs par ma zad/ zhig gsor sprad pa'i nyin nas nyin60bar da dung las ma tshar tshe/ nyo mkhan gyis nyos 'dzin dang‘‘'gan len gsum’’gyi dpang yig la brten nas/ 'tshong mkhan la rin ster mi dgos par dbyibs ang 'dra ba dang tshad 'dra ba'i kha par dang brje ba'i re ba bton choganyin sum cu/ gal te zhig gso pa rang nyid kyi rkyen gyis zhig gso'i dus yun nyin sum cu 'das kyang las ma thub pa byung tshe/ nyo mkhan gyis 'tshong mkhan la rin ster mi dgos par dbyibs ang 'dra ba dang tshad 'dra ba'i kha par dang brje ba'i re ba bton chog go/glog gdan bkol spyod dang gtses zas byed tshul/gcig glog gdan ma bkol gong la thog mar thon rdzos kyi nges gtan glog gnon la blta ba dang / bkol spyod byed pa'i glog khungs glog gnon de nges par du glog gdan gyi nges gtan glog gnon dang mthun dgos/ gal te glog gnon dma' ba'i rigs yin na nges par du der sbyar ba'i bde 'jags glog gnon bsgyur chas bkol ba las/ thad kar hphu178

220can gyi glog khungs su gtan nas mthud mi rung /gnyis/ glog gdan de mal khri sra mo'i steng snyoms por 'ding ba las lteb bcags gtong mi rung la/ rno skud mal khri dang ldem rtsib kyi mal khri sogs su'ang 'ding mi rung ste/ rgyu mtshan ni mal khri 'di rigs kyi steng du glog gdan bting na/ gnyid log pa'i skabs su de'i nang gi glog skud la gnon shugs thebs srid pas/ glog skud gcod pa dang chag sgo 'byung sla'o//gsum/ glog gdan 'ding ba gnas lugs dang mthun dgos pa las/ mal stan 'thug po'i 'og tu 'ding mi rung / gdan rkyang du'ang 'ding mi dung / rab yin na glog gdan gyi steng du ras gdan srab mo zhig bting na legs/ glog gdan gyi 'og tu 'gyig shog 'ding mi rung ste/'gyig shog las dbugs mi rgyu bas/ lus las bton pa'i rngul dbugs de bdeblag ngang rlangs 'gyur byed mi nus par/ rgyun par 'gyig shog steng brlan chags te glog gdan rlon pa byed sla bar brten glog rgyun gcod nus la bar chad thebs pa'o bzhi/ dgong mo ma nyal ba'i sngon gyi dus tshod skar ma15nas30yi yar sngon la glog gdan dros su 'jug dgos/ drod tshad snyoms chog pa'i glog gdan yin na/ sngon du dros tshadaspatho ru bcug chog dgong mor glog gdan bkol skabs/ gnyid ma log pa'i yar sngon la glog khungs bcad na 179

legs/lnga/ mtshan mor gcin pa 'chor ba'i byis pa dang rtswa chu dbang med du 'chor ba'i rgan rgon yin na/ glog gdan spyir btang ba thad kar bkol mi rung ste/ glog gdan rlon pa byas na glog phog pa'i nyen kha 'byung sla/drug glog gdan bkol ba'i skabs su lus po sbrid pa'i tshor pa yod na/ 'phral du bkol mtshams bzhag nas brtag zhib byed dgos/ glog mi phog pa'i ched du/ zhig gso byas rjes bkol spyod byed dgos/brnyan 'phrin gyi gnam skud la‘‘khrusami byedargha brjed mi rung /da lta brnyan 'phrin la lta ba'i khyim tshang mi nyung ba zhig gis gnam skud 'then yod/ yin na'ang gnam skud 'then rjes der lta rtog byed pa ha cang nyung / gnam skud bar snang du rjen par mngon yod pas/ yun ring bor char chu dang nyi 'og phog ste/ phyi ngos su rdul dreg mthug po zhig chags yod la/ des brnyan 'phrin gyi gsal tshad la gnod pa tshabs chen skyel ba red/de ni brnyan 'phrin gyi gnam skud dam gnam skud kyi spel skud(gnam skud kyi thog nas brnyan 'phrin gyi steng 'then pa'i skud pa)thog sa rdul dang dreg pa chags rjes/ gzugs med kyi‘‘glog 'dren’’zam pa zhig brnyan 'phrin gyi sdud len glog lam steng btsugs yod pa dang 'dra zhing / skabs der sdud len brda rtags khag cig zam pa brgyud nas 'gro srid pas/ brnyan 'phrin gyi phan yod nang 'dren brda rtags mngon gsal gyis zhan par byed la/180

brnyan 'phrin gyi gzugs ris mi gsal ba dang sgra'ang mi dwangs pa red/ de bas brnyan 'phrin gyi gnam skud de dus yun nges can zhig la bkol rjes/ras 'jam po chu'am 'dag rdzas dang bsgres nas gtsang mar 'byid dgos/nyi mar lde ba'i sring bal gyi nyal thul lag pas rdeb mi 'os cikhyod rang la sngar bzhin goms srol 'di 'dra zhig lobs yod pa ste/nyal thul nyi mar lde tshar rjes/ nyal thul de ka ba dang dngos po gzhan la deb pa'am yang na lag pas yang dang yang du shed kyis deb pa red/ 'di ltar byas na sa rdul dag cing / nyal thul sob po yong thub par 'dod/don dngos su de 'dra zhig ma yin te/ sring bal gyi tshi sna sbom zhing thung bas/rdeb tshe sil bur gtor sla ba dang / 'dres sbyor tshi sna phra zhing ring bas/deb tshe tshugs ka 'gyur sla ba ma zad/ tshi sna 'khums te rdog por gyur pa na yang bskyar sor chud dka'/ sgro spu'i nyal thul de bas kyang rdeb mi rung ste/sgro spu chad nas phra chung du thor rjes/ drod med par 'gyur ro// gtsang dag byed thabs la'ang dang dod byed dgos te/ dper na tshi sna'i nyal thul 'khru byed la 'dag dzos bkol ba las/ 'dag phye bkol nas phur mi rung zhing / dus yun chu tshod phyed ka yas mas kyis chog dar gos kyi nyal thul de skam 'khrud dam yang na dar gos 'khrud byed kyi 'dag rdzas bkol nas chu nang du bkru ba dang / dkar 'jug gi rdzas mi bkol bar rlugargyu sa nas bsil skam byed dgos/ — 181

nyal thul mi 'dra bar da dung bsil skam gyi drod tshad mi 'dra ba re yod de/ spyir btang du snga dro'i chu tshod11pa nas phyi dro'i chu tshod2pa'i bar ches legs shing / skam yun ring drags mi rung / sgro spu dang bal gyi nyal thul yang yang bsil skam byed mi dgos la/ nyi 'od drag po'i 'og tu gtan nas lde mi rung / rgyu mtshan ni drod mthon pos sgro spu dang bal gyi snum la 'gyur ba thebs su bcug ste rul dri slong bar byed pas/ rlung rgyu sa nas chu tshod1la bsil skam byas pas chogaja 'thungarghar dga' na dkar yol gtsang mar bkru dgos/tshan rig zhib 'jug pas brtag dpyad byas pa ltar na/ brlan che ba'i khor yug tu 'thung ja de myur bar dbyang 'gyur byas nas kham mdog gi ja dreg chags srid/ de'i nang du khad dang zha nye/ dngul chu/ sen sogs kyi gnod ldan lcags rigs 'dus pa red/ ja lo'i nang gi hphun dang ja dreg nang gi lcags rigs dngos rdzas gnyis mkha' dbugs khrod du dbyang 'gyur gyi byed nus thon pa las ja dreg 'byung ba dang / de ja dkar gyi nang ngos su chags te je mthug nas je mthug tu 'gro srid/ mi zhig gis ja dreg laljas 'gyur brtag dpyad byas myong ba dnge / ja dreg gi nang du da dung skran bskyed kyi rdzas 'ga' ste dper na ze 'bring skyur tshwa sogs 'dus pa shes/de dag gis mi lus kyi bde thang la gnod skyel ba red/ja dreg de ja 'thung mkhan gyi‘‘ja rngam 'thung’’byed pa dang bstun nas 182

rgyun chad med par 'ju byed ma lag tu rgyu zhing / zas rigs khrod kyi spri dkaraljas dang tshil skyur/ 'tsho ba'i rgyu sogs dang 'dres te gnod ldan rdzos mang po zhig tu 'gyur sla bas/ mi lus kyis zas rigs kyi 'tsho bcud bsdu ba dang 'ju bar 'gog rkyen bzo srid par ma zad/ don snod mang po zhig la'ang gnod pa thebs pa red/der brten ja 'thung rgyur dga' na ja dkar nam rgyun du bkru dgos/ja dreg chags yun ring ba'i ja dkar de/ so sman gyis yang yang bkrus na 'dag thub/ ja dreg chags pa'i ja dem de 'bras tshu'u dros ma'am yang na bul rkyang gi chu nang nyin zhag gcig la sbangs rjes/ sgul dkrugs byas nas yang yang bshal na gtsang mar bkru thub bo//byi ba rtsa med du gtong thabs 'ga'/1 byi ba'i sdod khungs rtsa med du gtong ba/ dus rgyun du byi khung bca' ba'i gnas te/ dper na gyang gi gru kha dang khang klad/ rgyun par mi sgul ba'i khyim chas/ de min zhing tshigs dang rtswa phung / sa phung sogs su zhib bsher byas te/ byi khung rnyed tshe kha gcod pa dang sngog pa/ chu ldug pa sogs kyi byed thabs spyad de byi ba med par gtong dgos/2 gzhan khyim du zhi la gsos na'ang khang pa'i nang gi byi ba rtsa med du gtong bar phan/3 byi 'joms dug sman bkol ba/ de la drag gshis can gyi byi 183

'joms dug sman dang dal gshis can gyi byi 'joms dug sman te rigs chen po gnyis su dbye/ drag gshis can gyi byi 'joms dug sman la dper na hphul dbyi zhan an(rgyu'ilkutshe'i74)dang byi 'joms dug chen(tsaṇḍazlibyeṣṭha)/ byi ba myur 'joms〈 zlint+ra7)sogs lta bu yod/ hphul dbyi zhan an 'dus pa'i byi sman(dper na chi'u hri byi sman lta bu )dar khyab byung myong na'ang / byi sman de rigs ni mi dang khyim bya/ sgo phyugs sogs la gnod pa che phyir/ rgyal khab kyis thon skyed dang phyir 'tshong byed par bkag sdom byas yod pas gtan nas bko'akhami rung / byi ba rtsa med du gtong bar bde 'jags kyi dal gshis can gyi sman te dper na hra hru'u smi(lhurdoblotshokhri)dang ti hru'u nā(chu'iṣṭha(48)zhi'u ti lung(tshorgyuchugrislong)sogs bkol dgos/ slu zas dug can byi khung gi kha dang gyang co/ de min byi ba rgyun par rgyug pa'i gnas sogs su 'jog pa dang / khang pa'i phyi rol gyi byi ba tso med du gtong na slu zas dug can zhing tshigs kyi brgyud du 'jog dgos/ byis pa dang khyim bya/ sgo phyugs sogatag kyirutiza bar mnyam 'jog dgos la/ lag pas kyang reg mi rung / dug phog pa'i byi ba shi ro mthong tshe 'phrale du sa zhog tu sbas te byi ladang phag sogs kyi khar 'gro ru 'jug mi rung /4 du bas bdug pa/ mdzod khang nang gi byi ba co med du gtong na/mu zi sbar ba'am yang na lin 'gyur ha yang dang pir ka won sogs kyi dzras 'gyur bdug rlangs bkol chog la/ mu zi dang shidzogazhog 'dres ma sbur 184

nas byi khung du badzrangs te khung sgo dam por bcad kyang chog5 rnyi 'dzugs pa/ 'tshir byed dang gzeb/ them skam/ chu rdza sogs spyad chog la/ sa ma rub gong byi ba rgyun par rgyug pa'i gnas su bzhag ste 'dzin pa'o// slu zas la snum byugs dgos par ma zad mer cung bsregs nas dri 'thul bar byed dgos/ byi ba bzung ba'i 'tshir rnyi dang gzeb rnyi sogs chu khol gyis bshal nas byi ba'i dri ma sel dgos/zhing spyod 'phrul 'khor nyar 'jog ma byas gong gi bdag skyong byed tshul/zhing spyod 'phrul 'khor dus yun ring bo zhig la bkol nas mtshams 'jog na/ nyar 'jog ma byas gong der bdag skyong tshags zhib mo zhig byed dgos/ de las ldog tshe/ de'i lag rtsal gyi rnam pa je btsog tu phyin nas/bkol yun je thung du 'gro srid/ bkol mtshams bzhag ma thag thog mar ngar ma yal ba'i skabs dang bstun nas 'phrul snum gtsang mar 'don pa dang / 'phrul chas dang chu sgam nang gi tsha 'beb chu gtsang mar phud dgos/ chu phud tshar rjes kyog mda' thengs 'gar bskor nas chu sgam du chu lhag mi lus ripa byed dgos la/'phrul 'khor gyi phyi ngos gtsang mar bkru dgos/khra'e snum gtsang mas 'jam 'dred ma lag gi lhu lag khag gtsang bkru byas rjes/ dwangs 'tshag dang chu bton zin pa'i 'phrul sdum spus legs blugs nas kyog mda' bskor te/ 'jam 'dred ma lag hril bor 'phrul 185

snum gyis khengs par byed dgos/ dbugs 'dren sbu gu blangs nas dbugs 'dren brgyud lam nas dbugs rdza'i khog tu chu bton 'phrul sdum khe300('phrul snum tu'u100yan du dros su bcug nas de'i nang gi brlan cha rlangs 'gyur byed pa) ldugs pa dang / de nas kyog mda' bskor te/'phrul snum de dang bstun nas ho se dang dbugs rdza'i kha sbyar ngos su khyab par byed dgos/ 'phrul 'khor gyi phyi rtsi dag pa'i gnas su rtsi gtong ba dang / chag pa'am dbyibs 'gyur ba'i lhu chas dag zhig gso'am yang na gsar par brje dgos/ 'phrul 'khor 'jog sa de rlung rgyu ba dang brlan med pa yin dgos la/ me dang rgyang du gyes pa dang / nye 'gram du rdzos lud dang zhing sman sogs kyi rul rdzas gtan nas spungs mi rung / glog gsog snod blangs nas bsil skam che sar 'jog pa dang / zla re'i nang glog thengs gcig la gsab dgos/ 'khor lo'i nang gi dbugs rgyun ldan gyi tshad dang mthil la shing leb 'ding dgos/ 'gyig thag blangs nas nyar ba dang snum sogs 'gos su 'jug mi rung /thog 'gog pa'i thabs brgyad/ 1 glog dmar 'khyug pa'i skabs su/ phyi nu mi 'gro bar khang pa'i nang du bsdad na rab yin/2 nges par du phyi ru 'gro dgos na/ khang pa sogs mang sar 'gro ba 186

las/ chu 'gram dang thang stong sogs su mi 'gro ba dang / rang nyid yod sa'i nye 'khor gyi gnas mtho sar langs par mi bya'o//3 khang pa'i nang du khyim spyod glog chas mi bkol ba dang / khang pa'i phyi ru glog 'dren dngos po'i nye sar bcar bar mi bya'o//4 lag khyer kha par mi gtong ba dang yu ba lcags can gyi char gdugs 'dzin par mi bya'o//5 chu rkyal rdzing bu dang mtshe'u/ mtsho 'gram mam sdong 'og bcas su sdod mi rung /6 lcags kyi lan kan dang lcags rdang / lcags lam gyi nye 'gram bcas su sdod mi dung /7 khrus chas bkol bar 'dzem dgos te/ chu sbug sa dang 'brel yod pas/ chu brgyud nas mi la glog phog ste 'chi rmas 'byung bar byed do//8 sgo dang dra ma dam por brgyab nas/ thog cha mched pa 'gog dgos/zhing las gnyer na'ang tho yig legs par 'god dgos/khe bzang la snyegs pa ni zhing ba tsho'i rgyu nor don du gnyer ba'i phugs 'dun yin/ zhing las kyi yong sgo dang 'gro song thor bkod na/ da gzod zhing las kyi go rim du tshur blangs pa'i spyi'i yong 'bab dang / phar btang ba'i 'gro song gi spyi'i gron dngul gsal bor shes thub/ rtsis brgyab pa 187

brgyud nas ma rtsa ci tsam brdibs pa'am yang na khe spogs ci tsam blangs pa shes la/ grub 'bras dang he bag kyang mthong thub pas/ khyim tshang gi dpal 'byor phan 'bras mu mthud du je mthor 'gro ba red/1 ma rtsa'i 'du shes je cher gtong dgos/ zhing las thon dzas kyi tshong brin min de gtso bo rgyu spus dang rin gong la thug yod/ rin gong gi rmang gzhi ni ma rtsa yin pas/ rin gong gi 'gran shugs je cher gtong 'dod na/ nges par du ma rtsa mar 'beb thabs byed dgos/2 'gro song dang yong sgo'i tho yig bzo dgos/ lo mjug gi zhib rtsis la gzhi 'dzin sa 'don sprod byed par stabs bde bzo ched/ zhing las kyi go rim khrod kyi 'gro song dang yong sgo dus ltar thor bkod nas/ gzhi grangs ngo ma khong du chud dgos/ 'bru rigs sogs zhing las thon rdzas kyi tshong rdzas sna tshogs dang phyir 'tshong las thob pa'i yong sgo dus thog tu thor 'god dgos pa dang / 'gro song gi gron dngul sna tshogs te dper na sa bon dang rdzas lud/ 'phrul rmo/ chu rin/ 'bru khral/ zhing las kyi dpya khral sogs dus thog tu thor 'god dgos/3 lo mjug gi zhib rtsis legs par len pa/ lo mjug gi skabs su/lo gcig ring gi zhing las thon skyed kyi yong sgo dang 'gro song gi gnas tshul la phyir 'dang dang spyi bsdoms byed dgos pa ma zad/ nor don dbye zhib byas na/ da gzod thon dzras 'phar ba dang yong sgo 'phar ba'i kha phyogs 188

dngos su mthong thub cing / der brten nas lo rjes ma'i thon las sgrig gzhi snyoms sgrig byas te/ sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas bdag gnyer gyi rigs lam gting zab tu 'byed pa dang / bab bstun gyi thabs jus spyad nas dpal 'byor phan 'bras mu mthud du je mthor gtong dgos/ko lham gyi gas srub nyams gso byed thabs/ko lham gyi ngos su gas srubs byung tshe/ thog mar srubs ka'i nang du rdolpu brdzangs pa dang / de'i rjes su dbur ti tsha drod dma' mo can gyis dus tshod 'os 'tsham zhig la 'chag 'chag byas te 'tshig tu mi 'jug pa dang / de nas kha dog gcig pa'i ko rtsi byugs pas chog go/ gal te gas srubs chung na/ snag kong gi nang du sgong dwangs blugs nas snag tsha gar po nu brdar ba dang / spu smyug dang bsgres nas gas srubs nang byugs te bsil skam byas rjes/ ko rtsi bskus tshe ko lham rnying pa gsar par 'gyur ro// tha mag gi si skudalpa spyod sgo gzhan/rdul dreg 'dag pa ste/ 'then 'phror lus pa'i tha mag gi si skud dang 'dag phye gnyis mnyam du khrus gzhong du 'phangs nas/ zhu 'byed byas rjes seng khra sogs 'khru bdar byas na gtsang ma yong /shel sgo phyi bdar byed pa ste/ tha mag gi si skud kyis rlung 'gog shel sgo phyi bdar byas na/ rdul dreg sogs 'dag par phan/189

dri ngan sel ba ste/ tha mag gi si skud spyod khang du bzhag na/ 'bu sbrang dang 'bu phra skye 'phel yong ba 'gog thub la/ dri ngan sel bar yang phan/za 'phrug sel ba ste/ skyi pags la 'bu sbrang gis so btab tshe za 'phrug langs/ tha mag gi si skud chu dang bsgres nas bskus na skrangs pa 'joms pa dang za 'phrug sel bar phan/me tog steng gi 'bu sel ba ste/ tha mag gi si skud ja phor du sbangs nas/ 'dag rdzas kyi zhu bsher nyung tsam blugs te/ rten sder me tog gi steng gtor na/ skye dngos kyi gnod 'bu sel thub/mdzub dkris phyi bdar byed pa ste/ tha mag gi si skud dang tshal snum phyed re mnyam du bsres nas/ gser gyi mdzub dkris phyis na 'od 'khyug po yong /khang pa'i nang gi dri ngan sel thabs/tha mag gi dri ma/ khang pa'i nang du du smug 'thib skabs/ tshu'u dang bsgres pa'i lag phyis yar mar du g.yugs pa'am yang na yang la gnyis sgron na du dri 'phral du med 'gro/bkrag rtsi'i dri ma/ gsar du bkrag rtsi byugs pa'i gyang sdebs sam khyim chas sogs la bkrag rtse'i dri kha mo zhig yod pas/ tshwa chu gzhong ba gnyis bzhag na/ nyin gnyis kyi rjes su dri ma med par 'gro/190

rlan dri/ 'then sgam dang gyang sgam/ gos sgam sogs la rlan dri yod na/ de dag gi nang du dri zhim 'dag rdzas shig bzhag na chogasol snum gyi dri ma/ sol snum gyi thab ka nas me 'bar ba'i skabs su du ba nag po zhig 'phyur ba dang / dbugs lam yongs su khyab 'gro/ snga mo nas sol sdum gyi nang du tshu'u thigs pa 'ga' btig pas chogame tog gi lud sman gyi dri ma/ khang pa'i nang du me tog gsos nas lud sman gtor na/ dus tshod yun ring 'gor tshe dri ngan pa 'thul srid/tsha lu ma'i shun pa zhib mor gtub nas gsher sman gyi nang du bsres chog la/tsha lu ma'i shun pa de'ang ma gzhi nas me tog gi lud rdzas legs po zhig kyang yin/rong 'brog mang tshogs grongaster du yong nas nad la ci ltar blta dgos/1 nad kyi lci yang la bltas nas sman khang gdam pa/ rgyun mthong gi nad de dper na cham pa dros 'khyag dang khrag shed mtho ba sogs lta bu ni/spyir btang gi sman khang chung 'bring tshang mas sman bcos byed thub cing /bcos thabs la'ang khyad par chen po med pas/ sman khang 'bring ba zhig gam yang na sman khang chung ba zhig tu song nas bstan na/ dus tshod dang sgor mo gnyis ka gron chung byed thub/ nad khyad par ba yin na ched las tshan pa'i dmigs bsal sman khang du song nas ston dgos/2 nad la lta thengs rer ched mkhas sman par ston mi dgos/ spyir 191

bshad na/ thog mar nad la blta skabs ched mkhas sman pa yin na'ang 'dra/sman pa phal ba yin na'ang 'dra/ tshang mas nad kyi gnas tshul gzhir bzung nas/ thog mar nad pa la bab bstun gyi khrag bsher dang gcin pa sogs rgyun srol brtag bsher byed du bcug rjes/ da gzod yang bskyar brtag pa red/ der brten nad la thog mar lta skabs spyir btang gi rtags tho zhig bkod na chog 3 nad tho rnying pa khyer rgyu brjed mi rung / sa cha gzhan gyi nad pa la las nad la lta skabs/ rang gi sa gnas kyi sman khang gis brtag dpyad byas pa'i dpyad yig 'khyer rgyu brjed 'gro bas/ bskyar du brtag bsher byed dgos pa dang / dus tshod dang sgor mo gnyis ka brlag gron du 'gro bas/ nad tho'i dpyad yig nyar 'jog dang de 'khyer nas sman khang du nad lalta ru 'gro rgyu brjed mi rung / 'di ni‘‘sgor mo nyung bkol dang na tsha sangs drag tu gtong ba'i ’thabs shig yin/4 ‘‘rin gong mtho ba'imi’brtag bsher byed dgos don med/ nad pa kha shas rgyun par nyan chas dang / snying par/ khrikhri'o sogs stabs bde'i sman bcos brtag bsher gyi sdom tshig la yid ches kyi med pas/bulasogs‘‘rin gong mtho ba'i ’sman bcos brtag bsher byed pa dang / de ltarakhyas na da gzod phyogs yongs dang rtsa ba nas brtag bsher thub par 'dod/ don dngos su gang 'dod du bkol sla zhing gla rin yang dka' ba'i 192

brtag bcos rnam grangs kha shas ni nad pa yod tshad la 'tsham pa zhig min la/ brtag bsher gyi skabs su zhor rkyen ngan pa'ang thon pa red/ nad pa mang po zhig gis don med du sgor mo mang po bkol bar ma zad/ brtag bsher gyi phan 'bras kyang rang gi thog ma'i 'dod pa dang 'gal srid/dper na mkhris nad dang snying gi grub tshul sogs la mtshon na/ sgor brgya stong mang po bkol dgos pa'ibu1dang ho tshi gung krin( ṣṭhaṭhaṣācho)gyi brtag bsher phan 'bras las sgor bcu phrag 'ga'i sgra 'das brtag dpyad bkol na bzang srid pa'o//5 spyir btang gi sman bkol bas chog sman nyo skabs thog marargyun bkol gyi sman la bsam blo gtong ba ni sgor mo gron chung byed pa'i thabs mchog tu gyur pa zhig yin la/ rin gong cung mtho ba'i phyi rgyal gyi sman dang ma rtsa mnyam bzhag gi sman dang bsdur na‘rgyun bkol gyi sman gyi rin gong dma' bar ma zad/ bde 'jags yin la yid rton yang byas chogadaper na rgyun mthong gi a si phe lin(lo7⑩rnyekhri )dang rams rtsa sbangs sman(75rsā41mu7/)sogs lta bu ni sman dam be gang(sgam chung gcig)gi rin gong la sgor 'ga' 'am yang na bcu lhag las mi shor zhing / phan nus kyang rin gong mtho ba'i sman gzhan las chung rgyu med do//6 nad la lta ba'i gnas 'phyugs mi rung / nad pa kha shas kyis nad la lta mi shes te/ dper na 'phral bcos nad pas‘dal bcosamibyed pa 193

'byung zhing mched pa yin la/ phag gi kha tsha rmig tsha spyir btang du zla2pa nas4pa'i bar mched pa red/2 nad rtags/ nor ni lus kyi tsha rgyas pa dang rnam rig mi gsal ba/zas kyi yi ga 'gag pa'am rtswa mi za ba/ kha btsum ste langs nas 'dug par ma zad kha mchu mang po bzhur ba/ kha nang la bltas na kha nang dang lce/ rnyil thog bcas na chu bur 'ga' re'am mang po yod pa/ lag pas reg na sha nur/ chu bur nang du chu ser dwangs mo yod pa dang chu bur brdol rjes che chung mi 'dra ba'i rul thig dmar por 'gyur/ skabs der tsha 'jags nas rgyun ldan du 'gro la rul thig rim bzhin sos nas drag nad phyugs kha shas kyi sna nang dang rmig bar/ nu ma'i thog sogs la chu bur ram rul thig 'byung ba red/ spyir btang du lug gi kha nang nas nad rtags mi mngon/ thog mar mthong ba ni rkang lag 'theng ba dang / rmig pa'i mtha' skor na chu bur dang rul thig yod pa de yin/ phag la kha tsha rmig tsha byung ba'i nad rtags kyang rmig thog na yod pa dang song na 'theng ba red/ nad lci na rmig pa lhung zhing nyal nas mi langs/ la la'i sna rtse la chu bur dang rul thig 'byung / nad 'di spyir btang du rang bzhin gyis drag pa dang / phyugs phrug kha shas 'chi ba'ang yod/3 nad la brtag pa/195

nad mched pa'i khyad chos dang nad rtags gzhir bzung nas rim bzhin nad la brtag dgos/ de dang mtshungs su chu ser dang chu bur gyi phyi shun khe10 yas mas len pa'am nad drag skabs kyi nad phyugs kyi khrag blangs te lan gru phyugs nad zhib 'jug khang la bskyal nas nad ngos 'dzin bya dgos/4 'gog bcos byed thabs/ snga ba dang mgyogs pa/ gzab nan/chung ba bcas kyi co don la dmigs nas dus thog tu nad rtsa med du gtong dgos pa ste/ nad byung ba snga mor shes dgos pa dang nad tshul snga mor yar zhu byed pa/ byed thabs mgyogs pa/ 'gog bcos byed pa gzab nan yin pa/ nad kyi gnas dang khul gyi khyab khongs chung ba bcas kyi rtsa don la dmigs dgos/(1)kha tsha rmig tsha yin par dogs pa yod pa'i skabs su dus thog tu yar zhu bya dgos par ma zad bkag sdom bya dgos/(2)nad ngos bzung rjes nad kyi gnas dang khul/ gnod skyon thebs khul bcas gtan la 'bebs dgos/ gal te nad phyugs nyung na myur du bsad nas sa 'og zab sar sba dgos/(3) gnod skyon thebs khul dang nad khul nas kha tsha rmig tsha'i 'gog sman spyad nas myur du sngon 'gog bya dgos/ nad yod pa'i gnas kyi phyugs thang bo la'ang 'gog sman brgyab nas mched rim je thung du gtong ba dang 196

myur du nad co med du gtong dgos/(4)nad phyugs la gso bcos bya dgos/ kha nang dang rmig bar sogs la wa tshwa mar snum bskus nas rul thig sos pa je mgyogs su gtong dgos/ btsog pa bzos sa'i sa cha dang phyugs rwa/ phyugs khang bcas la dug sel bya dgos/(5)nad khul dang gnod skyon thebs khul bar gyi sa mtshams nas nad bsher dug sel sa tshugs btsugs nas phyugs dang phyugs dzas 'khor rgyugs byed pa gtan 'gog bya dgos/(6)nad phyugs ches gzhug ma drag pa'am shi ba dang 'gog sman brgyab nas nyin14yi rjes su dug sel co ba nas byas pa brgyud de bkag sdom btang na chog nad khul nang gi phyugs zog zla gsum gyi rjes su da gzod rtswa sar spar chog(7)rgyun 'byung gi sa khul nas lo re'i ston dpyid la 'gog sman thengs gnyis la rgyag dgos/ lo gsum gyi nang du nad ma byung tshe da gzod 'gog sman ma brgyab na chogs skyon/saskyon ni sa skyon dbyig srin gyis slong zhing mi phyugs kun la 'byung ba'i myur langs khrag nyams rang bzhin gyi 'go nad cig red/ de'i khyad rtags gtso bo ni glo bur du tsha rgyas pa dang 'byar skyi smug por 'gyur ba/ bu 197

ga nas khrag 'bud pa bcas so// nad 'di dbyar kha char ba mang ba'i dus la rtag par 'byung ba'am sa gnas rang bzhin gyis mched pa red/1 nad rtags/ nad 'di mang che ba myur langs rang bzhin brgyud pa red/ ches myur langs rang bzhin can ni lug yin/ rtag par glo bur du nad byung ba dang / 'dar yom byed pa/ sa la log nas rtsa 'then byung ba/'byar skyi dmar skug tu 'gyur ba/ tsha rgyas nas40spuyan la bslebs shing /lus 'dar ba dang rnam rig mi gsal ba/ yi ga 'gag pa/ 'phar rtsa mgyogs pa/ 'byar skyi dmar nag tu 'gyur ba/ dbugs 'byin rngub dka' ba/ mig gi rno je cher 'gro ba bcas 'byung la/ spyir btang du nyin2kyi rjes su 'chi 'gro ba red/ rta la sa skyon byung na rtag par rgyu rlug pa'i nad rtags yod la/ rdzing dang rta brun nang du khrag yod/ rgyun du mgrin pa dang ske/ thong ga gsus pa sogs nas sa skyon rma ril 'bud pa red/ nor la sa skyon byung rjes rtag par glo bur du shi ba dang / 'jigs yer nas ngur ba/mi dang srog chags la rgol ba red/ phag la sa skyon 'byung ba ha cang nyung /sa skyon gyis shi ba'i ro la spyir btang du gshags dpyad gtong ba gtan 'gog byed pa yin/ de ni sa skyon dbyug srin de phyi yul khor yug khrod dug nus ha cang che ba'i srin sgong du gyur nas dus yun ring bor sa nang nas 'tsho zhing btsog 'gyur bzo bas red/ gal te gshags dpyad byas tshe ro tshang ma sra mor gyur med pa dang khrag mi dkag pa dang snum 'tshig 198

ro dang 'dra/ ko lngags 'og tu khrag mchis/ mtsher ba skrangs yod pa bcas red/2 nad la brtag pa/ ma shi ba'i sngon la nad ngos 'dzin rgyu cung dka'/ sa gnas de ga'i sngon chad kyi nad byung ba'i gnas tshul dang nad byung ba'i dus tshigs/ nad byung ba'i srog chags kyi rigs/ 'chi ba mgyogs pa bcas gzhir bzung na nad ngos 'dzin par phan/ nad ngos 'dzin ma nor ba bya na rlam phra rig pa dang khrag dpyad rig par brten nas thag gcod dgos/ 'chi khar rna'i sdod rtsa'i khrag dang mtshar khrag blangs nas shel thog tu bskus dpyad byas na sa skyon dbyug srin mthong thub/ shi rjes rna rtse cung tsam len pa dang ske'i spen mdud blangs nas tsi gu dkar chung dang mtsho phag sogs la brgyab na sa skyon gyi nad rtags ngo ma 'byung bar ma zad/ nyin2—3la shi 'gro/ khrag dpyad rig pas ngos 'dzin bya na khrag snyigs tshur snang gi byed thabs spyod dgos/3 'gog bcos/ nad byung rjes nad khul la bkag sdom byas nas dug sel gtsang dag bya dgos/ nad 'di rgyun 'byung gi sa khul nas lo re'i dpyid kar 'byung sla ba'i sgo phyugs la sa skyon dbyug sgong 'gog sman spyad nas nad 'gog bya dgos/ nad byung ba'i dus 'gor 'bu srin 'gog sman(74sau)dang hong an(tshoṣṭha)rigs kyi sman rdzas mang po spyad nas gso bcos bya dgos/ rta dang nor la thengs rer chin me su'u rtsis 199

gzhi wan400 — 500sha gseng du rgyag pa dang nyin rer thengs gsum/len me su'u dang thu'u me su'u/ zi hon su'u sogs mnyam spyod byas kyang rung / lus kyi ljid tshad spyi rgya rer khe0 015yi sman tshad ltar‘‘914’’brgyab na phan nus cung bzang bo yod pa dang / de yang‘‘914’’de skyes lugs tshwa chu nang du bsres nas zhu ru bcug ste sdod rtswa'i nang du rgyag dgos/hong an rigs kyi sman dzas de lus kyi ljid tshad spyi rgya gcig la khe0 1 —0 2kyi sman tshad ltar ldud dgos pa dang / dus tshod bzhi rer thengs re dang bstud mar nyin3 —5la ldud dgos/ khi la'o lin rta dang nor la thengs rer khe15—25dang / nyin rer thengs3la ldud dgos la/ rgyu ma'i sa skyon la phan nus nges can zhig yod/ sa skyon gyis shi ba'i sgo phyugs la rdo thal chu sogs kyis dug sel byas rjes sa 'og zab sar sba dgos/'gagand/(lko755)'gag nad ni pā hri dbyug srin gyis slong ba'i myur langs dang lus hril bor mched pa'i 'go nad cig yin/ de'i khyad rtags ni glo bur du nad 'byung ba dang tsha rgyas/ shi tshad mtho/1 nad rtags/ lus drod400yan la slebs pa dang / co 'phar ba mgyogs shing sna nang skam/ spu gzengs/ yi ga chad/ skyug ldad mi byed/'o ma bskams/ sngon la co 'gag pa dang phyis su rnyang / skabs 'gar rnyang 200

khu'i nang du khrag yod/ ol mdud 'og dang mid pa'i khag skungs pa dang dbugs kyi 'byin rngub dka'/ 'byar skyi smug por 'gyur/ nad phyugs rtag par dbugs 'gag pa'am rnyang nas 'chi/ khog gshags na myur langs khrag nyams kyi 'gyur ldog mngon/ glo tshad dbyibs kyi glo ba gshar ngos mchin 'gyur dang brang khog nang na gsher khu mang po yod pa dang / la la'i pho rgyu'i 'byar skyi na khrag 'dzum pa'am khrag thon yod/2 nad la brtag pa/ sa skyon dang rlung skungs 'bur nad/ nor gyi khrag srin tsha nad (ṭhayo)bcas dang dbye ba dgar dgos/ nor gyi 'gag nad chu skrangs ni gtso bo mid pa'i khag na yod par ma zad/ ro shing ba dang khrag yongs su dkag pa las sa skyon dang dbye ba dgar dgos/rlung skrangs 'bur nad kyi skrangs sbos gtso bo sha gnad rgyas pa'i gnas na yod pa dang mnan tshe skabs 'gar sgra yod la/ gshags tshe chu bur yod/nor gyi khrag srin tsha nad la khrag dmar spri dkar gcin dang khrag nyams pa'i nad rtags 'byung ba dang / nad ngos 'dzin na 'chi khar khrag blangs nas dpyad pa dang / shi rjes snying khrag dang mchin pa/ mtsher ba/ rmen mdud sogs la rlam phra rig pas zhib bsher bya dgos/ 3 'gog bcos/ nam zlar 'gyur ldog byung nas lus kyi nad 'gog nus pa je chung du song ba ni nad 'di'i 'byung rkyen yin/ rang zhing nas rtag par dgun dpyid la nad 'di 'byung ba yin pas/ lo re'i ston 201

khar 'gag nad 'gog sman spyad nas nad 'gog pa ni thabs lam gtso bo yin/ nad byung rjes myur du 'gog bcos byas kyang chog nad kyi dus 'gor 'bu srin 'gog sman dang hong an rigs kyi sman rdzas spyad nas sman gso byas na phan 'bras nges can nyabyung / sdod rtsa'i nang du105yi hon an mes tin na(lo'iḥyiskosaṣṭhakhyime )chusman ha'o hrin100— 150rgyag pa dang / nyin rer thengs gnyis brgyab na phan 'bras cung bzang / chin me su'u dang len me su'u/ thu'u me su'u sha gseng du brgyab na'ang chog glo tshad kyi nad rtags yod tshe sdod co'i nang du‘‘914mimirgyag dgos/ ljid tshad spyi rgya rer khe0 01ltar rtsi dgos/ rnyang skabs rig son(dzoju64)khe5—20dang li the lin(sko4〉〉〉glu)khe0 5— 1bsres nas chu drod 'jam 'os 'tsham bsnan te blud kyang choganor gyi dug nad rang bzhin gyi rnyang nadad wa'abyar byu'i nad/ (rgoglorsālta'i0 ṭhad waṣkatshoglorga)'byar skyi'i nad ni nad dug gis slong ba'i 'go nad cig yin/ khyad rtagasagatso bo ni lus drod je mthor 'gro ba dang sna nang dang 'ju lam gyi 'byar skyi rul ba dang smug por 'gyur/ nad 'di be'u la 'byung ba mang zhing rang zhing nas dbyar khar 'byung ba mang /1 nad rtags/ spyir btang du bag nyal nad yun nyin3—15yin/nad 'di mang che ba glo bur du 'byung zhing lus drod40—42sbyil je mthor 202

'gro/ nor nad pa'i rnam rig mi gsal ba dang yi ga med/ dbugs kyi 'byin rngub dang snying gi lding tshad je mgyogs su 'gro/ chu btung bar dga'/kha nang dang lce thog rnyil bcas kyi 'byar skyi dmar zhing skungs/ mi 'gyang bar rul/ kha mchu bzhur/ sna nang gi 'byar skyi'i thog khrag 'dzum pa dang rul/ snab lud 'bag ro bzhur/ phyis su rnag lta bur 'gyur/ nor nad pa la la'i rmig bar rul nas gyol bor 'gyur/ gza' 'khor gcig gi rjes su spyir btang du rnyang ba dang / lbu ba ldan zhing mdog nag dri ngan pa'i rnyang khu gtong / rnyang khu nang du rgyu shun dang khrag 'dres yod/ lci na 'chi 'gro ba red/ nor nad pa'i khog gshags na pho rgyu'i 'byar skyi rul zhing skungs pa dang / rgyu nag la myur langs rang bzhin gyi gnyan tshad yod/ long gar gnyan tshad dang smug rul mchis/ sna mang gi 'byar skyi nas khrag 'dzum pa dang khrag thon pa'am rul 'dug pa mthong /2 nad la brtag pa/ nad rtags ngo ma dang nad lugs ltar gshags dpyad byas nas thog ma'i ngos 'dzin bya dgos/ nad kyi ngos 'dzin mi 'khrul ba bya na nor nad pa'i khrag blangs nas tshod lta khang nas zhib bsher bya dgos/3 'gog bcos/ phan nus khyad par can gyi sman gso sman rdzas med/ phag nad dug nyung 'khyag skam 'bu phra'i 'gog sman spyad nas nad 'byung ba'i dus tshigs kyi sngon la sngon 'gog bya dgos/ nor rer phag nad 203

'bu phra'i 'gog sman phag gsum la rgyag tshad brgyab na sngon 'gog gi nus pa cung bzang po yod/ rang zhing phyugs las gso rig slob gling gis nor gyi nad dug rang bzhin gyi rnyang nad‘‘0’’rgyud dug nyung 'khyag skam 'gog sman zhib bzo byas nas grub pa dang / dam bu re'i rgyag tshad20yin/ skyes lugasatshwa chu ha'o hrin20spyad nas zhu rjes nor re'i sha gseng du ha'o hrin gcig brgyab na srung skyob nus pa90smoyan la bslebs/ nad 'gog yun gnas skabs su lo gcig la gtan khel byas yod/be'u li'i 'dar nad phal ba/(ṣṭha.oṃkhro//oṃ⑫)nad 'di ni sal mon dbyug srin gyis slong ba'i be'u li zla ba gnyis can la gtso bor ldang ba'i 'go nad cig yin/ gtso bo myur langs rang bzhin gyi pho rgyu gnyan tshad dang glo tshad dam grum nad bcas slong bar byed la/ shi tshad cung mtho/ nor chen por nad byung na nad rtags med/1 nad rtags/ nor nad pa'i lus drod rgyas pa dang snying rtsa 'phar ba gnyom zhing mgyogs/ dbugs kyi 'byin rngub je mgyogs su 'gro/dbugs rdib/ rnam rig mi gsal ba dang yi ga 'gag nyin2—3gyi rjes su pho rgyu gnyan tshad kyi nad rtags 'byung ba dang mdog ser zhing rgyu shun dang khrag bcas 'dres pa'i rnyang khu dri ngan can gtong / nad lci ba'i skabs su rtag par gcin gtong bar ma zad na zug gi snang ba dang glo lu/dbugs 'tshang ba bcas yod pa dang / 'chi bar 'gyur/ zla ba gnyis 204

yan gyi be'u lir nad 'di byung na nad cung yang ba dang spyir btang du rang bzhin gyis drag 'gro/ be'u li nad pa shi ba'i ro la gshags dpyad byas na khrag thon rang bzhin gyi pho rgyu gnyan tshad mngon/ grod pu'i 'byar skyi dang rgyu ma'i 'byar skyi la gnyan tshad yod/ mtsher ba'i nang du khrag babs nas skungs shing khrag thon/ la la'i glo ba dmar skya yin la sra mor gyur yod/ la la'i brang khog gi 'byar skyi 'brel yod/2 nad la brtag pa/ nad byung ba'i lo tshod dang nad rtags/gshags dpyad bcas gzhir bzung na nad ngos 'dzin bya thub/3 'gog bcos/ rgyun 'byung gi sa khul nas nor gyi 'dar nad phal ba'i dug nyung gson myug 'gog sman(༈khro//lta'izojushe'u oṃ)brgyab nas sngon 'gog bya dgos/ sman gso byed skabs li thi lin ljid tshad spyi rgya rer ha'o khe20/ nyin rer thengs gnyis/ bstud mar nyin3—5la ldud dgos/ lu'u me su'u ljid tshad spyi rgya rer ha'o khe20/ nyin rer thengs bzhi/bstud mar nyin4—6la ldud dgos/ hong an mes ljid tshad spyi rgya rer khe0 1/ nyin rer thengs gnyis/ bstud mar nyin bdun la ldud dgos/sgog pa brdungs nas nyin rer khe20—25blud na'ang chogapu'u lu'u gri dbyug srin nad/(oṃjotshaṣṭhasgroṣka)pu'u lu'u hri dbyug srin nad ni pu'u lu'u hri 'bu srin gyis slong ba'i mi dang srog chags mang por 'byung ba'i dal langs rang bzhin gyi 'go nad 205

cig yin/ gtso bo mo phyugs 'phyis pa dang pho phyugs la rlig tshad 'byung ba red/1 nad rtags/ srog chags sna tshogs la nad byung rjes nad rtags gsal bo med/gtso bo mo phyugs kyis 'phyis pa dang / lhag par du mtshar mo'i 'phyis tshad mtho/ rtag par nor khyu dang lug khyu khrod mo phyugs kyis 'phyis par ma zad/ sha ma mi lhung ba dang nu ma'i gnyan tshad sogs kyi nad rtags mngon/ pho phyugs la rtag par rlig tshad 'byung / phag la gtso bo grum nad dang rlig tshad 'byung / nad 'dis rta la gtso bo chi ca la'o slong bar byed/2 nad la brtag pa/ 'phyis pa'i nad rtags gzhir bzung nas rim bzhin nad ngos 'dzin dgos/ nad kyi ngos 'dzin mi 'khrul ba bya na khrag la zhib bsher byed pa'am 'phyis ro las pu'u hri dbyug srin len dgos/3 'gog bcos/ lug dang phag gi 'gog sman ang lnga ba(sdong75stsakhri lkommu5dngha.oṃ)spyad nas sngon 'gog bya dgos/ son phyugs ra ba nas nad yams la rtog zhib byas nas pho phyugs nad can 'dor dgos/sonaphyugs rin thang can la ma gtogs spyir btang du sman gso byed pa'i dgos pa med/rmig rul nad/(lkoṣkalo)rmig rul nad ni rul 'gyur dbyug srin gyis slong ba'i lug gi rmig 206

pa'ikhag rul ba'i dal langs rang bzhin gyi 'go nad cig yin/ dbyar khar 'byung ba mang /1 nad rtags/ nad lug gyol nas 'gro ba dang / rmig bar dang rmig rtse/ rmig mthil bcas kyi khag skrangs shing drod rgyas/ rim bzhin rul nas rnag pa dang rnag la dri ngan bro/ lci na rmig shun lhung ba red/ shi tshad mi mtho/ nad lci mo re 'gar mu mthud du 'gos nas 'chi ba red/2 nad la brtag pa/ gtso bo lug la sdang ba dang dbyar khar 'byung ba mang / lhag par rlan gsher che ba'i na thang nas 'byung ba red/ nad kyi gnas tshul ltar nad ngos 'dzin bya dgos/3 'gog bcos/ nad 'di 'byung ba'i skabs su rtswa sa spos nas bde 'jam skam sa nas 'tsho skyong bya dgos/ sman rdzas kyis gso bcos byed skabs thog mar rmig pa rul ba'i khag gtsang mar bkrus nas/ 3smoyi le sur(mo'i.oṃ)'i)ram1ṣṭhagi kon min son ca'i chu yis rma kha bkru dgos/15gi hphur ma lin nam5— 10ltayimuzi zangs chu(khyachi64shāgyetshesatsheji)spyad nas sug pa bkrus rjes 'bu srin 'gog sman nam hong an byug sman bsku dgos/ chin me su'u dang len me su'u sha gseng du brgyab na'ang chogalug gi gzer brel nad dang glo bur 'chi nad/(lha'islo74rṣasge mkho7)lug gi gzer brel nad dang glo bur 'chi nad de ni rul ba'i sun srin207

(lkosmokṣisgro)dngakhudabyibs dbugs 'byung srung skyi sun srin(bummurdzorsā྾ṣṭha.oṃ)so sos slong ba'i myur langs rang bzhin gyi 'go nad cig yin/ gtso bo lug la sdang zhing ra mar nad 'di 'byung ba cung nyung /nad 'di gnyis rtag par 'dres nas 'go ba dang nad rtags ha lam 'dra/ rang zhing nas dpyid dbyar la rtag par 'byung /1 nad rtags/ nad byung ba glo bur yin zhing rtag par nad rtags ma byung ba'i sngon la shi 'gro ba red/ nad lug mang che ba sha shed bzang ba'i lag ga yin/ rgyun du 'tsho skyong byed pa'i skabs su glo bur du shi ba'am zhogs par phyugs rwa'i nang du shi yod pa mthong / spyir btang du skar ma 'ga' nas dus tshod 'ga'i nang du 'chi ba red/ nyin gcig 'gor nas 'chi ba ha cang nyung / nad yun cung ring na dbugs kyi 'byin rngub dka' ba dang khrag lta bu rnyang / kha nas chu dwangs mo'am lbu ba dkar bo bzhur/ dbugs sbos pa/ gzer ba sogs kyi nad rtags yod/ 'chi khar so 'khyug pa dang dbugs gtong len ha cang dka'/ glo bur du 'gyel nas shi lug gi gzer brel nad kyis shi ba'i ro rul ba ha cang mgyogs shing bu ga nas gsher gzugs dmar nag bzhur/ grod pu'i thog tu khrag thon rang bzhin gyi gnyan tshad dang rul sungs yod la grod pu skrangs yod/ la la'i brang khog dang snying shun bar la chu bsags yod pa dang mchin pa skrangs/ lug 208
