gi glo bur du 'chi nad la pho rgyu gnyan tshad tshabs chen yod pa dang pho rgyu sbos/mchin pa btsos ma dang 'dra/2 nad la brtag pa/ shi ba glo bur yin pas gson dus nad ngos 'dzin pa ha cang dka'/ nad mched pa'i khyad chos dang 'chi ba mgyogs pa/shi rjes gshags dpyad byas pa'i 'gyur ba bcas zung 'brel byed pa gzhir bzung nas nad thag gcod dgos/ nad kyi ngos 'dzin 'khrul med bya na mchin pa shel dpyad byed pa'i thabs spyad na dul ba'i sun srin dang we hi sun srin mthong thub/3 'gog bcos/ nad 'di rgyun du 'byung ba'i sa khul nas lo rer lug sum 'brel ( ༈phyolko)lam lug bzhi 'brel 'gog sman gyi nad 'gog bya ba legs por bsgrub dgos/ nad yun cung ring bar chin me su'u dang hong an rigs sman rdzas kyis gso bcos bya dgos/ nad 'di byung ba shes ma thag dus thog tu phyugs khyu'i rtswa sa spo dgos pa dang / lhag par du gshong sa dang bral na nad 'di byung tshad je nyung du gtong thub/ gzhan yang phyugs khyu yongs la2smoyi mu zi zangs khu ldud dgos pa dang / lug rer ha'o hrin100'am105yi rdothal chu ha'o hron100—150blud na nad byung nas 'chi ba je nyung du gtong thub/lug gi 'jag sbos nad/(lkoṣṭha.oṃkhāeglo)nad 'di nibadabyibs we hri sun srin gyis slong ba'i myur langs rang 209

bzhin gyi 'go nad cig yin pa dang / nad rtags lug gi gzer brel dang 'dra bas rigs gzer brel zhes kyang bya/ sha shed bzang ba'i lag gar nad 'byung ba mang zhing mched/ rang zhing nas dbyar ston la 'byung ba mang /1 nad rtags/ rtag par glo bur du shi ba las nad rtags ci yang mthong mi thub/ la la glo bur du gnam la lding nas sa la 'gyel rjes skar ma 'gar rtsa 'then byung ste 'chi ba red/ nad cung yang tshe rtswa mi za ba dang khog pa gzer ba'i dbang gis langs pa'i skabs su rkang lag bzhi bo sa la bgrad/sgal ba sgang / mig gi rno je cher 'gro/ kha sna nas lbu ba bzhur/ ma shi ba'i sngon la rnyang khu nag po gtong / rkang lag bzhi bos chur rkyal ba'i rnam pa ston/ gshags dpyad byas na rgyu tshad dang grod pu'i gnyan tshad tshabs chen yod pa dang / gang sar khrag babs 'dug la/ rlangs gzugs kyis gang /rgyu ma'i nang du rnyang ba nyung zhing khrag 'dres/ mkhris pa skrangs nas che/ shi nas dus tshod 'ga'i nang du mkhal ma snyi mor gyur nas 'dam dang 'dra zhing thug nas btsir na gas/ de bas mkhal ma snyi ba'i nad kyang zer/2 nad la brtag pa/ ma shi gong la nad thag gcod pa cung dka'/nad mched pa'i khyad chos dang nad rtags/ nad lugs gshags dpyad 'gyur ba bcas zung 'brel byas nas nad thag gcod dgos/ nad ngos 'dzin byed skabs rgyu nag nang gi 'dus rdzas la dug rgyu 'jam po'i tshod lta byed pa'i zhib dpyod byed thabs spyod dgos/ gal te dug rgyu phyi na yod tshe 210

nad gtan la phab chog3 'gog bcos/ rgyun du 'byung ba'i sa khul nas dus bcad ltar lug sum 'brel lam lug bzhi 'brel 'gog sman gyis sngon 'gog byed pa'i bya ba legs por bsgrub dgos/ nad byung ba'i skabs su rtswa sa brje ba dang phyugasakhyu la myur du 'gog khab brgyab na nad byung nas shi tshad je nyung du gtong thub/ sman rdzas kyis gso bcos byed na chin me su'u dang len me su'u/ lu'u me su'u spyad chog pa dang sman de dag rkyang mar spyad kyang chogayin na'ang 'di gsum zung du sbrel nas gso bcos byas na phan 'bras de bas bzang / spyir btang du lug ren chin me su'u rtsis gzhi wan20dang /len me su'u dang lu'u me su'u re re ha'o khe chig stong spyod dgos/ thengs dang po'i spyod tshad ldab 'gyur gyis je mang du gtong dgos/ nyin rer sha gseng la sman khab thengs bzhi re drag rag bar du rgyag dgos/ hong an mes ljid tshad spyi rgya rer khe0 3dang nyin rer thengs gcig drag rag bar du blud na'ang chogalug nad nag po/(༈stsaṣṭha)lug nad nag po ni na'o be hri sun srin gyis slong ba'i myur langs rang bzhin gyi 'go nad cig yin/ gtso bo lug dang ra mar sdang / de'i khyad rtags ni ro'i pags mdog smug por gyur pa dang mchin par rul ba'i gnyan tshad yod/ ston khar 'byung ba mang /211

1 nad rtags/ rgyun par glo bur du nad 'byung ba dang chung lug shi tshad mtho/ nad phyugs kyi rnam rig mi gsal ba dang yi ga 'gag khyu dang bral nas kher 'dug byed/ gom 'gros 'khyor/ nyal bar spro/ lus drod rgyas/ dbugs kyi 'byin rngub dang snying ga 'phar tshad je mgyogs su 'gro/la lar skabs 'gar gsus khog gzer ba'i nyams snang yod/ rtag par lha ba dkar po skyug bzhin shi gshags dpyad byas na pags 'og tshang ma smug po yin pas‘‘nad nag’’zer/ pags 'og gi khrag rtsa nas khrag 'dzum/ phyi skyi na khrag mig yod/ snying shun du chu ser 'dus/ khrag dkag pa mi bzang /mtsher ba skrangs shing skug po yin/ mchin pa nul zhing snyi/ pho sul dang rgyu nag la khrag thon rang bzhin gyi gnyan tshad yod/2 nad la brtag pa/ nad byung ba'i dus tshigs dang shi ba mgyogs pa/ skyi pags smug po yin pa sogs kyi nad rtags la gzhigs na nad ngos 'dzin bya thub/ mchin pa rul ba'i mtha' nas reg dpyad byas na na'o be hri sun srin mthong thub/ 3 'gog bcos/ gso bcos byed thabs nus ldan med pa dang chin me su'u la nus pa nges can zhig yod/ gtso bo rgyun du 'byung ba'i sa khulanas lo rer rang zhing gis bzos pa'i lug nad nag po'i 'gog sman spyad nas sngon 'gog byas na nad 'di 'byung ba 'gog thub/yol lnga/(༈cha7oṃlo)212

nad 'di ni khrag nyams rang bzhin gyi dug srin zlum phreng can gyis slong ba'i lug dang ra ma'i myur langs rang bzhin gyi 'go nad cig yin/khyad rtags gtso bo ni mid pa'i rmen mdud dang mid pa skrangs pa de yin/lug la ches 'byung sla/ rang zhing nas lo re'i zla10ba nas phyi lo'i zla4ba'i bar nad 'di 'byung ba mang zhing shi tshad mtho/1 nad rtags/ lus tsha rgyas nas410yan la bslebs shing rnam rig mi gsal/ yi ga mi bzang / skyug ldad chad/ mid pa skrangs/dbugs 'byin rngub dka'/ kha gdangs/ lce phyi la bsnar/ nad lug kha shas lu bar ma zad snabs lud 'bag ro bzhur/ lug la lar smyos pa'i nad rtogs yod/ nyin2—3'gor rjes 'chi ba red/ dal langs rang bzhin yin tshe glo tshad kyi nad rtags yod pa dang gza' 'khor gcig nas gnyis 'gor rjes 'chi ba red/ ro la gshags dpyad byas na skyi pags 'og tu khrag yod pa dang mkhris pa'i nang du mkhris khu gang nas skungs/ mid pa skungs shing mid pa'i khag nas 'byar bag mang po yong ba dang / rkan rmen skrangs pa dang khrag thon/ snying shun dang rgyu ma'i 'byar skyi thog na khrag thig yod/ nad yun cung ring ba'i khog na gsher khu bsags yod la/ glo ba'i thog tu khrag thig yod pa ma zad brang skyi 'byar yod/2 nad la brtag pa/ nad mched pa'i khyad chos dang nad rtags/ro'i 'gyur ba bcas gzhir bzung na nad thag gcod thub/ snabs dang 213

khrag mchin pa/ mtsher ba/ rmen mdud sogs nas dug srin zlum phreng can dgar ba'i thabs spyad nas nad ngos 'dzin byas kyang rung /3 'gog bcos/ nad byung ma thag pa yin tshe chin me su'u sha gseng du brgyab na chogalug rer rtsis gzhi wan30dngha40brgyab na phan 'bras cung bzang /hong an rigs kyi sman rdzas la'ang phan 'bras cung bzang po thon/ rgyun 'byung gi sa khul nas lo rer nad 'byung ba'i dus tshigs kyi sngon la lug gi dug srin zlum phreng can 'gog sman nam chin dbyang hwa lu srin 'gog(lhunarsā7ṣṭhasgrokhri)spyad nas nad 'gog byas na nad 'di 'byung ba 'gog thub/lu gu'i rnyang nad/(cho༈ṣkaṣṭha)nad 'di gtso bo e zhi hri long ga'i dbyug srin dang dbugs 'byung sun srin/ hra mi hri 'bu srin bcas kyis slong zhing / gtso bo gza' 'khor gcig nang gi lu gur sdang ba dang rnyang du 'jug shi tshad mtho/ rang zhing nas dgun dpyid la lu gu rtseb skabs 'byung ba mang 1 nad rtags/ spyir btang du rtseb nas nyin2—3gyi nang du nad 'byung / na yun cung ring ba'i lu gu'i rnam rig mi gsal ba dang 'o ma mi nu/zur nas langs 'dug pa'am nyal nas mi langs/ mi 'gyangs par rnyang mgo rtsom/ rnyang khu chu ltar dwangs/ dri ngan bro/ ser mdog dang ljang 214

mdog gam skya mdog mngon/ nad gzhug tu rgyun du khrag rnyang / lu gu nad pa sgang ba dang mgo phyi la 'khor nas gsus par gtod/ lu gu nad pa la las btsir ba las rnyang mi thub pa dang / dbugs 'tshang zhing rkang lag sa la rdeb/ mgo ltag la dgyes/ 'khun 'ba' byed/ kha nas sbya ba dkar po yong / mjug mthar brgyal nas shi shi ro la gshags dpyad byas na myur langs rang bzhin gyi rgyu tshad du gyur pa dang / lhag par du rgyu nag gi nad rtags gsal ba ste/ rgyu ma rul 'gyur dang dul ba/ rgyu ma'i nang du dbugs mang po yod pa dang khrag thon pa/ pho sul gyi 'byar skyi nas khrag thon zhing chu skun yod/2 nad la brtag pa/ lu gu rtseb pa'i dubla tshigs su nad byung ba dang / nyin bdun man gyi lu gur nad byung ba mang zhing byung tshad mtho ba bcas gzhir bzung nas nad rtags dngos dang zung 'brel byas na nad thag gcod thub/3 'gog bcos/ ma mo'i gzan gso'i do dam la shugs snon dang /lu gu ma rtseb pa'i sngon la lug rwar gtsang sbra yag po byed pa/ tsag ngar dang nam zla mi bzang ba'i dus tshigs su lu gu rtseb par g.yol ba bcas byas na nad 'byung tshad dang shi tshad je nyung du gtong thub/ lu gu ma rtseb pa'i sngon la ma mor lug gi sum 'brel 'gog khab brgyab na'ang sngon 'gog gi nus pa 'don thub/215

1 nad rtags/ lug nad pa'i kha sogs kyi skyi pags thog tu rma 'brum 'bud pa dang rjes su rnag 'bur du 'gyur/ rnag 'bur brdol rjes rma sra mo skya mdog tu 'gyur/ la la'i kha'i 'byar skyi'i thog skya mdog gi chu bur 'byung ba dang der mthud nas rnag ste rul/ tshabs che na rmig pa dang nu ma/ rnga ma'i 'og sogs na nad 'gyur yod pa dang / spyir btang du shi tshad mi mtho/ 2 nad la brtag pa/ nad mched pa'i gnas tshul dang nad rtags dngos gzhi/ khyad par can gyi nad rtags rma sra mo bcas gzhir bzung na nad thag gcod thub/ kha tsha rmig tsha dang mi 'khrul bar yid 'jog bya dgos/3 'gog bcos/ spyir btang du rang bzhin gyis drag 'gro/tshabs che bar ten kan sdum dang tsi ya'o hros sogs bskus nas dug sel bya dgos/ lus yongs na nad rtags yod pa la dug srin 'gog rgyu dang hon an rigs kyi sman rdzas spyad nas gso bcos bya dgos/ rgyun 'byung gi sa khul nas lug gi kha rma dug nyung phra phung 'khyag skam 'gog khab brgyab na nad 'di 'byung ba 'gog thub/zur bkod/sgo phyugasaspyi 'go nad la 'gog sman spyod pa'i gsal bshad/1 sa skyon 'bu phra'i sbrum sgong 'gog sman gyis(lko⑫0a.oṃ)sgo 217

rīrīphyugs sna tshogs kyi sa skyon 'gog par byed/ ra ma'i mkhal mgo'i skyi gseng du ha'o hrin0 2rgyag pa dang / sgo phyugs gzhan dag gi skyi 'og la ha'o hrin1gam skyi gseng du ha'o hrin0 2rgyag dgos/ nad 'gog yun lo gciga'agog sman 'di 'khyag mi rung ba dang / drod tshad2—150nas lo gnyis la nyar 'jog bya thub/gsal bshad/ gong gi sa skyon 'bu phra'i sbrum sgong 'gog sman 'di gnyis po gar por gtong ba'i 'gog sman yin pas spyod skabs20ltayi chin dbyang hwa lu ca'o khu ldab10yis zhu ru bcug rjes spyod dgos/2 nor gyi 'gag nad chin dbyang hwa lu 'gog sman(rgo.oṃkhāe mismokhāeglozarsā7lkokhri)/ de ni nor gyi 'gag nad 'gog par spyod pa yin/lus kyi ljid tshad spyi rgya100yi yan gyi nor gyi sha gseng ngam ko lpags 'og tu ha'o hrin6rgyag dgos/ spyi rgya100yi man gyi nor la ha'o hrin4rgyag par bya/'gog khab brgyab rjes kyi nyin21gi nang du nad 'gog nus pa 'byung /nad 'gog yun zla9yin/ sman 'di khengs mi rung /2—15spuyi nang du lo gcig la nyar 'jog byed thub/yid 'jog byed sa/ be'u ma rtseb ran la nye bar rgyag mi rung / la lar sman khab brgyab rjes sman log gi nyams snang yod/ spyir btang du dus tshod gcig gi rjes su med 'gro/ nad tshabs chen la1gi mkhal mgo'i spen rtsi ha'o hrin4—8brgyab nas myur skyob bya dgos/218

3 nor gyi 'gag nad dug nyung 'gog sman(rgo7khāeṣṭhasmokhāeglozlasto11tsāni)/ 'gag nad 'gog par spyod pa yin/ khab rgyag pa'am rlangs lums kyis 'gog pa yin/ khab rgyag skabs20stiyi chin dbyang hwa lu 'gyig khus zhu nas 'dal du 'jug dgos/ ha'o hrin gcig la cun(ṣṭhaspro)dung phyur gnyis 'dus pa ltar 'dal du 'jug dgos/ yar be'u yan la sha gseng ngam yang na pags 'og tu ha'o hrin gcig dang / yar be'u man la ha'o hrin0 5rgyag dgos/ rlangs lums nad 'gog la che chung med par nor rer cun dung phyur8spyod dgos/ sman khab brgyab rjes kyi nyin21nang du nad 'gog gi nus pa 'byung / nad 'gog yun lo gcig 15sbyiman nas nyar 'jog byas na phan yun lo gcig yin/yid 'jog byed sa/ 'gog sman 'di 'dal du bcug rjes nyin der spyad nas tshar dgos/ 'gog sman 'di ni mtsho sngon zhing chen phyugs sman skye dngos sman rdzas bzo grwas thon skyed byas/4 nor gyi 'dar nad phal ba'i dug nyung gson myug 'gog sman/(rgokhro/)oṃzlokroṣākhri) nor gyi 'dar nad phal ba 'gog par spyod pa yin/ yar be'u man gyi sha gseng du ha'o hrin1 2dang yar be'u yan la ha'o hrin3—5rgyag dgos/ nad 'gog yun zla6—12yin/yid 'jog byed sa/ sman khab 'di brgyab rjes kher langs dang 'dar ba/ kha chu sna chu bzhur ba/ dbugs kyi 'byin rngub je mgyogs su 219

'gro ba bcas kyi nad rtags 'byung ba dang spyir btang du skar ma10yi rjes su rang bzhin gyis yal 'gro/ tshabs che na mkhal mgor sman rtsi ha'o hrin2—5brgyab na drag 'gro ba yin/5 phyugs spyod kyi khyi smyon rims nad dug nyung 'khyag skam 'gog sman(sdokhraṣṭharki gloddhastorsā.oṃ༈oṃ)/ sgo phyugs kyi khyi smyon nad 'gog par spyod pa yin/ skyes lugs tshwa chu'am rlangs chu spyad nas 'dal du 'jug dgos/ dam bu re ha'o hrin10yin/ khyi'i sha gseng du ha'o hrin gcig dang lug la ha'o hrin gnyis/ rta dang nor la ha'o hrin lnga bcas rgyag dgos/ sman khab brgyab rjes kyi nyin20nang du nad 'gog gi nus pa 'byung / nad 'gog yun lo gcig yin/gsal bshad/ 'gog sman 'di bdal du bcug rjes dus tshod6gi nang du spyad nas tshar dgos/ krin krig skyes sman bzo grwas thon skyed byas/6 lug gi gzer brel nad dang glo bur 'chi nad/ lug gi 'jag sbos nad sum 'brel 'gog sman(lko me7miwo⑫miphozlokhāekṣungulko.oṃ)/ lug gi gzer brel nad dang glo bur 'chi nad/ lug gi 'jag sbos nad bcas kyi 'go nad gsum 'gog par spyod pa yin/ lug che chung gang yin rung sha gseng ngam pags 'og tu ha'o hrin5rgyag dgos/ sman khab brgyab rjes kyi nyin14nang du nad 'gog nus pa 'byung / nad 'gog yun zla6yin/ 'gog sman 'di khengs pa 'gog dgos/ 2—5sbyinang du nyar 220

'jog dus yun lo2yin/7 lug gi gzer brel nad dang glo bur 'chi nad/ lug gi 'jag sbos nad sum 'brel phye skam 'gog sman(ze'i3ṭhatshocomitshokho71’skya'izloshālo1grosaboglorgo7oṃ)/ lug gi gzer brel nad dang glo bur 'chi nad/ lug gi 'jag sbos nad bcas 'gog par spyod pa yin/ sman khab ma brgyab pa'i sngon du dam bu'i thog tu gtan 'khel byas pa ltar re re bzhin bgo dgos shing / 205yi chin dbyang hwa lu 'gyig khu spyad nas 'dal du bcug rjes lug rer ha'o hrin1re bgo dgos/ lug che chung gang zhig yin rung tshang mar sha gseng ngam pags 'og tu ha'o hrin1rgyag dgos/ nad 'gog yun lo gcig yin la drod tshad2—50yi nang du nyar 'jog byas na phan nus ldan pa'i dus yun zla5yin/8 lug gi sun srin nad bzhi 'brel phye skam 'gog sman(sdongaskyoyi6gliglogakhruyo3rhachi/oṃ)/ lug gi gzer brel nad dang glo bur 'chi nad/lugagi 'jag sbos nad/ lu gu'i rnyang nad bcas 'gog par spyod pa yin/205yi chin dbyang hwa lu 'gyig khu spyad nas 'dal du 'jug pa dang /dam bu'i steng gi gsal bshad ltar cha 'gar bgo ba dang / lug re'i sha gseng dang pags 'og tu ha'o hrin1rgyag dgos/ rmo9 lug nad nag po'i 'gog sman(sge'itshesastarngo.oṃ)/ ra lug gi nad nag 'gog par spyod pa yin/ pags 'og tu chung lug la ha'o hrin1dang che 221

lug la ha'o hrin3rgyag dgos/ nad 'gog yun lo gcig yin/ 2—15sbyiyi nang du nyar 'jog byas na nus ldan dus yun lo2yin/10 pu hri dbyug srin phag dbyibs angasmopa'i 'gog sman(oṃṭhaṣṭhasprormisgommudnghaṣā.oṃ)/ nor dang lug phag shwa bcas kyi pu hri dbyug srin nad 'gog par spyod pa yin/ 'gog sman 'di 'thung ba dang khab rgyag pa/rlangs lums bcas kyis nad 'gog pa yin/ 'thung na ches bde 'jags yin/ khab brgyab nas nad 'gog byas na sman dug ha cang che/ chu dang rlangs chu spyad nas 'dal rjes lug la cun dung phyur100dang nor la cun dung phyur500ldud dgos shing / phag la thengs gnyis pa ldud pa'i bar du dus yun zla gcig dgos pa dang thengs rer cun dung phyur200ldud dgos/khab rgyag na lug gi pags 'og gam sha gseng du cun dung phyur50dang nor la cun dung phyur500/ phag la cun dung phyur200bcas rgyag dgos/rlangs gtor byas nas nad 'gog byed na lug la cun dung phyur50dang nor la cun dung phyur500yin/ nad 'gog yun lug lo gsum dang nor lo gnyis/ phag lo gcig bcas yin/gsal bshad/ mo phyugs be'u mar 'gog sman 'di spyad nas nad 'gog byas na 'phyis su 'jug pa red/ 0—8sbyikyi nang du nyar 'jog byas na nus ldan dus yun lo gcig yin/ sman 'di 'dal du bcug rjes nyin der spyad nas tshar dgos/ las 'di sgrub mkhan gyis rang lus srung 222

bar yid 'jog byed dgos/ 11 pu hri dbyug srin lug dbyibs lnga ba dug nyung 'khyag skam 'gog sman(oṃtsha༅༈7yodnghatsho.oṃ(ོriorha.oṃ)/ lug dang nor/ shwa bcas kyi pu hri dbyug srin nad 'gog par spyod pa yin/ sman 'di khab rgyag pa'am rlangs lums kyis nad 'gog bya chog la/ rlangs chu spyad nas 'dal du bcug rjes spyod dgos/ sman khab rgyag par lug la cun dung phyur10dang / nor dang shwa la cun dung phyur250rgyag dgos/ rlangs lums kyis nad 'gog par lug la cun dung phyur25dang / nor dang shwa la cun dung phyur250yin/ nad 'gog yun lug lo1 5dang / nor dang shwa lo gcig yin/gsal bshad/ sman 'di mo phyugs be'u mar spyod pa gtan 'gog bya dgos la/ sdeb sbyor ma byas pa'i zla gcig gi sngon la nad 'gog bya dgos/12 khudabyibs sha dug sun srin 'gog sman(bu 7/ ṭhazlo3thezlitsāni)/ nor dang lug rnga mong sogs lakhudabyibs sha dug sun srin gyi dug phog pa'i nad 'gogatshopar spyod pa yin/ lug gi ske'i pags 'og tu ha'o hrin bzhi rgyag pa dang / nor gyi pags 'og tu ha'o hrin bcu dang rnga mong gi pags 'og tu ha'o hrin nyi shu rgyag dgos/ nad 'gog yun lo gcig yin/2—15spuyi bsil grib 'og tu bzhag nas mi khengs par byas na nus ldan dus yun lo gcig yin/223

13 'udabyibs sha dug sun srin thi zhi gso skyong 'gog sman(du29rhaṣṭhatshedkulolkolkokhri)/ sman 'di mtsho sngon phyugs nad gso rig skye dngos sman rdzas bzo grwa gcig pus thon skyed byas pa yin zhing / lug gibudabyibs sha dug sun srin dug phog nad 'gog par ched du spyod pa yin/skyes lugs tshwa chu spyad de 'gog sman zhu ru bcug chonas ha'o hrin re ltar bgos te/ lug re'i pags 'og tu ha'o hrin gcig rgyag pa dang / nad 'gog yun lo gcig yin/ 2 — 15rirwayi bsil grib ldan sa nas nyar 'jog byas na phan nus ldan pa'i dus yun lo gnyis yin/ 14 ra lug 'phyis pa'i dbyi yon the snum khu sbrum sgong dug nyung gson myug 'gog sman(lkodkurdzo.oṃṭha6khutshitu'i(/sprokhrirsālko khri)/ra lug gi dbyi yon the rang bzhin gyi 'phyis pa 'gog par sbyod pa yin/lug re'i skyi pags 'og pu ha'o hrin gsum rgyag dgos pa dang nad 'gog yun lo gcig yin/ 2—15buyi cha rkyen khrod du nyar 'jog byas na phan nus ldan pa'i dus yun lo gcig dang phyed ka yin/15 lug gi rlam phreng chin dbyang hwa lu 'gog sman(sge'i64cakhriṣṭha135sgo(lta'iṣṭhatsāni)/ lug gi rlam phreng nad 'gog par spyod pa yin/ zla6yan gyi lug dang ra ma re'i pags 'og tu ha'o hrin5dang zla drug man la ha'o hrin3rgyag dgos/ sman khab brgyab nas nyin21gi rjes su nad 'gog gi nus pa 'byung ba dang / nad 'gog yun lo phyed yin/ 2—15sbyiyi nang du nyar 224

'jog dus yun lo gcig yin/ gsal bshad/ rtseb ran la nye ba'i mo phyugs la khab 'di rgyag mi rung /16 lug gi rlam phreng dug nyung 'khyag skam 'gog sman(sge 61shā khri.oṃshlaustorṣalkorhakhri)/ sman 'di mtsho sngon phyugs nad gso rig skye dngos sman rdzas bzo grwas thon skyed byas shing / lug gi rlam phreng nad 'gog par ched du spyod pa yin/ khab rgyag pa dang rlangs lums kyis nad 'gog byas na chog khab rgyag pa'i skabs su skyes lugs tshwa chu spyad nas 'dal du bcug ste ha'o hrin re la cun khri tsho50'dus par byas nas lug re'i pags 'og tu ha'o hrin gcig rgyag pa dang / rlangs lums kyis nad 'gog byed na khang pa'i nang gi phan nus rab yin/ lug rer cun khri tsho3000ltar rlangs chu spyad nas 'dal du bcug rjes spyod dgos/ nad 'gog yun lo gcig dang /15spuman nas nyar 'jog dus yun lo gnyis yin/gsal bshad/ sman 'di zhu ru bcug rjes nyin der spyad nas tshar dgos/ rlangs lums kyis nad 'gog na pu hri dbyug srin nad kyi 'gog sman dang mnyam du spyad chog17 lug gi long ga'i dbyug srin nad kyi srin myug 'gog sman(sge 33loṣṭha༅glo༅oṃ)/ lug gi long ga'i dbyug srin nad 'gog par spyod pa yin/ lo gcig gam man gyi ra lug la spyad na 'tsham/ ra lug re'i pags 'og tu ha'o hrin gnyis dang / zla gsum man la ha'o hrin gcig 225

—2can la ha'o hrin gnyis dang / lo gnyis yan la ha'o hrin gsum rgyag dgos/ lo gcig man la rgyag mi dgos/ shwa la rgyag tshad lug dang 'dra/khab brgyab rjes kyi nyin bcu bzhi'i nang du nad 'gog nus pa thon zhing nad 'gog yun zla4—6yin/ 2—60gi nang du nyar 'jog dus yun zla lnga yin/gsal bshad/ sman 'di phag la rgyag pa gtan 'gog bya dgos/227

phya ci ci /spyico rdo ci rtse —rsāktoskru / hūṃ rdzinigle tsāo rdzo ciske gasgruji sderu chi 4 ci shā dhershamoshe ducitsā sdursāṭwāṃtt+waṃ rte phyi 5 ri ṭaṃni—ci5 spyo stomāṃ rṣari ji〉ce :cho cho ñtsa — byu 5 rirmedzwa shā pa rwachici mitsho snyi ci chicho ri ri— tsā tsā( dze ci— tre lirte mi snyere — tsho ṅge rdo trīdnghasgyuchi ko — spre —— chi rma lho khul slob 'bring rgyu skar lta ba ra rgyang mthong chen mo/ rte 3 mi 〉‘ ṭwāṃsdoṣecardowa ca cho snye sgyu cho smi ri ge — mo‘pi sheji gyi rṣa rī rsha 4 ske rsha rdze ci tsā —rma lho khul slob 'bring rtsis 'khor slob da kyi zur 'ig

rke py-i ne rta rngo ru tre : —dku dzo tho ci —2 ri— ne sna— rmyo ༵ rdo 5/sgyu sto snanuX sdo7 gyirma lho mi rigs slob 'bring gi tshod lta'i slob khrid/rtse ne 7( tsho re sna ‘ tsā— /snye gi / )tsho tsa ṣa — 8 rdo( ‘ sketrī 9 rke dzā——— ‘ phab 4 cidage slob gnyis kyis mnyam du tshod lta byed pa/

tsho ci snastasnye phro sdu bye ri rdzo zi chori (rī — gesdu phyo —————snye 2007lo'i tshan rtsal bya dāgul spel ba'i zur zhigaskyi chi smra —— — snyu ༷ —— sna — 7rdo zhertswanghru 1 ji ram̐ —spre 8 / dngha — — byu rje —’7 4ci— — — — rī/ sme ji 4— kṣe tsā drotre2007lo'i tshan rtsal bya 'gul steng tshan rtsal rlangs 'khor 'grems dngos 'grems pa'i tshul/
myu

gcig krung hwa midamangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi tshan rig lag rtsal yar thon skor gyi bca' khrims/(1993lo'i zla7pa'i tshes2nyin skabs brgyad pa'i rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen rgyun las u yon lhan tshogs thengs gnyis pa'i steng gros 'cham byung)le'u dang po/ spyi'i rtsa don/don tshan dang po/ tshan rig lag col yar thon la skul 'ded dang /spyi tshogs ring lugs deng rabs/ can 'dzugs skrun gyi go rim khrod tshan rig lag rtsal dmigs su bkar nas 'phel rgyas gtong ba/ tshan rig lag rtsal ni thon skyed nus shugs ang dang po yin pa'i nus pa 'don spel gang legs dang / tshan rig lag rtsal gyis dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i gom stabs je mgyogs su gtong ched/ rtsa khrims gzhir bzung nas khrims lugs 'di gtan 'bebs byas pa yin/don tshan gnyis pa/ rgyal khab kyis dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun dang spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas tshan rtsal la brten pa dang / tshan rtsal bya ba dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun dang spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas la blo kha phyogs pa'i rtsa ba'i lam phyogs lag bstar byed pa/231

don tshan gsum pa/ rgyal khab kyis tshan rig zhib 'jug gi rang dbang la 'gan srung dang / tshan rig rtog dpyod dang lag rtsal gsar gtod la skul 'ded btang ste/ tshan rig lag rtsal de 'dzam gling gi sngon gras su tshud par byed dgos/rgyal khab dang spyi tshogs yongs kyis shes bya la brtsi bkur dang /shes ldan mi snar brtsi bkur/ tshan rtsal bya bzhag gnyer mkhan gyi gsar gtod rang bzhin gyi ngal rtsol la brtsi bkur dang / shes yon thon dbang la srung skyob byed dgos/don tshan bzhi ba/ rgyal khab kyis tshan rtsal yar thon dang spyi tshogs ring lugs tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi dgos mkho gzhir bzung nas tshan rig lag rtsal gyi sgrig srol bcos sgyur dang 'thus tshang du btang ste/ tshan rig lag rtsal dang dpal 'byor zung 'brel gang legs byed pa'i sgrig gzhi gsar 'dzugs byed dgos/don tshan lnga ba/ rgyal khab kyis tshan rig zhib 'jug dang lag col gsar rgetod/ tshan rig lag col gyi grub 'bras bed spyod gtong ba/ srol rgyun gyi thon las la bcos sgyur dang / lag col gyi tshad mtho ba'i thon las 'phel rgyas btang ste/ dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun dang spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas la zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i bya 'gul la skul 'ded gtong dgos/don tshan drug pa/ rgyal khab kyis tshan rig lag rtsal gyi shes bya khyab 232

gdal du btang ste/ spyi dmangs yongs kyi tshan rig shes bya'i chu tshad mthor 'degs gtong dgos/rgyal khab kyis las khungs dang / khe las tso 'dzugs/ spyi tshogs tshogs pa/ spyi dmangs sogs tshan rtsal yar thon gyi bya 'gul nang zhugs par rgyab skyor byed dgos/don tshan bdun pa/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis tshan rtsal 'phel rgyas kyi 'char gzhi bzo ba dang / tshan rtsal skor gyi las gzhi chen po dang tshan rtsal la 'brel ba dam zab yod pa'i las gzhi chen po gtan 'khel byas te/tshan tsol yar thon dang dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun/ spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas 'cham mthun yong bar 'gan len byed dgos/tshan rtsal 'phel rgyas kyi 'char gzhi dang srid jus gal chen gtan 'bebs dang / tshan rig skor gyi las gzhi chen po dang tshan col la 'brel ba dam zab yod pa'i las gzhi chen po gtan 'khel byed dus/ nges par du tshan rtsal bya bzhag gnyer mkhan gyi bsam 'char dang len byed dgos/don tshan brgyad pa/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi tshan rtsal srid 'dzin sde khag gis rgyal yongs kyi tshan rtsal bya bar spyi khog do dam dang 'cham mthun jus 'god byed dgos/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis gtan 'khel byas pa'i dbang cha'i khyab khongs ltar 'brel yod kyi tshan rtsal bya bar 'gan khur dgos/233

sa khul gyi rim pa so so'i mi dmangs srid gzhung gis phan yod kyi 'thab jus bkol te tshan rtsal yar thon la skul 'ded gtong dgos/rgyal khab kyis grangs nyung mi rigs sa khul dang mtha' 'khor dbul phongs sa khul gyi tshan rig lag rtsal las don gyi 'phel rgyas la ram 'degs byed dgos/don tshan dgu ba/ krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyis hur thag sgos rgyal phyi'i srid gzhung dang rgyal spyi'i tso 'dzugs bar gyi tshan rtsal mnyam 'brel dang brje res 'phel rgyas gtong ba/ gsar gtod zhib 'jug gi las khungs dang / mtho rim slob grwa/ spyi tshogs tshogs pa/ tshan col bya bzhag gnyer mkhan sogs kyis rgyal phyi'i tshan rtsal phyogs su sna 'dzoms kyi mnyam 'brel 'brel ba 'dzugs par skul 'ded gtong dgos/le'u gnyis pa/ tshan rig lag rtsal dang dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun/ spyi chogs 'phel rgyas/don tshan bcu ba/ rgyal khab kyis lag col dang thon rdzas/ rgyu cha/bzo col sogs kyi gsar gtod zhib 'jug la skul 'ded gtong ba dang /lag rtsal gsar bcos dang lag rtsal mnyam 'brel gyi bya 'gul spel te/thon rdzas kyi rgyu spus dang ngal rtsol thon skyed nus tshad/ dpal 'byor phan 'bras mu mthud du mthor 'degs gtong dgos/don tshan bcu gcig pa/ rgyal khab kyis dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun 234

la don snying chen po ldan pa'i las gzhi 'dems pa dang / tshan rig zhib 'jug dang lag rtsal gsar spel la rtsa 'dzugs byed pa/ tshan rig lag col gyi grub 'bras de thon skyed khrod bed spyod gtong ba'i myur tshad je mgyogs su gtong dgos/ don tshan bcu gnyis pa/ rgyal khab kyis lag rtsal 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i khrom ra 'dzugs pa dang tshan rtsal grub 'bras tshong zog can du bsgyur bar skul 'ded gtong ba/ nyo tshong bya 'gul thad rang dbang 'dra mnyam/gnyis phan tshab sprod yod pa dang drang bden yid rton gyi rtsa don la brtsi srung byed dgos/don tshan bcu gsum pa/ rgyal khab kyis tshan rtsal 'phel rgyas la brten nas dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun dang spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas/ mi grangs tshod 'dzin/ mi gshis mthor 'degs/ thon khungs bed spyod dar spel/ rang byung gnod skyon 'gog srung / skye khams khor yug gi 'tsho bar srung skyob byed par skul 'ded gtong dgos/don tshan bcu bzhi ba/ rgyal khab kyis tshan rtsal 'phel rgyas la brten nas zhing sde dpal 'byor dar spel dang / zhing las tshan col gyi grub 'bras bed spyod khyab gdal gtong bar skul 'ded byed dgos/ thon tshad mtho ba/ spus tshad bzang ba/ phan 'bras mtho ba'i deng rabs can gyi zhing las 'phel rgyas gtong dgos/235

don tshan bco lnga ba/ rdzong rim pa yan gyi sa khul rim pa so so'i mi dmangs srid gzhung gis 'thab jus bkol te/ zhing las tshan rtsal zhib 'jug sde khag dang mig dpe khyab gdal sde khag gis tshod lta'i sa gnas dang thon skyed rgyu cha rang bdag gis do dam dang bed spyod byed par 'gan len byas te/ zhing las thon rdzas gsar pa dang lag rtsal gsar par zhib 'jug dang tshod lta/ khyab gdal gtong dgos/zhing las tshan rtsal grub 'bras kyi bed spyod dang khyab gdal/ der 'brel yod khrims lugs kyi gtan 'khel ltar skyin med zhabs 'degs sam skyin yod zhabs 'degs byed dgos/don tshan bcu drug pa/ sa khul gyi rim pa so so'i mi dmangs srid gzhung gis zhing sde'i nang gi mang tshogs rang bzhin gyi tshan rig lag rtsal gyi rtsa 'dzugs kyi 'phel rgyas la skul 'ded dang rgyab skyor/ 'debs 'dzugs las rigs dang nags las/ phyugs las/ zhor las sogs thon skyed kyi thog mtha' bar gsum du sna 'dzoms 'thus tshang gi lag rtsal gyi zhabs 'degs zhu dgos/don tshan bcu bdun pa/ rgyal khab kyis sngon thon gyi tshan rig lag col la brten nas bzo las dang 'grim 'grul/ yig skyel/ glog 'phrin/sa gshis zhib dpyod/ 'dzugs sbun/ tshong las sogs kyi las rigs 'phel rgyas btang ste/ dpal 'byor phan 'bras dang spyi tshogs phan 'bras 236

mthor 'degs su gtong dgos/don tshan bco brgyad pa/ rgyal khab kyis khe las lag rtsal gsar spel dang zhib 'jug sde khag 'dzugs pa dang mtho rim slob grwar mnyam 'brel byed par skul 'ded btang nas/ bzo las rang bzhin gyi tshod lta'i nus pa gsar spel dang je drag tu gtong dgos/don tshan bcu dgu ba/ khe las kyis rgyal khab phyi nang gi tshong ra'i dgos mkhor gzhigs te lag rtsal gsar bsgyur dang sgrig chas je legs su gtong ba dang / tshan rig do dam gyi chu tshad mthor 'degs su btang nas/tshong ra'i 'gran rtsod kyi nus pa je drag tu gtong dgos/khe las kyis lag col gsar bsgyur dang phyi rgyal gyi sngon thon lag rtsal dang sgrig chas nang 'dren byed dus/ nges par du rgyal khab kyi thon las srid jus dang lag rtsal srid jus lag bstar mtha' 'khyol byed dgos/khe las kyis lag rtsal gsar par brten te thon rdzas gsar pa gsar spelakhyas na/ rgyal khab kyi gtan 'khel ltar dmigs bsalagyi khe bzang longs su spyad chogadon tshan nyi shu/ rgyal khab kyis sngon thon gyi tshan rig lag rtsal la brten te/ rgyal srung gi tshan rig lag col gyi bya bzhag 'phel rgyas su btang nas/ rgyal srung deng rabs can gyi 'dzugs skrun la skul 'ded dang rgyal srung gi stobs shugs je drag tu gtong dgos/237

don tshan nyer gcig pa/ rgyal khab kyis sngon thon gyi tshan rig lag rtsal bkol spyod byed par skul ma btang nas/ slob gso dang rig gnas/'phrod bsten/ lus rtsal sogs kyi las don 'phel rgyas gtong dgos/le'u gsum pa/ tshad mtho'i lag rtsal zhib 'jug dang lag rtsal gyi tshad mtho ba'i thon las/don tshan nyer gnyis pa/ rgyal khab kyis tshad mtho'i lag rtsal gyi zhib 'jug la skul 'ded dang / tshad mtho'i lag rtsal gyis tshan rig lag rtsal yar thon gyi khrod thon pa'i nus pa 'don spel byed pa/ lag rtsal gyi tshad mtho ba'i thon las kyi grub 'bras dang 'phel rgyas la rgyab skyor dang / tshad mtho'i lag rtsal bkol te srol rgyun gyi thon las gsar bsgyur byas te/ lag rtsal gyi tshad mtho ba'i thon las kyis dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun thad thon pa'i nus pa 'don spel byed dgos/don tshan nyer gsum pa/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi tshan rig lag rtsalasrid 'dzin sde khag dang 'brel yod kyi srid 'dzin sde khag gzhan pas/ rgyal yongs tshad mtho'i lag rtsal gyi zhib 'jug la rtsa 'dzugs byas te/ tshad mtho'i lag rtsal gyi grub 'bras gsar pa khyab gdal du gtong dgos/don tshan nyer bzhi ba/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi chog mchan brgyud de cha rkyen 'dzoms pa'i sa khul du lag rtsal gyi tshad mtho ba'i thon las gsar pa gsar spel khul 'dzugs dgos/238

don tshan nyer lnga ba/ lag rtsal gyi tshad mtho ba'i thon las gsar pa gsar spel khul dang / de min gyi lag rtsal gyi tshad mtho ba'i thon rdzas gsar spel dang thon skyed byed pa'i khe las sde khag tu/ rgyal khab kyis gtan 'khel byas pa'i dmigs bsal gyi srid jus lag bstar byed dgos pa dang / bye brag gi thabs shes de rgyal srid spyi khab khang gis gtan 'khel byed dgos/don tshan nyer drug pa/ rgyal khab kyis lag rtsal gyi tshad mtho ba'i thon rdzos gsar spel dang thon skyed/ bdag gnyer byed pa'i khe las 'dzugs dus rgyal spyi'i tshad ldan gyi bdag gnyer lam lugs dang 'tsham dgos la/ rgyal spyi'i tshad gzhi dang 'tsham pa'i thon rdzas thon skyed dang /rgyal spyi'i khrom ra'i 'gran rtsod la zhugs te/ lag rtsal gyi tshad mtho ba'i thon las de rgyal spyi can du 'gyur bar skul 'ded gtong dgos/le'u bzhi ba/ rmang gzhi'i zhib 'jug dang rmang gzhi'i zhib 'jug bkol spyod/don tshan nyer bdun pa/ rgyal khab kyi rmang gzhi'i zhib 'jug dang rmang gzhi'i zhib 'jug rgyun mthud dang gtan 'jags ngang 'phel rgyas 'gro bar 'gan len dang / tshan rig lag rtsal yar thon gyi rmang gzhi la shugs snon gtong dgos/rmang gzhi'i zhib 'jug dang rmang gzhi'i zhib 'jug bkol spyod kyi 239

'gro gron des zhib 'jug gsar spel spyi'i 'gro gron gyi nang bsdur tshad nges can zhig zin dgos/ don tshan nyer brgyad pa/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi tshan rig lag rtsal srid 'dzin sde khag gis tshan rig dang dpal 'byor/ spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas khrod kyi rmang gzhi rang bzhin gyi tshan rig zhib 'jug gi dpyad gzhi la rtsa 'dzugs byed dgos/ zhib 'jug gsar spel gyi sde khag dang mtho rim slob grwa/ khe las co 'dzugs/ spyi dmangs sogs kyis rang bdag gis zhib 'jug dpyad gzhi 'dems te/ rmang gzhi'i zhib 'jug dang rmang gzhi'i zhib 'jug bkol spyod kyi bya ba gnyer dgos/don tshan nyer dgu ba/ rgyal khab kyis rang byung tshan rig gi dngul rtsa btsugs te/ ched gnyer ba'i dpyad gleng dang bzang bo 'dems nas rgyabaskyor byed pa'i rtsa don gzhir bzung ste/ rmang gzhi'i zhib 'jug dang rmang gzhi'i zhib 'jug bkol spyod phyogs su rogs dngul gtong dgos/ don tshan sum cu ba/ rgyal khab kyis gtso gnad kyi tshod lta khang 'dzugs par rgyab skyor dang / rmang gzhi'i zhib 'jug dang rmang gzhi'i zhib 'jug bkol spyod byed sa'i sa gnas 'dzugs dgos/ rgyal khab kyis gtso gnad kyi tshod lta khang de rgyal khab phyi nang du sgo 'byed dgos/ le'u lnga ba/ zhib 'jug gsar spel gyi sde khagadon tshan so gcig pa/ rgyal khab kyis dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun tshi0

dang tshan rtsal yar thon gyi dgos mkhor gzhigs te/ tshan rig lag rtsal zhib 'jug gsar spel gyi sde khag 'dzugs par 'char 'god dang mdzub ston byas te/ deng rabs can gyi tshan rig lag rtsal zhib 'jug gsar spel ma lag 'dzugs dgos/don tshan so gnyis pa/ rgyal khab kyis rmang gzhi'i zhib 'jug dang rmang gzhi'i zhib 'jug bkol spyod/ tshad mtho'i lag rtsal zhib 'jugagal che ba'i bzo bkod las gzhi'i zhib 'jug tshan rtsal phar rgol gyi zhib 'jug spyi tshogs spyi phan rang bzhin gyi tshan rtsal zhib 'jug sogs kyi las don gnyer ba'i zhib 'jug sde khag dang / mtho rim slob grwa la ma dngul dang tshod lta'i yo byad sogs kyis rgyab skyor byed dgos/don tshan so gsum pa/ rgyal khab kyis lag rtsal gsar spel la zhib 'jug byed pa'i zhib 'jug sde khag dang khe las rtsa 'dzugs dang mnyam 'brelakhyas te/ lag rtsal dang bzo las/ nyo tshong dang yang na lag rtsal dang zhing las/ nyo tshong phyogs bsdus can gyi bdag gnyer lag bstar byed dgos/ rgyal khab kyis tshan rig lag rtsal gyi blo 'dri dpyad bsdur dang /tshan rig lag tsol gyi brda 'phrin zhabs zhu/ spyi tshogs kyi spyi phan rang bzhin gyi zhib 'jug gsar spel sde khag la skul 'ded dang mdzub ston byas te/ rim bzhin khe las can gyi bdag gnyer ram skyin yod zhabs zhu lag 241

bstar byed dgos/don tshan so bzhi ba/ zhib 'jug gsar spel sde khag nang du yon krang ngam sa'o krang gi 'gan khur lam lugs lag bstar byed dgos/zhib 'jug gsar spel sde khag gis rgyal khab kyi khrims ltar zhib 'jug gsar spel dang / thon skyed bdag gnyer/ ma dngul bkol spyod/sgrig gzhi 'dzugs skrun/ mi sna bsko bzhag sogs kyi rang bdag gi dbang cha longs su spyod chogadon tshan so lnga ba/ rgyal khab kyis spyi tshogs stobs shugs la rang 'gul gyis zhib 'jug gsar spel gyi sde khag 'dzugs par skul 'ded gtong dgos pa ma zad/ de tsho'i khrims mthun gyi khe dbang la gtor brlag mi thebs par 'gan len byed dgos/don tshan so drug pa/ zhib 'jug gsar spel sde khag gis khrims ltar phyi rgyal du ma dngul btang chog pa dang / yan lag gi sde khag kyang btsugs chogaphyi rgyal rtsa 'dzugs dang mi sger gyis rang rgyal du khrims ltar zhib 'jug gsar spel gyi sde khag btsugs chog pa ma zad/ krung go'i zhib 'jug gsar spel sde la/ ga dang rtsa 'dzugs gzhan pa mnyam 'brel byas te zhib 'jug gsar spel sde khag btsugs chog242

le'u drug pa/ tshan rig lag rtsal gyi bya bzhag gnyer mkhan/don tshan so bdun pa/ tshan rig lag rtsal gyi bya bzhag gnyer mkhan ni spyi tshogs ring lugs deng rabs can 'dzugs skrun gyi stobs shugs gal chen yin pas rgyal khab kyis byed thabs gang mang spyad de tshan rig lag rtsal gyi bya bzhag gnyer mkhan gyi spyi tshogs go gnas je mthor gtong ba dang /thabs lam sna tshogs bkol te tshan rig lag rtsal gnyer mkhan gyi shes ldan mi sna gso skyong byas te/ kho tsho'i nus pa gang legs 'don spel byed dgos/don tshan so brgyad pa/ rim pa so so'i mi dmangs srid gzhung dang khe las rtsa 'dzugs kyis tshan rig lag rtsal gyi bya bzhag gnyer mkhan gyi gla phogs je mthor dang / bya ba dang 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen je legs su gtong ba/byas rjes 'bur thon gyi tshan rig lag rtsal gyi bya bzhag gnyer mkhan gyi gla phogs sngar las kyang lhag par je mthor gtong dgos/don tshan so dgu ba/ rim pa so so'i mi dmangs srid gzhung dang khe las rtsa 'dzugs kyis/ tshan rig lag rtsal gyi bya bzhag gnyer mkhan rnams kyi lugs mthun 'khor bskyod la khor yug dang cha rkyen bskrun te/ de tsho'i khyad chos 'don spel gang legs byed dgos/don tshan bzhi bcu ba/ rmang gzhi'i zhib 'jug dang rmang gzhi'i zhib 'jug bkol spyod tshad mtho'i lag rtsal zhib 'jug gal che'i bzo bkod 243

las gzhi'i zhib 'jug spyi phan rang bzhin gyi tshan rtsal zhib 'jug dang /zhing sde'i dbul phongs sa khul dang grangs nyung mi rigs sa khul/ nyen kha che ba'i khor yug tu tshan col gyi bya bzhag gnyer mkhan rnams la rgyal khab kyi gtan khel ltar gsab dngul sprod dgos/don tshan zhe gcig pa/ rgyal khab kyis ched las nus rtsal gyi thob thang lam lugs lag bstar byed dgos shing / tshan tsol bya bzhag gnyer mkhan gyis rang nyid kyi chu tshad dang / nus col/ nyams myong / grub 'bras sogs gzhir bzung ste tshad ldan gyi thob thang blangs chogadon tshan zhe gnyis pa/ tshan rtsal bya bzhag gnyer mkhan la khrims ltar tshan rtsal spyi tshogs 'dzugs pa'am de'i nang zhugs pa'i dbang cha yod/tshan rtsal spyi tshogs tshogs pas dpyad gzhi 'dzugs skrun dang / tshan col shes bya khyab gdal/ ched gnyer mi sna gso skyong / blo 'dri'i zhabs zhu spel ba/ tshan rtsal bya bzhag gnyer mkhan gyi khrims mthun khe dbang srung skyob sogs kyi phyogs su hur brtson gyi nus pa 'don spel byed dgos/don tshan zhe gsum pa/ rgyal khab kyis phyi rgyal du tshan rtsal gyi bya bzhag gnyer mkhan rnams rgyal nang du yong ste/ spyi tshogs ring lugs deng rabs can 'dzugs skrun byed par skul ma gtong ba dang / yang na rnam pa gzhan pa'i steng rgyal khab kyi 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu bar skul ma gtong ba/244

don tshan zhe bzhi ba/ tshan rtsal bya bzhag gnyer mkhan rnams kyis ched las kun spyod brtsi srung dang / ched gnyer bya ba yongs 'grub byas te rang nyid kyi tshan rtsal chu tshad mthor 'degs su gtong bar brtson len byed dgos/le'u bdun pa/ tshan rtsal yar thon la 'gan len byed pa'i thabs shes/don tshan zhe lnga ba/ rgyal khab kyis tshan col phyogs kyi gtong dngul je mang du gtong dgos/ rgyal yongs kyi zhib 'jug gsar spel gyi gtong dngul gyis rgyal dmangs spyi'i thon 'bor gyi nang sdur tshad nges can zhig zin dgos pa ma zad/ rim bzhin je mang du btang ste tshan rtsal dang dpal 'byor/ spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi dgos mkho dang bstun dgos/zhib 'jug gsar spel gyi gtong dngul skor rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis gtan 'khel byed dgos/ rgyal khab nor srid kyis lag col phyogs su bkol ba'i 'gro gron gyi 'phar tshad de/ rgyal khab nor srid kyi rgyun ldan yong sgo'i 'phar tshad las mtho dgos/ las khungs dang mi sgor gang zhig yin rung rgyal khab kyis tshan rtsal phyogs su btang ba'i ma dngul de sger spyod dang / 'phri 'then/ bkag sdomasted mi rung /245

don tshan zhe drug pa/ rgyal khab kyis khe las la zhib 'jug gsar spel dang lag col gsar gtod skor gyi gtong dngul je mang du gtong bar skul ma gtong dgos/ khe las kyis lag rtsal gsar spel gyi gtong dngul de don dngos kyi 'gro song ltar rtsis rgyag dgos/don tshan zhe bdun pa/ rgyal khab kyi dngul las sde khag gis gtong dngul phyogs nas tshan col grub 'bras tshong zog can du 'gyur bar rgyab skyor byed dgos/don tshan zhe brgyad pa/ lag rtsal gsar spel la zhib 'jug byed pa'i sde khag gis rgyal khab kyi gtan 'khel ltar thabs shes sna tshogs spyad de spyi tshogs steng gi zhib 'jug ma dngul bsdu gsog byed dgos/don tshan zhe dgu ba/ rgyal khab kyis rgyal khab phyi nang gi rtsa 'dzugs dang mi sger la tshan rtsal thebs rtsa 'dzugs par skul ma btang ste/ tshan rig zhib 'jug dang lag col gsar spel phyogs su rogs dngul gtong dgos/don tshan lnga bcu ba/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi 'brel yod srid 'dzin sde khag dang sa khul rim pa'i mi dmangs srid gzhung gis thabs shes sna tshogs spyad de tshan rtsal brda 'phrin gyi brje res 'phel rgyas dang / deng rabs can gyi tshan rtsal brda 'phrin dra rgya 'dzugs dgos/don tshan nga gcig pa/ rgyal khab kyis tshan col sba gsang lam lugs 246

btsugs te/ rgyal khab kyi bde 'jags dang khe phan la 'brel ba dam zab yod pa'i tshan rtsal skor sba gsang byed dgos/le'u brgyad pa/ tshan rig lag rtsal gyi bya dga'/don tshan nga gnyis pa/ rgyal khab kyis tshan rtsal bya dga'i lam lugs btsugs te/ tshan rtsal yar thon gyi bya 'gul khrod byas rjes 'bur thon bzhag pa'i spyi dmangs dang rtsa 'dzugs la bya dga' ster dgos/don tshan nga gsum pa/ rgyal khab kyis tshan rtsal las don gyi 'phel rgyas la byas rjes 'bur thon bzhag pa'i spyi dmangs la khrims ltar mtshan snyan stsol dgos/don tshan nga bzhi ba/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis rang byung tshan rig gi bya dga'/ lag rtsal gsar gtod kyi bya dga'/ tshan rtsal yar thon gyi bya dga'/ rgyal spyi'i tshan rtsal mnyam 'brel gyi bya dga' sogs jus 'god byed dgos shing / dgos nges yod dus tshan rtsal gyi bya dga' gzhan pa'ang jus 'god byed chogarang byung tshan rig gi bya dga' ni rmang gzhi'i zhib 'jug dang rmang gzhi'i zhib 'jug gi bkol spyod khrod/ rang byung gi gnas tshul dang chos nyid skor la zhib 'jug byed par byas rjes gal chen bzhag pa'i spyi dmangs la ster dgos/lag rtsal gsar gtod kyi bya dga' ni tshan col shes bya bkol te thon 247

rdzas dang bzo col/ rgyu cha sogs kyi phyogs lag rtsal gsar gtod gal chen byas pa'i spyi dmangs la ster dgos/tshanartsal yar thon gyi bya dga' ni sngon thon gyi tshan rtsal grub 'bras bkol spyod dang khyab gdal btang ste/ gal che'i tshan rtsal bzo bkod dang 'charagazhi/ las gzhi yongs 'grub dang / tshan rtsal do dam 'thus tshang du gtong ba sogs kyi thad/ byas rjes 'bur thon bzhag pa'i spyi dmangs sam rtsa 'dzugs la ster dgos/ rgyal spyi'i tshan rtsal mnyam 'brel gyi bya dga' ni krung go'i tshan col las don la byas rjes gal chen bzhag pa'i spyi dmangs sam rtsa 'dzugs la stsol dgos/ don tshan nga lnga ba/ khe las rtsa 'dzugs kyis rgyal khab kyi 'brel yod gtan 'khel ltar/ tshan rtsal grub 'bras la brten nas 'phar snon byung ba'i khe bzang las sdur tshad nges can blangs te/ lag rtsal gyi grub 'bras mngon 'gyur byas pa'i mi sger la bya dga' ster dgos/don tshan nga drug pa/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi co 'dzugs dang mi sger gyis tshan rtsal bya dga'i dngul co btsugs te/ tshan rtsal yar thon gyi bya 'gulakhrod byas rjes 'bur thon bzhag pa'i spyi dmangs sam mi sger la bya dga' gnang chog 248

le'u dgu ba/ khrims lugs kyi 'gan 'khri/don tshan nga bdun pa/ rgyal khab kyi nor srid lam lugs la rgyab 'gal byas te/ tshan rtsal phyogs su bkol ba'i ma dngul de sger spyod dang 'phri 'then/ bkag sdom byas na/ rim pa gong ma'i las khungs kyis dus bcad ltar phyir spyod par bka' sgrog par byed dgos/ gnas tshul tshabs che na rim pa gong ma'i las khungs dang der yod las khungs kyis rang 'gan 'khur 'khan la srid 'dzin nyes chad gcod dgos/don tshan nga brgyad pa/ go gnas rang dgar spyad de tshan rtsal gsar gtod la bkag rkyen chen po bzos na/ rang 'gan 'khur mkhan la srid 'dzin gyi nyes chad gcod dgos/don tshan nga dgu ba/ lag rtsal gsar pa dang thon rdzas gsar pa gsar gtod dang / tshan tsol grub 'bras yar zhu byed pa'i go rim nang khrims 'gal gyi thabs shes spyad de/ dmigs bsal gyi gla phogs dang bya dga' len mkhan la srid 'dzin chad pa dang srid 'dzin nyes chad gcod dgos/tshan tsol grub 'bras la zhib bsher byed mkhan gyis bsam bzhin du zhib bsher rdzun bzo byas na/ 'brel yod gtso bdag sde khag gis srid 'dzin nyes chad gcod dgos/don tshan drug cu ba/ mi gzhan gyi dpe bskrun dbang cha dang /249

gsar gtod dbang cha/ gsar rnyed dbang cha dang dbang cha gzhan pa brku 'phrog dang rdzun bzo byed pa dang / khrims 'gal ltar lag rtsal gyi gsang ba brku 'phrog byas na/ 'brel yod khrims lugs kyi gtan 'khel ltar thag gcod byed dgos/le'u bcu ba/ kha gsab/don tshan re gcig pa/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi lag col srid 'dzin sde khag dang 'brel yod srid 'dzin sde khag gis khrims 'di gzhir bzung nas lag bstar gyi thabs shes gtan 'khel byas te rgyal srid spyi khyab khang la chog mchan 'god du 'jug dgos/don tshan re gnyis pa/ khrims 'di1993lo'i zla10pa'i tshes1nyin nas bzung lag bstar bya dgos/ 250

gnyis/ krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi zhing lasalag rtsal khyab gdal du gtong ba'i bca' khrims/(1993lo'i zla7pa'i tshes2nyin skabs brgyad pa'i rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen rgyun las u yon lhan tshogs thengs gnyis pa'i steng gros 'cham byung)le'u dang po/ spyi'i rtsa don/don tshan dang po/ zhing las lag rtsal khyab gdal gtong ba'i bya bar shugs snon pa dang / zhing las tshan rig zhib 'jug gi grub 'bras dang zhing las thon skyed thad lag rtsal myur du bkol ba/ zhing las 'phel rgyas la 'gan len byed pa/ zhing las deng rabs can mngon 'gyur byed pa bcas kyi ched du bca' khrims 'di gtan 'bebs byas pa yin/don tshan gnyis pa/ khrims 'di'i ming la zhing las lag rtsal gyi bca' khrims zer zhing / de ni 'debs 'dzugs las rigs dang / nags las/ phyugs las/ nya las sogs kyi thad la bkol ba'i tshan rig zhib 'jug gi grub 'bras dang dngos bkol lag rtsal yin/ der son bzang gso spel/ zhing lud bed spyod/ nad 'bu'i gnod pa sngon 'goga'adebs gso dang gso spel lag rtsal/ zhing las dang zhor las thon rdzas 251

las snon byed pa/ mi rnying par byed pa/ nyar tshags skyel 'dren lag rtsal/zhing las 'phrul chas lag rtsal/ zhing bkol mkha' skyod lag rtsal/ rmo zhing chu bed/ sa rgyu legs bcos/ sa chu srung 'dzin lag rtsal/ zhing sder chu bo mkho sprod/ zhing sde'i thon khungs bed spyod dang zhing las khor yug srung skyob lag rtsal/ zhing las gnam gshis lag rtsal/ zhing las bdag gnyer do dam lag rtsal sogs 'du/zhing las lag rtsal khyab gdal du gtong ba ni tshod lta dang / rang dpe gzhan ston/ gso sbyong / mdzub ston/ blo 'dri zhabs zhu sogs brgyudanas zhing las lag rtsal zhing las thon skyed kyi go rim cha tshang gi bya 'gul khrod phyogs yongs nas bed spyod byed pa red/don tshan gsum pa/ rgyal khab kyis tshan rig dang slob gso 'phel rgyas la brten nas zhing sde'i dpal 'byor/ zhing las lag rtsal phyogs yongs nas bed spyod byed par shugs snon pa dar spel byed pa dang / thon tshad mtho ba dang / khyad 'phags dang 'bras bu bzang ba'i zhing las 'phel rgyas gtong dgos/don tshan bzhi ba/ zhing las lag col khyab gdal gtong bar gsham gyi rtsa don brtsi srung byed dgos/(1) zhing las 'phel rgyas la phan pa/(2) zhing las ngal rtsol ba'i 'dod mos la brtsi bkur byed pa/252

(3) yul bab dang bstun nas tshod lta brgyud de rang dpe gzhan ston byed pa/(4) rgyal khab dang zhing sde'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs la srung skyob byed pa/(5) tshan rig zhib 'jug gi las khungs dang / 'brel yod slob grwa/sgrig gzhi khyab spel dang / mang tshogs rang bzhin gyi tshan col rtsa 'dzugs/tshan rtsal mi sna/ zhing las ngal rtsol pa phan tshun zung 'brel byas nas lag bstar byed rgyu/(6) zhing las thon skyed kyi dpal 'byor phan nus dang / spyi tshogs phan nus/ skye khams phan nus la do snang byed dgos/don tshan lnga ba/ rgyal khab kyis tshan tsol mi sna dar spel dang / sngon thon gyi zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel dang bed spyod la skul 'ded dang rgyab skyor byed pa/ zhing las ngal rtsol ba dang zhing las thon skyed tshong gnyer co 'dzugs kyis sngon thon gyi zhing las lag rtsal bed spyod la skul 'ded dang rgyab skyor byed dgos/ don tshan drug pa/ rgyal khab kyis phyi rgyal sngon thon gyi zhing las lag rtsal la skul 'ded dang rgyab skyor byas te zhing las lag rtsal khyab gdal du gtong ba'i rgyal spyi'i mnyam 'brel dang rjes spel la skul 'ded byed dgos/don tshan bdun pa/ rim pa so so'i mi dmangs srid gzhung gis zhing 253

las lag rtsal khyab gdal gtong ba'i bya ba'i sne khrid la shugs snon dgos pa dang / 'brel yod sde khag dang las khungs rtsa 'dzugs byas te byed thabs spyad nas zhing las lag rtsal khyab gdal gtong ba'i las don gyi 'phel rgyas la skul 'ded byed dgos/don tshan brgyad pa/ zhing las lag rtsal khyab gdal gtong ba'i bya ba'i khrod las khungs dang mi sger la byas rjes bzhag cipar bya dga' gnang rgyu/don tshan dgu ba/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis zhing las dang /nags las/ phyugs las/ nya las/ chu bed sogs srid 'dzin sde khag(gsham du spyi ming la zhing las lag tsol khyab gdal du gtong ba'i srid 'dzin sde khag zer)rang rang gi las 'gan ltar rgyal yongs mnga' khongs su 'brel yod kyi zhing las lag rtsal khyab gdal du gtong ba'i bya bar 'gan khur dgos/ rdzong rim pa yan gyi sa gnas rim pa so so'i mi dmangs srid gzhungagi zhing las lag col khyab gdal du gtong ba'i srid 'dzin sde khag gis rim pa gcig mtshungs kyi mi dmangs srid gzhung gi sne khrid 'og rang rang gi las 'gan ltar rang srid 'dzin sa khongs su 'brel yod kyi zhing las lag rtsal khyab gdal du gtong ba'i bya bar 'gan 'khur dgos/ rim pa gcig mtshungs kyi mi dmangs srid gzhung tshan rig lag tsol srid 'dzin sde khag gis zhing las lag rtsal khyab gdal du gtong ba'i bya bar sne khrid byed dgos/254

le'u gnyis pa/ zhing las lag rtsalakhyab spel gtong ba'i ma lagadon tshan bcu ba/ zhing las lag col khyab spel du gtong dgos/zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel du gtong ba'i las khungs dang zhing las tshan dpyod las khungs/ 'brel yod slob grwa dang / da rung mang tshogs rang bzhin gyi tshan col rtsa 'dzugs/ zhing ba lag rtsal mi sna phan tshun zung 'brel byas te khyab spel du gtong ba'i ma lag lag bstar byed dgos/rgyal khab kyis mkho sprod mnyam 'brel khang dang / gzhan khe las las don sde khag spyi tshogs tshogs pa dang bcas spyi tshogs las rigs so so'i tshan rtsal mi snar skul lcag dang rgyab skyor byas te zhing sde ru zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel du gtong ba'i zhabs phyi'i bya 'gul spel dgos /don tshan bcu gcig pa/ zhang dang mi rigs zhang / grong brdal yan gyi rim pa so so'i rgyal khab zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel sgrig gzhi'i 'gan 'khri ni/(1) zhing las lag col khyab spel 'char gzhi bzo bar zhugs dgos par ma zad rtsa 'dzugs byas te dngos 'bebs byed dgos/(2) zhing las lag rtsal gyi ched las gso sbyong byed par rtsa 'dzugs byed dgos/(3) zhing las lag rtsal dang brda 'phrin zhabs phyi 'don sprod byed 255

dgos/(4) zhing las lag rtsal tshod lta byed pa dang dpe mtshon khyab spel byed par gtan khel byed dgos/(5) rim pa 'og ma'i zhing las lag col khyab spel sgrig gzhi dang mang tshogs rang bzhin gyi tshan rtsal rtsa 'dzugs/ zhing ba'i lag col mi sna'i zhing las lag col khyab spel du gtong ba'i bya 'gul la mdzub ston bya dgos/don tshan bcu gnyis pa/ zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel sgrig gzhi'i ched las tshan rtsal mi snar nges par du 'bring rim yan gyi 'brel yod ched las kyi slob sbyong gi slob gnyer brgyud rim yod dgos/ yang na rdzong rim pa yan gyi mi dmangs srid gzhung gi 'brel yod sde khag gis gtso gnyer byas pa'i ched las dpyad zhib gso sbyong byas pa brgyud de 'brel yod kyi ched las lag rtsal gyi chu tshad yod dgos/don tshan bcu gsum pa/ sde ba'i zhing las lag col khyab spel zhabs phyi'i rtsa 'dzugs dang zhing ba'i lag rtsal mi snas zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel sgrig gzhi'i mdzub ston 'og nas/ zhing las lag col shes bya khyab sgrog dang / zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel byed thabs dngos 'bebs byas te zhing las ngal rtsol bar lag col zhabs phyi 'don sprod byed dgos/ zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel du gtong bar nges par du cha rkyen yod pa'i zhing khyim bdams te dper mtshon rgyun spyod byed dgos/ rgyal khab kyis byed thabs 256

spyad de zhing ba'i lag rtsal mi sna gso sbyong byed dgos/ zhing las lag rtsal mi snar dpyad zhib byas te cha rkyen longs tshe 'brel yod gtan khel ltar 'os 'tsham gyi lag rtsal thob thang ster chog par ma zad/ da dung 'dzin yig ster dgos/ sde dmangs u yon lhan khang dang sde ba'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyis nges par du sde ba'i zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel zhabs phyi'i rtsa 'dzugs dang zhing ba'i lag rtsal mi snas bya ba sgrub par skul khrid dang rogs ram byed dgos/don tshan bcu bzhi ba/ zhing ra dang / nags ra/ phyugs ra/ nya gso ra ba/ gzhan rang ra ba'i zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel bya ba legs sgrub byed dgos par ma zad/ da dung spyi tshogs la zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel bya 'gul spel dgos/don tshan bco lnga ba/ zhing las tshan zhib sde khag dang 'brel yod slob grwas nges par du zhing sde'i dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun 'phel rgyas kyi dgos mkho dang bstun te/ zhing las lag rtsal gsar spel dang khyab spel bya ba sgrub pa dang / sngon thon lag rtsal je mgyogs su btang ste zhing las thon skyed khrod rgyun spyod byed par khyab gdal du gtong dgos/ slob gso sde khag gis nges par du sde bar zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel dang 'brel ba yod pa'i las rigs lag rtsal slob gso dang zhing las lag rtsal gso sbyong byas te zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel mi sna dang zhing las ngal rtsol ba'i lag rtsal 257

byang tshad je mthor gtong dgos/ rgyal khab kyis zhing las thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs dang / khe don las sde khag gzhan pa'i spyi tshogs stobs shugs kyis zhing sder zhing las lag rtsal slob gso spel bar skul lcag gtong dgos/zhing las tshan zhib sde khag dang / 'brel yod slob grwa'i tshan col mi snas zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel bya ba sgrub par thob thang dpyad bsdur byed pa'i skabs su nges par du kho tshos zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel bya ba sgrub nas grub 'bras dngos bzhag pa der dpyad zhib kyi nang don gal chen du 'jog dgos/don tshan bcu drug pa/ rgyal khab kyis zhing sde khrod kyi mang tshogs rang bzhin gyi tshan rtsal rtsa 'dzugs spel bar skul lcag dang rgyab skyor byas te kho tsho'i zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel byed pa'i nus pa 'don spel byed dgos/le'u gsum pa/ zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel dang rgyun bkol byed thabs/don tshan bcu bdun pa/ zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel las gzhi gtan khel byed dgos/ gnad sa'i zhing las lag rtsal 'phel rgyas su gtong ba'i 'char gzhi'i khrod 'jog rgyu dang / zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel srid 'dzin sde khag dang tshan rig ldag rtsal srid 'dzin sde khag gis rang gi 'gan 'khri ltar phan tshun mnyam 'brel sgos rtsa 'dzugs byas te don 'khyol 258

byed dgos/don tshan bco brgyad pa/ zhing las tshan zhib sde khag dang 'brel yod slob grwas zhing las thon skyed khrod lag rtsal gnad don thag gcod byed dgos pa rnams zhib 'jug bya gzhir 'jog rgyu dang / tshan zhib grub 'bras zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel sgrig gzhir brgyud de khyab spol byed chog pa dang / zhing las tshan zhib sde khag dang slob grwa des thad kar zhing las ngal rtsol ba dang / zhing las thon skyed tshong gnyer rtsa 'dzugs byas te khyab spel byas chogadon tshan bcu dgu ba/ zhing las ngal rtsol bar khyab spel byas pa'i zhing las lag rtsal der/ nges par du khyab spel sa khul gyis tshod lta'i bden dpang brgyud de sngon thon rang bzhin dang bkol spyod rang bzhin yod dgos/ zhing las ngal rtsol pas khyab spel sa khul gyi sngon thon rang bzhin dang bkol spyod rang bzhin gyi zhing las lag rtsal la tshod lta'i bden dpang ma brgyud par/ zhing las lag rtsal bar gyong gud bzo bar nges par du dmangs don skyin tshab 'jal ba'i 'gan 'khri 'khur dgos pa dang /thad kar 'gan khur ba'i gtso gnyer mi sna dang gzhan pas thad kar 'gan khur mi snar las khungs dang yang na rim pa gong ma'i las khungs kyis srid 'dzin chad pa gcod dgos/don tshan nyi shu ba/ zhing las ngal rtsol bas rang gi 'dod mos rtsa 259

don gzhir bzung ste zhing las lag rtsal bkol spyod byed dgos/ rtsa 'dzugs dang mi sger gang yin rung zhing las ngal rtsol bar btsan shed kyis zhing las lag rtsal bkol spyod byed du 'jug mi dung / zhing las ngal rtsol bar btsan shed kyis zhing las lag rtsal bkol spyod byed du bcug tshe zhing las ngal rtsol bar bzos pa'i gyong gud la nges par du dmangs don skyin tshab 'gan 'khri 'khur dgos pa dang / thad kar 'gan khur ba'i gtso gnyer mi sna dang gzhan pa'i thad kar 'gan khur ba rnams la 'dug sa'i las khungs sam yang na rim pa gong ma'i las khungs kyis srid 'dzin chad pa gcod dgos/don tshan nyer gcig pa/ rdzong dang zhang zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel sgrig gzhis nges par du zhing las ngal rtsol bar zhing las tshan rig lag rtsal shes bya slob sbyong byed pa co 'dzugs byas te kho tsho'i zhing las lag rtsal rgyun bkol nus shugs je mthor gtong dgos/ zhing las ngal rtsol bas thon skyed khrod sngon thon gyi zhing las lag rtsal bkol spyod byed par/ 'brel yod sde khag dang las khungs kyis nges par du lag col gso sbyong dang / ma dngul/ dngos rdzas/ phyir tshong sogs kyi thad nas rgyab skyor byed dgos/rgyal khabakyis zhing las ngal rtsol ba zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel bya 'gul du zhugs par skul lcag dang rgyab skyor byed dgos/don tshan nyer gnyis pa/ rgyal khab zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel sgrig 260

gzhis zhing las ngal rtsol bar zhing las lag col khyab spel byed pa der don tshan 'di'i don chung gnyis par yang bskyar gtan 'bebs byas pa phan chad nas rin dod med pa'i zhabs phyi lag bstar byed dgos/ zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel sgrig gzhi dang zhing las tshan zhib sde khag 'brel yod slob grwa/ de min da dung tshan rtsal mi snas lag rtsal bshig gtong dang / lag rtsal zhabs phyi/ lag rtsal gtsang khur sogs kyi rnam pa spyad de zhing las lag col mkho sprod byed par rin dod yod pa'i zhabs phyi lag bstar byas chog khrims mthun yong sgor khrims lugs kyis srung skyong byed dgos/zhing las lag col bshig gtong dang / lag rtsal zhabs phyi/ lag rtsal gtsang khur byed par do bdag pa phyogs so sos nges par du gan rgya 'jog dgos/ rang sa'i khe dbang dang 'os 'gan gtan 'bebs byed dgos/rgyalakhab zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel sgrig gzhis zhing las lag tsol khyab spel byed par mkho ba'i gron dngul srid gzhung nor srid kyis bkod sgrig byed rgyu/ le'u bzhi ba/ zhing las lag rtsalakhyab spel gyi 'gan srung byed thabs/don tshan nyer gsum pa/ zhing las lag col khyab spel gtong ba rim bzhin mthor 'degs gtong dgos/ rim pa so so'i mi dmangs srid gzhung gis nor srid sngon rtses khrod zhing las lag col khyab spel gyi ma dngul 261

la 'gan len bed spyod byed dgos pa ma zad/ da dung ma dngul de lo re bzhin je mthor gtong dgos/rim pa so so'i mi dmangs srid gzhung gis nor srid gron dngul gtong ba la brten pa dang / zhing las gong spel thebs rtsa'i khrod bsdur tshad nges can yod pa'i ma dngul bton te zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel byed pa'i ched spyod ma dngul bsdu rub byed pa dang / de zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel gyi rnam grangs lag bstar byed pa'i phyogs su bkol dgos/las khungs gang dang gang yin rung zhing las lag tsol khyab spel gyi ma dngul bkag nyar dang sger spyod byas mi chogadon tshan nyer bzhi ba/ rim pa so so'i mi dmangs srid gzhung gis byed thabs spyad de zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel bya bar zhugs pa'i ched las tshan rtsal mi sna'i bya ba'i cha rkyen dang 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen thad la 'gan srung dang legs bcos byed pa dang / kho tsho'i thob thang je legs su gtong ba/rgyal khab kyi thag gcod ltar gla phogs kha gsab byed pa/ zhing las lag colakhyab spel sgrig gzhi dang ched las tshan col mi sna'i brtan 'jags la rgyun 'khyongs byed dgos/ zhang dang sde ba'i zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel bya bar zhugs pa'i ched las lag rtsal mi sna'i las ka'i go ming dpyad bsdur gtan 'bebs la dpyad zhib dang gzhan bya ba'i las don lag col chu tshad dang dngos 'bras gtso bor bzung nas khyab spel byed dgos/262

don tshan nyer lnga ba/ zhang dang sde ba'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs dang / gzhan gyis btsugs pa'i khe las kyi bzo bas zhing las kha gsab dang / zhing sde 'dzugs skrun gyi ma dngul khrod grangs nges can zhig bton te rang zhang dang rang sde ba'i zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel gyi phyogs su gtong dgos/don tshan nyer drug pa/ zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel sgrig gzhi dang zhing las tshan zhib las khungs/ 'brel yod slob grwa'i zhing sde dpal 'byor gong spel gyi dgos 'dod ltar lag rtsal khrid ston dang dngos dzas mkho sprod phan tshun zung 'brel bcas byas te rnam pa mang po'i bdag gnyer zhabs zhu dar spel du btang chog zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel sgrig gzhi dang /zhing las tshan zhib las khungs/ 'brel yod slob grwas btsugs pa'i zhing las kyi ched du srid zhu sgrub pa'i khe las/ rgyal khab kyis khral sdud dang /yid rton dngul bun bcas kyi phyogs su gzigs skyong gnang rgyu/don tshan nyer bdun pa/ zhing las lag col khyab spel du gtong ba'i srid 'dzin sde khag dang rdzong yan gyi zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel las khungs kyis 'char gzhi yod pa'i sgo nas zhing las lag col khyab spel mi snar lag rtsal gso sbyong byed du 'jug pa dang / rtsa 'dzugs byas te ched las zab sbyong byas nas rgyun chad med par rig gnas gsar sgyur dang / las don chu tshad mthor 'degs gtong dgos/263

don tshan nyer brgyad pa/ sa gnas rim pa so so'i mi dmangs srid gzhungagis byed thabs spyad nas zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel sgrig gzhi la nges par du thob pa'i tshod lta'i rten gzhi dang thon skyed rgyu chas 'gan srung byas te zhing las lag rtsal gyi tshod lta dang / dpe ston byed dgos/sa gnas rim pa so so'i mi dmangs srid gzhung gis zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel sgrig gzhi la zhing las lag col khyab spel bya bar nges par du tshang dgos pa'i cha rkyen 'gan srung byed dgos/ sa gnas rim pa so so'i mi dmangs srid gzhung gis zhing las lag rtsal khyab spel sgrig gzhi'i tshod lta'i rten gzhi dang / thon skyed rgyu chas/ de min gzhan rgyu nor btsan bzung mi byed par 'gan srung byed dgos/le'u lnga ba/ zur bkod/don tshan nyer dgu ba/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis khrims 'di gtan 'bebs byas te khrims srol lag bstar byed rgyu/zhing chen dang rang skyong khul/ thad skyong grong khyer gyi mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen rgyun las u yon lhan khang gis khrims 'di dang rang sa khul gyi gnas tshul dngos ltar gtan 'bebs byas nas lag bstar byed dgos/don tshan sum cu ba/ khrims 'di khyab bsgrags byas pa'i nyin nas bzung lag bstar byed dgos/264

gsum/ krung hwa mi dmangasaspyi mthun rgyal khab kyi lag rtsal gan rgya'i bca' khrims/(1987lo'i zla6pa'i tshes23nyin skabs drug pa'i rgyal yongs dmangs chen rgyun las u yon lhan tshogs thengs nyer gcig pa'i steng gros 'cham byung)le'u dang po/ spyi'i rtsa don/don tshan dang po/ tshan rig lag rtsal 'phel rgyas dad tshan rig lag rtsal gyis spyi tshogs ring lugs deng rabs can 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs dang / lag rtsal mkhan gyi khrims mthun khe dbang la 'gan len dang khrom ra'i sgrig srol la srung skyob byed ched/ khrims 'di gtan 'bebs byas pa yin/don tshan gnyis pa/ khrims 'di ni khrims mi bar dang / khrims mi dang spyi dmangs bar/ spyi dmangs phan tshun bar lag col gsar spel dang brje res/ blo 'dri/ zhabs 'degs sogs gan rgya 'jog dus bkol spyod byed dgos/ 'on kyang / gan rgya 'jog mkhan gyi phyogs gcig ni phyi rgyal gyi khe las dang co 'dzugs/ mi sger yin na bkol spyod byed mi rung /don tshan gsum pa/ lag rtsal gan rgya 'jog dus/ nges par du 265

khrims lugs dang khrims srol brtsi srung byed dgos/ de ltar byas na tshan col yar thon dang tshan rtsal grub 'bras bkol spyod dang khyab gdal yong bar phan thogs yod/don tshan bzhi ba/ lag rtsal gan rgya 'jog dus/ nges par du rang mos 'dra mnyam dang rang gzhan phan thogs/ gzhung drang yid rton gyi rtsa don rgyun 'khyongs byed dgos/don tshan lnga ba/ lag col gan rgya'i nang du rgyal khab kyi bde 'jags dang khe phan la 'brel ba yod pa'i nang don skor 'dus na/ rgyal khab kyis 'brel yod kyi gtan 'khel ltar thag gcod byed dgos/don tshan drug pa/ rang las khungs kyi 'gan khur dang len dang yang na rang las khungs kyi dngos po'i lag rtsal cha rkyen la brten nas lag rtsal gyi grub 'bras mngon 'gyur byed pa ni/ las gnas lag rtsal gyi grub 'bras la gtogs/ las gnas lag rtsal grub 'bras kyi bkol spyod dbang cha dang /brje res dbang cha de las khungs la gtogs pa dang / las khungs la las gnas lag rtsal grub 'bras kyi gan rgya 'jog pa'i dbang cha yod pa ma zad/bkolaspyod dang brje res byas pa las thob pa'i khe bzang gzhir bzung ste/lag rtsal grub 'bras mngon 'gyur byas pa'i mi la bya dga' gnang dgos/las gnas lag rtsal grub 'bras ma yin pa de'i bkol spyod dbang cha dang brje res dbang cha ni lag rtsal grub 'bras mngon 'gyur byed mkhan gyi 266

mi sger la dbang ba ma zad/ mi sger de la las gnas lag rtsal grub 'bras ma yin pa'i lag rtsal gan rgya 'jog pa'i dbang cha yod/las gnas lag col grub 'bras sam las gnas lag rtsal ma yin pa'i grub 'bras la thob thang len skabs/ rgyal khab kyi 'brel yod gtan 'khel ltar thag gcod byed dgos/lag col grub 'bras mngon 'gyur byas pa'i mi sger gyis 'brel yod kyi lag col grub 'bras yig cha'i steng / rang nyid kyi dbang cha'i skor gsal bor 'bri dgos/don tshan bdun pa/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi gtso gnyer sde khag dang zhing chen/ rang skyong khul/ thad gtogs grong khyer gyi mi dmangs srid gzhung gis rgyal khab kyi khe phan dang spyi tshogs spyi'i dgos mkho gzhir bzung ste/ rang nyid kyi bdag gnyer khyab khongs nang gi dmangs yongs la dbang ba'i lam lugs kyi las khungs kyi lag rtsal grub 'bras de/ gtan 'khel byas pa'i las khungs nang du bkol spyod dang khyab gdal gtong ba'i dbang cha yod/ bkol spyod byed pa'i las khungs kyis lag rtsal grub 'bras sba gsang byed dgos pa dang / phyogs gnyis gros 'cham byung ba ltar bkol spyod kyi rin gong ster dgos/ gal te phyogs gnyis gros 'cham ma byung tshe/thag gcod byed mkhan gyi las khungs kyis lugs mthun gyi bkol spyod rin gong gtan 'khel byed dgos/267

thun mong la dbang ba'i lam lugs kyi las khungs dang mi sger gyi lag col grub 'bras de/ rgyal khab kyi khe phan dang spyi tshogs spyi'i khe phan la don snying chen po yod pa ma zad khyab gdal du gtong ba'i dgos mkho yod na/rgyalasrid spyi khyab khang gi gtso gnyer sde khag gis rgyal srid spyi khyab khang la snyan zhu dang chog mchan bkod rjes/ gong gsal gyi gtan 'khel ltar thag gcod byed dgos/don tshan brgyad pa/ lag col gan rgya'i do dam sde khag de rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis gtan 'khel byed dgos/le'u gnyis pa/ lag rtsal gnargya 'jog stangs dang dzodang len/ gsar bcos/ rtsa med skor/don tshan dgu ba/ lag col gan rgya 'jog pa dang / dang len/gsar bcos/ rtsa med skor yig thog tu 'god dgos/don tshan bcu ba/ lag rtsal gan rgya ni de'i nang du zhugs mkhan gyi mi snas ming rtags bkod pa dang tham ga brgyab rjes mgo tshugs pa yin la/rgyal khab kyi gtan 'khel ltar 'brel yod sde khag gis chog mchan 'god dgos na/ chog mchan bkod pa'i dus de nas bzung mgo tshugs pa yin/don tshan bcu gcig pa/ gan rgya'i nang du zhugs mkhan gyis lag rtsal gan rgya la 'gan len byed pa'i mi gtan 'khel byas chog mi ang gsum pas 'gan len byed pa'i gan rgya de/ 'gan len mkhan dang 'gan 268

len bya yul gyi mis ming rtags bkod pa dang / tham ga brgyab rjes mgo tshugs pa yin/don tshan bcu gnyis pa/ lag rtsal gan rgya'i nang gi bar bcug ma dngul dang gla phogs de gan rgya'i nang zhugs mkhan gyis gtan 'khel byas chogadon tshan bcu gsum pa/ gan rgya'i nang zhugs mkhan gyis tshab byed mi snas re bcol ltar lag col gan rgya bzhag chog la/ re bcol mi snas tshab byed mi snar re bcol gyi yi ge mkho sprod byed dgos/ tshab byed mi snas re bcol mi sna'i dbang cha'i khyab khongs nang re bcol mi sna'i ming g.yar te gan rgya 'jog dgos/don tshan bcu bzhi ba/ lag rtsal gan rgya 'jog par zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i 'dum 'grig sde khag gis khrims 'di'i 'brel yod kyi gtan 'khel dang gzhung drang yid rton gyi rtsa don la brtsi srung byas te/ lugs mthun gyis 'dum 'grig rin skyin len chogadon tshan bco lnga ba/ lag col gan rgya'i nang don ni de'i nang du zhugs mkhan gyis gtan 'khel byas chog la/ spyir btang du gsham gsal gyi nang don dag 'dus/(gcig) las gzhi'i ming rtags/ (gnyis) las gzhi'i nang don dang khyab khongs/ re ba/269

(gsum) dang len byed dgos pa'i 'char gzhi dang myur tshad/dus yun/ sa gnas/ thabs shes/(bzhi) lag rtsal dang rgyu cha'i sba gsang /(lnga) nyen kha'i 'gan khur tshul/(drug) lag rtsal grub 'bras gang la gtogs tshul dang longs spyod/(bdun) zhib bsher gyi tshad gzhi dang thabs shes/(brgyad) bar bcug ma dngul dang gla phogs brtsi stangs/(dgu) rgyab 'gal gyi ma dngul dang gyong gud skyin sprod kyi ma dngul brtsi stangs/(bcu) rtsod gleng 'dum 'grig byed stangs/(bcu gcig) ming tshig dang gsal brda'i yi ge 'grel stangs/gan rgya dang len byed par 'brel ba yod pa'i lag rtsal gyi rgyu cha dang lung rigs/ lag rtsal gdeng 'jog snyan zhu/ las gzhi'i 'gan 'khri yi ge dang 'char bkod yi ge lag rtsal gyi tshad gzhi/ thog ma'i jus 'god dang bzo rtsal rgyu cha/ de min da dung shog ris dang re'u mig 'dra par sogs ni/ gan rgya'i nang zhugs mkhan gyis bton pa'i gros gzhi ltar gan rgya'i grub cha zhig tu brtsis chogadon tshan bcu drug pa/ lag rtsal gan rgya ni khrims ltar 'dzugs 270

dgos pa ma zad/ nges par du khrims lugs kyi tshod 'dzin nus pa'ang ldan dgos/ phyogs gnyis kyis gan rgya'i nang gtan 'khel byas pa'i 'os 'gan dang len byed pa las/ gang 'dod du gan rgya'i gsar bcos dang rtsa med du btang mi chogadon tshan bcu bdun pa/ gan rgya'i nang zhugs pa'i phyogs gang zhig yin rung lag rtsal gan rgya'i 'os 'gan dang len mi byed pa'am yang na dang len byas rung gan rgya'i cha rkyen dang ma mthun tshe/ phyogs gzhan par rgyab 'gal byed mkhan la 'os 'gan dang len byed pa'am kha gsab byed pa'i re ba 'don dbang yod pa ma zad/ gyong gud la skyin tshab len pa'i dbang cha'ang yod/ stophyogs gcig gis gan rgya'i nang gi gyong gud skyin sprod kyi 'os 'gan dang len ma byas tshe/ phyogs gzhan pas gan rgya'i gtan 'khel ltar skyin tshab blangs chogagan rgya'i nang zhugs mkhan gyi phyogs gang zhig yin rung gan rgya'i nang don dang rgyab 'gal byas tshe/ rgyab 'gal byed mkhan la grangs tshad nges can gyi skyin dngul 'jal dgos pa'i re ba bton chogagan rgya la rgyab 'gal byas rkyen rang nyid la gyong gud thebs pa'i phyogs des nges par du thabs shes spyad de pyong gud che ru 'gyur bar sngon 'gog byed dgos/ de ltar min tshe gyong gud la skyin tshab len par re ba 271

bton mi chogadon tshan bco brgyad pa/ gan rgya'i nang du zhugs mkhan tshang mas lag rtsal gan rgya la rgyab 'gal byas tshe/ phyogs gnyis kyis nges par du 'brel yod kyi 'gan 'khur dgos/ don tshan bcu dgu ba/ gal te rim pa gong ma'i rgyu rkyen las lag rtsal gan rgya'i 'os 'gan phyogs gcig gis dang len byed ma thub tshe/ nges par du gan rgya'i nang gi gtan 'khel ltar phyogs gzhan par skyin tshab 'jal ba'am kha gsab byed dgos la/ rim pa gong mas gnad don de la 'gan 'khur te thag gcod byed dgos/ don tshan nyi shu ba/ gan rgya'i nang du zhugs mkhan gyis gan rgya'i 'os 'gan dang len byed par bkag rkyen bzos te/ gan rgya dang len byed mi thub pa'i re ba bton na/ khas len byed mi dgos/don tshan nyer gcig pa/ gsham gsal gyi lag rtsal gan rgya la phan nus mi ldan/(gcig) khrims lugs dang khrims srol la rgyab 'gal byas te rgyal khab dang spyi tshogs kyi khe phan la gtor brlag thebs pa/(gnyis) khrims 'gal gyi sger sdom lag rtsal dang lag col yar thon la bkag 'gog bzo ba/(gsum) mi gzhan pa'i khrims mthun khe dbang la gnod skyel ba/272

(bzhi) mgo skor dang 'jigs skul la brten nas gan rgya 'jog pa/phan nus mi ldan pa'i gan rgya de 'go tshugs pa nas bzung khrims lugs kyi nus mthu mi ldan/ gan rgya'i nang don kha shas la phan nus mi ldan yang nang don gzhan pa las phan nus ldan na sngar bzhin bkol chogadon tshan nyer gnyis pa/ khrims lugs dang khrims srol dang 'gal ba'am yang na rgyal khab dang spyi tshogs kyi khe phan la gnod pa yod pa'i gan rgya bzhag ste/ khrims 'gal gyi bya 'gul spel na khrims ltar srid 'dzin dang nyes don gyi 'gan 'khur dgos/don tshan nyer gsum pa/ gan rgya'i nang du zhugs mkhan gyi phyogs gnyis gros mthun byung tshe/ lag rtsal gan rgya de gsar bcos dang rtsa med du btang chog sgyu'abrel yod kyi sde khag brgyud de chog mchan bkod pa'i gan rgya de gsar bcos dang co med du gtong na/ nges par du de sngon chog mchan bkod pa'i sde khag gis khas len thob dgos/don tshan nyer bzhi ba/ gsham gsal gyi gnas tshul dag las gcig byung ste/ lag col gan rgya dgos nges med pa'am dang len byed ma thub na/gan rgya'i nang du zhugs mkhan gyi phyogs gcig gis phyogs gzhan par gan rgya dor bar brda sbyor gtong dgos/273

(gcig) phyogs gzhan pas gan rgya la rgyab 'gal byas pa/(gnyis) bkag rkyen byung ba/(gsum) lag rtsal gan rgya'i nang don smru gzhan pas gsal bsgrags byas pa/don tshan nyer lnga ba/ lag rtsal gan rgya gsar bcos dang 'dor skabs/ gan rgya'i nang du zhugs mkhan gyi skyin tshab len pa'i dbang cha la shugs rkyen thebs mi chogadon tshan nyer drug pa/ lag col gan rgya la phan nus ldan pa'i dus tshod nang / gan rgya'i nang du zhugs mkhan gyi phyogs gnyis las gang rung zhig 'thad pa ma byung tshe/ 'os 'gan dang dbang cha kha shas sam yongs rdzogs phyogs gsum par bskor mi chogale'u gsum pa/ lag rtsal gsar spel gyi gan0/don tshan nyer bdun pa/ lag rtsal gsar spel gyi gan rgya ni de'i nang du zhugs pa'i mi'i bar lag rtsal gsar pa dang / thon rdzos gsar pa/bzo rtsal gsar pa/ rgyu cha gsar pa gsar spel byed dus bzhag pa'i gan rgya de la zer/lag col gsar spel gyi gan rgya'i nang du re bcol byas pa'i lag rtsal gsar spel gyi gan rgya dang mnyam 'brel byas pa'i lag rtsal gsar spel gyi gan rgya gnyis 'dus/274

don tshan nyer brgyad pa/ re bcol byas pa'i lag rtsal gsar spel gyi gan rgya ni de'i nang du zhugs pa'i phyogs gcig gis phyogs gzhan par zhib 'jug gsar spel byed par re bcol byed dus bzhag pa'i gan rgya de la zer/re bcol byed mkhan gyi 'os 'gan gtso bo ni/(gcig) gan rgya'i nang gi gtan 'khel ltar zhib 'jug gsar spel byed mkhan la 'gro dngul dang gla phogs sprod dgos/(gnyis) gan rgya'i nang gi gtan 'khel ltar lag rtsal rgyu cha dang /thog ma'i grangs gzhi mkho sprod byed dgos pa ma zad/ mnyam 'brel gyi bya ba dag yongs 'grub byed dgos/(gsum) dus bcad ltar zhib 'jug gsar spel gyi grub 'bras dang len byed dgos/zhib 'jug gsar spel byed mkhan gyi 'os 'gan gtso bo ni/(gcig) zhib 'jug gsar spel gyi 'char gzhi bzo ba dang lag bstar byed pa/(gnyis) zhib 'jug gsar spel gyi 'gro dngul lugs mthun gyis bkol spyod byed pa/(gsum) dus bcad ltar zhib 'jug gsar spel gyi bya ba yongs 'grub dang de'i grub 'bras mkho sprod byas te/ re bcol mkhan gyis zhib 'jug gsar spel gyi grub 'bras khong du chud par ram 'degs byed dgos/275

don tshan nyer dgu ba/ re bcol mkhan gyis gan rgya la rgyab 'gal byas te zhib 'jug gsar spel gyi bya ba mtshams bzhag pa dang dus 'gyangs byas tshe/ rgyab 'gal dngul skyin dang gyong gud dngul tshab sprod dgos/zhib 'jug gsar spel mkhan gyis gan rgya la rgyab 'gal byas te zhib 'jug gsar spel gyi bya ba mtshams bzhag pa dang dus 'gyangs byas tshe/ kha gsab kyi byed thabs spyad de gan rgya mu mthud du lag bstar byed pa las gzhan/ rgyal 'gal dngul skyin dang gyong gud dngul tshab sprod dgos/zhib 'jug gsar spel gyi bya ba la pham kha byung tshe/ nges par du zhib 'jug gsar spel gyi 'gro dngul dang gla phogs kha shas sam yongs rdzogs phyir sprod dgos pa ma zad/ rgyab 'gal dngul skyin dang gyong gud dngul skyin sprod dgos/don tshan sum cu ba/ lag rtsal gsar spel gyi gan rgya ni de'i nang du zhugs mkhan gyi phyogs gnyis mnyam 'brel byas te/ zhib 'jug gsar spel byed dus bzhag pa'i gan rgya de la zer/ phyogs gnyis kyi 'os 'gan gtso bo ni/ ri (gcig) gan rgya'i nang gi gtan 'khel ltar ma dngul gtong dgos/ de'i nang du lag col la'ang gtogs/ (gnyis) gan rgya'i nang du gtan 'khel byas pa'i las bgos ltar zhib 'jug gser spel gyi bya bar zhugs dgos/276

(gsum) phyogs gzhan gyis mnyam 'brel dang rgyab skyor byed dgos/don tshan so gcig pa/ mnyam 'brel gsar spel byed pa'i phyogs gnyis las/ gang dung zhig gis gan rgya la rgyab 'gal byas te zhib 'jug gsar spel gyi bya ba mtshams bzhag pa dang dus 'gyangs byas tshe/ rgyab 'gal dngul skyin dang gyong gud dngul tshab sprod dgos/don tshan so gnyis pa/ lag col gsar spel gyi gan rgya dang len byed dus mngon 'gyur byas pa'i lag rtsal gyi grub 'bras de gang la gtogs pa dang longs spyod byed pa'i rtsa don ni/(gcig) gsar spel re bcol byed skabs mngon 'gyur byas pa'i gsar gtod de gan rgya'i nang du gtan 'khel gzhan pa byas pa las gzhan/thob thang 'god pa'i dbang cha de zhib 'jug gsar spel byed mkhan la gtogs/ zhib 'jug gsar spel byed mkhan la thob thang yod tshe/ re bcol byed mkhan gyis skyin tshab med pa'i sgo nas de lag bstar byed dgos/zhib 'jug gsar spel byed mkhan gyis rang nyid kyi thob thang de gzhan la bskor dus/ re bcol byed mkhan la thob thang de thog mar thob pa'i dbang cha yod/(gnyis) mnyam 'brel gsar spel byed dus mngon 'gyur byas pa'igasar gtod de gan rgya'i nang du gtan 'khel gzhan pa byas pa las 277

gzhan/ thob thang 'god pa'i dbang cha de mnyam 'brel gsar spel byed mkhan thun mong la dbang / phyogs gcig gis thun mong la dbang ba'i thob thang de thog mar thob pa'i dbang cha yod/mnyam 'brel gsar spel byed mkhan nang gi phyogs gcig ma 'thad tshe/ phyogs gzhan so sor thob thang 'god pa'i dbang cha yod/(gsum) re bcol gsar spel dang mnyam 'brel gsar spel byed dus mngon 'gyur byas pa'i thob thang med pa'i lag rtsal grub 'bras kyi bed spyod dbang cha dang / gzhan la bskor ba'i dbang cha'am khe phan bgo 'grem byed pa'i thabs shes de/ gan rgya'i nang zhugs mkhan gyis gan rgya'i nang du gtan 'khel byas chog gal te gan rgya'i nang du gtan 'khel ma byas tshe/de'i nang zhugs mkhan gyi mi tshang mar bed spyod kyi dbang cha dang gzhan la bskor ba'i dbang cha yod/ 'on kyang / gsar spel re bcol byas pa'i zhib 'jug gsar spel byed mkhan gyis re bcol dang len byed mkhan la zhib 'jug gsar spel gyi grub 'bras ma sprad tshun du/ zhib 'jug gsar spel gyi grub 'bras de phyogs gsum par bskor mi chogadon tshan so gsum pa/ lag rtsal gsar spel gyi gan rgya dang len byed pa'i go rim nang du/ dag sel byed dka' ba'i lag rtsal gyi dka' khag byung ste zhib 'jug gsar spel la pham kha byung dus/ de'i nyen kha'i 'gan khur ni gan rgya'i nang zhugs mkhan gyis gtan 'khel byas chog278

gan rgya'i nang du gtan 'khel ma byas tshe de'i nyen kha ni gan rgya'i nang zhugs mkhan gyis lugs mthun sgos 'gan khur dgos/phyogs gcig gis zhib 'jug gsar spel la pham kha bzo ba'i nang don skor rnyed tshe/ nges par du dus ltar phyogs gzhan par byed thabs spyad de gyong gud je chung du gtong bar brda sbyor gtong dgos/ de ltar min tshe je cher sgyur ba'i gyong gud la 'gan khur dgos/le'u bzhi ba/ lag rtsal gzhan la bskor ba'i gan rgya/don tshan so bzhi ba/ lag col gzhan la bskor ba'i gan rgya ni de'i nang du zhugs mkhan gyis thob thang gi dbang cha dang thob thang la yar zhu byed pa'i dbang cha/ thob thang lag bstar byed chog pa'i dbang cha/ thob thang med pa'i lag col gzhan la bskor dus bzhag pa'i gan rgya de la zer/don tshan so lnga ba/ lag rtsal gzhan la bskor ba'i gan rgya'i nang du lag rtsal bskor mkhan dang tshur len mkhan gyis thob thang yod med kyi lag rtsal khyab khongs gtan 'khel byas chog 'on kyang / lag rtsal gyi 'gran rtsod dang 'phel rgyas la tshod 'dzin byed mi chogadon tshan so drug pa/ thob thang dbang cha gzhan la bskor ba dang thob thang yar zhu byed pa'i dbang cha gzhan la bskor ba'i gan rgya 'jog dus/nges par du 'brel yod thob thang khrims lugs kyi gtan 'khel dag la brtsi srung byed dgos/279

don tshan so bdun pa/ thob thang lag bstar chog pa'i gan rgya gzhan la bskor mkhan gyi 'os 'gan gtso bo ni/(gcig) thob thang tshur len byed mkhan gyis gan rgya'i nang gtan 'khel byas pa'i khyab khongs nang du thob thang lag bstar byed dgos/(gnyis) thob thang lag bstar byed pa'i 'brel yod kyi lag rtsal rgyu cha dang dgos nges kyi lag rtsal mdzub ston mkho sprod byed dgos/thob thang lag bstar chog pa'i gan rgya tshur len byed mkhan gyi 'os 'gan gtso bo ni/(gcig) gan rgya'i nang gtan 'khel byas pa'i khyab khongs nang du thob thang lag bstar byed pa las/ de las brgal ba'i phyogs gsum pas lag bstar byas mi chog (gnyis) gan rgya'i nang gi gtan 'khel ltar bkol spyod kyi rin gong sprod dgos/don tshan so brgyad pa/ lag rtsal gzhan la bskor ba'i gan rgya'i nang du thob thang gi skor 'dus na/ nges par du gsar gtod kyi ming rtags dang thob thang yar zhu byed mkhan/ thob thang dbang mkhan/ yar zhu'i dus tshod dang ang rtags/ thob thang gi ang rtags dang thob thang dbang cha'i phan nus kyi dus tshod sogs gsal bor 'bri dgos/thob thang lag bstar chog pa'i gan rgya ni thob thang gi dbang cha gtan 280

'khel byas pa'i dus tshod nang phan nus ldan pa yin/ phan nus ldan pa'i dus tshod mjug rdzogs pa'am thob thang gi dbang cha la phan nus med pa khyab bsgrags byas rjes/ thob thang dbang mkhan gyis mi gzhan par thob thang gi lag rtsal lag bstar chog pa'i gan rgya bzhag mi chogadon tshan so dgu ba/ thob thang med pa'i lag rtsal gzhan la bskor ba'i gan rgya'i nang gi lag rtsal bskor mkhan gyi 'os 'gan gtso bo ni/(gcig) gan rgya'i nang gi gtan 'khel ltar lag rtsal rgyu cha dang lag col mdzub ston mkho sprod byed dgos/(gnyis) lag col gyi dngos bkol rang bzhin dang yid rton rang bzhin 'gan len byed dgos/(gsum) gan rgya'i nang gi gtan 'khel ltar sba gsang gi 'os 'gan dang len byed dgos/thob thang med pa'i lag rtsal gzhan la bskor ba'i gan rgya'i nang gi lag rtsal tshur len mkhan gyi 'os 'gan gtso bo ni/(gcig) gan rgya'i nang gtan 'khel byas pa'i khyab khongs nang du lag rtsal bed spyod byed dgos/(gnyis) gan rgya'i nang gi gtan 'khel ltar bkol spyod rin pa sprod dgos/(gsum) gan rgya'i nang gi gtan 'khel ltar sba gsang gi 'os 281
