'gan dang len byed dgos/don tshan bzhi bcu ba/ gan rgya gzhan la bskor mkhan gyis gan rgya la rgyab 'gal byas tshe/ nges par du gsham skasal gyi 'gan dag 'khur dgos/(gcig) gan rgya'i gtan 'khel ltar lag rtsal gzhan la ma bskor na/ nges par du rgyab 'gal dngul skyin dang gyong gud dngul skyin sprod dgos/(gnyis) thob thang lag bstar dang thob thang med pa'i lag rtsal bed spyod byed dus gan rgya'i nang gtan 'khel byas pa'i khyab khongs dang brgal ba dang / yang na gan rgya'i nang gi gtan 'khel dang rgyab 'gal byas te gang 'dod kyis thob thang gi dbang dang bed spyod byed pa'i dbang cha phyogs gsum par sprad na/ nges par du rgyab 'gal gyi dngul skyin dang gyong gud dngul tshab sprod dgos/(gsum) gan rgya'i nang gtan 'khel byas pa'i sba gsang gi 'os 'gan dang 'gal na/ nges par du rgyab 'gal dngul skyin dang gyong gud dngul tshab sprod dgos/ don tshan zhe gcig pa/ thob thang dbang cha tshur len byed mkhan gyis gan rgya dang rgyab 'gal byas na/ nges par du gsham gsal gyi 'gan dag khur dgos/282

(gcig) gan rgya'i nang gi gtan 'khel ltar bkol spyod kyi rin pa ma sprad na/ nges par du bkol spyod rin pa kha gsab byed dgos pa ma zad rgyab 'gal gyi dngul skyin sprod dgos/ bkol spyod rin pa kha gsab mi byed pa'am rgyab 'gal gyi dngul skyin ma sprad na/ thob thang lag bstar dang thob thang med pa'i lag rtsal bkol spyod byed mtshams 'jog dgos pa dang /rgyab 'gal gyi dngul skyin dang gyong gud kyi dngul tshab sprod dgos/(gnyis) thob thang lag bstar dang thob thang med pa'i lag rtsal bkol spyod byed dus gan rgya'i gtan 'khel gyi khyab khongs dang 'gal ba dang / lag col bskor mkhan 'thad pa ma byung bar gang 'dod kyis thob thangagi dbang cha dang bkol spyod byed pa'i dbang cha de phyogs gsum par sprad na/ nges par du gan rgya mtshams 'jog dgos pa ma zad/ rgyab 'gal gyi dngul skyin dang gyong gud kyi dngul tshab sprod dgos/(gsum) gan rgya'i nang gtan 'khel byas pa'i sba gsang gi 'os 'gan dang 'gal na/ nges par du rgyab 'gal gyi dngul skyin dang gyong gud kyi dngul tshab sprod dgos/don tshan zhe gnyis pa/ thob thang dbang cha tshur len byed mkhan gyis gan rgya'i nang gi gtan 'khel ltar/ thob thang lag bstar dang thob thang med pa'i lag rtsal bkol spyod byas te/ mi gzhan pa'i khrims mthun gyi khe dbang la gtor brlag thebs na thob thang dbang cha bskor mkhan gyis 283

'gan 'khur dgos/don tshan zhe gsum pa/ gan rgya'i nang du zhugs mkhan gyis rang gzhanaganyis la phan pa'i rtsa don gzhir bzung ste/ lag rtsal bskor ba'i gan rgya'i nang du thob thang lag bstar dang thob thang med pa'i lag rtsal bkol spyod pa'i thabs shes gtan 'khel byed dgos/ gan rgya'i nang du gtan 'khel ma byas na phyogs gang zhig yin rung phyogs gzhan pa'i lag rtsal grub 'bras longs spyod byas mi chogale'u lnga ba/ lagartsal blo 'dri'i gnargya dang / lag rtsal zhabs zhu'i gnargu/don tshan zhe bzhi ba/ lag col blo 'dri'i gan rgya ni de'i nang du zhugs mkhan gyis phyogs gzhan pa'i nges gtan gyi lag rtsal las gzhir lag rtsal sngon dpag dang / lag rtsal brtag dpyod/ gdeng 'jog snyan zhu mkho sprod byed dus bzhag pa'i gan rgya de la zer/don tshan zhe lnga ba/ lag col blo 'dri'i gan rgya'i nang gi re bcol mkhan gyi 'os 'gan gtso bo ni/(gcig) blo 'dri'i gnad don gsal bor byas te/ gan rgya'i nang gi gtan 'khel ltar lag rtsal rgyu cha dang 'brel yod kyi grangs gzhi mkho sprod byed dgos/(gnyis) dus bcad ltar blo 'dri mkhan gyi bya ba'i grub 'bras skra4

ltar gla phogs sprod dgos/lag rtsal blo 'dri'i gan rgya'i nang gi blo 'dri mkhan gyi 'os 'gan gtso bo ni/(gcig) rang nyid kyi lag rtsal shes bya bkol spyod dang / gan rgya'i nang gi gtan 'khel ltar dus bcad ltar blo 'dri'i snyan zhu dang / re bcol mkhan gyi gnad don la lan 'debs dgos/(gnyis) blo 'dri'i snyan zhu dang gan rgya'i re ba gnyis gcig mthun yi na dgos/don tshan zhe drug pa/ lag col blo 'dri'i gan rgya'i nang gi re bcol phyogs kyis gan rgya'i gtan 'khel ltar dgos nges kyi grangs gzhi dang rgyu cha mkho sprod ma byas par bya ba'i myur tshad dang spus tshad la shugs rkyen bzos na/ sprad zin pa'i gla phogs phyir 'then byas mi chog la/ sprad med pa'i gla phogs de sngon grangs ltar sprod dgos/lag col blo 'dri'i gan rgya'i nang gi blo 'dri phyogs kyis dus bcad ltar blo 'dri'i snyan zhu 'don mi thub pa dang / yang na blo 'dri'i snyan zhu gan rgya'i gtan 'khel dang ma mthun tshe/ gla phogs nyung 'phri dang med par gtong dgos pa ma zad/ rgyab 'gal dngul skyin dang gyong gud dngul tshab sprod dgos/ —lag rtsal blo 'dri gan rgya'i nang gi re bcol phyogs kyis re bcol skra5

mkhan gyi blo 'dri snyan zhu dang bsam 'char la gyong gud bzos na/ nges par du re bcol phyogs kyis 'gan khur dgos/ 'on kyang / gan rgya'i nang du gtan 'khel byas pa gzhan pa mi 'du/don tshan zhe bdun pa/ lag rtsal zhabs zhu'i gan rgya ni de'i nang du zhugs mkhan gyi phyogs gcig gis/ lag rtsal shes bya bkol te phyogs gzhan pa'i nges gtan gyi lag col gnad don thag gcod byed dus bzhag pa'i gan rgya la zer/ de'i nang du 'dzugs skrun bzo bkod kyi brtag dpyod dang jus 'god/ sgrig bzo'i gan rgya dang las snon 'gan len gan rgya sogs mi 'dus/don tshan zhe brgyad pa/ lag rtsal zhabs zhu gan rgya'i nang gi re bcol phyogs kyi 'os 'gan gtso bo ni/(gcig) gan rgya'i nang gi gtan 'khel ltar zhabs zhu bya yul du bya ba'i cha rkyen mkho sprod byas te bya ba yongs 'grub yong bar rgyab skyor byed dgos/(gnyis) dus bcad ltar zhabs zhu mkhan gyi bya ba'i grub 'bras ltar gla phogs sprod dgos/lag rtsal zhabs zhu gan rgya'i nang gi zhabs zhu byed mkhan gyi 'os 'gan gtso bo ni/(gcig) dus bcad ltar gan rgya'i nang gi gtan 'khel ltar 286

zhabs zhu'i las gzhi bsgrub dgos shing / lag rtsal gnad don thag gcod byas te bya ba'i spus tshad la 'gan len byed dgos/(gnyis) lag col gnad don skor gyi shes bya brgyud sgrog byed dgos/don tshan zhe dgu ba/ lag rtsal zhabs zhu gan rgya'i nang gi re bcol phyogs kyis gan rgya dang rgyab 'gal byas te/ bya ba'i myur tshad dang spus tshad la shugs rkyen bzo ba dang / zhabs zhu byed mkhan gyi bya ba'i grub 'bras dang len mi byed pa'am dus 'gyangs byas tshe/ nges par du sngon grangs ltar gla phogs sprod dgos/ rilag rtsal zhabs zhu gan rgya'i nang gi zhabs zhu mkhan gyis gan rgya'i nang gi gtan 'khel ltar zhabs zhu'i bya ba yongs 'grub ma byas na/ gla phogs sprod dgos pa ma zad nges par du rgyab 'gal dngul skyin dang gyong gud dngul tshab sprod dgos/don tshan lnga bcu ba/ lag rtsal blo 'dri'i gan rgya dang lag rtsal zhabs zhu'i gan rgya dang len byed pa'i go rim nang du/ blo 'dri mkhan dang zhabs zhu byed mkhan gyis re bcol phyogs kyis mkho sprod byas pa'i lag rtsal rgyu cha dang / bya ba'i cha rkyen bkol spyod byas te yongs 'grub byas pa'i lag col grub 'bras ni/ blo 'dri mkhan dang zhabs zhu mkhan la gtogs/ re bcol phyogs kyis blo 'dri mkhan dang zhabs zhu mkhan gyi bya ba'i grub 'bras 287

bed spyod byas te yongs 'grub byas pa'i lag col grub 'bras ni/ re bcol phyogs su gtogs/ 'on kyang gan rgya'i nang gtan 'khel gzhan pa byas yod pa mi 'du/le'u drug pa/ lag rtsal gan༅'i rtsod glenganang gi bar 'dum dang gtug bsher/don tshan nga gcig pa/ lag rtsal gan rgya la rtsod gleng byung dus/de'i nang du zhugs mkhan gyis gros mol dang bar 'dum brgyud de thag gcod byed dgos/ gal te gros mol dang bar 'dum byed mi 'dod pa'am thag gcod byed ma thub tshe/ gan rgya'i nang gi bar sprudum skor gyi gtan 'khel dang bya ba byung rjes bris pa'i bar 'dum gyi gtan 'khel ltar/ rgyal khab kyis gtan 'khel byas pa'i bar 'dum sde khag tu bar 'dum byed par snyan zhu byed dgos/gan rgya'i nang du zhugs mkhan gyi phyogs gcig gis dus bcad ltar bar 'dum sde khag gi gtan 'khel skor dang len ma byas na/ phyogs gzhan pas mi dmangs khrims khang du yar zhu byas te btsan gyis lag bstar byed du bcug chogadon tshan nga gnyis pa/ lag rtsal gan rgya'i rtsod gleng nang gi gtug bsher dus yun dang bar 'dum snyan zhu'i dus yun ni lo gcig yin la/de'i nang du zhugs mkhan gyis rang nyid kyi khrims mthun khe dbang la gnod 288

skyon thebs pa shes pa nas bzung brtsi dgos/le'u bdun pa/ kha gsab/don tshan nga gsum pa/ khrims 'di nyid lag bstar byas rjes lag rtsal gan rgya 'jog skabs/ dpal 'byor skor gyi gan rgya'i khrims bkol mi chogadon tshan nga bzhi ba/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi tshan rtsal gtso gnyer sde khag gis khrims 'di nyid gzhir bzung4ste lag bstar gyi gtan srol gtan 'khel byas chog pa dang / rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis chog mchan bkod rjes lag bstar byas chogadon tshan nga lnga ba/ khrims 'di1987lo'i zla11pa'i tshes1nyin nas bzung lag bstar byas/ 289

rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ bkra rgyal/deb gzhi'i bzo 'god pa/ bkra shis/dpar srun 'gan len pa/ yi'u chi'u hwa/rma lho'i tshan rtsal klog deb/rma lho khul tshan rtsal cus bsgrigs bsgyur byas/daX slun/ri mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang /(zi ling grong phyo thun rin lam sgo rna10)'grams spal/ sprag ang /810001 kha par/6143426babyud 'tshong / zhin hwa dpe khang /par 'debs/ zi ling mi rigs par khang /deb tshad/ 850kṣekṣe྾116877 1phro32dpar shog 9 25yib/ sprusprorngapab / khri18gsab zhog 8par thengs/ 2007lo'i zla12par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/dpar thengs/ 2007lo'i zla12par dpar thengs dang po dpar/dpar grangs/ 1—4 000dpe rtags/ 1byaskusmo 978—7—5420—1292—0rin gong / sgor19 00par dbang 'di gar yod bas par bshus brgyab na khrims chad phog(shog ngos chad nor slog skyon gang rung yod tshe par khang la dri gtug bya)
